note: Gushimisha (442) na Agakiza (110) biva mu ndirimbo-zikundwa (public-domain collections); Guhimbaza Imana (500) iva kuri rejnac/cis-hymnals. Biba mu gitondo (Gushimisha #286 / Guhimbaza #74) ifite altVersion.

praise.title: Ur’Uwer’Uwera
stanzas: Ur’Uwer’Uwera, Mwami Mana yacu, kare mu gitondo tukuririmbire: Ur’Umunyambarag’ ur’Umunyebambe; Ur’Ubutat’uri n’Iman’Imwe.
Ur’Uwer’Uwera; dor’Abera bose, baguhimbazanya n’Abamalayika, tukuramye, Mwami, Wahozeho kera, kand’Uriho, kand’Uzahoraho.
Ur’Uwer’Uwera, kand’Ubwiza bwawe, burut’uko bwarebwa n’abacumuye. Niwowe Wenyine Wer’Urusha bose, Ubuntu no gutungana kose.
Ur’Uwer’Uwera, Mwami Mana yacu, Ibyaremwe byose biragusingiza: Ur’Umunyambarag’ ur’Umunyebambe: Ingoma yawe ntizahanguka.

praise.title: Dushim’Iman’ Ihoraho
stanzas: Dushim’Iman’Ihoraho kukw’ Ari yo Yaturemye; Yatugiriy’ Imbabazi, tuyishime, Haleluya.
Iman’Ijy’Itugabira Ibyiza bidukwiriye: Abayo bayiringiye duhora tuyisingiza.
Yemwe Ngabo z’Uwiteka, namwe Bamarayika be, muhora mu Rurembo rwe, mumuhimbazanye natwe.
Dushim’Imana y’Ubuntu, tuyishime twebwe twese: Dushime Data wa twese n’Umwana n’Umwuka Wera.

praise.title: Mwa bari mw’isi yose mwe
stanzas: Mwa bari mw’isi yose mwe, nimuhimbaz’ Uwiteka. Muhore mumukorera, kukw’ibyo bidukwiriye.
Mumenye yuk’Uwiteka Ari We Watwiremeye; Turi n’Intama Aragira, tur’izo mu Mukumbi We.
Mwinjire mu Marembo ye, mugere no mu Rugo rwe, muhore mumusingiza, muhimbaze n’Izina rye.
Umwam’Imana ni Mwiza; Imbabazi n’Ubuntu bye Iteka bizahoraho; Mwese mushim’Izina rye.

praise.title: Dushime cyan’Izina ryawe
praise.chorus: Umwami wacu Yesu Usumba byose.
stanzas: Dushime cyan’Izina ryawe, Yesu Mukiza wacu, tukwimik’ Utwitegekere.
Mwa bishwe bamubahora mwe, mwishimire mw’Ijuru; muhimbaz’ Uwadupfiriye.
Namwe rubyaro rw’Adamu mwe, bacunguwe na Yesu, muhimbaza mwese Dawidi.
Abakuwehw’ibyaha twese, twahaw’ ubwo Buntu bwe, nimuze tumupfukamire Umukunzi w’abantu.
Mwa bava mu mahanga mwese, nimwumvir’ Umukiza, Ni We Mucunguzi w’abantu.
Twifuza cyane gusohora mw’Ijur’aho Yes’Ari, ngo tumushim’Iteka ryose.

praise.title: Duhimbaz’Uwitek’Imana
stanzas: Duhimbaz’Uwitek’ Imana no kuyisenga. Kukw ari yo Yaremy’ibyo mu isi n’iby’Ijuru Yesu Mwami wez’imitima yacu ngo turirimbir’ Imana.
Duhimbaz’Uwitek’ Imana no kuyisenga kukw’ijy’ Itegeka neza mu bihugu Izaduh’ ibidukwiye byose, byose twizer’iri Jambo ryayo.
Duhimbaz’Uwitek’ Imana no kuyisenga Yaraturemye; ni yo Yaduhay’ Ubugingo; Iturinda mu byago byacu byose; ni y’Itugirir’ Ubuntu.
Duhimbaz’Uwitek’ Imana no kuyisenga. Ibihumeka byose bishim’ Izina ryayo; Tuyikunde kukw’ar’ Umucyo wacu;Tuyisab’ iminsi yose.

praise.title: Nagir’indim’igihumbi
stanzas: Nagir’indim’igihumbi, na bwo byananira gusingiz’ Umucunguzi ngo mbirangize neza.
Umfashe, Man’ Ihoraho nkwiz’ Icyubahiro cy’Izina ryiza rya Yesu namamaz’ Ishimwe rye.
N’Izina ridutinyura mu bwoba dufite; ruhumuriz’ ubabaye rikabyuts’ uwaguye.
N’ukuri, Yes’Ashobora, Gutsembahw’ ibyaha, akesh’amaso ye abacumuye bose.
Gipfamatwi, umva Yesu kiragi ririmba kimug’itere hejuru mpumyi tumbira Yesu.

praise.title: Dor’Abera bo mw’Ijuru barishimye
praise.chorus: Bat’Icyubahiro cyose kib’icya Yesu, Wadunz’ Akatwuhagiz’ Amaraso.
stanzas: Dor’Abera bo mw’Ijuru barishimye cyane, baririmbira Yes’iyi Ndirimbo nshya.
Abo bose bari bandujwe n’ibyaha kera, none bambay’ imyenda y’Abakijijwe bat’Icyubahiro.
Uwahoz’ar’ umugome Yes’Amuhindura umutambyi w’Umwami tumusingize tut’Icyubahiro.
Iyo Yes’Atadukunda tutarozw’ ibyaha tuba twihebye rwose twakozwa na non’Icyubahiro nde?
Turirimbire n’aband’ uko Yadukijije bibareherez ‘ahw’ari, baririmbe bati’Icyubahiro.

praise.title: Izina rya Yesu turaryubaha
stanzas: Izina rya Yesu- turaryubaha, twemer’ Umukiza-yukw’ Ar’Uwiteka ngo biter’Imana - Icyubahiro kuko Yes’Ari We-Jambo ry’Imana.
Yesu ni We Jambo- ryaremy’iyi, si n’umunsi n’ijoro- n’izuba n’ukwezi n’inyamaswa na zo - n’ibiguruka n’umuntu mw’ishusho - y’Uwiteka Se.
Yaciye bugufi, - az’ino mw’isi, maz’ abanyabyaha - babi baramwica, nubw’afit’ Izina - ry’Icyubahiro, hanyum’ Arazuka Ajya mw’Ijuru.
Mwene Dat’Ushimwe - iryo Zina rye, wice bugufi - kukw’Ari We Mana. N’Umukiza wacu - yitw’Uwiteka. Kokw’ Izina Yiswe - rirahebuje.
None mu mutima - waw’Umwimike: rek’Anesh’ Atsembe - ibyo byaha byawe, Yahaw’Ubutware - ngw’Agutsindire wa Mubisha wawe - iy’ahingutse.
Kand’Umwami Yesu - Azagaruka, Azany’ Ubutware - n’Icyubahiro cye. Maz’iyi si yose - izamwimika; najye nzamubona - njyemusingize.

praise.title: Yes’Ashimwe turamushim’ Umukiza
stanzas: Yes’Ashimwe turamushim’ Umukiza hose bahimbaz’ Urukundo rwe. Mumushime Ngabo zo mw’Ijuru mwese muhimbaz’ Ubuntu n’Ubwiza bwe ukw’intama zirindwa n’umushumba ni ko Yes’Arind’abana be. Mumushime Ngabo mw’Ijuru mwese Mutanarir’urwo Rukundo rwe.

Yes’Ashimwe turamushim’ Umukiza kubw’ ibyaha byacu Yapfiriye yaje mw’isi ngw’atubohore Adukize Aduh’ Ubugingo budashira Yarabambw’ Abyemejwe n’Urukundo, abagome baramuhemukira Yambikwa n’ikamba ry’amahwa mu mutwe byos’Abyemezwa n’Urukundo rwe

Yes’Ashimwe turamushim’Umukiza Yarazutse Yicara mw’Ijuru non’Ashimwe n’abari mw’Ijuru rirerire none twese ntitugitiny’ urupfu nyagasani Wararunesheje ahubwo rwahinduw’ irembo ry’Ijuru no kuzaka kwawe Mucunguzi.

praise.title: Nshim’Umwami wo mw’Ijuru
stanzas: Nshim’Umwami wo mw’Ijuru ntang’ibyo mushimisha nari mboshyw’ Arambohora nari ndway’ Arankiza. Tumushimire tumushimire (X3) Ni We Mwam’Uhoraho.
Basogokuru kera bari mu mubabaro abagirir’ imbabazi tumuhimbariz’ibyo na none tumwizigire (X3) kukw’ ar’uko Yahoze.
Ni Data wa twese Mwiza az’intege nke zacu nukw’ Aradukuyakuya ngw’ Aturinde Satani. Duhimbaze Imbabazi (X3) ze zitarangir’iteka.
Yewe Bamarayika beza nimushim’ Uwiteka namwe bera bo mw’Ijuru bavuye mw’isi yose mwese mushimane natwe (X3) Nyirigir’Uhoraho.

praise.title: Mpimbariz’Iman’ ibyo Yankoreye
praise.chorus: Nsingize, nsingize Yesu Wamfiriye! Nsingize, nsingize uwo Mwami wanjye! Namwe ngo nimuz’ Abageze kwa Se; Mumwitabe mwese, mumusingize!
stanzas: Mpimbariz’Iman’ ibyo Yankoreye: Yatanz’ Umwana wayo w’ikinege, Amfir’ab’ icyiru cy’ibyaha byanjye; Nukw’ Anshir’icyanzu ngo njye mw’Ijuru.
Yamberey’Inshungu i Gologota, Angur’ Amaraso: sinkir’ uwanjye. Uwab’ umugome, akamwizera, Yakizw’ako kany’ akababarirwa.
Yakoz’Ibikomeye! Twishimane! Twishimir’ Ubuntu n’Imbabazi ze. Nyamar’ ubw’Azaza tumwirebera, nta wavug’ uburyo tuzamushima.

praise.title: Tunezerewe k’Umukiza Yaje
praise.chorus: Turirimbir’Umukiza ko Yadupfiriye! Haleluya, tunezerwe kuko Yazutse!
stanzas: Tunezerewe k’Umukiza yaje. Yadupfiriye twese, maz’Arazuka.
Tunezerewe kw’ar’ Umucyo w’isi; Ni We weyuy’ umwijima twahozemo.
Tunezerewe kw’Amaraso Yeza; Yaduhay’ Agakiza; turacunguwe.
Tunezerewe ko twarihiriwe, ubw’Uwera Yapfirag’ abanyabyaha.
Tunezerewe k’Umukiz’ Ariho; Ni We Mwana w’Intama Watsinz’ Urupfu.
Tunezerewe kw’Ari mw’Ijur’ubu; N’Umuvugire wacu ku Mana yera.
Tunezerewe k’Umukiza wacu, Azaz’ Atujyan’ atugeze mw ijuru.

praise.title: Uwambitswe ker’ikamba
stanzas: Uwambitswe ker’ ikamba ritatse mu mahwa, none Yambitsw’ iry’Ubwami kuko Yanesheje.
None Yicaye mw’Ijuru, Ategeka byose, ari We Mwami w’abami n’Umucy’udashira.
Ni We munezero wacu, n’uw’abo mw’Ijuru: Yatwerets’ Urukundo rwe, Ubwo Yabambwaga.
Yes’Umusaraba wawe, Nubw’ ar’uw’isoni, uvamw’ Ubuntu kubwacu n’ibyishimo byinshi.
Tubabarana na Yesu, tukir’aha mw’isi. Maze, ni tujya mw’Ijuru, Tuzimana na We.
Mukiza, ku Musaraba, Waradupfiriye: twabishwe n’ibicumuro, tubeshwaho na wo.

praise.title: Mana turaguhimbaza
stanzas: Mana, turaguhimbaza; Twemeye yuk’ur’ Umwami; Haleluya! Haleluya! Data wa twes’Udashira, Isi yos’irakwambaza: Haleluya! (x5)
Ni Wowe Wera dedede, Mwami w’iyi si n’ijuru: Haleluya! Haleluya! Dor’Icyubahiro cyawe cyamamaye mw’isi yose: Haleluya! (x5)
Kand’Abahanuzi bawe, n’Intumwa nziza za Yesu: Haleluya! Haleluya! Baguhimbazanya, Mana, n’abishwe babamuhora: Haleluya! (x5)
N’Itorero na ryo n’uko, ry’Abera bo mw’isi yose: Haleluya! Haleluya! Rikunda kugushimana na za Ngabo zo mw’Ijuru: Haleluya! (x5)
Data wa twese n’Umwana, n’Umwuka Wer’Iman’ Imwe, Haleluya! Haleluya! Iman’imwe mu Butatu ishimirw’ icyubahiro: Haleluya! (x5)

praise.title: Nimushim’Izina ryiza
praise.chorus: Urukundo rw’Uwiteka ruratemba nk’uruzi, kand’Ubuntu bwe n’ibambe ntabwo bizashir’iteka ryose.
stanzas: Nimushim’Izina ryiza ry’Uwiteka Rurema; N’Icyubahiro cye cyinshi nimucyamamaze hose hose! Nimuvug’ Urukundo rwe, bose barwumve, abo ku mpera y’isi bamenye kw’Akiza.
Nimushim’Umwami Yesu: Ni We Mwana w’Intama Wapfiriy’ abanyabyaha, hanyum’ Agahambwa mu gituro! Maze, ku wa gatatu, Yaneshej’ Urupfu, Arazuk’ Arazamuka, Yima mw’Ijuru.
Kand’umuns’ uzaza vuba, Yes’Agaruke mw’isi kwim’ Ingoma Ye n’Ubwami mu Cyubahiro n’Ubwiza bwinshi, Isi n’Ijuru byombi binezerwe hamwe, n’inyamaswa n’inyoni n’ibyaremwe byose.
Icyo gihe cy’Ibirori, tuzarimba twishimye, twiteguye nk’umugeni, uko arimba yitegur’ umukwe; Kukw’ Umwam’ Azamanuka ngw’az’ Adusange, Tub’imbata ze zera zinezerw’iteka.

praise.title: Aba Yesu bishimira
stanzas: Aba Yesu bishimira Izina rye ryiza, ribamara umubabaro rikabatinyura.
Umutima ukomeretse niryo Riwukiza, ushonje rirawuhaza Riruhur’ urushye.
Niryo Ngabo yanjye nziza Ihor’Inkingira, N’Urutare nubakaho n’Inzu yanjy’itagwa.
Ur’Umutambyi nemera n’Umwam’ Untegeka, n’Umwungeri ujy’Andagira n’Inshuti nizera.
Ni Wowe Bugingo bwanjye, kandi kuri Wowe, ni ho nsiganirwa, Yesu kand’uri n’Inzira
Nuko ndasaba Wemere Ishimwe ngushima, nubwo ntabasha kuvuga Ibigukwiriye.
Yes’ubwo nzakwirebera uk’uri Mw’Ijuru, nibwo nzajya ngusingiza uko bikwiriye.
Na non’uko mbishoboye nzajya nguhimbaza, no mw’ipfa ryanjye iryo Zina rizampumuriza.

praise.title: Nshim’Umuremy’ Uhoraho
stanzas: Nshim’Umuremy’ Uhoraho Wahanits’ ijuru, inyanj’ akazidendeza; Yiremeye byose. Yashyizeho n’izuba rye kumurika ku munsi, n’ukwezi n’inyenyeri bye byo kwaka n’ijoro.
Mushime ko Yategetse imyaka ngw’imere; Yaremeshej’ Ijambo rye ibizima byose. Nitegerez’ ibyiza bye ku mpande zos’iteka, hasi no hasi no hejuru; Ntabwo bihinyuka.
Mw’isi nta kintu kiriho kiterekan’ibye. Ni We Wenyin’ utegeka izuba n’imvura. Imana ni y’Ibeshaho twe n’inyamaswa zose. Nta hantu twayihungira, nta na hw’itagera.

praise.title: Umwungeri wacu ni We Yesu
stanzas: Umwungeri wacu ni We Yesu; Ajy’Arinda Intama ze. Aturagira mu bwatsi bwiza; Ni W’utubumbatira. Yes’Umwami, Yes’Umwami, ni We Waducunguye:X2
Ni twe Ntama zawe, Mwami Yesu; Utuyubor’Inzira! Uturind’ibyago n’amakuba, Udukure mu byaha! Yes’Umwami, Yes’Umwami, Mutabazi, twumvire!X2
Yesu Yemeye kutwakir’ubu, nubwo dukiranirwa. Amaraso y’Aratwuhagira; Ni We Munyambabazi! Yes’Umwami, Yes’Umwami, twihute, tumwitabe.X2
Yes’ Utwemere tw’abagusanze, twihannye, tubabaye. Ur’Umwami kand’ur’ Umukiza; Tur’abawe kuv’ubu! Yes’Umwami, Yes’Umwami. Dor’abakwiragije!X2

praise.title: Mukiza Mwungeri Mwiza
praise.chorus: Mukiza turi abawe. Twebwe tur’abaw’iteka kand’ Uhimbazwe, Yesu.
stanzas: Mukiza. Mwungeri Mwiza, Dushorez’ Urukundo. Ikiganza cyawe cyiza kitugaburir’ubu. Uhimbazwe, Mucunguzi.
No kubw’Imbabazi zawe Utwuhagir’ ibyaha; No kubw’imbaraga zawe Wez’imitima yacu,
Turashaka kukumvira mu Mategeko yawe; Nuko kubw’ibyo, dushaka kubon’imyizerere.
Mukiza, Mwungeri Mwiza. Turagukurikira. Utugwiriz’ imbaraga kand’ujy’ Uturamira.

praise.title: Ijuru ryawe Mana riraguhimbaza
stanzas: Ijuru ryawe, Mana, riraguhimbaza: Ushimwa. n’ikirere n’ibirimo byose. Bishim’ ubudasiba ku manywa na n’ijoro Icyubahiro cyawe n’Ubwenge n’Ubuntu.
Izuba ryawe, Mana, Hamwe n’inyenyeri n’ukwezi na ko, byose biraguhimbaza. Bibwiriz’ amahanga Atarumv’ibya Yesu, Ubwiza bw’Umuremyi Wabiremye byose.
Ijambo ryawe ryera n’iry’ukuri rwose; Ni ryiza, kandi ni ryo riduhumuriza. Kand’Ubutunzi bwawe n’Ubwenge bwo mw’Ijuru, duhora tubihabwa Iyo tukumviye.
Nta n’umw’ubasha kubwe kwirinda ngw’atagwa. No kujy’akor’ ibyiza no kudacumura: Man’ujy’ Umfash’iteka. Ndeke kukwibagirwa no kugucumuraho bikakubabaza.
Ibyo Waremye byose byo mw’Ijuru n’isi bishim’ Izina ryawe; Nanjye ndisingize. Ndashaka kugutura, uyu mutima wanjye, n’uyu mubiri na wo; Bib’imbata zawe.

praise.title: Mbony’Umukiza Mwiza
praise.chorus: Anyirura mbabaye, ankiz’ amakuba; Amaganya yanjy’ajy’ Ayanyakira, Yaka nk’inyenyer’ iteka; n’uw’Igikundiro; Ni W’Urut’ inshuti zose zo mw’isi.
stanzas: Mbony’Umukiza Mwiza, ni Yesu Krisito, ni W’Urut’ inshuti zose zo mw’isi. Igikundiro cye cyinshi ni cyo cyanyemeje, kumusanga ngw’Anyuh’ agir’ankize! Anyirura mbabaye, ankiz’ amakuba; Amaganya yanjy’ajy’ Ayanyakira, Yaka nk’inyenyer’ iteka; n’uw’Igikundiro; Ni W’Urut’ inshuti zose zo mw’isi.

Intimba zanjye zose, Yarazikoreye; Uko ngeragejw’ Andinda wa Mubi. Ibyantwazag’ igitugu, Yarabimbatuye: N’igihome cyanjye, njya mwihishamo. Naterwa na Satani, ngahanwa n’inshuti, Yes’Azantabar’ Angeze mw’Ijuru! Yaka nk’inyenyer’ iteka; n’uw’ Igikundiro; Ni W’Urut’ inshuti zose zo mw’isi.

Ntazansiga nk’imfubyi, ntazampemukira. Mpora mbeshwaho no Kwizera gusa. Ubw’Angoteshej’ Ingabo, nta cyo ngitinya pe. Ajy’Antungisha Manu yo mw’Ijuru. Njya nkumbura n’umunsi nzagera mw’Ijuru. Nzanezerwa ni mureba mu Maso: Yaka nk’inyenyer’ iteka; n’uw’Igikundiro. Ni W’Urut’ inshuti zose zo mw’isi.

praise.title: Mwami turagushima
stanzas: Mwami, turagushima, Turaguhimbaza rwose: Mana, turagukuza hamwe n’abamarayika. Turagupfukamiye, Turakuramya, Mwami.
Kiz’abaw’Uwiteka. Ushimish’ impano zawe. Ukuz’ Ubwiza bwawe, Bub’ubwaw’ iteka ryose! N’Urukund’ Ubajyane mu Bwami bwo mw’Ijuru!
Hos’Amahoro yawe agwire mu bawe bose! None n’ibihe byose! Mw’isi no mu nyanja hose, Izina ry’Umukiza ripfukamirwe cyane!
Shimishwa, Mwuka wera! Shimishwa, Data wa twese! Shimishwa, Mwami Yesu, Murokozi wacu twese! Nukw’ imbabazi zawe Zibahw’ iteka ryose.

praise.title: Mwami Mwiza w’Ijuru
stanzas: Mwami Mwiza w’Ijuru, twese twaje kugushima, Uri Nyir’Imbaraga, Muremyi w’ibintu byose; Kand’ uduh’Amahoro, Udukiz’ imitima.
Watumy’ Umwami Yesu ngw’Atwigish’ ibyiza byawe; Twe gukomez’ ibyaha, kandi turek’ingeso mbi; Kuk’Utubabarira, Twese turagushima.

praise.title: Mana yo mw’Ijuru
stanzas: Mana yo mw’Ijuru, byos’Uri Nyira byo, kand’ubiduh’ ubudasiba. Utang’ Utimana; Ujy’udukenura, bituma tuguhimbaza.
Impan’ihebuje Yes’Atugabira n’Ubuntu bwe n’Amahoro ye. Yatubabariye, twaramugomeye: Mbes’ibyo s’igitangaza?
Mwami, ndakwinginze, Nubwo ntakwiriye, Nyigiza hafi, tugumane! Mpa kugukorera, ndusheho kwemera gukund’ibiri mw’Ijuru!

praise.title: Njya nshima nshima
stanzas: Njya nshima nshima nshima nshim’ Imana mu mutima, Mu mutima, mu mutima. Njya nshima nshima nshima nshim’ Imana mu mutima, Mu mutima wanjye.
Nta n’urubanza, nta rubanza nshiriweho rwose, Mu mutima, mu mutima. Nta n’urubanza, nta rubanza nshiriweho rwose, Mu mutima wanjye.

praise.title: Uwiteka n’Umunyambabazi
stanzas: Uwiteka n’Umunyambabazi; n’Umukunzi wac’Udahemuka; Nta Warondor’ Imbarag’Agira; Nta wager’Urukundo rwe rwinshi.
Ni We Tangiriro n’Imperuka. Aturindish’ Imbaraga nyinshi. Tumushimir’ ibyatubayeho; Tumuragize n’ibir’imbere.

praise.title: Mana Rurema, ndagushima
stanzas: Mana Rurema, ndagushima: Wabonetse muri Yesu. Dor’Urukundo rwawe rwinshi Wakunze twebw’ abangizi! Mana, watanz’ Umwana wawe ngw’Adukirish’ Amaraso ye.
Njye nguhimbaza, Mwami Yesu, kuko Wangiriy’ ibambe, kandi Unkurahw’ ibyaha byanjye. Muvunyi wanjye, ndagushima; Ndakwihaye, mb’uwawe rwose.
Wasiz’Ubwiza bwawe bwose War’ufit’ Ahw’Iman’Iri, Umber’Intama y’igitambo, Utwar’ibyaha by’abantu. Ngukundira, Mukiza wanjye ibyo Wanyishyuriye byose.
Urwo Rukundo rwawe rwinshi rujya runtangaza cyane, uko nagiriw’ubwo Buntu, Usumba byos’Akamfira! Reka ngukunde, Mwami Yesu; Iminsi yose ngushimishe.

praise.title: Mutabazi wacu Yesu
stanzas: Mutabazi wacu Yesu, twese tuguhimbaze; Ni Wowe Wadupfiriye, Yesu Mwana w’Intama.
Yes’Ashimwe. Yes’ Ashimwe Icyubahiro kibe icy’uwo Mwana w’Intama. Duhimbaz’ Izina rye.
Twar’imbohe za Satani, twari mu mubabaro; Yatuboheshej’ ingoyi, Yes’ Aratubohora.
Tuguh’imibiri yacu n’imitima n’ubwenge; Kand’ibyo dufite byose bib’ibyawe, Mukiza.
Tukwijejwe cyane cyane n’uk’Ushobora rwose kuturinda no kutwoza ibyo twagucumuye.

praise.title: Muganga wacu ni Yesu
praise.chorus: Indirimbo z’Imana ni zo zidushimisha: Turirimbane, tuti; Yesu, Yesu, Yesu!
stanzas: Muganga wacu ni Yesu: Ni We Mukiza wacu; Ni na w’ubyuts’abaguye; Umv’ijwi ry’Ugukunda!
Imyerid’urayirihiwe! Umv’ijwi ry’Umukiza. Azakugeza mw’Ijuru. ng’unezeranwe na We.
Izina ryiza rya Yesu ni ryo Rikuru rwose. Dushim’uwo Mucunguzi imyaka yacu yose.

praise.title: Uduhagarare hagati
stanzas: Uduhagarare hagati, Mukiza, iki gihe cyacu cyo guseng’Ucyeze.
Yesu tugisenga, Suk’Umwuka Wera mu mitima yacu, atubwir’ibyawe.
Kwinjira kwe kwera kutumar’ubwoba n’agahinda kose, tube mu Mahoro.
Tutabuzwa n’ibyo, Yes’Inzira yawe, tuzayikomeza. Dufit’intege nshya.
Kandi tukigenda, tuzategereza igihe cyo kuza kwawe turi maso.

praise.title: Ai Mukunzi wanjye We
stanzas: Ai Mukunzi wanjye We, Umpe kukwihishamo. iyo ntewe n’iby’isi n’ingabo za Satani, Mutabaz’ Umpish’ubwo, ba banzi be kumfata, Umber’ Ubuhungiro, Mu rupf’Uzanyakire.
Nta bundi buhungiro, Mwam’ Unyirokorere; We kunsiga, Krisito, Komez’ uiy’undengera. Ni Wow’Ump’ imbaraga, Nta wundi mfit’Umfasha; Mbundikiz’ Amababa, Uhor’ Undind’ibibi.
Ur’Umunyambabazi zitarangira, Yesu; Usindagiz’ urushye, n’urway’ uramukiza, Urera bihebuje, nta bwo ngutunganiye; Ndi mubi bikabije, Wow’Urakiranuka.
Yesu ni Wowe Soko y’amazi y’Ubugingo, reka nkunyweho cyane, Undudubiz’ imbere. Nuk’umutima wanjye Ujye wuzur’iteka, Amazi y’iyo Soko, abe mensh’adakama.

praise.title: Mutabaz’Ubuntu bwawe
stanzas: Mutabaz’Ubuntu bwawe ni jyew’ubukwiriye. Burakiz’ abandi cyane; None, nanjye bunzemo. Bunzemo, bunzemo. None, nanjye bunzemo.
Data Mwiza, Mana Yera, mpora ngucumuraho. Mfit’ibyaha byinshi cyane, Umbabarir’ Umpire. Bimveho! Bimveho! Umbabarir’ Umpire.
Ntumpiteho, Yesu wanjye; Nkwisunge, nkwiragize! Mfit’inzara, mfit’inyota, Ndakwinginz’ Undengere. Ndengera, ndengera ndakwinginz’ Undengere.
Mwuka Wer’ump’ umutima wizey’ Umucunguzi; Yes’Unyuhagir’ ibyaha, mu Maraso Wavuye. Mboneza, mboneza mu Maraso Wavuye.
Mwuka Wera, jye nd’impumyi; Ndakwinginz’ Umpumure. Ujy’Uhamy’ iby’Umukiza; Non’Umumpishurire. Nd’impumyi, nd’impumyi! Non’umumpishurire.
Urukundo rwawe, Yesu, ruva ku Musaraba, Urunyerek’ ub’Unkize; Noneh’ Unyiharire. Nkiz’ubu! nkiz’ubu! noneh’Unyiharire!

praise.title: Mwam’Utuvubir’ Imvura
praise.chorus: Utuvubir’Imvura, iy’Umugisha wawe hahoze hagw’urujojo: Duh’umuvumbi wawe.
stanzas: Mwam’Utuvubir’Imvura, nkuko Wasezeranye twumva twumye mu mitima: Uduhembuz’imvura.
Mwam’Utuvubir’Imvura: Yaduhembura rwose. Twumva mu matw’ irahinda: Uyidusohozeho!
Mwam’Utuvubir’Imvura, iducunshumukeho. Tuje guhabw’Umugisha Wadusezeranije.
Mwam’Utuvubir’Imvura, icyamp’ikagwa vuba, ubu tukiri ku mavi, tukigutakambira.

praise.title: Ndagushimiye Mukiza
praise.chorus: Mb’umugende gusa, Yesu, wuzuyemw’ imbaraga z’Agakiza kawe, Mwami, Kabone kuntembamo.
stanzas: Ndagushimiye, Mukiza, Urukundo Wankunze; Nuk’umpindur’ umugende w’amazi y’Ubugingo.
Mb’umugend’ ugez’amazi mu mitim’ isaraye, ibone kunyw’Agakiza k’Ubutumwa bw’ineza.
Mb’ikibindi cyawe, Yesu: Nuk’Unyoz’ Untunganye, maz’ Unyuzuz’ayo mazi, ni yo Mwuka w’Imana.
Mb’ umugabo wo guhamya Uburyo wankijije: Waranguze ngo mb’ uwawe, Nuk’unyuzure rwose.
Yesu, suk’ Umwuka Wera Mu mutima wanjy’ ubu, Kugira ngo ngez’ amazi Yawe mu basaraye!

praise.title: Ndusheho kukwegera Mukiza
stanzas: Ndusheho kukwegera, Mukiza, ne kukuba kure: Nkwishingikirizeho, Mukiza, Ungendeshe neza.
Nerekan’Icyubahiro cyawe mu byo nkora byose; Akanwa kanjye kajye kavuga ibyiz’Umbwiriza.
Umpindure nk’isoko y’ibyiza, itemb’idakama; He kugir’undi nkorer’iteka, Databuja Mwiza.
Kand’imigambi yanjye n’inama Ubyigandurire; Nyemeza k’ur’Umwami Wenyine Utegeka byose.
Ni Wowe mutsima w’Ubugingo n’amazi mazima; Iyo nishwe n’inzara n’inyota, ni Wow’ujy’ Umpaza.
Ni Wow’uhaza kwifuza kwiza, kose niyumvamo. Ni tujy’i wawe, nta cyo, Mukiza, tuzifuz’ukundi.

praise.title: Umpe kukwegera Mana yanjye
stanzas: Umpe kukwegera Mana yanjye naho twafatanya Umusaraba nagumya kwishima, nkajya ngusenga nti:Umpe kukwegera Mana yanjye.
Umpe kukwegera Mana yanjye Jy’Undenger’iteka ngumye nkwizere ntewe na Satani, Ujy’Undwanirira, Umpe kukwegera Mana yanjye.
Naho Natungurwa n’umwijima nkisegur’ibuye mbaye Jyenyine nzabe nka Yakobo ndot’ibyo mw’Ijuru nkomeze nkwegere Mana yanjye.
Wakinguy’Ijuru Mana yanjye urwego ruriho rutugezayo mugenzi komera, jy’usab’ itek’uti tujye tugumana Mana yanjye.

praise.title: Ntumpiteho Mukiza
praise.chorus: Yesu Mukiza Wanjye Wumv’uko nganya, ubwo Ugenderera abandi nanjye ntusige.
stanzas: Ntumpiteho Mukiza We Wumv’uko nganya, ubw’Ugenderera abandi nanjye ntusige.
Mpa kweger’Intebe yawe mpabw’ imbabazi, ngupfukamiye mbabaye mpa kukwizera.
Nta wundi nakwizigira ni Wowe nshaka, Mvur’ibikomere byanjye Umbabarire.
Ur’isoko y’Amahoro Nyir’Ubugingo, singir’undi niyambaza keretse Wowe.

praise.title: Tuguman’iteka
praise.chorus: Ku manywa na n’ijoro,—Ndagushak’iteka. Ndahiriwe, Mukiza:—Twigumanire.
stanzas: Tuguman’iteka,—Mukiz’Uhebuje. Ijwi ryawe ryiza—Rizan’Amahoro.
Ndagushak’iteka:—Jy’ungum’ iruhande. Nsind’amoshya yose,—Iyo turi kumwe.
Ndagushak’iteka,—Nturiz’amaganya. Ngwin’ubu, tubane,—Mbone gutungana.
Ndagushak’iteka,—Nyigish’iby’ ushaka kand’uce muri jye—Ingeso zose mbi.
Ndagushak’iteka,—Wa Mwami Wera We! Mb’uwaw’ Unyobore,—Nyir’imigisha We.

praise.title: Ai Mana Ndondor’ Umenye
stanzas: Ai Mana Ndondor’ Umenye ibyo nkora byose, Werekane uko ndi kose ntifata uko ntari.
Ndondorere uyu mutima ni Wowe Ushobora kugaragaza ibirimo mu bwihisho bwawo.
Umurik’ahatabona ah’umwijim’uba Ump’umutima ukangutse uzinukw’icyaha.
Kand’umeny’ibyo nibwira n’imigambi yanjye n’ibimbamo binyanduza bikangir’imbohe.
Mvugutira kand’unshure inkamba zimvemo umpindur’icyuma cyawe uhor’Ukoresha.
Maze nkwikubis’ imbere mpishurirwe rwose yukw’Imana ar’Urukundo rutagir’ingano.

praise.title: Ngwino mutima wanjye
stanzas: Ngwino, mutima wanjye, witab’Umwami wawe! Winjir’ umuhakweho, Kukw’Akund’ abaz’i We.
Kw’ar’Umwam’ Ukomeye, wamusaba bike, se? Ubushobozi n’ubwe, n’Ubuntu n’Imbabazi.
Mbanze nsab’imbabazi, kuko nakugomeye. Umutwaro w’ibyaha, Dor’ubury’ Undembeje!
Amaraso Wavuye, uri ku Musaraba, Yoz’abakiranirwa, nukw’anyoz’ amboneze.
Unduhure nonaha, ndakwihay’ Unturemo! Wanshunguj’ Amaraso, nukw’ Unyitegekere!
Mu Rugendo rw’iyi si, mb’Intumwa ya Krisito, ahw’ashak’ Antumeyo, nkuz’Izina rya Yesu!

praise.title: Ndakwizeye Yesu
stanzas: Ndakwizeye, Yesu, Mwana w’Intama ko Wamfiriye. None, ndakwinginze, Unyoz’umutima, non’ubu, mb’uwawe Unyakire!
Nyuzuz’imbabazi, Unyobor’ inzira, Umpembure! Ubwo Wankunz’utyo, Ukamfira, Yesu, Umvugutire, nanjye ngukunde!
Ni nterw’umwijima n’ibyago by’iyi si, Unyobore! Mmar’ umubabaro, Weyur’ umwijima, kandi ntundekere kure yawe!

praise.title: Nasezeranije guhora ngukurikira Yesu
stanzas: Nasezeranije guhora ngukurikira, Yesu; Iminsi yos’Umpore hafi, Mukiza wanjye Mwiza. Singitiny’ Intambara mbi zose. Wow’ Umpagarikiye, sinashobora kuzimira, ni mpora nkuyoboka.
Ndashaka yuko twibanira, ni ngeragezwa n’isi. numv’ amajwi yay’anyinginga iteka ngo nkuveho. Ababisha baranyegereye, bar’inyuma n’imbere. nyamara, nkwisunge, Krisito, Undind’ibicumuro.
Mukiz’Ijwi ryawe numvise rindutir’ayo yose: Unyongorere mu mutima ngo ntumvir’ayo moshya, hor’umbwiriz’ ibyo kuntinyura, kand’ uhor’Untegeka, Uvuge ngo nanjye nkumvire, Murengezi nizera.
Mukiza Wasezeranije abagukurikira yuk’Uzabageza mw’Ijuru, bahoraneyo nawe. Kandi nanjye nasezeranije guhora ngukorera; Umfashish’ Ubuntu n’ibambe, We Databuja Wera.
Kand’umpe kuger’ ikirenge mu cyawe, Muyobora. Imbaraga zawe zonyine, ni zo njya niringira. Ujy’Unyobor’iyo Nzira yawe, nkiriho mur’iyi si; Maz’ Uzanyakire mw’Ijuru, Mukunzi Wankijije.

praise.title: Mwami wanjye nshaka kuba uwakijijwe nawe
stanzas: Mwami wanjye, nshaka kuba uwakijijwe nawe: Nake kubwawe Wenyine kuk’ur’ Umucyo wanjye; Mu kwitonda kwanjye numve Urukundo rw’ukuri. No mu mwijima w’ijoro, nkwibuke, Mwami Yesu.
Mwami wanjye, nshaka kuba Urumuri kubwawe, ngo njye mmurikir’ ab’isi baheze mu mwijima. Nakire mu Nzira zabo, bakiri kure cyane. Mbageze ku Mwami Yesu, ngo na bo bamwizere.
Mwami wanjye nshaka kuba Uvug’Ijambo ryawe, namamaze, Databuja, yuko Watubambiwe: Abari mu rupfu rubi, mbabwir’ Ikibakiza, mpumuriz’ abababaye; Nyobore bos’i Bwami.

praise.title: Ngwino Mwami Yesu
stanzas: Ngwino, Mwami Yesu, ngwino, kuko tugukumbuye. Utuvane mu ntege nke, uturuhure vuba.
Yesu, byishimo by’abawe, Byiringiro by’ababi, amahanga yose yose, arakwifuza cyane.
Yesu ni ryo Zina wiswe: Waje kuturokora, Wavuts’ur’ akana gato, nyamar’ uri n’Umwami.
Kubw’Umwuka wawe Wera, Mwami Yes’Unyimemo! Nuk’Ungirir’ uk’ushaka, Uzangeze mw ijuru!

praise.title: Tubabarire
stanzas: Tubabarire:—Duh’ umugisha. Tumurikirwe—N’ubuntu bwawe, ngw’inzira yaw’ imenyekane mw ‘isi, abantu bameny’ Ubugingo bwawe.
Kand’amahanga—Agusingize. Nukw’anezerwe,—Kand’aririmbe. Ur’Umucamanza n’Umwami wabo; Uzacir’ab’isi—Imanza nziza.
Wategets’isi—Ngo yer’imyaka. Mana, ni Wowe—Uturengera. Imigish’uduha—Tuyamamaze, maz’iyi si yos’ikugandukire.

praise.title: Ndagushaka Mwami Yesu
praise.chorus:
Nta cyo nti... nya noneho.., nkore byo... s’untegeka... Njye nguku...rikira hose, nkumvira, nguhakwaho.
Nta cyo nti... nya noneho.., Nkore byo... s’untegeka... Njye nguku...rikira hose, nkumvira, nguhakwaho.
stanzas: Ndagushaka, Mwami Yesu ntabwo nakwishoboza. Ndifuza k’Umpora hafi, Ukajy’ Ump’imbaraga.
Ndagushaka, Mwami Yesu jye nd’umunyantege nke. Uzamber’ Umujyanama. Nta wundi mbitezeho.
Ndagushaka, Mwami Yesu, aho ndi mur’iyi si, mu muvumbi no ku zuba, mu bimbabaza byose.
Ndagushaka, Mwami Yesu, hos’uzajy’ Unyobora; Ngeze kuri wa Mugezi, Uzamfashe nywambuke.

praise.title: Unjy’imbere Man’ Isumba byose
stanzas: Unjy’imbere, Man’ Isumba byose, Jye nd’umunyantege nke. Mur’iyi si ko nd’umwimukira, ntagufite, nagera he? Unjy’imbere, Unjy’imbere, Mber’ Ingab’ Inkingira. Yes’Umber’ Ingab’ inkingira.
Mwam’ Undudubirizemw’ Isoko y’amazi y’Ubugingo. Unyoboz’ umuriro n’igicu mu nzir’injyana mw’Ijuru. Mber’impamba, mber’ impamba, ijy’intunga mu nzira, ijy’intunga ngana mw’Ijuru.
Ni ngera ku nkombe ya rwa Ruzi, Uzampe gutinyuka amazi maremare y’urupfu, nyambuke, ngere mw’Ijuru. Nzaririmba, nzaririmba Indirimbo z’Ishimwe, Indirimbo zigusingiza.

praise.title: Ube maso Mukristo
stanzas: Ube maso, Mukristo: Nturuhuke nonaha, amakub’ari hafi; Usabe!
Ababisha b’Imana bajya bakwubikira, baguciriy’ibico; Usabe!
Ujye Wambar’intwaro Yesu Yakwihereye. Ku manywa na n’ijoro, Wirinde!
Umv’abatsinze kera Iyo ntambar’ urwana; Baraguhugura, ngo: Usabe!
Umva n’Umwami wawe, Yesu Wagupfiriye, Ni We Watubwiy’ati; Ba maso!
Iryo Jamb’uryemere n’umutima wizeye, kugira ng’urikore; Usabe!

praise.title: Ni jye ni jye gusa nkwiriye gusabirwa
praise.chorus: Ni jye, ni jye gusa, nkwiriye gusabirwa. Ni jye, ni jye gusa, nkwirive gusabirwa.
stanzas: Si na data, si na mama, ni jye jyenyine, nkwiriye gusabirwa. Si na data, si na mama, ni jye jyenyine, nkwiriye gusabirwa.
Kandi si na mwene data, ni jye jyenyine, nkwiriye gusabirwa. Reka, si na mwene data.
S’abo mu muryango wacu, ni jye jyenyine, nkwiriye gusabirwa. S’abo muryango wacu....
Ndetse si n’inshuti zanjye, ni jye jyenyine, nkwiriye gusabirwa. Reka, si n’inshuti zanjye ....

praise.title: Ibihe nseng’Uwiteka
stanzas: Ibihe nseng’Uwiteka bintarura mu mpagarara, ngo nigir’aho Data ari, muganyir’ibyo nkennye byose mu bihe by’umubabaro, bimpumuriz’ umutima. Nsind’ubukana bw’Umwanzi, mubihe byiza byo Gusenga.
Ibihe nseng’Uwiteka binyemeza yukw’ asubiza. Ategerej’ abana be, ngo bamusang’ abakenure ndamwihereje rwos’ubu kuko yampamagay’ubwe. Niringiye bwa Buntu bwe: Nogez’ibihe byo Gusenga.
Guhora nseng’Uwiteka kujye kumar’ umubabaro, kugez’aho nzager’i We, mwirebere ngeze mw’Ijuru, niyambuy’ umubir’upfa, nambaye kudapf’iteka; Ubwo ni bwo nzasezera ku bihe byiza byo Gusenga.

praise.title: Muze mwenyine twihererane
stanzas: Muze mwenyine, twihererane, Munsang’ ahantu hatar’ abantu; Dor’imiruhw’ irabarembeje; Urusaku rurabaruhije.
Murek’ibyifuzwa n’ab’iyi si, mushak’ ibyahishw’ abanyabwenge; Jyewe na Data tubana namwe: Ntimuri mwenyine, turi kumwe.
Murajye mumbwir’ibyo mwibwira, ibyo muvuga n’ibyo mukora, mu miruho yanyu munaniwe; Bimenywa n’uz’imigambi yanyu.
Inzir’iraruhije mwitange, mutazananirwa mukigenda; Mury’ umutsim’ uter’ imbaraga, munywe no ku mazi y’Ubugingo.
Nuko, mukor’ imirimo yanyu; Nzajya mbafasha mu mibabaro; Uwitanga nzamugororera; Ndaza vub’ umusek’ utambitse.

praise.title: Muze musange Yes’Ubakunda
praise.chorus: Yes’ubw’Uzaza, tuzishima twese, tujye kuban’ akaramata nawe, dutandukanye n’isi n’ibyaha tubanye mw’Ijuru.
stanzas: Muze musange Yes’ Ubakunda, Mwese nimuze, mwe kuzuyaza. Yes’Arashaka yuko mukira, nuko, mumwitabe.
Mwese nimuze, mwitabe Yesu, Abaruhur’ Abah’amahoro. Nuko, mumuh’ imitima yanyu, Yos’Ayibarire.
Wibuke yukw’igihe gikuze: Nta n’umw’ umenya kw’atinda mw’isi, Umwami Yes’Ageze bugufi; Tebuk’umwakire!

praise.title: Utahe! Utahe! Ko wazerereye?
praise.chorus: Mwana wanjy’uzimiye, tyo ngwino, garuka! Ngwino, Ngarukira!
stanzas: Utahe! Utahe! Ko wazerereye? Mu gihugu cya kure, ibya S’ubyayirayo?
Utahe! Utahe! Nturarambirwa se? Izo ngurub’uzite! Ibyo zirya si byiza.
Utahe! Utahe! Ntuzi ko niriwe mpagaz’aha kwirembo, Mfit’ubwuzu kubwawe.

praise.title: Nimusang’Umwami Yesu
stanzas: Nimusang’Umwami Yesu: Arabaruhura; Nimubyumve, mw’abarushve, Yasezerany’atyo. Ni W’ugab’ umugisha: Ashobora byose. Ni W’ugab’ Ubugingo butazashira.
Nimusang’Umwami Yesu: Dor’Arabashaka; Nimubyumve, mw’abahabye, Yasezerany’atyo. Kand’ushavura wese, agahab’inzira, yumvire Yesu vuba. Az’amwakire.
Nimusang’Umwami Yesu: Atang’ imbaraga; Banyantege nke mubyumve, mumwisunge mwese. Satan’ arabarwanya, akajy’ abashuka. Yesu Yaramutsinze: Nimutinyuke!
Kand’usang’ Umwami Yesu ntazamukumira; Mwe gushidikanya rwose, mwumve munezerwe. Akund’ abanyabyaha Urukundo rwinshi. Arabahamagara ngo muz’ahwari.

praise.title: Yemwe mwes’abananiwe
praise.chorus: Mumwizere, mumwizere, mwizere Yesu, abarenger’ abakize ibyaha byanyu.
stanzas: Yemwe mwes’abananiwe n’abaremerewe, muyoboke Yesu Kristo; Arabarahura.
Yavushijw’amaraso ye ngo tuzasugire; Mumwemer’ Abuhagire, Aboze dedede.
Yesu ni W’Utuyobora mu Nzira y’Imana; Mubanguke, mumwizere, mumukurikire.
Nimuze muteranire mu Nzira ye nziza; Nuko muzamushimira iteka mw’Ijuru.

praise.title: Yes’Araduhamagara
stanzas: Yes’Araduhamagara kureka ibyaha byose: ahora atubwira iteka ngo tumukurikire.
Tumere nka ba barobyi, bumvis’ Amagambo ye; Bemeye gusig’ibyabo, ngo bamukurikire.
Atubuza kwifuz’ibyo mw’isi n’icyubahiro; Azaduh’ ibiduhaza, ni tumukurikira.
Nubwo twaba tunezerwa, cyangwa turi mu byago, Yes’Araduhamagara, ngo tumukurikire.
Yes’Araduhamagara; Nuko, tub’intore ze, tumukunde, tumusenge, tuzageze ku gupfa.

praise.title: Yes’Aragutegereza
stanzas: Yes’ Aragutegereza; n’Inshuti yawe. Araguhamagar’ati: Ngwino hano!
Ita ku Magambo meza Akubwir’ati: Nabambiwe kugira ngo ngucungure.
Mbes’Ubuntu bwanjye bwinshi ubwangir’iki? Ntiwanyemera, nkaguha Agakiza?
Mbese ntiwamaz’ imyaka myishi mu byaha, ur’imbata ya Satani, nturambiwe?
None, reka nkubohore, naw’unyizere, unkurikire wishimye, ub’uwanjye.
Yesu yahoz’Akubwira kensh’ibyo byiza; Dore, n’ub’Arakwinginga! Wamwang’ute?
We gutind’ahar’ ijwi rye ryahora vuba; Ubu n’igihe gikundwa, we gutinda.
Mwami Yesu, singitinda; Noneho ndaje. Ububata bwawe bwiza ni bwo nkunze.

praise.title: Yes’Araguhamagara
stanzas: Yes’Araguhamagara: Ngwino, murushywa! Ubu tugisab’Imana, ngwino, murushywa! Ubu n’igihe gikwiye ngwino, murushywa! Itaba Yes’uyu munsi! Ngwino, murushywa!
Ubwo wumv’ uremerewe, ngwino, murushywa! Yes’Akuruhure none: Ngwino, murushywa! Nta w’ajy’ashuka, mugenzi, ngwino, murushywa! Yes’Arakwakira none: Ngwino, murushywa!
Yes’Arakwinginze ng’uze: Ngwino, murushywa! Aguh’Umugisha mwinshi; Ngwino, murushywa! n’Umunyambabazi rwose: Ngwino, murushywa! Tukigusabir’ Imana. Ngwino, murushywa!

praise.title: Shobuj’Uguhamagara
praise.chorus: Mwitabe Mwitabe! Sanga Yesu nonaha.
stanzas: Shobuj’Uguhamagara munyabyah’ umwitabe, wumvir’ijwi rye ryinginga: N’Umucunguzi wawe.
N’iki gitum’umutera kukurindira cyane? Kera kose waramwanze none ngwino: ntutinde!
Banguk’aguh’uyu munsi ubwera n’imbabazi n’amahoro y’adashira n’Ubugingo n’Ubwami.
Agutegey’amaboko, Agukund’ akwifuza. Banguk’uve mu bugoryi: Ngwino, wikebaguza.
Aracyaguhamagara: Wihut’Atarahita. Wumvir’ijwi rye ryinginga, udasanga Yagiye!

praise.title: Nimuze mwa ndushyi mwe
stanzas: Nimuze, mwa ndushyi mwe mwese, muremerewe, murembye. Yes’Aje kubasanganira n’Ubuntu bwe n’Urukundo mwese, nimuze! Muze, mwese! Mumwitab’Arabifuza!
Nubw’ur’ umunyabyaha byinshi, humura ye! N’uw’ibambe! Iby’agushakaho nibike: n’ukwihan’ ukamwizera. Wa munyabyaha we wihebye, Arakogesh’Amaraso.
Umwana wera w’Uwiteka yubamiy’i Getsemane, baramubamb’ari tw’azira. Nukw’ati: Birarangiye! Utegerej’iki se, kandi? Ibyo ko biguhagije!
Dore, Yazamutse mw’Ijuru, Atsinz’Urupfu n’ibyaha! Aratuvugira kuri Se, Agaragaz’ Amaraso. Na S’Akareb’izo nkovu ze, nihanny’Akambabarira.
Nukw’abakijijwe na Yesu tuzamusanganirayo! Abo mw’isi n’abo mw’ijuru ni ko kuririmba, tuti: Turagushimye! Haleluya! Ur’Umukiza n’Umwami!

praise.title: We mutim’urira
stanzas: We, mutim’urira,—uze kwa Yesu; Amakuba yawe,—uyamubwire. Mubwire buhoro—ibikuriza; We kugir’ubwoba,—kandi wirira.
Bwira Yesu byose,—n’Inshuti yawe, ibikubabaza—n’ibigutera. Arakund’ Afasha—abashavuye; Wizer’Ijambo rye,—kandi wirira.
Abaremerewe—n’ibiruhanya, babwire kw’Imana—Yabaruhura. Ubahumurize,—ut’Umukiza Amar’agahinda:—None, mwirira!

praise.title: Umwuk’ukubwira
stanzas: Umwuk’ukubwira,—wumv’ ijwi ryawo, uve mu butindi.—reba ku Giti! Umwuk’ugushaka,—ntuwunanire! Ur’umunyabyaha:—sanga Krisito.
K’ur’umunyehirwe,—uratiny’iki? Akira kunesha:—waracunguwe. Ugutitiriza,—ntuwushavuze. Indirimbo zawe—zisange Yesu.
Mu mutima wawe—here dedede. Ber’Umwuka Wera—Urusengero. Umwuk’ukongeza—Kwizera kwawe, ugukomereze—gukund’Imana.

praise.title: Ntumwa za Yesu
stanzas: Ntumwa za Yesu, murangurure, mwamamaze mw’is’ubwo Butumwa bwe! Nimukwiz’ inkuru z’Umucunguzi: Ubikunz’amwitabe!
Haz’uwemeye! Haz’ uwemeye mubibwir’abato n’abakomeye. Yemera gutarur’ abazimiye: Ubikunz’amwitabe!
Ubikunze naze, ntakererwe. Yinjire mw’irembo twugururiwe. Yesu ni We Nzir’igeza mw’Ijuru:Ubikunz’amwitabe!
Ubikunze wese namwumvire: Ntabw’ Avuguruz’ Isezerano rye. Umusang’ agabany’ Ubugingo bwe: Ubikunz’amwitabe!

praise.title: Yemwe banyabyaha mwe
praise.chorus:
Muririmbe,.. .munezerewe... Yesu Yaki... r’abacumuye... Vug’iryo Ja... mbo, ryamamare... Yukw’ababi’ abakira.
Muririmbe,.. .munezerewe... Yesu Yaki... r’abacumuye... Vug’iryo Ja... mbo, ryamamare... Yukw’ababi’Abakira.
stanzas: Yemwe, banyabyaha mwe, mwitab’ Umucunguzi. Nubwo mwe mwazimiye, mwemer’abatarure!
Muz’abaruhur’ubu, muze, mumwiringiye. Arabakira, nubwo mwanduye bikabije.
Wa mutima wanjye we, nta rubanz’ ukiriho, kuko bya bicumuro byose Yabyishyizeho!
Yakir’abacumuye, nanjy’uko ndi nanduye! Noze mu Maraso ye: Azangeze mw’Ijuru.
Namwe, mwa bakonje mwe, nubwo mwamuvuyeho, none nimutebuke, Yes’Aracyabifuza.

praise.title: Muze ku Mwami w’Ubugingo
praise.chorus: Umukunz’akihan’ ibyaka ntabwo yanga kumwakira.
stanzas: Muze ku Mwami w’Ubugingo bangizi, musange Yesu. Ni We Wenyin’Uzabakira; Azabah’Umwuka wera.
Abamwizera mw’isi yose abatabaz’ imbaraga; Urukundo rwe rutangaza ruboneka hose hose.
Krisito, Mukiza mwiza, tungany’imitima yacu; Duhe gukiranuka rwose n’Amahoro no Kwizera.

praise.title: Musange Umwami ugira Ubuntu
stanzas: Musange Umwami ugira Ubuntu, abatakimwizigira. Ntiyanga kwakira abatindi; Ahabur’ abazimiye kandi yemeye kubapfira: Yabaviriy’ Amaraso. Nta kindi abasha gukirisha abanze kumvir’Imana.
Musang’Umwami ujy’ahembura nimuze, mwes’abaguye, batacyizigir’ Agakiza: Abategey’ amaboko! Yakirishij’ Ubuntu bwinshi wa munyabyahakaz’ arira; Na wa mwambuzi babambanywe ntiyamwisungiy’ ubusa.
Musang’ubasha kuruhura; Az’ibibarushya byose. Kubw’Urukundo rusaga, Ahez’ ibibashavuza. Cya gihe, muri Getsemani,Yariz’amarira menshi: Kubw’Ubuntu bwe buhoraho, Azahanagur’ayanyu.

praise.title: Ngwino ngukize mwangizi
stanzas: Ngwino, ngukize, mwangizi: Nabony’ishavu ryawe ryose; Nyamar’ushatse ko ngukiza, ukwiriye kunyumvira. Dor’uko mpagaze ku rugi; Ndi Shobuj’ Umucunguzi. Nkuzaniy’ imigisha myinshi: Mbese, ntiwankingurira?
Kera, narakuvukiye, ngucunguz’ Ubugingo bwanjye. Mbese, k’unangiw’ umutima, ubuz’uko wanshyiramo? Namaz’iminsi myinshi cyane ku rugi rwawe nkomanga. Mugenzi, ko bugiye kwira, mbese, ntiwankingurira?
Rya joro ridacy’iteka ni ryir’uzantabaza s’ute? Ntutind’unyitab’ uyu munsi, ngukikire, nkurengere! Igihe cyawe kirakuze; Ntuvug’uti: Nzaz’ubundi. N’uza ku rugi rwanjy’utinze, uzakomangir’ubusa,

Nubwo wumv’utanyitaho, Jye ndacyakwinginga ngukunze, nkurindire kugeza ryari? Ngwino, ndakwifuz’i wanjye; Dor’uko mpagaze ku rugi: Ndi Shobuj’ukwitayeho. Nkuzaniy’imigisha myinshi; Mbese, ntiwankingurira?

praise.title: Uhagaze Mukiza ku rugi rukinze
stanzas: Uhagaze, Mukiza ku rugi rukinze, utegereza yuko bagukingurira. Ariko, bene Data, n’iby’isoni nyinshi gukingiran’ Umwami Yes’Umucunguzi.
Akomanga ku rugi. Kandi dor’afite inkovu z’imbereri n’ikamba ry’amahwa. Mbeg’Urukundo rwinshi rw’utegerez’atyo! Nta kindi cyaha kibi nko kutamwakira!
Umwam’atwingingisha ijwi ryongorera, Ati: N’iki gituma mungirira mutyo? Mwami, tugiz’isoni z’uko guhemuka: Nonehw’injira, Mwami ntudusig’ukundi.

praise.title: Nta kindi gihesha gukiranuka
praise.chorus: Wogejwe na Yesu? Watunganijwe n’Amaraso? Har’ubwo Yakuhagij’ Amaraso? Mbes’imyambaro yaw’irera?
stanzas: Nta kindi gihesha gukiranuka mu b’isi no mu bo mw’Ijuru, keretse kwizera ko wogejwe de n’Amaraso ya Yesu masa.
Amaraso ya Yesu yogej’atyo abanduy’imitima yabo: Ntimukererw’ ahubwo mutebuke, Mwezw’ imitima yanyu neza.
Umukiz’ ubw’Azagaruk’ afite Icyubahiro cy’Ubwiza bwe, abatari bezwa bazinjir’i We mu birori by’Ubukwe bate?
Bazatinya guhinguk’ imbere ye, bazahinduk’ ubwoba busa. Nukw’iyambur’ iyo myambaro mibi Yes’Akwambik’iye y’Ubukwe.

praise.title: Nkuko Mose yamanits’ inzoka ku giti
stanzas: Nkuko Mose yamanits’ inzoka ku giti, abarembejwe bakayireba, bagakir’ uburibwe, bakaba bazima kubw’ imbabazi z’Uwiteka, ni ko na Yesu Yatumanikiwe ku Musaraba kera: Tumurebe, tumwiringire.
Mutim’ushavuye, reb’Uwagupfiriye; Reba Yesu Wakumanikiwe! Munyabyah’ umutumbir’ Aragukiz’ubu, umureb’ urakira rwose! Reba, wizere! Kubabarirwa kwawe kuv’i Gologota: Reba, reba ku Musaraba.

N’iki cyatumy’Umwana w’Iman’ababazwa? Umv’icyatumy’ Abambwa ku giti, kand’ icyatumye Yambikw’ ikamba ry’amahwa: Ni kubwawe n’ibyaha byawe! Reba, wizere! Dor’urupfu n’urwe, nahw’imyandu n’iyawe: Reba, reba ku Musaraba.
Naho warir’ukicuz’ ukanababara, ntibyarih’ ibicumuro byawe. Dor’impongan’ ikwiriy’ ibyaha wakoze n’Amaraso ya Yesu masa. Reba, wizere! Wizer’ Uwakubambiw’ Arakurokora: Reba, reba ku Musaraba.
Yagukirishije ya mibyimba Yagize; Ni na We gukiranuka kwawe. Yakubeshejeho, war’uwo kurimbuka: Wakir’ubwo Bugingo Aguha. Reba,wizere! Yes’ubw’ Atagipfa, tuzabanaho na We: Reba, reba ku Musaraba.

praise.title: Nimuze mwese kumv’ inkuru nziza
stanzas: Nimuze mwese kumv’ inkuru nziza z’Agakiza kabwirizwa none. Yesu Yabasanze: Arabashaka; Namwe muh’Umwami imitima.
Mwitinyishwa n’uko mufit’ibyaha, Ngw’azabang’ abater’umugongo; Ntabwo Yabigira: Yasezeranye kwakir’ uwihanny’ umwizera.
Ni W’ubwe wizanye gukiz’ abantu; Yavuye ku Witek’aza mw’isi. Ngo tubon’Ijuru, Yaradukunze; Yaratubambiwe; Yaravumwe!
Abwira bos’ati: Jye nd’Ubugingo, kand’unyizera wese ntazapfa. Nzamuha kubaho mu Bwami bwanjye; N’urupfu nzamuha kurunesha.

praise.title: Hagarara munyabyaha
praise.chorus: Ngwin’Iman’ijya Yakira munyabyaha wese. Ibuka, nta n’umwe yanze: Ngwin’Irakurokora.
stanzas: Hagarara, munyabyaha, kuk’uri mu mwijima; Urarindagira hose, ugiye kwiyahura.
Wajyaga wibwir’ibibi, ukagir’agahinda; Washatse gutsind’ibyaha, nyamar’urananirwa.
Washaka kuza mu mucyo ng’ubohorwe n’Imana? Wakwemera kuyikunda nkuko na y’Igukunda?
Teg’amatwi, munyabyaha: Araguhamagara. None wemere gukizwa; We kwihemukir’utyo!

praise.title: Twaheze mu mwijima mwinshi cyane
praise.chorus: Sang’uwo Mucy’ ukwakir’ubu! jye nzi yuko wamurikiye, nari nd’impumy’ arampumura. Usang’uwo Mucyo nawe!
stanzas: Twaheze mu mwijima mwinshi cyane; Umucyo w’isi ni Yesu! Ubwiza bwe bwaratumurikiye: Umucyo w’isi ni Yesu!
Nta mwijim’ ugir’uri kumwe na We: Umucyo w’isi ni Yesu! Tugendane na W’Atumurikire: Umucyo w’isi ni Yesu!
Mwa mpumyi zaheze mu mwijima mwe, Umucyo w’isi ni Yesu! Mwoge mu Maraso, muhumuk’ubu: Umucyo w’isi ni Yesu!
Har’indi s’itagomb’ izuba rwose, Umucyo waho ni Yesu! Umwana w’Intam’ Ahaber’izuba: Umucyo waho ni Yesu!

praise.title: Ngwino zan’ibyaha byawe
praise.chorus: Gira bwangu! Wizarira! Nturushy’ utindiganya na hato. Yiteguye kugukiza: Arakwinginze ng’uze.
stanzas: Ngwino zan’ibyaha byawe kuri ya Soko nziza. Ubiyirohemo byose, wiboner’ihumure.
Ngwino, zan’ibyaha byawe kuri ya Soko nziza, nubwo bitukura rwose, birab’umweru dede.
Umv’Amagambo ya Yesu, wihan’umwiringire! Mwitab’ Aguh’Ubugingo; Nuk’umukurikire.
Subira kuri ya Soko, ni ho wakirira pe; Ni cyo kizatum’ impundu zivugira mw’Ijuru.

praise.title: Jye mfit’Umukiz’ ujy’Amvugira ku Mana
praise.chorus: Njye ninging’Imana ngw’Ikwereke Yesu. Ngumwakire nawe: ni ko ngusabira.
stanzas: Jye mfit’Umukiz’ ujy’amvugira ku Mana. N’Inshut’ idahana, si nk’izo mw’isi itek’arandind’ akankingira n’ibyago. Icyamp’uw’ Akab’Umukiza wawe!
Nahaw’ikibanza na Data wo mw’Ijuru mu Rugo rwe rwera kubw’Umwana we Azangezayo ngo tuban’iteka ryose. Icyampa ngo nawe tuzabaneyo!
Nzahabwa n’umwambaro mwiza, wera cyane tw’Abacunguwe Yatubikiyeyo. Njya ngir’amatsiko, nkawifuza, mugenzi. Icyampa ngo naw’uzawambar’ubwo.
Kur’ubu, njya ngir’amahoro mu mutima: Nyahawe na Yes’Umukiza wanjy’ Atemba nk’uruzi: ab’isi ntibayazi. Icyampa ngasang’ uyahawe nawe.
N’umara kumwemerah’ Umukiza wawe uhamye mu band’iby’ Agukoreye, usabe n’Iman’ Ibahishurire Yesu, bahabw’ubwo Buntu wahawe nawe.

praise.title: Yesu ni We Nshuti yacu
stanzas: Yesu ni We Nshuti yacu; Ni W’Utwikorerera imibabaro n’ibyaha, Akatwuzuza na Se. Dore, tubur’amahoro, tuyabuzwa n’ubusa, kuko tudasaba neza ibyo dukena byose.
Ni tugir’ibyago byinshi. Tugashukwa n’Umubi, tumuganyir’ amaganya, kukw’ Ayadukuraho. Harihw’indi Nshuti nk’iyi Yababarana natwe? Yes’Az’ intege nke zacu, tumwisunge dusaba.
Niba ufit’ishavu ryinshi ukababara rwose, Ubuhungiro ni Yesu: ngwino tumwihishemo. Inshuti zidutaye, zikaduhemukira, Yes’Adukingir’ ingabo, Akaduhumuriza.

praise.title: Bene wacu bo mw’isi
praise.chorus: Satani yayobeje Sogokuruza wacu, amuteg’ikigoyi, maz’amuta mu rwobo.
stanzas: Bene wacu bo mw’isi, mwese ni mutwiteho, mwitegure kumvira Imigambi y’Imana.
Nuko, natw’abana be tumukurikir’ubwo, twibagirw’Uwiteka, tugwa mu minyururu.
Umv’Ubuntu bw’Imana, ko butangaza cyane! Nawe, wabwiyumvira, warek’iby’ ugundira.
Ntangazwa n’Uwiteka: Yambuy’uwo Mwana we bwa bwiza bukomeye, ngwaz’apfir’ abagome.
Yemeye guhemurwa, nta n’icyaha Yakoze, yicw’urupfu rubi pe, Atubohor’ibyaha.
None, banyabyaha mwe, bakene na bakire, uko muri, mwitabe, mwakir’Umucunguzi!

praise.title: Umva munyabyaha we
stanzas: Umva, munyabyaha we. Yes’ukw’ Akuburira: Sigaho gukinisha Ubugingo n’urupfu!
Umubir’ushukana uzasaz’ ushireho, ujy’iy’utagaruka: Nuko, wibikinaho.
Takambir’Iman’ubu, Itarac’amateka: Yo ntikinish’ibyayo. Ngwin’usab’ imbabazi!
Gupfa ntikuba kure: We kujarajar’utyo! Ntuzi k’uzarimbuka? We kugum’ uk’ur’uko.
Haguruka! Huguka! Hung’ urupfu rw’iteka Yesu n’ubukiriro: Wamuhungiyeho se?

praise.title: Kera har’Umubibyi wasohoy’ imbuto
stanzas: Kera har’Umubibyi wasohoy’ imbuto; Zimwe zigwa ku nzira, zimarwa n’inyoni, izindi ku rutare, zumishwa n’izuba, kuko zari zibuze ahantu horoshye.
Mu mahwa hagw’ izindi, zikurana na yo; Nukw’ aziniga zose, ntizera na gato. Izindi mbuto zigwa mu butaka bwiza; Zimeze zirakura, Zer’imbuto nyinshi.
Har’umubibyi wundi, ni Yesu Krisito. Ijambo ry’Agakiza ni iyo mbut’abiba, kand’ imitima yacu ni na yo mbibe ye, ari mib’ari myiza, amishamw’ imbuto.
Ku mutwe n’ibiganza no ku birenge bye, hatonyang’ Amaraso akibib’ imbuto; Imvura ni y’imeza imbuto z’iyi si: Amaras’akameza izo mu mitima.
Mugenzi, har’ibiki mu mutima wawe? N’inzira nyinshi, mbese? Cyangwa n’urutare? Cyangwa n’imbibe nziza? Mbe harafumbiwe? Weramw’ imbuto nziza, Cyangw’ umez’amahwa?
Umwami Yes’Azaza Gusarur’ imbuto; Azaz’ Afit’intara, maz’azigosore; Ingano nziza zose Azazihunika, maz’umuram’ Awute na wo mu Muriro.
Uzajya hehe wowe? Nturabimenya se? Uzajya mu kigega, cyangwa mu Muriro? Urorere gutinda: Wihane nonaha! Uyu n’umunsi mwiza wo kwemererwamo.

praise.title: Jy’uhor’Undinganirije
praise.chorus: Ni yo meza, ndayakunda, anter’ibyishimo byinshi: Ni yo meza, ndayakunda, anter’ibyishimo.
stanzas: Jy’uhor’Undinganirije ayo Magambo meza. Umpugur’ uyamenyeshe, aya Magambo ye. Ayo ni yo njya nkunda, ni y’Ampesh’ Amahoro.
Krist’aber’abantu bose aya Magambo meza. Mumwitabe, banyabyaha, mwumv’ Amagambo ye. Abayoboz’ituza, n’Amagamb’ atunganye.
Kwiza hos’Ubutumwa bwe bw’aya Magambo meza. Muz’Arabababarira, mwumv’ Amagambo ye. Yesu ni We Mukiza, Utubeshahw’iteka.

praise.title: Mwa bitang’igicuri mwe
praise.chorus: Mpisemo guhora nkizwa, ngashingwa mu Gakiza ke; Sinzava mu Gakiza ke.
stanzas: Mwa bitang’igicuri mwe, muyoberw’ Umusaraba, turababwira turira, yuko mubabaza Yesu.
Mwa barets’Ubugingo mwe, mukabuguran’ iby’isi, ubw’ibyo bizabora se muzakuramo ndamu ki?
Mwa barets’Igihugu mwe, cyuzuy’ubuki n’amata, mukimiranye vuba ye, musubiye mw’Egiputa!
Yemwe abavug’inkurumbi cya Gihugu Siyoni, mwit’ amananiza bishoboker’ uwizeye.
Dor’Amaraso ya Yesu; ni mo dukirizw’ibyaha, ngwino, dusubiraneyo, tugere ku Musaraba!
Yemwe bakunzi ba Yesu, mwihane, ye kubabara! Mumaramaze kwitanga, igihe ni kigufi pe!
Mwa batuy’imitwaro mwe, ko mugifit’ ingata se? Turababwira turira ko muri kure ya Yesu.
Muze, musange Krisito, ku Ntebe ye y’Imbabazi, dor’abategerej’ubu; Muz’arabababarira!

praise.title: Teg’amatwi wumve ijwi rya Yesu
praise.chorus: Ati: Wemere—ko nkurokora: Ni . .. jye. .. Mucunguzi—ntiwaza se?
stanzas: Teg’amatwi, wumv’Ijwi rya Yesu. Arakongorera,—Akwinginga.
Umvir’ijwi ryiza—rigusaba ngo, nganyir’ amaganya,—Nyikorere.
Umuhungireho,—Umwihishemo. Arakuruhura—Unaniwe.
Ni wowe Yazize—ku Musaraba emer’Aguture—ibyo byaha.
Ur’uw’intege nke:—W’Arakomeye umwiyegurire,—usugire.
Ubwo Yakuguze,—non’umwinjize mu mutima wawe,—Akwimemo.

praise.title: Mwami Wakomeretse
stanzas: Mwami, Wakomeretse: ni twe waziraga wahemuw’ utyo Mwami Ushinyagurirwa. Ker’Utaraza mw’isi, War’ufit’Ubwiza! Dor’uko bagushyize mur’abo bambuzi.
Mpindukirir’Undebe, Mukiza w’Ukuri: N’impano y’Imbabazi njya nkuboneramo. Yesu, Waramfiriye: N’ibyanjye Wazize; Ump’Amahoro masa kuko nkwiringira.
Kand’imipfire yawe ni yo yankijije. Intera kugushima mu kubaho kose: Imbabazi n’izawe, Mucunguzi wanjye. Nah’urupfu rwantera, nta cyakunkuramo.
No mw’ipfa ryanjye, Yesu, Uzambe bugufi: Urupfu ni runsinda, Uzamar’ ubwoba. Kokw’umubiri wanjye, uzabor’uveho; Nyamara, nzakubona mu maso, Mukiza.
Mukiza wanjye mfite ubwuzu n’Ishimwe, ngo ndeb’inkovu zawe Wagize kubwanjye! Umpe kunesha rero, nkuko Wanesheje. Hahirw’uzapfa apfira muri wowe, Yesu.

praise.title: Umutwaro wanjye
stanzas: Umutwaro wanjye, Krisito, Warawikoreye. Bakubambye ku Musaraba, ni jyewe Wazize; Unkuraho wa Mutwaro: Sinkiwikoreye!
Igikombe cyanjye cyarimo kuvumwa n’Urupfu; Nuk’ucyiranguza kubwanjye; Ibyo bisharira, uherak’ Ubisimbuza ibyiza by’Ijuru.
Uwiteka wang’ibyaha pe Yabanguy’ inkoni, ariko si jye yakubise, ahubwo ni Wowe. Iyo mibyimba, Krisito, ni yo yankijije!
Haguy’iy’inkundura, Yesu, Jye nkunamamw’ubwo; Iguhitiraho ku Giti, Jye ntiyanyagira. Yarakunshocaguriye; None, hareyutse.
So Yakuy’inkota ye yera, Aragusogota; Umutima waw’uhinduka urwubati rwayo. Non’iyo nkot’iragimbye: Nta cy’ikintwar’ubu!
Jye napfanye nawe, Krisito, ubwo Wamfiraga; Urazuka, nzukana nawe, Uraz’unturamo. Non’untungany’ unyeze de, Uzangez’i Wawe.

praise.title: N’iki cyankiz’ibyaha?
praise.chorus: Ayo Maraso ye ni y’amboneza rwose: Nta cyampa gukira, nk’Amaraso y’Umukiza.
stanzas: N’iki cyankiz’ibyaha? N’Amaraso yawe, Yesu. N’iki cyanyeza rwose? N’Amaraso yawe, Yesu.
Nta kindi cyantunganya, nk’Amaraso yawe, Yesu. Nta kindi cyiru mfite, nk’Amaraso yawe, Yesu.
Nta cyantsembahw’ ibyaha, nk’Amaraso yawe, Yesu. Nta byanjye byamboneza, nk’Amaraso yawe, Yesu.
Ni Wowe niringira, n’Amaraso yawe, Yesu. Ni Wow’ump’ Amahoro, n’Amaraso yawe, Yesu.
Nguhimbariza cyane Amaraso yawe, Yesu. Mwami, ndagushimira Amaraso Wamviriye.

praise.title: Amaraso Y’Umucunguzi
praise.chorus: Ndaguhimbariza Mucunguzi Imbabazi Wangiriye Ukanyoz’ ibyaha nakoze mu Maraso Wavuye.
stanzas: Amaraso Y’Umucunguzi niyo Soko yoz’abanduye niyo Yeza abanyabyaha de bakabonera rwose.
Urya Mwambuzi mwabambanywe ayarabutsw’ aranezerwa nanjy’ umwihebe mubi nka we, Untabare Umboneze.
Mwami Yesu Mwana W’Intama njya ngukundira Mucunguzi Amaraso yaw’ atunganye ayo Watuviriye.
Nta N’ikindi kibasha nkayo kudutsembaho ibicumuro no Gucungura n’abemeye kwizer’ Umucunguzi.
Mperey’aho nayaboneye ava mu bikomere byawe nogez’ Urukundo Wankunze nzagushima ndinde mpfa.
Nd’ino mw’isi, birananira kugushim’uko bikwiriye nyum’ Uzamp’urundi rurimi njye ngusingiz’iteka.

praise.title: Amaraso y’Umukiza Yakuyiriye
praise.chorus: Amaraso y’ Umukiza Yakuviriye, rek’akoze, rek’akweze, agukiz’ubu.
stanzas: Amaraso y’Umukiza Yakuyiriye. Yayaviriy’ abagome n’abanyabyaha.
Amaraso y’Umukiza ni y’atunganya. Rek’atembe nk’umugezi, akugeremo.
Nubw’ufit’ibyaha byinshi, kandi wanduye, Amaraso y’Umukiza arakweza de.
Amaraso ni yo masa yanyishyuriye irya myenda yanjye yose, ndababarirwa.
Ubu nshiz’amanga cyane kwinjir’Ahera, kuko yaduhay’Inzira Mu maraso ye.
Amaraso yo kunesha ni yo ndwanisha, nsind’ibyaha na Satani, nshobojwe na yo.
Amaraso y’Umuhuza wacu n’Imana, Ni y’ambonez’ umutima; Ndayasingiza.

praise.title: Mbe ntiwaturw’ibyo byaha byawe
praise.chorus: Amaraso, kokw’ashobora imitim’ ishobewe, Amaraso y’Umucunguzi ni yo mas’atuneshereza.
stanzas: Mbe, ntiwaturw’ibyo byaha byawe? Usange Yesu! Usange Yesu ntushaka no kubinesha rwose? Wizer’ Amaras’akiza.
Mbe, ntiwaturw’ ubwigenge bwawe? Usange Yesu! Usange Yesu! Akugir’ umugwaneza nka we! Wizer’ Amaras’akiza!
Mbese, ntushaka no kwezwa dede? Usange Yesu! Usange Yesu! Emer’ akoz’ibyo byaha byose, Wizer’ Amaras’akiza!
Mbese, ntushaka kumuyoboka? Usange Yesu! Usange Yesu! No kumusingiz’iteka ryose? Wizer’ Amaras’akiza!

praise.title: Numva Yes’Anyemeza
praise.chorus: Yanyishyuriye ya myenda yose, Yambabariye ibyaha atuma nera de.
stanzas: Numva Yes’Anyemeza ko mbuz’ imbaraga, ngo njye museng’iteka ntacyo nzamuburana.
Niw’Ufit’Imbaraga zihagije rwose zo gukiz’ababembe zigakiz’umutima.
Singir’icyiza nkora nibesherejweho n’Ubuntu bwawe gusa, nezwa n’Amaraso de.
Nasaga n’Uwapfuye mu mutima wanjye maze Yes’Aranzura kandi niw’Unkomeza.
Imbere ya ya Ntebe nzahagararayo nzaba njyany’iminyago nyishyikirize Yesu.

praise.title: Yesu yaje kunshaka
praise.chorus: Umv’uko Yankunze, umv’uko Yanshatse! Ibuk’Amaraso Yanguze! Mbur’uko mbivuga, numiwe.
stanzas: Yesu yaje kunshaka, ndi kure, nzimiye, Anshyira ku bitugu nukw’ Arantarura! Maz’ Abamarayika be baririmba basingiza.
Yasanze nkomeretse, nukw’ Aranyomora, Ampumuriza neza at’ur’uwanjye ko! Sinari numv’ijwi nk’iryo, nduhuka mu mutim’ubwo.
Anyereka n’inkovu zo mu biganza bye, n’izatewe n’amahwa zo mu ruhanga rwe. Nibaz’icyo Yambonyemo, cyatumye yihangan’atyo!
None, tuban’iteka; Mu maso he hera hamvir’Umucyo mwinshi, uhor’unyobora; Amp’ibikwiriye byose; Mbur’uko mbimushimira.
Nduhutse mu mutima, Amp’ Amahoro ye. Iteka ntegereje Umuns’ azazaho, Antahukan’ Angez’i We. Anguze n’Amaraso ye.

praise.title: Nari kure y’Imana mu ngoyi
praise.chorus: Shimwa Gologota! Shimwa Gologota! Ni hw’ibyaha byanjve byankuriweho. Shimwa Gologota.
stanzas: Nari kure y’Imana mu ngoyi, ntazi ko naboshywe; Mbohorwa n’Amaraso ya Yesu, ngez’i Goligota.
Yesu ni We Wankuye mu mbohe! Njye muririmbira, Indirimbo nshya nziza Yampaye; Ngez’i Gologota!
Yahamperey’Umwuka hw’ingwate, mwakira nishimye. Yemeye no kumba mu mutima, ngez’i Gologota.
Ngwino, sang’Umukiza, mugenzi nukw’Akubohore. Yesu Yahaniw’ abanyabyaha rimw’i Gologota.

praise.title: Ai Gitare Cy’Imana reka nguhungireho
stanzas: Ai Gitare Cy’Imana reka nguhungireho, kubw’imbabazi zawe kera Waramenewe. Non’ubu nkwihishemo Umujinya W’Imana.
Amazi n’Amaraso byo mu rubavu rwawe, binkiz’uburyo bwombi, urubanza rw’ibyaha n’imbaraga mbi zabyo bye, kuzansind’ ukundi.
Ibyo twakora byose n’umwete wacu wose n’agahinda gasaze n’amarira adashira. Byose ntibyashobora kudukurah’ ibyaha.
Ntacyo nzanye mu ntoki cyabasha kunshungura, simfit’icyo naguha, nizey’ Umusaraba, uwo Wamfiriyeho niwo njya niringira.
Dore nambaye ubusa ndakwinginze Unyambike, sinabasha kwikiza ndagushakaho Ubuntu. Unyuhagir’ ibyaha Mutabazi ne Gupfa.

praise.title: Ushimwe Mana ko Wampaye Yesu
praise.chorus: Haleluya, nyirigira! Haleluya Amen! Haleluya, nyirigira ngwino umpembure!
stanzas: Ushimwe Mana ko Wampaye Yesu. Akankirish’ urupfu rw’Akanzukira.
Yankirishije wa Musaraba We, singicirwahw’iteka kubw’Amaraso.
Nar’uwo gupfa, Yes’Aransimbura. Ibicumuro byanjye ni byo Yazize!
Ngwin’Umpembure! Maramw’ubukonje! Ats’Umurir’ubu mu mutima wanjye!

praise.title: Umunsi mwiza nibuka
praise.chorus: Nsingize, nsingize Yesu wanyogej’ ibyaha. Anyigish’ iby’Inzira Ye, ngo nsenge, nshime nezerwe. Nsingize, nsingize Yesu Wanyogej’ibyaha.
stanzas: Umunsi mwiza nibuka, n’uwo nakwemereyeho, wamberey’ Umucunguzi njye nkwiz’ibyawe nishimye.
Warangije kundokora nd’uwawe nawe ur’uwanjye, iryo Jwi ryawe ryinginga nabura nte kuryitaho?
Najyaga ndorogotana mu by’isi no mu ngeso mbi, nkugarutseho noneho sinzongera kuzimira.
Iteka nzagukorera iby’isi ndabizinutswe, no mw’ipfa ryanjye Mukiza sinzarorera kwishima.

praise.title: Ubugingo bwanjye bwahinduts’ ukundi
praise.chorus: Kuv’ubwo Yanyinjiyemo(x2) Yaranyuze; ndishima ndamuhimbaza, kuv’ubwo Yanyinjiyemo.
stanzas: Ubugingo bwanjye bwahinduts’ ukundi, Yes’ubwo Yangeragamo; Umucyo winjiye mu mutima wanjye, Yes’ubwo Yangeragamo.
Naretse kuzerera no kuzimira, kuv’ubwo Yanyinjiyemo; Kand’ibyaha byanjye byakuweho; rwose, kuv’ubwo Yanyinjiyemo.
Noneho, mfit’Ibyiringiro, nizeye Yes’uwo wanyinjiyemo; Nshizwe imbere mu Nzira, sinshidikanya, Yes’uwo Wanyinjiyemo.
Sinzatinya kunyura mu rupfu, hamwe na Yesu Wanyinjiyemo; Kuko mbon’Umurwa wer’urimbishijwe Wa Yesu Wanyinjiyemo.
Nzi ko nzajya kubana kur’uwo Murwa na Yesu Wanyinjiyemo; Ni cyo kizatuma njya ndirimba nshima, Yes’uwo Wanyinjiyemo.

praise.title: Ibyaha byanjye
stanzas: Ibyaha byanjye, Yesu Yarabyikoreye, W’Atigeze gukora icyaha na kimwe; Ndamwegera, ndasenga, nd’umunyabyaha pe, nizer’ Ijambo ry’ati: Urababariwe!
Maz’ibindushya byose ndabimukorera. Nta wund’utari Yesu Wabyihanganira. Ndamwegera, njy’ahw’ari, ndushye, ndendebutse, ndagenda, mpaw’intege, nsindishirijwe pe!
Nukw’amaganya yanjye, nyakurwaho na We, nduhukira muri We, Amp’Amahoro ye. Imanuweli Kristo, Zina rihebuje! Rimbera nk’imibavu, ihumura neza.
Icyampa nkaba nka We, Akamp’ineza ye, n’imbabazi n’ubuntu n’ubugwaneza bye. Yes’Uzampe gutura i wawe mw’Ijuru, nkajya ngusingizanya n’Abamarayika.

praise.title: Iby’Iman’ Ijy’Inkorera
stanzas: Iby’Iman’ Ijy’Inkorera, bikorwa neza byose; Inam’ Ijy’ingira zose nzishima nezerewe. Ni yo Mana; ni y’Imenya kundind’ umunsi mubi: Ni ko kuyihereza.
Iby’Iman’ Ijy’Inkorera bikorwa neza byose; Inzira nziz’ Inyuzamo n’iy’umurava wayo. Yankirije muri Yesu, Ingirira n’Ubuntu; Nta cyo Yanyima rwose.
Iby’Iman’ Ijy’Inkorera bikorwa neza byose; nagir’ishavu n’ibyago binguye mu mutima. Ntibinyica; Nsind’ibibi, kukw’ijy’ Impumuriza: Nta kindi niringira.
Iby’Iman’ Ijy’Inkorera bikorwa neza byose; Urupf’ubwo ruzantera, rukazankura mw’isi, sinzatinya; Nzakomera, kukw’Uwiteka anjyana mu Bugingo budapfa.

praise.title: Nishimiye ko menye rwose
praise.chorus: Yambwiye ko nd’umunyabyaha, ndihana ndizer’ Arankiza; Nibyo ndirimba, ni byo mvuga, nshim’ Umukiz’ ubudasiba.
stanzas: Nishimiye ko menye rwose, Yesu kw’ar’ Umukiza wanjye; Ni We Wanshunguj’ Amaraso; Ndizera, mvuk’ubwa kabiri.
Nditanze, ndamwiyeguriye; Binzanir’ ibyishimo byinshi, Namuhay’ ibyanyanduzaga, Abinkurahw’ amp’Amahoro.
Sinkir’uwanjy’ arantegeka; Mpiriwe n’uko mba muri We; Njya ntegerez’ ibyiza bindi nzagirirwa n’Urukundo rwe.
Kubimenya ni kwiza rwose: Nd’uwa Yesu, sinshidikanya. Ushobora byos’ Arandinda; Nkimwizeye, nta wamunyaga.

praise.title: Ndumva k’umutim’ ukeye
stanzas: Ndumva k’umutim’ ukeye: Biranejeje rwose! Ndakijijwe, ndakijijwe: N’umunezero cyane! Ibyaha byanjye byogejwe n’Amaraso ya Yesu; Agahinda kamvuyemo: Sinkir’ umunyabyago.
Nishimiye, nishimiye ko ntegekwa na Yesu. Murokozi, Murokozi, nemeye kub’uwawe. Wanyikuriye mu byaha, Wowe, Ntwari y’Imana; Wandokorey’ umutima Kand’umpaye kubaho.
Waj’unshakan’ Urukundo, ubwo nari nzimiye. Wankuye mu byaha byanjye, Unyigirir’uwawe. Mpereye none n’iteka, ni Wowe nziringira; Kubaho kwanjye kurindwe n’Amaboko ya Yesu.
Ndakuririmbira, Mwami; Namwe ndababwiriza. Ibyo Yesu Yankoreye: Birantangaza rwose. Kuko Yemeye kumfira, Akamber’ igitambo, umutima wanjye wose n’uw’Uwawucunguye.

praise.title: Unkunda n’Umwana w’Imana
stanzas: Unkunda n’Umwana w’Imana; Yaje mw’isi kunshungura. Umutima wanjy’ utangazwa n’urwo Rukundo rwa Yesu. Unkunda ni Yesu; (x2) Yamfiriy’ibyaha byanjye; Unkunda ni Yesu.
Amaraso yawe, Mukiza, Ankurahw’ ibyaha byanjye. Nahinduts’ Uwatsinz’urupfu kubw’izo mbabazi zawe. Unkunda ni Yesu (x2) Wanzukiye ngw’Ambesheho: Unkunda ni Yesu.
Uzi kubaho kwanjye kose; Unshorer’iminsi yose. N’Umucyo waw’umurikira, Ukandindish’ Urukundo. Unkunda ni Yesu; (x2) Yankujije mu by’Imana: Unkunda ni Yesu.
Nzi ko Yes’atajy’ Ahinduka, no gukiz’ Aracyakiza. Uk’uri kose, munyabyaha, mwizer’ ukizwe nonaha! Ukundwa na Yesu: (x2) Yapfiriy’ibyaha byawe; Ukundwa na Yesu!

praise.title: Nzaririmb’ igitangaza
praise.chorus: Nzaririmb’igitangaza Yes’Umwami Yakoze: Ndi kumwe n’abo mw’Ijuru imbere ya ya Ntebe.
stanzas: Nzaririmb’igitangaza, Yes’Umwami Yakoze; Ko Yavuy’i We mw’Ijuru ngw’Amfir’i Gologota.
Nari nzimiye nk’intama maze Yes’Arambona; Nukw’Anshyira ku bitugu, Ansubiza mu Nzira.
Nar’impumyi, mfit’ ubwoba nshits’intege, mbabaye, njanjaguritse, nihebye, maze Yes’Arankiza.
Ndacyabon’ibimbabaza; Haracyar’ ibindushya; Nyamar’ubwo turi kumwe, nzi yuko nta cyo nzaba.
Azanyuza no mu rupfu, nambuke na rwa Ruzi; Maze, ni mfata hakurya, nzasangay’abo nkunda.

praise.title: Nabony’Uburuhukiro
praise.chorus: Nta wundi wese nizera; Nta kindi nireguza, keretse Yesu Wabambwe, ari jyew’Azize.
stanzas: Nabony’Uburuhukiro muri Kristo Yesu. Ni We musa nihishemo; Nta handi nizeye.
Mpagijwe n’Agakiza ke, nta bwoba ngifite; Yansanze, nd’umunyabyaha; Maz’Aranyakira.
Kand’iyo ndway’ Aramvura, nkaba muzima pe; Njya mpeshwa n’Amaraso ye Ubugingo bushya.
Mpumurijwe n’ljambo rye, n’Ijambo ry’Imana; Nkijijwe kubw’Izina rye, singishidikanya.

praise.title: Iby’isi Yesu Yabinkuyemo
praise.chorus: Jye nkunda... jye nkunda... Umukiza wanjye, Wanyiguriy’i Gologota ku Giti.
stanzas: Iby’isi Yesu Yabinkuyemo: Ubw’Amaraso, ntibinkang’ubu. Nunamy’ imbere y’Umusaraba; Yesu Yanyejeje de mu Maraso Ye.
Nari nazimiriye mu byaha, nd’imbata y’ishyari n’inzangano, umunsi w’amateka nywutinya, Ankirish’ Amaraso ku Musaraba.
Jye nar’imbat’ Amp’ umudendezo; Jye nar’impumyi, Arampumura; Jye nari intumbi, maz’Aranzura! Nimwumv’ayo Mahoro Yesu Yampaye!

praise.title: Kera nari mw’isayo y’ibyaha
praise.chorus: Imana yanjye Yarandokoye, Ubu ni Yo nsingiza kuko Yankijije.
stanzas: Kera nari mw’isayo y’ibyaha ngira ngo nd’uw’Imana, ndi mwiza; Nyuma, nsanga nibeshya.
Nuko Yes’Ansangamo, mbyigaraguramo, Ati: Mwan’unyemere, ngutabare, ngukize!
Haz’Umwuka Wer’ubwo mu mutima wanjye, mbona ko nacumuye; Ndihan’ Arandokora.
Mana, ndagushimira yuk’ Umwana wawe Atandetse ngo nzapfe nkiri mu byaha byanjye.
Reka njye nkuyoboka; Nta wundi nifuza. Noneh’ Unyiharire; Mwami Yes’Untegeke.
Nahatswe na Satani; Nta cyiza yampaye; amp’Urupfu rw’iteka; ni kw’ahemb’ ingabo ze.
Ariko, Mucunguzi, Wowe Wangabiye Ubugingo ku Buntu, buva ku Musaraba.

praise.title: Imbabazi z’Umukiza
praise.chorus: Nari mw’isayo y’ibyaha, Aramfat’ Aransayura. Nari mu mwijim’ ukomeye non’Aramurikira.
stanzas: Imbabazi z’Umukiza zamuzanye kunshungura; Natabitswe n’ibyaha byanjye, Ankuramw’ Arankiza.
Natinze cyane kwitaba Yesu Wampamagaraga; Nyuma, niringiy’Ijambo rye, Yes’Ankurahw’ ibyaha.
Yaje kunkiz’Agifite inkovu nyinshi z’amahwa n’iz’icumu n’iz’imbereri. Mpimbaz’ Urukundo rwe.
None mpora mu Mahoro; Umutima ni muzima; Arikw’ icyatumy’ Anshungura, Akankiza, sinkizi.

praise.title: Ubuntu bw’Imana
stanzas: Ubuntu bw’Imana—Butangaje ni bwo bwankuyeho—Imigozi. Byavuye se kuki? Byavuye ku gushaka kw’Imana yonyine—Yambohoye.
Ni Yesu Wenyine—Wantoreye Guhirwa mw’Ijuru—Mu Bwami bwe. Mwese nimumenye yuk’Umukiza wacu Ajy’asanganira—Abaz’i We.
S’uko nari mwiza—Haba na mba! N’Ubuntu bwa Yesu—Yangiriye. Yarambabarijwe kuri wa Musaraba ndetse Yabambanywe —N’abambuzi.
Kand’iyo nibutse—Ibya Yesu, uko Yagiriwe—bamubamba, binyibuts’ ibyaha; We nta kibi Yakoze; Ni jyewe Yazize:—N’Umukiza!
Ub’icyo nifuza —N’ukuguma mu Mukiza wanjye,—Mwihishemo. Ni We Ngabo yacu Ihor’Idukingira imyambi wa Mubi—aturasa.
Non’Icyo ngusabye,—Mwami Yesu: Ingeso wa Mubi —yanyanduje zashaka kubyuka, Zirimbur’ Uzice pe, mpore nihariwe—N’ibya Yesu.
None, maso yanjye,—na we matwi, nawe munwa wanjye,—mubiri we! Mwese, mushimishe Uwankuye mu ngoyi. Ibyaremwe byose,—Tumushime.

praise.title: Sinterw’isoni na Yesu
praise.chorus: Ku Musaraba rwose ni ho naturiw’ Umutwaro w’ibyaha byanjye. Nizeye, ndahumuka, mbon’Umucyo; Bituma mpora nezerewe.
stanzas: Sinterw’isoni na Yesu, cyangw’iz’ishyaka rye, naho zab’iz’ Ijambo rye, cyangw’ Umusaraba.
Izina rya Yesu wanjye ni ryo nishimira; Nzi kw’Atazanyihakana kuko mwiringiye.
Ntabw’Azivuguruz’ ibyo Yansezeranije, kukw icyo namubikije Azagikomeza.
Mw’Ijur’ Azanyemera, nubwo nta cyo maze; Yerusalemu yaho, Azamp’ Icyicaro.

praise.title: Nkomeze njye niringira Amaraso
praise.chorus: Nikomeze ku Rutare, nahw’ ahandi n’umusenyi, nahw’ ahandi n’umusenyi.
stanzas: Nkomeze njye niringira Amaraso y’Umukiza. Nta wundi nshaka kwigana keretse Yesu wenyine.
Iyo ngoswe n’umwijima, niringir’ubwo Buntu bwe. Mu byago no mu makuba, ntagir’ubw’ anzibukira.
Ntunganywa n’Amaraso ye na ya Masezerano ye. Naho napfush’ibyo mfite, ni We musa niringira.
Maz’icyo gih’Azazira, Azasanga mwiteguye, nambaye gukiranuka; Ntanenge nzaba ngifite.

praise.title: Njye nd’Umukristo
stanzas: Njye nd’Umukristo: nzahora ndiwe mubintu byose, ngeze kugupfa. Njye nd’Umukristo: Mpora mbihamya nahw’ igihugu cyose cyanseka. Njye nd’Umukrsto wo mumutima kuk’ubu nsigaye nkunda Kristo. Icyatumy’Apfa Yazize njyewe nabuzwa n’iki kujya mukunda.

Njye nd’Umukristo umv’ ubwo Buntu narakijijwe nkurwa mubyaha. Njye nd’Umukristo naho naterwa n’ibyago nkaba no kurugamba. Njye nd’Umukristo nd’umutabazi muntambara ndasana n’ibyaha. Mfite Umugaba n’Umwami Yesu nituba hamwe nzahora nesha.

Njye nd’Umukristo nd’umwimukira ndakomeje mu Rugendo rwanjye. Ibyino mw’isi ndabihinyuye nsigaye nifuz’ibyo mw’Ijuru. Njye nd’Umukristo gakondo yacu iri mw’Ijuru kumana yacu. Ntanzar’ibayo nta n’imiruho abaho bose baguwe neza.

Njye nd’Umukristo icyo n’ikintu gihumuriz’ umutima wanjye. Kinyibagiza ibyago byose nkumva nduhuwe n’Umwami Yesu. Njye nd’Umukristo uko ndi kose. Maze nintumirwa ngiye gupfa nzagir’ ibyishimo bitavugwa nzabona ihirwe, ngeze mw’Ijuru.

praise.title: Nyuzwe n’Ubucuti bwo mw’Ijuru
praise.chorus: Niseguye Amaboko yawe, Yesu; Singitinya: Nisunz’ Umukiz’Ukomeye.
stanzas: Nyuzwe n’Ubucuti bwo mw’Ijuru, nisunz’Umukiz’ Ukomeye. Ngiz’ihirwe, mbony’ umunezero: Nisunz’ Umukiz’Ukomeye.
Nezezwa n’uko Yes’Anyobora: Nisunz’ Umukiz’Ukomeye. Sinkiyoberw’ Inzira nyuramo: Nisunz’ Umukiz’Ukomeye.
Umutima wanjye ntuhagaze: Nisunz’ Umukiz’Ukomeye. Ngubwa neza ndi kumwe na Yesu: Nisunz’ Umukiz’Ukomeye.

praise.title: Igituma nkunda Yesu
praise.chorus: Igituma nkunda Yesu Akandutira byose, N’uko Yankuyehw’ ibyaha, Akanyoza, nkera de.
stanzas: Igituma nkunda Yesu, nkikumenyeshe none. N’ukw’uwo Mukiza Mwiza Yanguz’ Amaraso ye.
Igituma nkunda Yesu n’Urukundo Yankunze, Akankiz’ibyaha byanjye byajyaga bintegeka.
Igituma nkunda Yesu n’ukw’ar’ Umurengezi. Ahor’Antabar’iteka, uk’Umwanz’ Anyoheje.
Igituma nkunda Yesu n’ukw’ Atazarorera kumber’ Umukunzi Mwiza, Akamber’ Umwungeri.

praise.title: Izina ryiza Rihebuje
praise.chorus: Yesu ndamukunda, Yesu ndamukunda, ndamukundira y’uko Yabanje kunkunda atyo.
stanzas: Izina ryiza rihebuje rinezeza amatwi yanjye nzajya ndihimbaza ntahwema ndivuge nirya Yesu.
Kok’iryo Zina rinyibutsa uko Yankunz’ Akampfira ababi nkanjy’ Akabeza de mur’ayo Maraso Ye.
Rimbwira Data wa twese ibyo Yanshyinguriye mu Ijuru naho nagenda mu mwijima rimurikira hose.
Rinyeyurir’umubabaro, rihanagur’amarira rinyongorera ngo mpumure ngo ntinyuke, nkomere.
Izina nkunda n’irya Yesu Risumb’uko turivuga ntawo mw’isi warisingiza uburyo buhagije.

praise.title: Nzi k’Umukiz’ Ankunda
praise.chorus: Yes’Arankunda (x3) Mpora mbihamya ntyo.
stanzas: Nzi k’Umukiz’ Ankunda: Ni ko tubibwirizwa. Abato bose n’abe, kandi n’uw’Imbaraga.
Yesu n’uw’Imbaraga: Yapfiriye kunkiza. Ni mwizer’ Azanjyana mu Bwami bwo mw’Ijuru.
Arankund’ Andindira mu migendere yanjye; Nimpfa mukunze nzaba Mu muryango We Wera.

praise.title: Nkunda kwizigira Yesu
praise.chorus: Yesu, Yesu, ndakwizeye: Ur’uwo kwiringirwa Yesu, Yesu Mwiza nkunda, ndusheho ku kwizera.
stanzas: Nkunda kwizigira Yesu, nkajya mwumvira rwose, ngo njye nishingikiriza ku Masezerano ye.
Nkunda kwizigira Yesu: Nkizwa n’Amaraso ye. Nishyize mu ruzi rwayo, nogamo, ndatungana.
Nkunda kwizigira Yesu, nkaruhuk’ Intambara y’ibicumuro n’ibyaha, Akamp’ umunezero.
Mpimbawe n’uko nkwizeye, Mutabaz’ Undengera; Nizeye k’Umpora hafi; iteka tugumane.

praise.title: Kuva ubu sintinya ibizaba ejo
praise.chorus: Mbeshwaho no kwizera Yesu, niringiye Imbabazi ze. Mbumbatiwe n’Umukiza Unkunda, nizeye Yesu nta bwoba mfite.
stanzas: Kuv’ubu sintinya ibizab’ejo, ibyago cyangwa amahirwe, nzi byose ko Imana Ibitegeka kwiganyira n’uk’ubusa.
Umwanzi Satani Yangerageza, nkabona amakuba menshi nzi yuko Umukiza Azamba hafi njye mwisunga, mwihishemo.
Numv’amatsiko mu mutima wanjye yo gucya k’umunsi mwiza Yes’ubwo Azagaruka kunjyana mu Rugo rwe rwo mw’Ijuru.

praise.title: Nabony’Umukunzi Mwiza
stanzas: Nabony’Umukunzi Mwiza, Yarankunze ntamuzi Yamfatishij’ umugozi, ari rwo Rukundo rwe. Izo ngoyi ze zanteye kub’imbata Ye rwose. Jye ndi uwe, na We ni Uwanjye kugez’iteka ryose.
Nabony’Umukunzi Mwiza, kera Yaramfiriye Yaranguz’ Amp’Ubugingo, na We Yaranyihaye. Non’ibintu mfite byose ntabwo nkibigundira. Ibyo ntunze nanjy’ ubwanjye n’iby’uwo Mucunguzi!
Nabony’Umukunzi Mwiza, byos’Arabishobora. Ajy’Andind’ akaga kose mu Nzir’ijya mw’Ijuru. Kumuhang’ amas’iteka bizankiz’intege nke. Nshir’ ubwoba, nshir’ubute, nyuma, nzatabaruka!
Nabony’Umukunzi Mwiza, ni We Nyir’Imbabazi. Ni We Mujyanama wanjye. Niw’Undenger’ iteka. Nta kubaho nta n’urupfu, nta n’abadayimoni, nta bya none, nta bizaza byazantanya na Yesu!

praise.title: Numva Yes’Ampamagara
praise.chorus: Nzamukurikira hose, (x3) Jye na Yesu, tuzagendana.
stanzas: Numva Yes’Ampamagara; Numva Yes’Ampamagara; Numva Yes’Ampamagara, Ati: Mwana, ngwino, Nyoboka!
Tuzajyana mu miruho; Tuzajyana mu makuba; Tuzajyana no mu byago; Tuzajyana: Sinzamuvaho.
Tuzajyana mu Rugendo no mu mirimo yo mw’isi; No mu ndwara no mu rupfu: Jye nzajyana na We mu Nzira.
Azamp’Amahoro menshi; Azamp’ imigisha myinshi; Azamp’Urukundo rwinshi! Nkurikir’ Umwungeri Yesu!

praise.title: Numvise Yes’Ambwir’ati
stanzas: Numvise Yes’Ambwir’ Ati: Ngwino nkuruhure. Zana ibyo bikuruhije, mbikwikorerere! musang’uko nari nd’uko; Ndushye mfite ishavu; Ambera Uburuhukiro, Ampa umunezero.
Numvise Yesu Ambwir’ Ati: Nguherey’ Ubuntu amaz’azan’ Ubugingo, unyw’uram’ iteka. Njy’aho ari, nywa nezerewe kuri ayo mazi ye umutima ushira inyota, mpabwa Ubugingo bwe.
Numvise Yesu Ambwir’ Ati: Ni jye Mucyo w’isi. Wavukiye mu isi, wavukiye mu mwijima, ngwin’ umurikirwe. Ndebye kuri Yesu mbona ko ari Izuba ryanjye rizamvira iminsi yose y’Ubugingo bwanjye.

praise.title: Ibyaha byanjye byose
stanzas: Ibyaha byanjye byose n’ibyago nabihariy’ Umwana w’Imana. Namwitegerej’ ari ku Giti, menya yukw’ari jye Yabambiwe. Numva mbabariwe, ndanezerwa; Ndishima.
Mpora mbiharira Yesu; ni W’uzi kujy’amar’ agahinda mbabaye. Iyo ndiz’andeban’ Imbabazi; Iyo mbay’ umunyantegenke pe, Yes’Arushaho kump’imbaraga. Ndishima.
Nzajya mbiharira Yesu, ntahwema, mfite muri W’ibyiringiro; Kumwizera kumpesh’ Amahoro, nkamwisegura nduhutse neza. Turi kumwe, mba ndi mw’Ijuru pe: Ndishima.
Yewe wa mwihebe wese, emera kumuharira byose, ntutinye. Nubw’ari We Rurema wa byose, Arikw’ Aragukund’ ugayitse. Yaguhay’ Ikibanza mw’Ijuru. Tahayo.

praise.title: Yesu murutisha byose
stanzas: Yesu murutisha byose: Nta kindi nkifuza. Iminsi yos’Aramfasha, ngo nkomere, ne kugwa. Iyo ndushye njya kuti We; Nta wund’ unduhura nkawe We. Yanyujuje... ibyishinno ..! N’uwanjye!
Yesu murutisha byose: Amfasha naniwe. Itek’Amp’ Imigisha, mbur’uko nabivuga. Atang’izuba n’imvura ngo nez’imyak’ inkwiriye Angabira ... byose nkena ..! N’uwanjye!
Yesu murutisha byose: Nzajya mukorera kukw ar’uwo kwiringirwa; Sinzamuhemukira. Nkurikira Yesu turi kumwe, nta cyo nzaba. Arankunda ..! Arandinda. N’uwanjye!
Yesu murutisha byose: N’Inshuti yanjye pe. Nta wundi nabona nka We; Nzahora mwizigira. Yampay’ impan’ ihebuje, ni yo Bugingo bw’iteka. Aranyuze ..! Musingize. N’uwanjye!

praise.title: Mw’Ijuru imbere Y’Imana
stanzas: Mw’Ijuru imbere y’Imana, mfit’umuntu Umvugira n’Umukuru W’abatambyi kandi yitwa Rukundo. Mpamya Y’uko izina ryanjye riri mu Mutima We Ubw’Amvugira, nta Mwanzi Wamunyirukanaho.
Satan’iy’ anyibukije gukiranirwa kwanjye, Ashaka kunyihebesha njya ntumbira mw’Ijuru. Ndebay’Umukiza wanjye Wabikuyeho rwose kera Yarampongereye nuko, Sinzarimbuka.
Uwitek’Umucamanza Ambonyehw’ Amaraso, Ntancir’ urubanza rubi anyit’ukiranutse. Yaranshunguye ngo mb’uwe niko kunyishingira kukw’Adapfa, Singipfuye jye na Yesu Tur’umwe.

praise.title: Yesu ni We Mucyo wanjye
stanzas: Yesu ni We Mucyo wanjye; Amurikir’Inzira. Nemer’intege nke zanjye; Nizera kw’Andengera. Amurikir’ Inzira. (x2) Nemer’intege nke zanjye; Nizera kw’Andengera.
Yesu ni We nshungu yanjye: Koko Yaramfiriye! Ni We byiringiro byajye; Ni We Wambabariye. Koko Yaramfiriye! (x2) Ni We byiringiro byanjye; Ni We Wambabariye.
Yesu ni W’ump’ Amahoro; Atuma nkiranuka. Ajy’Amp’ Ubugingo na bwo bunkiz’ibyah’ iteka. Atuma nkiranuka (x2) Ajy’amp’ Ubugingo na bwo bunkiz’ibyah’iteka.
Yishyuye n’imyenda yanjye, Angur’ Amaraso ye. Yanteguriye gakondo mu Bwami bwo mw’Ijuru. Angur’ Amaraso ye; (x2) Yanteguriye gakondo mu Bwami bwo mw’Ijuru.

praise.title: Ukunda kujy’ambabarira
stanzas: Ukunda kujy’Ambabarira n’Umukiza. Umfasha kujya nesh’ibibi n’Umukiza. Umwami wanjy’ Aranyizeza, nanjye nkunda kumukorera, kukw’Ashaka kubabarira umwegera.
Nkund’iyi Nzira y’Agakiza Y’Umukiza, kukw ijy’intera kunezerwa mu Mukiza. Nababazwa n’iby’isi cyane, mfashwa no kujya mwizigira, ngahora mpanz’ amas’iteka Umukiza.
Ndashima rwos’Uwankijije: Ni We Yesu. Kand’Azanjyana mu Bwami bwe kukw’Ankunze. Nuko nemera gushorerwa n’Umwuka Wera w’Umukiza, kukw’ari wo Mufash’uhamya ibya Yesu.

praise.title: Yesu ni Wowe musa
praise.chorus: None, ni Yes’Umpaza wenyine nta n’irindi zina nemera, kuk’Ubugingo n’umunezero bibonekera muri We.
stanzas: Yesu, ni Wowe musa mbonyemo Amahoro nifuzaga. Najyaga nyashaka, sinyabone, ngasuhuz’ umutim’iteka.
Nifuzag’uko nakwinezeza, ntita ku Mukiza wanjye. Nkimwirengagiza ntamwitaho, nukw’amfatish’ Urukundo rwe.
Najyaga njya kw’iriba ry’iyi si, mfit’inyota nyinshi cyane, naba ngiye kunyw’agakam’ubwo, nuko nkayabura, nkiheba.
Nuzuy’agahinda n’ubwihebe, mbuz’ibyo niringiraga; Maz’amaso yanjy’ arahumuka, ndakureba, Yesu, ndanyurwa.

praise.title: Yes’Amp’Amahoro
praise.chorus: Ni neza... Ndatuje... Nguwe neza, ndatunganiwe!
stanzas: Yes’Amp’ Amahoro y’atarondoreka, Andinda mu byago byose. Uko mba kose, nzajya nishima, nti: Nguwe neza, ndatunganiwe.
Satan’iy’antey’ankandas’ imyambi ye, njya mpeshw’Amahoro menshi no kwibuka Yes’uko Yandengeye, Ava mw’Ijuru ngw’Anshungure.
Ibyaha byanjye Yabyikoreye byose: Ntiyashigaje na kimwe byabambwe byose ku Musaraba We: Yes’Ashimwe Yarankijije!
Kuv’ubu, kubwanjye kubaho ni Kristo; Ndetse, singitinya gupfa; urupfu na rwo ruzamber’ indamu. Yes’Ampay’ Amahoro menshi
Mumeny’iyo tujya: n’i Bwami mw’Ijuru; Ntabw’ar’i Kuzimu mu mva. Ni twumva za mpanda, tuzanezerwa. Uzagaruka ryari, Yesu?

praise.title: Ubw’Umwami Yes’Ankunda
stanzas: Ubw’Umwami Yes’Ankunda, Nd’Amahoro! Kubw’ Imbabazi ze nyinshi, nd’Amahoro! Nuhagiwe n’Amaraso; Nkomezwa n’Ubuntu bwinshi; Kand’ Amfashe n’ukuboko: Nd’Amahoro!
Naho haz’ibyago byinshi, nd’Amahoro! Yesu n’Umukiza wanjye: Nd’Amahoro! Niragij’Imana, Data; Nguma muri Yesu Kristo; Nejejwe n’Umwuka Wera: Nd’Amahoro!
Byose bizambera byiza: Nd’Amahoro! No mu byago, nzaririmba: Nd’Amahoro! Naho ndiho, naho napfa, nzi ko nkundwa n’Uwiteka; Yes’Amp’ibyo nkena byose: Nd’Amahoro!

praise.title: Yesu tuguhungiyeho
praise.chorus: Mukiz’Utwemere, n’ubwo turi babi. Yesu, Waradupfiriye: Mukiz’ Utwemere.
stanzas: Yesu, tuguhungiyeho; Udutabare, tudapfa. Nubwo tutabikwiriye, Utubabarire.
Ntabwo twaguhish’ibyaha; Turatsinzwe rwos’ariko, Amaraso yawe Yesu, Yaratuviriye.
Ntabwo twashobora rwose gutungany’ ingeso zacu. Iyo tubigerageje, biratunanira.
Dore, nkwikubis’imbere! Ungirir’uko Washaka. Sinshyanga Mwam’Unkureho ingeso zose mbi.

praise.title: Mukiza numvis’Ijwi ryawe
praise.chorus: Nditabye, Yesu, Ndaje, Mukiza. Amaraso wavuye anyoz’antunganye.
stanzas: Mukiza, numvis’Ijwi ryawe ry’Imbabazi rimpamagara ngo nozwe n’Amaraso yawe.
Dor’ukonje, nihebye, ibyaha ni byinshi: Byose ndabikuzaniye, Naw’Ubikureho.
Kand’Uramp’umutima wuzuy’ Urukundo, wuzuye Kwizera na ko n’Amahoro menshi.
Kand’uzajy’Umfashisha Imbabazi nyinshi. Ibyo Wansezeranije Uzabisohoza.
Nshim’Amaraso yawe, ankurahw’ibyaha; Mpimbaz’Imbaraga zawe zinkiz’intege nke.

praise.title: Numvis’Ijwi ryawe
praise.chorus: Mwami w’abami Waaramfiriye. Nje gupfa hamwe Nawe, Ye, ku Musaraba.
stanzas: Numvis’ijwi ryawe, Yesu, ndagusanze, ndaje, Mucunguz’Unyoze mu Maraso yawe.
Numvis’ijwi ryawe, Riti: Nyizigira! Unkomereze Kwizera, kandi, tugumane.
Numvis’ijwi ryawe ryinjiiye muri jye, rimbwiriza kujya nkunda nkuko naw’Unkunda.
Numvis’Ijwi ryawe, Wowe, Wamfiriye! Mwami, mbane naw’iteka; Ni Wow’Unyizeza.

praise.title: Ubu nj’uko ndi
praise.chorus: Ubu, nj’uko ndi, mbuyerezwa n’Intambara yo mu mutima n’intimba nyinshi n’ubwihebe: Mucunguzi, nditabye, nditabye.
stanzas: Ubu, nj’uko ndi, niringiye gus’Amaraso wamviriye kandi yuko Wampamagaye Mucunguzi, nditabye, nditabye.
Ubu, nj’uko ndi: Sinabasha kwikurahw’ ibinter’isoni; Niringiy’ Amaraso yawe: Mucunguzi, nditabye, nditabye.

praise.title: Ndeger’Umusaraba
praise.chorus: Mwami ndakwiringiye, Ayi Mucunguzi wanjye; Dor’uko nkunamiye Mwami Yes’Unkiz’ubu.
stanzas: Ndeger’Umusaraba, naniwe, nkennye, mpumye; Nta kindi kindi nshaka: Ngusabye kunkiz’ubu.
Nakwifujije kera, ndi mu ngoyi z’ibyaha; Maz’umbwiranez’uti: Ngukiz’ibicumuro!
Ubu ndakwihereje: End’ibyo mfite byose, ubwenge n’imbaraga; Byose Yes’Ubyakire.
Nizey’ibyo Wavuze n’Amaraso Wavuye; Ndicuza gutinda ntyo: None, Yesu, nyakira!
Yesu, non’Ungezemo; Urakaza, Mukiza! Nta n’ineng’ Umbaraho Shimwa, Shimwa, Nyakuza!

praise.title: Nazimiriye kure yawe non’Untarure
praise.chorus: Nditabye nditabye ntabwo nzongera. Nyemerer’Umbabarire. Mwami, nyakira!
stanzas: Nazimiriye kure yawe non’Untarure! Nagundiriy’ ibyaha byanjye: Ndaje, noneho.
Napfapfany’iyo myaka yose: Non’Untarure nkwitwayeho, Mukiza wanjye ndaje, noneho.
Narembejwe n’ibyaha byanjye: Non’Untarure! Niringiy’ Urukundo rwawe: Ndaje, noneho.
Wamviriy’Amaraso yawe: Non’Untarure! Ubwaw’uraz’ Uranshungura ndaje, noneho.
Umv’uko ntats’Unkize, Yesu Non’Untarure! Mukiza, Nyeza nk’urubura: Ndaje noneho.

praise.title: Mwumv’Imbabazi z’Imana
praise.chorus: Ndaje, Yesu ..ndakwitabye.. Uko ndi ko...s’ Unyemere. Ndaje, Yesu ndakwitabye Mukiz’Unyakire.
stanzas: Mwumv’Imbabazi z’Imana: Ntabwo zarondoreka! Mbeg’umunyabyaha nkanjye koko yababarirwa?
Nari kure y’Uw’Unkunda, Mbabaz’ umutima We, kuko namwimag’ ahwaba mu wanjye Yapfiriye!
None Yesu, ndakwihaye, Umbohor’ Undokore. Ibi byaha binyomaho, Non’uz’Ubinkureho!
Haleluya: Yanduhuye! Singishidikany’ubu! Ndi mu Nzir’ijya mw’Ijuru, Nuzuy’umunezero.

praise.title: Nsiz’ububata n’umwijima
stanzas: Nsiz’ububata n’umwijima, ndaje, Yesu; Ndaje, Yesu. Mbony’umudendezo n’umucyo: Yesu, ndakwitabye! Nsiz’ubutindi n’uburema, mbony’Ubukire n’intege nyinshi. Mvuye mu byah’Urankijije: Yesu, ndakwitabye!

Mvuye mu byago n’ibihendo, ndaje, Yesu; Ndaje, Yesu, Mbony’indamu mu rupfu rwawe, Yesu ndakwitabye! Mvuyemw’ intimba n’amarira, ngeze mu byishimo. bidashira. Nshizemw’ induru, mpaw’ impundu Yesu, ndakwitabye!

Nsiz’amahane n’ubwigenge, ndaje, Yesu; Ndaje, Yesu. Ngeze ku kwemer’ iby’Ukunda, Yesu, ndakwitabye! Ntay’ibyanjye, nguhungiyeho; Mvuye mu bwihebe, nd’Amahoro: Ntaye Satani, ngo mb’uwawe: Yesu, ndakwitabye!

Nsize gutiny’urupfu n’imva, ndaje, Yesu; Ndaje, Yesu. Mbony’ umutim’ ushyitse mu nda, Yesu, ndakwitabye! Nkuwe mu kanwa k’inyamaswa, ntashye mu Rugo rw’Intama zawe! Mpere none, nkugandukire: Yesu, ndakwitabye!

praise.title: Ndagukurikira Yesu
praise.chorus: Ndagukurikira, Yesu, ubwo wanguz’ Amaraso; Ndakwihaye, Mwami Yesu: kera Waranyitangiye.
stanzas: Ndagukurikira, Yesu; Nemey’Umusaraba. Jye nta shinge, nta rugero: Urampagije Wenyine.
Icyubahiro n’iby’isi, Sinkibimaranira. Kubwa Yesu, ndabiretse: Amp’ibyiza byo mw’Ijuru.
Nahw’ab’isi bazanyanga, ni ko bakugiriye. Ntibankund’akaramata: Wowe ntabw’Uzanzinukwa.
Uwansek’Ansuzuguye, byakunsunikiraho. Uko bizamera kose, Uzabinyihanganisha.
Ko mpaw’Urukundo rwawe, har’ikindi nshaka se? Ibinezaneza by’isi, simbishaka: Mfite Yesu.

praise.title: Nshaka Yesu nta wundi nifuza
praise.chorus: Nshaka Yesu, nshaka Yesu, nshaka Yesu, ntasiba: Mu mahoro, mu byago, ni We nshaka Wenyine; None n’iteka ryose, jye nshaka Yesu.
stanzas: Nshaka Yesu; nta wundi nifuza. Andengera mu byago by’iyi si. Nshaka Yesu; ni W’Umpumuriza. Nah’undi Yakwishoboza, jye nshaka Yesu!
Nshaka Yesu: n’Inshuti yanjy’ubu. N’Umujyanam’ uhor’Unyobora. Nshaka Yesu, ngw’Ansindir’ Umwanzi; Jyenyine nzi ko nta cyo maze; Nshaka Yesu.
Nshaka Yesu: ni We Murengezi. S’Inshuti yac’abanyabyaha se? Nshaka Yesu: Nafashwa n’undi se? Ntawund’ ukund’abantu nka We: Nshaka Yesu!

praise.title: Mukiz’Utubonez’ iminsi yose
stanzas: Mukiz’Utubonez’ iminsi yose; Mu kubaho kwacu, tugusingize. Utubonekere, tur’abangizi; Nukw’Amahoro yaw’Atwinjiremo.
Tugendan’iteka mu byiringiro; Tubabaye nabwo, tukwizigire. Hahirw’uruhurwa n’inama zawe, Ukamutabar’ Ukamwikiriza.

praise.title: Ubugingo bwanjye bwose
stanzas: Ubugingo bwanjye bwose, Yesu, ndabukwihereye; Kand’iminsi yanjye yose, njye ngushimisha ntasiba.
Amaboko yanjye, Mwami, ajy’akor’iby’ Untegeka; Ibirenge byanjye na byo bijye bijy’ah’ Unkundiye.
Ijwi ryanjye na ryo n’uko rijye rikuririmbira; Kand’akanwa kanjy’iteka kavug’ibyo Wankoreye.
Ibyo mfite byose na byo. Simbikwima, Mwami Yesu; Kand’ubwenge bwanjye na bwo jy’Ubukoresh iby’Ushaka.
Hindur’umutima wanjye, nkund’iby’Ukunda byonyine. Sinzigeng’ ukund’ahubwo ndakugandukiye, Mwami.
Urukundo rwanjye rwose ndugukunde gusa, Yesu; Nkomeza, mb’uwaw’iteka: Ndakwihaye, sinkitwara!

praise.title: Numvise Ijwi ry’Umukiza
stanzas: Numvise ijwi ry’Umukiza, Anyihamagarira; None, mutim’ungomesha, Umvir’Umucunguzi.
Akir’ubugingo bwanjye: Mwam’ Ubwitegekere; Ubwimemo, budakurwa mu mategeko yawe.
Ujy’ukoresh’uk’Ushaka: Ubu bugingo bwanjye; byanjye ndabigutuye: Databuja, nd’uwawe.
No mu bihe byanjye byose, komeza kunshorera n’imbaraga zawe zose; Ujy’untegek’iteka.

praise.title: Wowe Mana ndaguhimbaza
stanzas: Wowe, Mana, ndaguhimbaza kukw’ari nta yindi Man’ibaho; Nguhaye n’umutima wanjye Ump’imbaraga z’Umwuka wawe, mbashe gukor’ ibikunezeza, mw’Izina ry’Umwami wacu Yesu.
