Mbese tuzumv'ishimwe ngo: Nuko, wakoze neza; Cyangw'iteka ryo gupfa ngo: Mwasanzwe mudashyitse?
Nimutyo twite kw'ijwi rye, Igihe kikiriho. Tureke gutindiganya, Tumaramaze rwose.

praise.title: Wumv'Amagambo Y'Umukiza
praise.chorus: Hahirw'abayakomeza yose, Nibo bahirwa, barahirwa; Hahirw'abayakomeza yose, Barahirwa, barahirwa.
stanzas: Wumv'amagambo y'Umukiza; Niy'aguhesh'ubugingo. Wa munyabyaha we, menya ko hahirw'abakomez'amategeko.
Kuyumva gusa nta kamaro, N'ukutugwabiza rwose; Kuyumva dutinya, ntibyadukiza, Hahirw'abayumvira yose.
Bazinjiran'umunezero mu mudugudu w'Imana, Ahatab'ishavu n'umubabaro, Beger'igiti cy'ubugingo.

praise.title: Nta Nshuti Nziz'Ihwanye Na Yesu
praise.chorus: Yes'az'ibiturushya byose; Azabana natw'iteka. Nta ncuti nziz'ihwanye na Yesu, Nta n'imwe! nta n'imwe!
stanzas: Nta nshuti nziz'ihwanye na Yesu; Nta n'imwe! nta n'imwe! Nta wundi wabasha kudukiza; Nta wundi! nta wundi!
Nta nshut'ibahw'ikomeye nka we; Nta n'imwe! nta n'imwe! Nyamara nta wiyoroshya nka we; Nta n'umwe! nta n'umwe!
Nta kanya na gato tutabana; Ye nta ko! ye nta ko! Nta joro ryira tutari kumwe; Ye nta ryo! ye nta ryo!
Mbese har'uwo yigez'ahana? Nta n'umwe! Nta n'umwe! Mbese har'umunyabyah'aheza? Nta n'umwe! nta n'umwe!
Harihw'impano yahwana nawe? Nta n'imwe! nta n'imwe! Mbese har'uwo yavuts'ijuru? nta n'umwe! nta n'umwe!

praise.title: Kurabukw'Umusaraba Wawe
praise.chorus: **S.:** Kurabukw'i Golgota, Nibyo bizambeshaho. Mbeg'amahirwe yanjye, Yo kurabukwa Yesu! **A., T. na B.:** Kurabu … Go… Golgota, Nibyo bi … mbe … mbeshaho. Mbeg'amahirwe yanjye…rwe yanjye, Yo kurabukwa Yesu! …rabukwa Yesu.
stanzas: Kurabukw'umusaraba wawe, Mwami nibyo byambeshaho; Sinita ku manjwe y'iby'isi, Ntez'agakiza ku musaraba.
Ubwo nari nkibon'Umukiza, Yanyakirany'ibyishimo; Na n'ubu ningir'ibindwanya, Kumurabukwa nibyo byankiza.
Nzajya mpang'amas'umusaraba, Kandi mwiringire rwose. Nta wutumbir'umusaraba, Wari wiger'aneshwa n'Umwanzi.

praise.title: Yesu Araguhamagaran'Ituza
praise.chorus: Ngwino (ngwino); Ngwino (ngwino); Abarushye mwese nimuze. Yes'araguhamagaran'ituza, ati: Mukundwa, ngwino.
stanzas: Yes'araguhamagaran'ituza, Ub'arahamagara; Ategereje k'umwiyegurira, We kuzuyaza; ngwino.
Twatinzwa n'iki, kand'ategereje kuturokora twese? Twahinyuzwa n'ik'imbabazi zose adufitiye twese?
Twakererew'ibihe birahita, Aradutegereje; Turarindagirira mu mwijima; Nimutyo tumusange.
Zirikan'urukundo ruhebuje, Yadusezeranije; N'ubwo twagomye, Tuzababarirwa; Aradutegereje.

praise.title: Har'Irembo RyuguruyeH
praise.chorus: Mbeg'ineza n'imbabazi byatumye nugururirwa! Nugururiwe, Iman'ihimbazwe!
stanzas: Har'irembo ryuguruwe, Ryatumye mpishurirwa. Umusaraba wa kure, Yesu yatangiyeho.
Irembo ryugururiwe abashak'agakiza; Ngw'abakire n'abakene bose barinyuremo.
Nshuti komez'utwaran'irembo ricyuguruwe. Ikorer'umusaraba; Nibw'uzahabw'ikamba.
Tumaze kwambuk'uruzi, Dute wa musaraba; Twambikw'amakamba meza, Twitahire mw'ijuru.

praise.title: Umukiz'Ageze HafiH
praise.chorus: Nta wuhwany'izina nawe, Rirut'amazina yose. Nta wusingizwa nkawe; Yesu mwiza rwose.
stanzas: Umukiz'ageze hafi, Yes'Umukunzi wanjye. Yazanywe no guhembura; Mwese nimumwumvire.
Icyubahiro kib'icye; Mutyo twizere Yesu. Nkund'izina ry'Umukiza; Nkund'izina rya Yesu.
Izina rye rirankiza, Rikamar'agahinda. Nta kinezeza nko kumva, Iryo zina rya Yesu.
N'az'azatugororera, Ikamba ry'ubugingo. Ubwo nibwo tuzicara, Tuvug'iby'agakiza.

praise.title: Ntacyo Wasigiye Yesu
stanzas: Dor'umutima wawe, Wuzuyemw'amaganya. Nta mwanya wasigiye Yesu ngo yinjiremo? Ub'ahagaze ku rugi, Arakomanga yinginga. Nta mwanya wasigiye Yesu ngo yinjiremo?
Upfush'igih'ubusa, Kand'ar'ingenzi rwose. Mbese nta mwany'ufite wo gukorera Yesu? Nturarushy'ugerageza gutarur'abazimiye; Mbese nta mwany'ufite wo gukorera Yesu?
Mbese k'umaranira kwishakir'ubutunzi, Nta gih'ufite washishikarir'ibya Yesu? Dor'uharanira kwikubir'ibinezeza by'isi; Nta gih'ufite washishikarir'ibya Yesu?
Wabay'ingumba nk'igiti cy'ibibabi gusa. Mbese ntabwo wazerer'Umwami Yes'imbuto? Ntacy'ufite cyo kuzamumurikira n'agaruka; Mbese ntabwo wazerer'Umwami Yes'imbuto?

praise.title: Mwami Ndumv'Ijwi Ryawe
praise.chorus: Mukiza ndaje, Ubu nj'ah'uri! Nyejesha ya maraso, Wamviriye kera.
stanzas: Mwami ndumv'ijwi ryawe, Rindarika ngo nze, Nuhagizwe ya maraso, Wamviriye kera.
N'ubwo nje nahindanye, Ntunyirengagize; Ahubw'umboneze rwose, Mb'umweru waka de.
Yesu niw'unkomeza, Niw'umpa gutsinda; Ng'urukundo n'amahoro, Binsabemo rwose.
Mwese nimwishimire! Ya maras'akiza, Yatwujuje na Rurema, Ngo tub'abana be.

praise.title: Ndumv'Umukiz'Ambwira
praise.chorus: Yanndihiriye imyenda yose; Yambabariy'ibyaha, Bihinduk'umweru.
stanzas: Ndumv'Umukiz'ambwira, Ko mbuz'imbaraga; Ngo: Njye museng'iteka, Ntacyo nzamuburana.
Niw'ufit'imbaraga, Zihagije rwose; Zo gukiz'ababembe, Zikoroshy'umutima.
Ubwo nta cyiza nkora, Nibesherejweho; N'ubuntu bwawe gusa, Ni wowe nkesha byose.
Imbere ya ya ntebe, Nzahahagarara; Nzaba njyany'iminyago, Nyishyikirize Yesu.

praise.title: Harihw'Isokw'Itukura
praise.chorus: Nduz'umuvu w'amaraso; Ndayogamo nere rwose! Haleluya! Aranyeza, Aranyeza, Aranyeza!
stanzas: Harihw'isokw'itukura, Ivamw'amaraso; Niy'Umwami yamviriye, Ngw'ayandokoreshe.
Mpinduts'icyaremwe gishya, Mbyaw'ubwa kabiri. Ntsinze kamere ya kera, Nzahora ndi mushya.
Nsigaye mvirwa n'umucyo, Sinkirindagira; Nshitse ku ngoyi z'umwanzi, Mbatuwe na Yesu.
Mbeg'ubuntu butangaje! Kwejeshw'amaraso! Byanyujuje n'Umukiza, Yesu wambambiwe.

praise.title: Data Ndambuy'Amaboko
stanzas: Data, ndambuy'amaboko; Nta wundi wamfasha; Iy'unyivumburiy'ukamvaho, Mbes'ahandi najya ni he?
Nizey'Umwana waw'ubu, Undem'umutima; Ujy'unkenur'umar'ubukene, Nkomeze nemerwe nawe.
Nyir'ukwizera ni wowe, Nuburiy'amaso; Icyamp'ukangwiriza kwizera, Kuko ntagufite napfa.
Ntuzantererane ngo mpfe, Ahubw'umbesheho; Nibwo nzacika ku kinyoma, Mbishobojwe n'Umwuka wawe.
Nakwishima cyane rwose, Nibaniye nawe; Maze nkakumv'umpumuriz'umbwira ko nagiriw'ubuntu.
Nizeye rwos'ubu yuko, Yesu yampfiriye; Kandi kubw'amaraso ye yeza, Nzabaturwa mve mu byaha.

praise.title: Nzasingiz'Urukundo Rwa Yesu
praise.chorus: Nzasingiz'urukundo rwe; Mpimbaze, Yaramfiriye, Ashaka kumbeshaho; Nzahora muhimbaza.
stanzas: Nzasingiz'urukundo rwa Yesu, Wambambiwe; Yemeye kumanuka, Azanywe no kumpfira.
Yesu yambabarijwe, Ntararushya mbabara; Yahoze ansabira, Ntarameny'iyo bijya.
Urukundo rw'Imana, Mbega ngo rurankiza! Ibyaha byanjye byose, Bikantamururwaho!
Nta cyiza nakoreye, Umwami wankunz'atyo; None maze kwemezwa, Mwami nguhaye byose.

praise.title: Nyigiza Hafi
stanzas: Nyigiza hafi, mbane nawe; Nta cyandutira kubana nawe. Ngumisha mu gituza cyawe; Mpisha nibere mu buhungiro; Mpisha nibere mu buhungiro.
Nyigiza hafi, ntacyo mfite; Ntacyo nzanyehw'ituro ry'Umwami, Kerets'umutim'ushavuye; Mpa kuhagizw'amaraso yawe; Mpa kuhagizw'amaraso yawe.
Nyigiza hafi, Mwami wanjye; Nishimiye gucika ku byaha. Ndeke kwikuza n'ubwibone; Umpe Yes'Umwami wambambiwe; Umpe Yes'Umwami wambambiwe.
Nyigiza hafi, ngihumeka; Kugez'ubwo nzager'i Budapfa; Maze mu bihe bidashira, Nzibere hafi y'Umwami wanjye; Nzibere hafi y'Umwami wanjye.

praise.title: Har'Izina Rihebuje
praise.chorus: Ni ryo zina ryera (izina); Ni ryo zina ryera (ryera de)! Ryakomotse ku Mana, Riza mw'isi, Maze riririmbwa (izina) n'abamarayika (ryera de). Iryo zina n'irya Yesu.
stanzas: Har'izina rihebuje, Rirut'ayandi yose nzi; Ni ry'Imana yaturemye yis'Umwana way'ikunda.
Niryo rimpesh'umugisha; Nkunda kuryogez'iteka. Simpwema kuriririmba, Mvug'ukuntu rihebuje.
Icyampa nkaririmbana n'abamarayika bera, Nkajya nsingiza rya zina rihebuj'ayandi yose!

praise.title: Yesu Gusa
stanzas: Yesu gusa, niw'ukwiriy'ikuzo; Naho jyewe, ntacyo ndi cyo rwose; Sinkwiriye kub'ari jyew'uratwa; Yesu gusa, niw'uzajy'uvugwa.
Yesu gusa, niw'umar'agahinda; Naho jyewe nd'uwo gushavura. Sinshobora kwikorer'ibindushya; Naho Yesu nta kimushengura.
Yesu gusa, ab'ari we wogezwa; Sinkwiriye kwiratan'ibyanjye. Yesu gusa, niw'uzambonekamo; Kugez'ubwo nzahinduka nka we.
Yesu gusa niw'umar'ubukene; Niwe gusa nkesh'ibyanjye byose. Yesu gusa, niw'undutira byose; Yesu Mwami twibanir'iteka.

praise.title: Nk'Ukw'Izuba Rituvira
praise.chorus: Mbeg'umucyo w'agatangaza, Wansabye mu mutima! Ineza y'Umwami Yesu, Yambereye nk'umucyo.
stanzas: Nkukw'izuba rituvira, Rikarabagirana, Nik'umucyo wo mw'ijuru wansabye mu mutima, Wawukuyemw'iby'amanjwe, Utangaz'ibihishwe; Kuko mu mutima wanjye, Nahatuj'Umukiza.
Natay'agahinda kose; Ntabwo nkikitayeho; Kuk'unyambik'amahoro, Ameze nk'umwitero, Nkwerekejeh'umutima, Ndakwishimiye cyane. Nzagezw'i wawe mw'ijuru, Na rwa rukundo rwawe.
Mukiza warancunguye; Nd'uwaw'uko ndi kose. Nyemerera nguhimbaze, Nkuber'umucyo waka. Nkwerekejeh'umutima, Ndakwishimiye cyane. Nzagezw'i wawe mw'ijuru, Na rwa rukundo rwawe.

praise.title: Njya Nkunda Kuririmb'Indirimbo
praise.chorus: **Sop:** Kuk'ubwe yancunguye; Kuk'ubwe yancunguye, Nzahimbaz'izina rye. Kuk'ubwe yancunguye, Nzaririmbir'uwandokoye. **A.T.B.:** Kuk'ubwe yancunguye; Kuk'ubwe yancunguye; Kuk'ubwe yancunguye, Nzahimbaz'izina rye. Kuk'ubwe yancunguye, Kuk'ubwe yancunguye; Nzaririmbir'uwandokoye.
stanzas: Njya nkunda kuririmb'indirimbo, Ngo yarancunguye. Niwe waciy'ingoyi z'umwanzi, Maz'arambatura.
Mfit'Umukiz'unogeye rwose, Niwe wancunguye. Mpimbazwa no gukor'iby'ashaka, Kuko yancunguye.
Nzahora mpamya ntacyo nikenga, Yuko yancunguye. Sinzashidikanya ngo ncogore, Kuko yancunguye.
Mfit'aho yanteguriye heza, Kuko yancunguye. Niho nzibanira naw'iteka, Kuko yancunguye.

praise.title: Iman'Ikund'Utunyoni
praise.chorus: Irankunda, irankunda; Nzi ko nanjy'inkunda; Kukw'ikund'utuntu duto, Nzi ko nanjy'inkunda.
stanzas: Iman'ikund'utunyoni, Tuba mur'iyi si; Ubwo yita ku tunyoni, Nzi ko nanjy'inkunda.
Niy'irimbish'uburabyo, Buhumura neza; Ubw'ikund'uburaby'ityo, Nzi ko nanjy'inkunda.
Imana yaremye byose, Ntigir'icy'isobwa. Nzi kw'ikund'abana bose, Nzi ko nanjy'inkunda.

praise.title: N'Igihe Cyo Gusengat
praise.chorus: N'igihe cyiza cyo kuramy'Umwami, Mbeg'ihumure ryiza, ryo kwibanira na we!
stanzas: N'igihe cyo gusenga, Twicishe bugufi, Duteraniye hamwe turamya Yesu, Nituza tumwizeye, Azajy'aturinda; Mbeg'ihumure ryiza, ryo kwibanira nawe
N'igihe cyo gusenga, Umwam'ari hafi, Kand'adufitiy'ibambe rya kibyeyi. Tumuganyir'ibyacu, Dushir'agahinda; Mbeg'ihumure ryiza, ryo kumvikana nawe!
N'igihe cyo gusenga, no gushyikirana, N'Imana yac'ihor'ituzirikana, Iturem'agatima, tub'indahangarwa; Mbeg'ihumure ryiza, ryo kumvikana nawe!
N'igihe cyo gusenga, twiringiye Yesu. Twizeye kw'azaduh'ibyo, tumusaba, Kukw'atangan'ubuntu, ataziganije. Mbeg'ihumure ryiza, ryo gutabarwa nawe!

praise.title: Yesu Waduhay'Isezerano
stanzas: Yesu waduhaye isezerano, K'uzabana natwe, niduterana, Naho twaba babiri, Cyangwa batatu, Uzab'uri kumwe n'abana bawe. Gusubiramo: Yesu, ngwin'uduhire, Tutarava hano; Yesu ngwin'uduhire ubu, Tuban'iteka.
Wateranye natwe, mu bindi bihe, Ariko na n'ubu turakwifuza. Ngwino, Mubyeyi mwiza, Turakwinginze; Twumvir'utwemere, Duhirwe nawe.
Wakir'indirimbo z'ishimwe ryacu, Uduhe gusenga tubyitayeho. Twongerere kwizera, No kwiringira; Dukundane rwose, Dushyire hamwe.

praise.title: Nd'Uwawe, Mwami
praise.chorus: **S.A:** Hafi yawe, Nibyo nifuza, Ku musaraba wawe. Hafi yawe, Mwami, tuban'iteka, Njye nibanira nawe. **T.B:** Hafi yawe cyane, ni byo nifuza, Ku musaraba wawe. Hafi yawe, Mwami, Tuban'iteka, Njye nibanira nawe.
stanzas: Nd'uwawe Mwami, Ubu nditanze; Numvis'ubury'udukunda. Nsingiriz'amabok'untabare, Njye nibanire nawe.
Nkwiyeguriye namaramaje, Nkoresh'umurimo wawe; Nkwerekejeh'umutima wanjye, Ng'uhor'ugengwa nawe.
Kubana nawe birahebuje, Nibyo bindutira byose. Iyo mpfukamye nkakuganyira, Dusabana nk'inshuti.
Sinashobora kukurondora, Ngo mmeny'urukundo rwawe. Ruzahishurwa turi mw'ijuru, Aho twateguriwe.

praise.title: Ndusheho Gusa Nawe
stanzas: Ndusheho gusa nawe, Yesu Mukiza wanjye; Nyuzuz'ubugwaneza, Mp'urukundo ruhebuje. Ndusheho kumera nkawe, Aho ngenda hose, Mwami; Ndiyoroheje rwose, Mwami njye ngukurikiza.
Nib'irind'icyanira, Ikamenya n'igishwi; Sinshidikanya rwose, Nanjy'ihor'inyitayeho. Izanyigisha kwitonda, Imbabarir'amafuti; Ndiyoroheje rwose, Mwami njye ngukurikiza.
Ndusheho gusa nawe, Ndusheh'uko bukeye; Nyigiza hafi yawe, Ahw'amahor'adashira. Uhor'umpindura mushya, Kubw'urukund'ungirira; Ndiyoroheje rwose, Mwami njye ngukurikiza.

praise.title: Yesu, Unkomereze Ku Musaraba
praise.chorus: Umusaraba wa Yesu nzawirata, Kugez'ubwo nzabona uburuhukiro.
stanzas: Yes'unkomereze, Ku musaraba wawe; Har'isokw'ibeshaho, Itemb'i Kal'vari.
Hafi y'umusaraba, Mpaboner'iteka, Imbabazi n'impuhwe, Bitarondoreka.
Hafi y'umusaraba, Intama y'Imana, Niyo yahangejeje, Ntsind'ibimbabaza.
Hafi y'umusaraba, Niho ntegereje; Niringiye kugera, Mu bwami bw'Imana.

praise.title: Nyemerera Ngendane Nawe
stanzas: Nyemerera ngendane nawe, Mana, Nk'ukw'Enoki yagenje. Nyoboresh'ukuboko kwawe, Unyerekez'ah'ushaka hose. Nubw'inzir'itagaragara, Nkomeze njyane nawe, Mwami.
Ntabwo nahangara kugenda, Ntari kumwe nawe, Mukiza; Nagoswe n'abanz'igihumbi; Dor'imitegw'intaye hagati. Burije rwose, ntihabona, Nkomeze njyane nawe, Mwami.
Ninguma mu maboko yawe, Sinzaba ncyitaye ku by'isi; Nta kindi nziratana rwose, Keretse wa musaraba wawe, Ngez'ubwo nzager'i Siyoni, Nkomeze njyane nawe, Mwami.

praise.title: Icyampa Nkarangurura
praise.chorus: Urukundo ruhebuje! Urukundo rwa Yesu! Urukundo ruhebuje! Urukundo rwa Yesu!
stanzas: Icyampa nkarangurura, Ngahimbaz'Umwami wanjye, Ariko ni nde wabasha kuririmb'ishimwe rya Yesu?
Niwe munezero wanjye, Ni naw'umpesh'amahoro. Mu makuba no mu byago, Yesu niw'umber'ihumure.
Niwe byiringiro byanjye, Byo kuzahabw'ubugingo. Mu mwijim'amber'umucyo, Yesu niw'umber'ihumure.

praise.title: Mwami Nzi Kw'Ari We Nkunda
praise.chorus: Urukundo rwankijije (ngakira), Ntirurondoreka. Ntitwarusobanukirwa (na hato), Kuko ruhebuje (ruhebuje).
stanzas: Mwami, nzi kw'ari We nkunda, Kurut'iby'iyi si; Kuko wampay'amahoro, Atagir'impinduka.
Nzi k'uhor'unzirikana, Undutira byose, Mwami, kugutekereza bindutir'ibyiratwa.
Wanyujuj'umunezero, Natay'umuruho. Kumenya k'unkunda cyane, Nibyo bimpumuriza.
Mucunguzi wanjye mwiza, Icyakunyereka! Ngo tuzabane mw'ijuru, Ahatab'agahinda.

praise.title: Ahw'Azanyobora Hose
praise.chorus: Yes'azanyobor'iteka, Maz'angez'iw'amahoro; Kukw'ar'inshuti y'ukuri, Itigeze guhemuka.
stanzas: Ahw'azanyobora hose, Niho nzishimira kujya; Kukw'ari jye yapfiriye, Akanzir'atacumuye.
Nishimira kw'antegeka, Nishimira kw'anyobora. Nishimira kumwumvira, Kukw'ari jye yapfiriye.
Singishidikanya rwose, Kuko ndi kumwe na Yesu. Nizigiye ko vub'aha, Nzamureba duhanganye.

praise.title: Isi Ndayihararutse, Mpisemo Yesu
praise.chorus: Imbabazi zidashira, N'urukundo rw'iteka, Nibyo bijya binyemeza, Ko nzaramishwa nawe.
stanzas: Isi ndayihararutse, Mpisemo Yesu gusa. Mpaz'umunezero wayo, Uzashirana nayo.
Isi ndayihararutse, Mpisemo Yesu gusa. Mu kaga niwe humure; Nzahora nezerewe.
Isi ndayihararutse, Mpisemo Yesu gusa. Icyamp'akamwenyurira, Nkamurikirwa nawe.
Isi ndayihararutse, Mpisemo Yesu gusa. Nzirat'umusaraba we, Yatangiyeho kera.

praise.title: Mwami Wanjye, Nyakira
praise.chorus: Nyuhagiz'amaraso yawe (nere rwose); Maz'anyezehw'inenge yose (nere rwose); Ibyanjye byose ndabikweguriye, None n'iteka ryose.
stanzas: Mwami wanjye nyakira, Ndakwiyeguriy'ubu; Ngay'amaboko yanjye, Yakoresh'uk'ushaka.
Ngib'ibirenge byanjye, Byerekez'ah'ushaka. Ngir'ijwi ryanjye na ryo, Rijye riguhimbaza.
Nguhay'akanwa kanjye; Mwami, kakuvugire. Ngub'ubutunzi bwanjye, Sinzagir'icyo nkwima.
Nguhay'igihe cyanjye, Sinzakiguteraho; Nguhay'ubwenge bwanjye, Bukoresh'uk'ushaka.
Ngiy'imigambi yanjye; Igengwe nawe, Mwami. Nguy'umutima wanjye, Ube uwawe rwose.
Mwam'urukundo rwanjye, Ni wowe nzarukunda; Nkwihaye nimazeyo, None n'iteka ryose.

praise.title: Nabony'Inshut'Ihebuje
stanzas: Nabony'inshut'ihebuje! Yankunze ntarabaho; Yanyiyegereshej'ineza, N'urukundo rw'iteka, Bituma dushyikirana, Ubudatandukana; Kuko nd'uwe nawe n'uwanjye, Ibihe bidashira.
Nabony'inshut'ihebuje! Yamberey'impongano. Urets'ibyo kump'ubugingo, Yaranyitangiriye. Ntacyo mfite nit'icyanjye, Kuko tubisangiye. Ndamwiyeguriye burundu; Ibihe bidashira.
Nabony'inshut'ihebuje! Nyir'ubutware bwose! Nibw'indindish'uko bukeye; Izangeza mw'ijuru. Ibyiza byanshyizw'imbere, Binsubizamw'intege; Reka nkore, noye kwiganda, Ngez'ubw'izanduhura.
Nabony'incut'ihebuje! Y'impuhwe n'urukundo. Niy'indind'ikanyunganira; Niy'indenger'iteka. Mbese n'iki cyadutanya, Ko dukundana rwose? N'iby'iyi si, cyangwa s'urupfu? Oya nzab'uw'iteka.

praise.title: Numvise Yesu Ambwira Ati
stanzas: Numvise Yes'ambwir'ati: Ngwino nkuruhure. Zan'ibikurushya byose, Mbikwikorerere. Musanga, mez'uko nari ndi, ndushye, mfite n'ishavu; Amber'uburuhukiro, Maz'aranezeza.
Numvise Yes'ambwir'ati: Ndaguher'ubuntu, Amaz'azakubeshaho, Unyw'uram'iteka. Nuko nsanga Yesu maz'ampa ya mazi y'ubugingo, Nshir'inyota, Ndahembuka; Nzahorana nawe.
Numvise Yes'ambwir'ati: Ni jye Mucyo w'isi. N'undeb'uramurikirwa, Ntuzarindagira. Maze muhanz'amaso koko, Mbon'ar'izuba ryanjye; Rizamvir'iminsi yose y'ubugingo bwanjye.

praise.title: Mwami Mb'Uwawe Maramaje
praise.chorus: Mb'uwawe (Mwami) ; Mb'uwawe (Mwami) ; Niyo migambi yanjye ; Mb'uwawe (Mwami); Mb'uwawe (Mwami) ; Mb'uwawe Mwami, None.
stanzas: Mwami, mb'uwawe maramaje, Nyigisha, nyigisha. Nkor'iby'ukunda, Mwami wanjye; Komez'umfashe.
Iby'iyi si byamarir'iki, Ntari kumwe nawe? Byose nzabihara kubwawe, Ntungishwe nawe.
Ndets'umunezero w'iyi si, Ngwino twibanire; Nibyo bizajya binogera, Bimpumurize.

praise.title: Mbeg'Umuns'Urush'Indi Kwera
stanzas: Mbeg'umuns'urush'indi kwera; Niwo wa karindwi! Ng'uratuma ndek'iby'isi, Nkibwir'iby'ijuru!
Mbeg'uyu munsi wa karindwi, Turuhukiramo, Ng'uradutera kuramya Data, Wo mw'ijuru!
Ni mutyo turamy'Uhoraho, Watuzirikanye, Agaherakw'akaduha, Uyu munsi wera.
Niw'utugobotor'ibyaha, Bikaducikaho, Kukw'atugirir'ubuntu, Buvuye mw'ijuru.

praise.title: Udusezeresh'Umugisha Wawe
stanzas: Udusezeresh'umugisha wawe; Mwam'utwuzuz'amahoro; Urukundo rwawe rudusabemo, Tubone kunesha rwose. Ngwin'uduhembure, Ngwin'uduhembure; Tukiri mur'iyi si y'igomero.
Tuguhay'ishimwe no kukuramya, Kubw'ubutumwa bw'imvaho, Bwagukomotseho bukadukiza, Bunyur'imitima yacu; Tubushikamemo, Tubushikamemo; Tugundir'ukuri, Tudacogora.
Mbeshwaho n'imbabazi zawe nyinshi, None ndakwiyeguriye. Ngwin'uduhumurish'impuhwe zawe, Duhore turwan'ishyaka; Tuzager'i wawe, Tuzager'iwawe; Tukubone nta kidukingirije.

praise.title: Mukiza, Ndamaramaje
praise.chorus: Nzamura maze nger'aho wangeneye, Mwami wanjye; Ku rugero rusumbyeho; Mwami mfasha ngo ndusheho.
stanzas: Mukiza, ndamaramaje, Ndatwaranira kugera, Ku rugero runkwiriye; Mwami mfasha ngo ndusheho.
Ntabwo ngifit'umutima, Wo kuguma mu by'iyi si; N'ubwo bamwe babikunda, Ngambiriye kujya mbere.
Ndashaka gusumb'iby'isi, Nubw'umwanz'anyibasiye; Kuko namaze kwizera, Yukw'Iman'izandengera.
Ndashaka kumaranira, Kurabukw'ubwiza bwawe; Ariko nkomeze nsenge, Ngez'ubwo nzager'i wawe.

praise.title: Ntushak'Urwitwazo
praise.chorus: Itaba! (none); Ntushak'urwitwazo; Itaba! (none); Wigingimiranya. Ntushak'urwitwazo, Udasubizwa ngo: Hoshi wampinyuye; Nkuvukij'ubwami.
stanzas: Ntushak'urwitwazo, Harihw'imirimo, Ahubw'itegure gukorer'Imana. Yakwinginze kenshi, Kand'ikurarika; Witinda kwemera, Bizakunezeza.
Ntushak'urwitwazo urahamagawe; Dor'aho wangiye, Noneho witabe. Imirim'ireze, Hagumy'abakozi; Ngwin'umukorere; Uzagororerwa.
Ntushak'urwitwazo, Kuko nib'utinze, Bizagukoraho, Izakwivumbura. Imbabazi zayo, Ntabwo zirashira; Haguruka bwangu, Ubibabarirwe.

praise.title: Yesu Mwami W'Abami
stanzas: Yesu Mwami w'abami, Ngwin'ube muri jye! He kub'ari jy'uvuga, Ujy'umvugiramo. Unsabe mu mutima, Ngengwe nawe rwose, Maz'abajya bandeba, Bajye bakubona.
Ndakwiyeguriy'ubu, Ez'ibyaha byanjye; Ngaragareh'ubwiza bwawe buhebuje. Ngir'umutim'utuje, Ne guteraganwa; Niyoroshye nganduke, Ngo nkoreshwe nawe.
Ingingo zanjye zose, Zijye zikumvira; Uzikoreshereze, Zikubahirize. Ne kujya nivovota, Ngo mpore ku nkeke. Y'ibimbaho, nishama, Nta mahoro mfite.
Ni wowe ntegereje, Ungenz'uk'ushaka. Ubwanjye nditeguye, Simfit'ikinziga. Yesu Mwami w'abami, Ngwin'ube muri jye! Maz'ibyo nkora byose, Mbikoreshwe nawe.

praise.title: Data Mwiza, Nyigiza Hafi
praise.chorus: **S.na A:** Data, nyigiza hafi, Ndifuza ko tubana; Data, ndifuza ko tubana. **T. na B:** Data, data, nyigiza hafi, Ndifuza cyane ko tubana; Data, nyigiza hafi; ndifuza ko tubana, Ndifuza ko tubana.
stanzas: Data mwiza, nyigiza hafi; Nkube mu gituza; Ni wowe buhungiro bwanjye, N'uburuhukiro.
Data mwiza, nyigiza hafi; Nkomeza ntundeke; Nakwishimira ko tubana, Ne kuraragira.
Data mwiza, nyigiza hafi; Ngez'ubwo nsa nawe; Mpembur'unyuhagir'unyeze, Mb'umuziranenge.

praise.title: Aho Njyanye Na Yesu
praise.chorus: Aho njyanye nawe, nta kintinyisha, Aho njyanye na Yesu mb'amahoro.
stanzas: Aho njyanye na Yesu mb'amahoro, Ahw'anyobora hose mur'iyi si. Aho njya tutajyanye nta kinyura, Iyo njyanye na Yesu ntacyo ntinya.
Aho njyanye na Yesu sinigunga, Nubw'izindi nshuti zampemukira; Nubw'anyobora mu nzir'iruhije, Aho njyanye na Yesu ndanezerwa.
Njyanye na Yesu sinatiny'urupfu, N'iyo ngoswe n'umwijima w'icyago, Nzi ko nzakanguk'ubutazongera, Kujarajarira mur'iy'isi mbi.

praise.title: Nshuti Jy'ugendera Mu Mucyo
praise.chorus: **S. na A:** Gendera mu mucyo, Gendera mu mucyo; Gendera mu mucyo, Mu mucyo waka w'Imana. **T. na B.:** Gendera mu mucy'utangaje w'Imana; Gendera mu mucy'utangaje w'Imana; Gendera mu mucy'utangaje w'Imana; Mu mucyo waka w'Imana;
stanzas: Nshuti jy'ugendera mu mucyo, Woye kurindagira; Umwuka Wera wo mw'ijuru, Ajy'akuyobora.
Gendera mu mucyo w'ukuri, Ko mw'Ijambo ry'Imana; Uzajy'ukuyobor'iteka, Ukwizez'Imana.
Jy'ugendera mu mucy'iteka, Ujy'ukumurikira; Maz'utamurur'umwijima, Hose hatangaze.
Gendera mu mucyo ng'umenye, Urukundo rw'Imana, N'uburyo yakunze ab'isi, Ikabarokora.

praise.title: Mbes'Abasaruzi Bari He?
praise.chorus: Abasaruzi se bari he? Ngo bafatanye natwe gusarura, Maze twishime, Turi kumwe, Isarura nirirangira.
stanzas: Mbes'abasaruzi bari hehe, Bo gusarur'abakiranutsi? Babangir'ukurink'imihoro, Kandi ntibab'ar'abanyabute.
Mushakire mu mihana yose; Nubw'urwiri rwarenga ku ngano; Muzishake kuko zirurimo, Zose muzisarurir'Imana.
Dor'imirima yereye rimwe, Kandi bose bitez'isarura; Arikw'abasaruzi ni bake, Umurimo wab'urabasaze.
Mwa bantu mwe, Mwahur'imihoro! Musarur'igihe kirageze! Mushishikare Umwam'araje; Dor'abazaniy'ingororano!

praise.title: Ngamij'Iby'Igihugu Cy'Igikundiro
praise.chorus: Mbes'ikamba ryanjye Yes'azamperayo, Azaritakahw'inyenyeri (inyenyeri)? Ningir'amahirwe, Nkabana na Yesu, Azaritakahw'inyenyeri (inyenyeri)?
stanzas: Ngamij'iby'igihugu cy'igikundiro; Nzageray'izuba rirenze. Ariko s'ikamba Yes'azamperayo, Azaritakahw'inyenyeri?
Reka nkore, nsenge, mbiheshejwe nawe, Mugarurir'abazimiye. N'agaruka kuri wa munsi w'ubwiza, Nzatakwehw'inyenyeri nyinshi.
Mbeg'umunezer'uhebuje nzagira, Nimwerek'abo nakijije, Mfite n'ibyishimo bitavugwa, Mbonye inyenyeri kw'ikamba ryanjye.

praise.title: Ngwino Yesu
praise.chorus: Mbwiz'ijwi ryongorera, Mbwiran'urukundo; Ut'uzanesh'iteka, Ub'umudendezo. Vugana nanjy'iteka, Mbwir'ubudahwema, Reka numv'uk'umbwira ngo: Sinaguhanye.
stanzas: Ngwino Yes'uvugane, N'umutima wanjye: Maz'umpumuriz'uti: Ntabwo nagusize. Nyugurur'umutima, Nihutire kumva, Ijwi ryawe ry'impuhwe, Nyuzuz'ibyishimo.
Yobora abana bawe, Uvugane nabo; Ubuzuz'ibyishimo, Bige kugusenga. Mwami, Bitange rwose, Bakwiyegurire; Tebuts'ubwami bwawe, Twibanire nawe.
Ngwin'uvugane natwe, Uduhishurire, Iby'imigambi yawe, N'inshingano yacu, Duhe kuguhimbaza, Tukubahirize, Tujye tunezererwa gukor'iby'ushaka.

praise.title: Mwami, Sinsabir'Iby'Ejo
stanzas: Mwami, sinsabir'iby'ejo, Mfasha none, Ndind'urukongi rw'ibyaha, Uyu munsi. Ne gucumuz'ururimi, Mputiyeho; Mwami, rind'iminwa yanjye, Uyu munsi.
Njye nshunguz'ubury'umwete, No gusenga; Ngwe neza mu buryo bwose, Uyu munsi. Nkomeze nkor'iby'ushaka, Ngire bwangu; Mwami, nemere kwitanga, Uyu munsi.
Urupfu niruntungura, Mbe ntunganye; Amasezerano yawe, Ndayiteze; Mwami, sinsabir'iby'ejo, Mfasha none; Ndind'unkomez'undagire, Uyu munsi; Amen.

praise.title: Murinzi We, Ngaho Mbwira
stanzas: Murinzi we, ngaho mbwira, Mbese bugiye gucya? Nta bimenyets'urabona, K'Umwami yegereje? Mugenzi we haguruka! Umusek'uratambitse; Tyo kenyera, maz'ukeshe, Haguruka; bwakeye!
Murinzi we, dor'umucyo, Ukomeje gukwira! Reba naw'ibimenyetso, Bitangaza kuza kwe. Ubw'impanda zizavuga, Abapfuye bazazuka. Ubutazongera gupfa, Bibanire n'Umwami.
Murinzi we, vuz'impundu, Igihe kirageze! Mwese nimurangurure, Mubyamamaze hose. Mugenzi we, nawe reba; Ubwami bugeze hafi; Ngiriya Yerusalemu, Irarabagirana.
Murinzi, mur'uwo murwa, W'igikundiro rwose, Nih'Umwami w'i Sioni, Adutegerereje. Ubwami bwe buragutse, Buhetuy'iyi si yose; N'ubwami budahanguka; Hahirw'ababujyamo.
Murinzi dor'igihugu, Cy'uburumbuke cyane, Gihora kimeze neza, Nka Edeni ya kera. Gira bwangu ntuzarire, Hasigay'igihe gito, Abacungujw'amaraso bakagerayo vuba.

praise.title: Aho Nzahamagarwa Hose
praise.chorus: Nzajy'ah'unshakira hose, Mwami; Mu misozi no mu bibaya. Nzavug'iby'ushaka ko mvuga Mwami, Kandi nzaba nk'uk'ushaka.
stanzas: Aho nzahamagarwa hose, Ari no mu misozi, Cyangwa ku rugamba rukaze, Mubyeyi, n'unkenera, Ukambwiz'ijwi ryawe ritoya, Ukannyuz'inzira ntazi, Nzakwishyira mu maboko, mvuge nti: Nzajy'ah'unshakira hose.
Ahari Yes'ashaka yuko muvugir'uyu munsi; Ahari habonek'impabe, Nkwiriye guhabura; Murokozi wanjye, N'unyobora, N'ahar'ibihanamanga; Sinzareka kogez'inkuru yawe; Nzajy'ah'unshakira hose.

Ntabwo nshidikanya, Har'aho Mwam'ushaka ko nkora, Mu kubaho kwanjye kugufi, Nkorer'Uwambambiwe. Mwami, Nkubikij'ibyanjye byose, Nzi k'unkunda bitangaje. Nzakor'iby'ushaka, mbikunze cyane; Nzajy'ah'unshakira hose.

praise.title: Amagambo Y'Umujinya
praise.chorus: **S. na A.:** Mukundane rwose; Yes'aravug'ati: Ngir'itegeko ryanjye mbahaye: Mukundane rwose, Yes'aravug'ati: Bana banjye, mukundane. **B.na T.:** Mukundane, Mukundane; Ngir'itegeko ryanjye: Mukundane, Mukundane; n'itegeko rye.
stanzas: Amagambo y'umujinya, Ntakabave mu kanwa! Ahubw'umutim'uyacuby'atararushy'asohoka.
Urukundo n'imbonera, N'ubucuti, birera; Byab'ishyano kubyicisha, Ubupfu bw'akanya gato.
Amagambo y'intonganya, Ntaregama mu kanwa, Ijambo rimwe ry'intonganya, Ritandukany'inshuti.

praise.title: N'Igihe Cy'Isarura
praise.chorus: Yemwe ga ngo zirakura! Reba uko zingana! Imirima yos'ireze, N'igihe cy'isarura.
stanzas: Nib'umunt'agend'arira, Asohoy'imbuto nziza, Ntacogora ngw'agw'isari, Ahirwa n'Uwiteka.
Ikime kiva mw'ijuru, N'umucy'urabagirana. Bizatum'imbuto zera, Kubw'ubuntu bw'Imana.
Bib'imbuto wicogora, Woye gukuk'umutima, N'ubw'iby'ubon'ar'umwaku, Uzasarur'ishimwe.

praise.title: Isarura Ry'Isi Riregereje
praise.chorus: **S.:** Mugire bwangu, muhunik'imiba; Mugire bwangu, nimuze. **A.T.B.:** Mugire bwangu mwese; Nimuze muhunik'imiba ye. Nimuze mugire bwangu mwese; Nimuze mwese nimuze.
stanzas: Isarura ry'isi riregereje, Yes'arahamagar'abasaruzi. Dor'imirim'irez'ahantu hose, Nimuzan'imihoro musarure!
Uwo muns'utazabamw'amarira, Uhora wegerej'uko bukeye. Imyaka yararitswe n'umuyaga, Mugire bwangw'imvur'itarahanguka.
Urukundo ni nk'isokw'idakama, Ituruka mw'ijuru ku Muremyi; Nirwo ruturarikira gukora, Rukadukomeza ntitugw'isari.

praise.title: Nyabun'Uburyo Ngukennye!
praise.chorus: Ku manywa na n'ijoro; Mwami ndagushak'iteka; Ku manywa na n'ijoro; Mwam'unyikomereze.
stanzas: Nyabun'uburyo ngukennye! Nd'umukene n'impumyi; Mfat'ukubok'unyobore, Ni wow'ump'imbaraga.
Nyambik'urukundo rwawe, Nahindanye nd'intebyi. Ubu mfit'intege nkeya, Nyongeramw'imbaraga.
Nzab'amahor'unyoboye, Sinakwiyiringira. Yes'ujy'ungend'i ruhande, Kuk'undutira byose.
Nubw'ibind'imbere byose, Byankoma mu nkokora, Nzakomeza komatana nawe, Mwana w'Imana.

praise.title: Icyampa Nkab'Uwawe
praise.chorus: Icyampa nkab'uwawe, Nitanze maramaje. Jye ntacyo maze, Ntacyo, Ntacyo; Niwe mpay'ikuzo.
stanzas: Icyampa nkab'uwawe, Yesu Mwami wanjye; Ne kononwa n'iby'isi, Nkwikurikirire.
Icyampa nkab'uwawe, Yesu Mwami wanjye. Nkoresh'uk'ushaka, Njye nkubahiriza.
Icyampa nkab'uwawe, Yesu Mwami wanjye; Ntandukanya n'iby'isi, Umboneze rwose.
Icyampa nkab'uwawe, Yesu Mwami wanjye; Mb'uwaw'uko ndi kose, Nta kintu kinziga.

praise.title: Mfit'Inshuti Y'Ukuri
stanzas: Mfit'inshuti y'ukuri y'inkoramutima, Irankunda bihebuje, Nzi kw'itazampana. Ntabwo nayiv'iruhande, Nkunda ko tubana, Iyo nshuti ni Yesu, Umukiza.
Iyo nguy'agacuho, Ameny'uko meze; Ntanyirengagiza rwose: Aransindagiza, Akanyobora mu nzira, Yo gukiranuka; N'inshuti nkunda cyane, Yes'Umwami.
Mutur'umubabaro, Mubwir'ibyishimo; Mubwir'ibinnyura nabyo, N'ibindushya byose. Angaragariz'uburyo, Nkwiriye kwifata; Nkunda kwiganirira, Naw'iteka.
Az'imigambi yanjye, Yo gukiz'abandi; Niko kunshing'umurimo, Wo kumuvugira, No kwamamaz'urukundo, Rwatumy'adupfira: Yewe, mukunda rwose, Bihebuje.

praise.title: Umukiz'Aranyobora
stanzas: Umukiz'aranyobora, Birampagije rwose. Sinshidikany'impuhwe ze, Kuko njya nzibonaho. Amahoro yo mw'ijuru, Yanyuzuy'umutima; Sinzatinya na hatoya, Kuko Yes'anyobora; Sinzatinya na hatoya, Kuko Yes'anyobora.

Umukiz'aranyobora, Akanampumuriza; Iyo ngeze mu makuba, Ntamvirira na hato; Bona n'ubwo nateguza, Yandamir'akamfasha; Ahor'anyitahw'iteka, Nta cyo nzamuburana; Ahor'anyitahw 'iteka, Nta cyo nzamuburana.

Umukiz'aranyobora, Niryo humure ryanjye! Niw'uzampaz'uburame, Njye mpora musingiza. Nta cyatuma ntiny'urupfu, Mfit'iryo sezerano; Nzajya ndirimb'iteka, Nti: Yesu niw'unyobora; Nzajya ndirimb'iteka, Nti: Yesu niw'unyobora.

praise.title: Yes'Arahamagar'Ati:
stanzas: Yes'arahamagar'ati: Nind'unkorera none? Isarura rirageze, Nind'uribusarure? Umv'ukw'aduhamagara; Kand'azagororera. Umusubiza wes'ati: Ndi hano Mwami ntuma.
N'utabasha kujya kure, Ngo wambuke n'inyanja; N'ino har'abapagani, Wagarurira Yesu. N'utabasha gushyanuka, Ngo wigishe nka Paulo, Wakogez'iby'urukundo rw'Umukiza wabambwe.
Wabura kub'umurinzi, Ku nkike z'i Siyoni, Wafashish'amasengesho, No gutur'amaturo; Ukayobora n'abandi, Mu nzir'ijya mw'ijuru, Nk'ukw'Aroni yakomeje amaboko ya Mose.
Abantu bari mu kaga; Yes'aragutabaza. Ntukagir'ubw'uvug'uti: Ntacyo nakora rwose. Ishimire gukoreshwa, Hitam'umurimo we; Maz'usubize bwang'uti: Ndi hano, Mwami ntuma.

praise.title: Nicay'Imbere Ya Yesu
stanzas: Nicay'imbere ya Yesu, Mpaboner'ihumure; N'ahantu h'igikundiro; Icyampa nkahibera. Iyo nicay'imbere ye, Nimenyah'ubugoryi; Kumuhang'amaso nibyo, Bimpa gukiranuka.
Kwicar'imbere ya Yesu, Nta mahirw'arut'ayo; Niho nsig'ibimbabaza, Nkumva nduhutse rwose. Iyo nicay'imbere ye, Nkunda kumuganyira; Naw'ababarana nanjye, Maz'akampumuriza.
Yesu mp'umugisha wawe; Dore, Ndategereje; Ndeban'imbabazi zawe, Menye k'unyitayeho. Mp'umutima wawe, Yesu;Nyeza nkubonerere; Bigaragarir'abandi, Yuko mporana nawe.

praise.title: Ndagukunda, Mwami
stanzas: Ndagukunda, Mwami; Uzi ko ngukunda; Ndagukunda Yesu, Bihebuje rwose. Ndagukunda Yesu, Naw'urabizi; Imirimo yanjy'izabyerekana.
Nishimye, Nishimye; Rwose bitavugwa. Ibyishimo byanjye, Nta wabirondora. Ndareb'ubutunzi buri mw'ijuru, Nzagabirwa nawe kubw'ubuntu bwawe.
Yesu Mwami wanjye, Niwe nkesha byose; Ar'ugucungurwa, Ari n'ubugingo. Nzakogez'iteka, Nkuririmbire, Kuk'ubuntu bwawe bwandemy'umutima.
Naguhwanya nande, Mucunguzi wanjye? Uhoran'ineza, Ntugir'impinduka. Nzajya nguhimbaza, Nkubahirize; Umutima wanjye Wuzuy'ibyishimo.

praise.title: Ayi Rutare Rw'Imana
stanzas: Ayi Rutare rw'Imana, Reka nguhungiraho! Kubw'imbabazi zawe, Kera waramenewe, Non'ubu nkwihishemo, Umujinya w'Imana.
Ibyo twakora byose, N'umwete wacu wose, N'agahinda gasaze, N'amarir'adashira, Byose ntibyashobora, Kudukurahw'ibyaha.
Yes'ibyo mfite byose, Nta mumaro bigira. Sinabasha kwikiza, Ndagushakah'ubuntu, Unyuhagir'imbyiro, Mutabazi ne gupfa.
Nuko nkiri muzima, Mwami, nguhungireho. No ku munsi w'imanza, Ninger'imbere yawe, Ayi Rutare rw'Imana, Uzandeke nkwisunge!

praise.title: Mwa Bera B'Umwami
stanzas: Mwa bera b'Umwami, Mwishimir'Ijambo rye; Niryo rufatiro rwo kwizera kwanyu. Dore, yababwiye byose; Ntacyo yabahishe. Ntitwabasha kongera kur'iryo jambo ryiza, Cyangwa kuritubya, Kukw'ar'iry'Imana.
N'ugera mu kaga, Yesu yasezeranye, Kw'azakugoboka, Akakurengera; Amakuba yawe yos'akuber'umugisha; Niy'azakweza rwose, Maz'atum'ushikama; Niy'azakweza rwose, Agukomeze.
Ibigeragezo nibikugwa gitumo, Ubuntu bwanjye buzaba buhagije. Ibirimi by'umuriro, Ntibigutinyishe; Bizakongor'ibyaha, Usigar'utunganye; Bizakongor'ibyaha, Bikuboneze.
Unamba ku Mana, Ntizamuhemukira; Ntizamuharir'umubisha na hato. N'ubw'ingabo zose z'umwanzi zamusatira, Ntizamuhemukira, Ntizamuhemukira, Ntizamuhemukira, Haba na gato.

praise.title: Uwiteka Niwe Mwungeri Wanjye
stanzas: Uwiteka niwe Mwungeri wanjye, Sinzakena; Andyamisha mu cyanya cy'ubwatsi butoshye cyane; Anyobor'iruhande rw'amaz'adasuma; Uwitek'asubiz'intege mu bugingo bwanjye.
Nanyura no mu gikombe cy'igicucu cy'urupfu, Sinatiny'ikibi cyose, kuko ndi kumwe nawe; Inshyimbo yawe n'inkoni, bimp'ihumure; Nta kaga kazantungura, ndi kumwe nawe, Mwami.
Untunganiriz'ameza mu gihe cy'amakuba. Unshagijehw imbabazi, zimeze nk'amavuta; Wanyujurij'igikombe, cyuzur'ubuntu. Mwami, ntacyo wisigiye, ng'ubon'uk'ukingomwa.
Mana y'ubuntu, n'ukuri; Ineza wangiriye, N'imbabazi bizanyomahw'iminsi yanjye yose; Nzakomeza nkuyoboke, Sinzateshuka; Kandi nzaba mu nzu y'Uwiteka iteka ryose.

praise.title: Wa Muragwa We!
stanzas: Wa muragwa we, mbese k'uhunikira? K'ucogoy'ugiye kugerayo? Kanguka bwangu, shak'intwaro zawe; Wizarira, dore byatinze rwose!
Amahanga yose yasubiranyemo; Bose baradagadwa bihebye. Umv'ukw'amagar'ahindira hose; Wa muragwa we, wigumya gutinda!
Ntugwabizwe n'iby'iyi si biguhenda; Reb'ubwiza bwabyo burashira. C'ingoy'Umwanzi yakubohesheje; Wa muragwa we, zicikeho bwangu!
Nyamuneka, ntugir'imitim'ibiri; Ba mas'Umwam'atagutungura; Dor'umucy'utangiye gutangaza; Muragwa we, vuz'impundu, wishime!

praise.title: Mwami Mana Yanjye
stanzas: Mwami Mana yanjye, Ni wow'umbeshaho; Ubuntu bwawe n'isoko nkesh'ibyiza byose. Ubuntu bwawe n'isoko nkesh'amahirwe yose.
Ni wowe wandemye, Nta wakundutira; Ineza yawe ni nyinshi, Ntacyo nayinganya; Ineza yawe ni nyinshi ntacyo nayigeraho.
Mwami, Natur'iki, Ko byos'ar'ibyawe? Kerets'umutim'ushima, Wo kuguhimbaza; Kerets'umutim'ushima, Wo kukuramya, Mwami.
Umpe gushikama, Kubw'ubuntu bwawe; Nkweguriy'ibyanjye byose, Mbay'uwawe rwose; Nkweguriy'ibyanjye byose, Mb'uwaw'akaramata.

praise.title: Murinzi We W'i Siyoni
stanzas: Murinzi we, w'i Sioni, Ijoro rigeze he? Mbes'umusek'uri hafi? Ntiburatandukana? Ntacy'ushishoz'i burasira-zuba? Ntacy'ushishoz'i burasira-zuba?
Nyamuneka tumenyeshe, K'urugendo rushize; Mbese tugeze ku cyambu, Tugiye kugerayo? Mbese koko, ubwami buri hafi? Mbese koko, ubwami buri hafi?
Burakey'umuns'uraje! Tubyamamaze hose; Dor'izuba rirarashe, Mwese nimurirebe! Mwa bera mwe, Mugiye gucungurwa! Mwa bera mwe, Mugiye gucungurwa!
Tugeze ku rugabano, Rw'igihugu tujyamo, Nimukabuze twihute, Icyambu kiri hafi. Nimurangurure ya majwi yanyu! Nimurangurure ya majwi yanyu!

praise.title: Ngabo, Muhaguruke!
stanzas: Ngabo, muhaguruke! Murwanire Yesu; Murind'ingabe yanyu, Mutazayinyagwa. Mu nzira yo kunesha, Tuyoborwa na Yesu, Tujyane naw'iteka, Niho tuzanesha.
Impanda ziravuze, Muze mwebwe mwese. Ikamba ry'ubugingo, N'ibihembo byanyu. Nimwangwa n'ababisha, Mukomere, murwane; Mwonger'umwete mwinshi, Muganze Satani.
Mubyuke, mutabare, Mudashidikanya. He kugir'umw'usiba, murebe kwa Yesu. Kandi mujye mutwara, Intwaro zo kwizera. Muhabwe ukunesha, N'ibyishimo byinshi.
Mubyuke vuba vuba, Murwane iteka, Mwizer'izina ryera, Niho muzanesha; Maz'izo ntwaro zose, Muzih'Umwami Yesu, Muzabon'amahoro y'iteka mw'ijuru.

praise.title: Icyampa Nkizera
stanzas: Icyampa nkizera rwose, Ubutadohoka; Sintinyishwe n'ubukene, Cyangw'ibyago byose.
Sinivovote, mbabajwe, N'igihano cyawe; Ahubwo, nimba mu kaga, Nkunambeho Mwami.
Mpabwe gushikama cyane, Umugaru n'ugwa; Ne guhindishw'umushitsi, N'ibyago bitera.
Ne gukangishwa n'ab'isi, N'igitsure cyabo; N'ubwo bangir'urw'amenyo, Noye kubyitaho.
Mwami, ben'uko kwizera, Niko ngutezeho; Niringiye ko nzahabwa kwibera mw'ijuru.

praise.title: Hahirw'Ufit'Ibyiringiro
stanzas: Hahirw'ufit'ibyiringiro bishyitse, Akiri mu miruho y'iyi si; Bimukomez'agatsind'ibishuko by'umwanzi. Bimukomez'agatsinda ibishuko n'amakuba menshi.
Nibyo bitwibuts'iby'uburuhukiro, Ahw'abakiranutsi bazaba; Bakibanira n'inshut'ubudatandukana. Bakibanira n'inshuti ntibatandukane.
N'igihugu kitazarangwamw'icyaha; Ahw'ibishuko bitazagera; Ni nahw'ibyishimo bitazagir'impinduka. Nihw'ibyishimo bitazongera kugira kirogoya.
Nta n'umw'uzahabogorez'amarira; Ntabw'urupfu ruzahahangara; Abaturage baho baziberahw'iteka. Abaturage baho bazamera nk'abamarayika.
Icyaduh'igihe kikihuta bwangu! Tukabon'Umukiza wac'aje, Akatujyana muri cya gihugu cy'ibyiza. Akatugez'aho tuzibanira n'Umukiza wacu.

praise.title: Nyagasani, Turakwiragije
stanzas: Nyagasani, Turakwiragije, Turagukennye cyane; Turagire mu bwatsi butoshye, Turakwiyeguriye; Nyagasani, Nyagasani, Niwe waducunguye; Nyagasani, Nyagasani, Niwe waducunguye.
Ubu tur'abawe rwose Mwami, Tureban'imbabazi; Turinde, Tur'umukumbi wawe, Twe guteshuk'inzira; Nyagasani, Nyagasani, Nyamuneka twumvire; Nyagasani, Nyagasani, Nyamuneka twunvire.
Wasezeranye k'uzatwakira, N'ubwo tur'abangizi; Udufitiy'imbabazi nyinshi, N'ubuntu buhebuje; Nyagasani, Nyagasani, Turakugarukira; Nyagasani, Nyagasani, Turakugarukira.

praise.title: Ibyiringiro Dufite
stanzas: Ibyiringiro dufite bigir'agaciro cyane; Kurut'iby'iyi si by'imburamumaro, Bijya bishimisha benshi.
Twabony'umucy'utangaje, Utamurur'umwijima, Wazanywe n'uk'urupfu rwiganzuy'isi, None twaretse kwiheba.
Twumvis'ijwi ry'ihumure, Rinyur'imitima yacu; Ridutinyura rwose, rikatwizeza, Yukw'Iman'ar'urukundo.
Iryo jwi n'irya Rurema, Uwo mucyo n'Ijambo rye; Ibyo byiringiro n'ukuragw'ijuru, Ntitwongere gupf'ukundi.

praise.title: Mu Gihugu Cy'Ibyiza
praise.chorus: **S:** Nta marir'azabayo, Nta rupfu cyangw'ubwoba; Ibihe ntibibarwayo, Kuko ntabwo bwira. **A., T. na B.:** Nta marir'azabayo, Nta rupfu cyangw'ubwoba; Ibihe ibihe ntibibarwayo, Kuko ntabwo bwira.
stanzas: Mu gihugu cy'ibyiza, Har'umurwa wera; Uzahorahw'iteka: Nta joro rihaba.
Inkike z'uwo murwa, Zose n'izahabu; N'inzira nazo nuko; Nta joro rihaba.
Kand'amarembo yawo, Ntabwo yugarirwa; Uruzi rw'ubugingo, Ruzawutembamo.
Ntuzagomba kuvirwa, N'izuba n'ukwezi; Kand'Umwana w'Intama, Niwe mucyo wawo.

praise.title: Ahar'Azaza Umusek'Utambitse
praise.chorus: Tuzageza ryari, Mwami tugutegereje? Urakaza, Haleluya, Haleluy'amina! Haleluy'amina!
stanzas: Ahar'azaza, umusek'utambitse, Igih'umucy'utamurur'umwijima; Azany'icyubahiro kitarondorwa, Aje kurokor'intore ze.
Ahar'azaza, nko ku manywa y'ihangu; Cyangwa s'azaza mu gicuku hagati; Umucy'usab'impande zose z'iyi si, Aje kurokor'intore ze.
Mbeg'ibyishimo, N'asanga tukiriho! Tutarwaye, Tutaririwe twapfuye; Maz'akadutumbagirana mu bicu, Aje kurokor'intore ze.

praise.title: Mbes'Uzaba Witeguye
praise.chorus: Dore, Umukwe araje, Araje! Dore, Umukwe araje, Araje! Dore araje! Dore araje! Itegure, Dor'Umukw'araje!
stanzas: Mbes'uzaba witeguye, Yes'aje, Yes'aje? Mbes'uzaba witeguye, Yes'aje, Yes'aje? Dore araje! Dore araje! Itegure, dor'Umukw'araje!
Muringaniz'amatara, Araje, Araje! Muringaniz'amatara, Araje, Araje! Dore araje! Dore araje! Itegure, Dor'Umukw'araje!
Mutyo, tumusanganire, Araje, Araje! Mutyo, tumusanganire, Araje, Araje! Araje koko! Araje koko! Itegure, Dor'Umukw'araje!
Turirimbe: Haleluya; Araje, Araje! Turirimbe: Haleluya; Araje, Araje! Araje koko! Araje koko! Turirimbe: Haleluy'araje!

praise.title: Ntituz'Umunsi
praise.chorus: Azaza (azaza), duhore twiteguye. Azaza (azaza), Haleluya! Haleluya! Azaza ku bicu, Afit'ubwiza bwa Se, N'umunsi tutazi.
stanzas: Ntituz'umunsi Yesu azagaruka, Arikw'igihe, cyo kiri hafi cyane, Ibimenyetso byagaragaye byose, N'umunsi tutazi.
Abitondera, igitabo cy'Imana, Ukuri kwayo, nimwo bakubonera, Ibyahanuwe bitangaza kuza kwe, N'umunsi tutazi.
Imuri zacu ntizigahweme kwaka, Tujye dukora, dutegerej'Umwami, Tumuhimbaze, twe kujya turambirwa, N'umunsi tutazi.

praise.title: Ntituz'Igihe Azazira
praise.chorus: Tumwitegure, Tumwitegure, Tumwitegure; Dore, Turamwiteguye.
stanzas: Ntituz'igihe azazira, Ku manywa cyangwa n'ijoro; Ahar'azaza bugorobye, Cyangw'umusek'utambitse. Aratwihanangiririza kuba mas'iteka ryose; Kugira ng'ubw'azatunguka, Azasange twiteguye.
Ndibuk'uburyo yadukunze, Akaduharira byose; Yasiz'ubwiza bwe mw'ijuru, Yitangira kudupfira. Azanezerwa n'agaruka, Kujyan'abo yacunguye, Nib'azasanga bari maso, Bamaze kumwitegura.
Ayi Yesu Mwana w'Imana, Dor'uz'ibyo ndangamiye; Nizigiye ko nzakubona, Nkurebesh'amaso yanjye; N'ubwo bamwe bazaguhunga, Babony'igitsure cyawe, Jye, nzakuramutsa nk'inshuti; N'ubu ndagutegereje.

praise.title: Umunsi W'Ihumur'Uregereje
praise.chorus: Umusek'utangiye gutambika, Weyuyeh'umwijima! Umusek'utangiye gutambika, Bugiye gucya!
stanzas: Umunsi w'ihumur'uregereje; Yes'azazaho. Nibw'azajyan'abana be bizeye, Bigir'i wabo.
Ubutumwa bwiza nibuhetura iyi si yacu, Umwam'azashok'aza bidatinze, Atujyan'iwe.
N'az'ashagawe n'abamarayika batabarika, Azatsembahw'ibihumanya byose; Ntabw'azasobwa.
Abazaba baratandukanijwe, Bazabonana; Be kongera kubogoz'amarira, Bagubwe neza.

praise.title: Yesu Yadusezeraniy'Ati:
praise.chorus: Komez'icy'ufit'utakinyagwa; So yiteguye kuguh'ubwami. Ngwino, Winjire mu munezero; Urahabw'ikamba ritangirika.
stanzas: Yesu yadusezeraniy'ati: Dore ndaza vuba kujyan'abanjye; Komez'icy'ufit'utakinyagwa; Komeza wizere, we kurambirwa.
Tuzajye tuba maso dusenga, Kukw'azaza nk'umujura w'ijoro; Ntituz'umunsi, cyangwa s'igihe; Icyo tuzi n'ukw'ari bugufi.
Dufit'ijambo ritwiringiza yuko, Tuzaragw'ubwami bw'Imana; N'isezerano ridakuka ngo: Dore ndaza vuba, we kurambirwa.

praise.title: Mwese, Nimuvuz'Impundu
stanzas: Mwese, nimuvuz'impundu! Dor'Umwam'araje! Mwitegure mwiboneze, Musangwe mwinonosoye. Isi yos'iririmbe (isi yos'iririmbe)! Isi yose niririmbe (yose niririmbe)! Nawe juru, wishim'uririmbe cyane!

Mwese, nimuvuz'impundu! Dor'Umwam'araje! Azim'ingom'ihoraho, Ntabw'izahanguka rwose. Muvuz'ijwi ry'impundu (vuz'ijwi ry'impundu), Nimuvuz'ijwi ry'impundu (vuz'ijwi ry'impundu), Nimwishime mwese muririmbe cyane.
Azanatsembahw'icyaha, Is'igubwe neza; Imibabar'izashira, Habehw'amahoro masa, Nta mivum'izabayo (Nta mivum'izabayo), Ntabwo hazab'imivumo (Ntabwo hazab'imivumo), Ntayo rwose, Nta mivum'izarangwayo.
Azategekesh'ubuntu no gukiranuka; Ngw'ab'isi bose bamenye, K'Uwitek'agira neza, Urukundo rwe rwinshi (urukundo rwe rwinshi), Urukundo rutangaje (urukundo rutangaje), Urukundo rwe rwinshi rurahebuje.

praise.title: Mbese Ko Tujya Tuvuga
stanzas: Mbese, Ko tujya tuvuga, Iby'igihugu cy'ihirwe; Tukogez'ubwiza bwaho; Kubayo bizacur'iki? Ko tuvug'inzira zaho, Zasizw'izahabu nziza; Ar'ukugenekereza; Tugezeyo, hacur'iki?
Ko tuvug'uko hameze, Kw'ari nta byaha n'urupfu, Cyangw'ibishuko bibayo, Tugezeyo hacur'iki? Ko tuvug'iby'urukundo, N'ibishura bizambarwa, Tukabyishimira cyane; Kubayo bizacur'iki?
Tuvuga n'iby'igitondo, Kizaba gitamanzuye, Tukazabona wa murwa, Umanuk'urimbishijwe. Umurw'urabagirana, Utarangwamw'agahinda, Ntubemo n'imibabaro, Har'umunezero gusa.
N'ubwo ngoswe n'ibishuko, Ntunganiriza kujyayo; Ngo nanjye njye niyumvamo, Uko kubayo byamera; Nibwo tuzatambagira, Icyo gihugu cy'ihirwe, Hamwe n'abamarayika, Na Yes'Umukiza wacu.

praise.title: Data Mwiza Tugarutse Kugushengerera
stanzas: Data mwiza, Tugarutse kugushengerera none; Twicishije bugufi, twiyoroheje, Twifuza kubabarirwa.
Twongeye kugushimira, Kuko waturinze twese; Ukatuzirikana ukaduhira, Ukatugarura hano.
Ayi, twagushij'ishyano; Tur'abo kwangw'urunuka; Dore, tujya duteshuk'inzira yawe, Noneho turahabutse.
Mana y'imigisha yose, Niw'utang'utaziganya; Tureban'imbabazi, turakwinginze; Uduhaz'ijambo ryawe.

praise.title: Mwam'Ubwo Tukigushengereye
stanzas: Mwam'ubwo tukigushengereye, Tukuririmbirir'icya rimwe Iyi ndirimbo yac'iheruka, Twicishije bugufi, duhire.
Mwami dusezerer'amahoro; Duherekeze, tujyane nawe; Turindir'iminwa n'imitima, Ngo yoye kujy'igukoz'isoni.
Amahoro yaw'abane natwe; Ab'ari y'ajy'aduh'ihumure. Maze n'uturuhur'imiruho, Tuzongere kuyabon'i wawe.

praise.title: N'Ubwo Nsazwe N'Ibyaha
stanzas: N'ubwo nsazwe n'ibyaha, Yesu yarankijije, Yamviriy'amaraso, Angura n'urupf'atyo. Tuzab'akaramata, Ak'ishami n'igiti.
Urukundo rwa Yesu, Rusaguts'ikirere. Ntacyo twarugeraho, Ruzagumahw'iteka; Niwe warumbwirije, Jye ntabwo nari nduzi.
N'ubwo nsazwe n'ibyaha, Yes'andutira byose; Az'ibyo nkennye byose, Ankiz'umubabaro. Namuberey'imbata, Nta cyago cyampangara.

praise.title: Twabuze Gakondo Mur'Iyi Si
stanzas: Twabuze gakondo mur'iyi si; Tuyirimo tur'abasuhuke; Arikw'ikitunezeza, Nuko dushaka gakondo, Irushaho kuba nziza.
Twabuze gakondo mur'iyi si; Tugamij'iy'iwacu mw'ijuru; Niyo Siyon'ihoraho, Ifit'umucy'udashira, Ihor'irabagirana.
Mbeg'uburyo tuzanezererwa; Ahw'abagenzi bat'umuruho. Icyamp'amababa none, Nkaguruka, Nkigirayo, Nkibanira nawe, Mwami.
Mutima wanjye, reka kuganya! Dor'igih'Imana yangeneye, Nicyo cyiza, nicyo cyiza; Njye nkomeza kwiringira, Ngez'ubw'izampamagara.

praise.title: Mw'Ijuru No Mw'Isi Yose
praise.chorus: N'izina (n'izina) rya Yesu (rya Yesu), Niryo ritwiringiza; N'izina (n'izina), Ry'Umukiza, Riduhesh'amahirwe.
stanzas: Mw'ijuru no mw'isi yose, Nta zina nk'irya Yesu; Ntaryo nkunda ku mutima, Nk'iry'uwaducunguye.
Nihagir'umunt'ushimwa, Akarutishw'abandi, N'abarush'icyubahiro, Yes'aramuhebuza.
Abamarayika bose, Bitw'amazina meza, Ariko nta zina ryabo, Ribasha kunnezeza.
Yes'ankiz'ibyago byose, Kandi niw'unkomeza; N'iyo nagiz'intege nke, Anyonger'imbaraga.

praise.title: Ngiz'Amahirwe Nd'Uwa Yesu
praise.chorus: Nibyo ndirimba, nibyo mvuga; Nshim'Umukiz'ubudasiba; Nibyo ndirimba, nibyo mvuga; Nshim'Umukiz'ubudasiba.
stanzas: Ngiz'amahirwe, nd'uwa Yesu; N'ubu mfit'umunezero mwinshi! Ndazw'agakiza; ndacunguwe; Mbyawe n'Umwuka, ndatunganye.
Nditanze, ndamwiyeguriye; Ndumv'ibyishimo binsabye rwose. Narokotse kubw'ubuntu bwe, None ntegerej'iby'ijuru.
Sinkir'uwanjye, ndamwihaye, Niwe wambohoy'arambatura. Mbe maso nsenge, ntegereze; Maz'ubuntu bwe bunyuzure.

praise.title: Reba Yesu Ku Musaraba
praise.chorus: Duhimbaz'izina rye, Duhimbaz'izina rye; Yaducunguj'amaraso ye; Yes'ahimbazwe!
stanzas: Reba Yesu ku musaraba, Reb'uko twatumy'agirirwa; Huguk'araguhamagara, Ngwin'umusange.
Yesu yambatuye mu byaha, Atura mu mutima wanjye; Niw'uwuzanamw'ihumure; Yes'ahimbazwe!
Niwe Sokw'inyezahw'ibyaha; Narayiyuhagije ndera; Nzi yukw'ineza y'izaramba; Yes'ahimbazwe!
Muze kw'Isoko y'Agakiza; Maze muyiyuhagiremo; Irabezahw'ibyaha byose; Yes'ahimbazwe!

praise.title: Mbes'Urumv'Ushaka Gutunganira Yesu?
praise.chorus: Azagutungany'akuboneze, Amaraso y'akwezehw'ibyaha, Akuzuz'urukundo rwe rwinshi; Niwemera kujy'ugengwa nawe.
stanzas: Mbes'urumv'ushaka gutunganira Yesu? Ng'ugendane nawe mu nzira ntoya? Akwikorerer'imitwaro yawe yose ? Emer'ugengwe nawe.
Mbes'urashaka kw'akubatura mu byaha? Ngw'aguh'amahoro yo mu mutima? Ajy'akuramira, we guhor'ugwaguza? Emer'ugengwe nawe.
Mbes'urashaka kugabana ku bugingo? Ngo wibere mu bwami bwo mw'ijuru? Urashaka kumaramaza muri byose? Emer'ugengwe nawe.

praise.title: I Muhira Hahirwa
praise.chorus: Ineza mu rugo, Niy'izan'ibyishimo, Har'urukundo.
stanzas: I muhira hahirwa, Har'urukundo; Byose bib'amahoro, Har'urukundo. Ntihab'impagarara, N'urutoto n'inkeke; Hab'ibyishimo gusa, Har'urukundo.
Ivundi ryanezeza, har'urukundo; Ntihaba kirogoya, Har'urukundo, Ibiri mu nzu byose byahinduk'inyamibwa, Hab'ibyishimo gusa, Har'urukundo.
Yes'akunda kuhaba, Har'urukundo; Isi yos'irishima, Har'urukundo. Isanzure ry'ijuru, Ryuzur'umucyo waka, N'Iman'ikamwenyura, Har'urukundo.

praise.title: Icyamp'Umuriro Waka
stanzas: Icyamp'umuriro waka, Wajyag'urabagiranira. Mu bera ba kera bose, Ukabagir'intwari z'Imana.
Mwam'icyampa wa mutima, Aburahamu yahoranye; Wari no muri Pawulo, Ukamutera kwiyumanganya.
Ntukiban'intore zawe, Nk'uko wabanye na Eliya? Ugahumuriza Yobu, Ageze mu kaga katavugwa.
Ibuka, Mwam'aba kera, Uko wabagendereraga; Ab'arik'ujy'utugenza, Utwuzuz'Umwuka wawe wera.

praise.title: Mbes'Urashaka Kunesh'Ibyaha?
praise.chorus: **S. na A.:** Har'imbaraga mu maraso, Y'Umwana w'Intama; Har'imbaraga mu maraso, Ya Yes'Umwana w'Imana. **T. na B.:** Koko har'imbaraga mu maraso…; Y'Umwana… w'Intama; Koko har'imbaraga mu maraso, Ya Yes'Umwana w'Imana.
stanzas: Mbes'urashaka kunesh'ibyaha? Izer'amaraso ya Yesu. Mbes'urashaka kumeny'intsinzi? N'amaraso y'Umukiza.
S'urashaka gukir'ubwibone? Izer'amaraso ya Yesu; Ngwin'umusange ku musaraba, Akwejesh'amaraso ye.
Mbes'urashaka kujya wera de? Izer'amaraso ya Yesu. Icyakwez'ibizinga by'ibyaha, N'amaraso y'Umukiza.
Urashaka gukorera Yesu? Izer'amaraso y'akiza. Urashaka kujy'umusingiza? Izere ya maraso ye.

praise.title: Yesu N'Az'Umwijim'Uzahunga
praise.chorus: Gukorany'abakunzi be (bose); Gukorany'abakunzi be (bose); Impundu zizavuga Yes'aje, Gukorany'intore ze.
stanzas: Yesu naz'umwijim'uzahunga, Yesu naz'umwijim'uzahunga, Impundu zizavuga Yes'aje, Gukorany'intore ze.
Imibabaro yos'izashira, Imibabaro yos'izashira; Ubw'Umwami Yes'azagaruka, Gukorany'intore ze.
Nta wuzongera kurir'ukundi, Nta wuzongera kurir'ukundi; Umwami Yesu n'aza ku bicu, Gukorany'intore ze.
Hazab'indirimbo z'indamutso, Hazab'indirimbo z'indamutso; Z'abakijijwe Yes'agarutse, Gukorany'intore ze.

praise.title: Yesu Niwe Nshut'Ihebuje
praise.chorus: Yesu n'inshut'ihebuje (ihebuje); Yesu n'inshut'ihebuje (ihebuje); N'ugw'azakuramira, N'utak'agutabare; Yesu niwe nshut'ihebuje.
stanzas: Yesu niwe nshut'ihebuje, Iy'amagany'agucogoje. Niwe womor'inguma zo mu mutima wawe; Yesu niwe nshut'ihebuje.
Nasanz'ar'inshut'ihebuje, Kukw'atampana mu makuba; Nindek'akanyobora, Sinzagir'icyo ntinya; Yesu niwe nshut'ihebuje.
N'ubwo natahirwa n'ibyago, Bikantera byiyungikanya, Sinzakuk'umutima, Kukw'ampor'i ruhande; Yesu niwe nshut'ihebuje.
Ubwo tuzagera mw'ijuru, Tugahura n'abo twatanye, Impundu zizavuga, Tumusingiz'iteka: Yesu niwe nshut'ihebuje.

praise.title: Imana Ihimbarizw'Ibyo Yakoze
praise.chorus: Dushime, dushime, Yes'Umwami wacu; Dushime, dushime, Twese tumushime. Niwe watwujuje n'Imana yacu; Tumuhimbariz'iyo neza nyinshi.
stanzas: Iman'ihimbarizw 'ibyo yakoze; Yakunz'ab'is'itang'Umwana wayo; Niwe Yesu waducunguye twese, Akaducir'icyanzu ngo dukire.
Yesu yaducunguj'amaraso ye, Maz'aduca kuri kamere yacu; Ngo n'ubwo twaba twarashayishije, Tube nk'abatigeze gucumura.
Ibyo yadukoreye ntibigerwa, Twakiran'Umwana w'Imana ishimwe; Ariko tuzarushaho kwishima, Nitumurebesh'aya maso yacu.

praise.title: Ur'Uwera Wera
stanzas: Ur'Uwera wera, Man'ikomeye! Mu gitondo tujye tukuririmbira. Nubw'ukomey'ute, Ugir'imbabazi; Ingoma yawe ntizahanguka.
Ur'Uwera wera, Abera bose, Baguhimbazanya n'abamarayika! Ibyaremwe byose bikuramye, Mwami, Wahozeho, Kand'uzahoraho.
Ur'Uwera wera, Ubwiza bwawe, N'ubwo butarebwa n'inkozi z'ibibi, Uhor'ur'Uwera, Nta wundi mwahwana, Kugira neza, No gutungana.

praise.title: Uhoraho Nyobora
stanzas: Uhoraho nyobora, Kuko nd'umugenzi mu butayu, Nd'umunyantege nke, Ariko wowe ur'umunyambaraga. Mutsima wo mw'ijuru we, Nshaka guhazwa nawe (guhazwa nawe), Nshaka cyane guhazwa nawe.
Twifuza kumarw'inyota nawe, Wowe sokw'idakama, Tuyoboresh'inkingi y'igicu, Tuzarangiz'urugendo. Ur'umutabazi wacu, N'ingab'idukingira (idukingira), Tuber'ingab'idukingira.
Ningera ku nkombe ya Yordani, Umutim'uzatuza, Maz'unyambuts'amasumo yaho, Ngere hakury'i Kanani. Nzaririmba, Nzaririmba, Nzagusingiz'iteka (iteka), Nzagusingiz'iteka ryose. Amen.

praise.title: Urugo Runezerewe
stanzas: Urugo runezerewe, Iman'irubamo, Iyo bahuj'imigambi yo kujya mw'ijuru.
Urugo rurimo Yesu, Rugir'amahoro, Abana biga kuvuga, Bahoh'izina rye.
Urugo runezerewe, Bahora basenga, Ahw ababyeyi bakunda, Ijambo ry'Imana.
Mukiza fash'ingo zacu, Zigir'amahoro, Uzuz'imitima yacu, Urukundo rwawe.

praise.title: Munsi Y 'Amababa Ye
praise.chorus: Munsi y'ayo mababa ye, Havuy'urukundo rwinshi, Mu mababa niho nzibera, Mu mahor'iteka ryose.
stanzas: Munsi y'amababa ye nihw'ampisha, N'ubw'ijoro ryakwijima cyane, Ntacyo nzatinya nzi kw'azankomeza, Ubu nd'umwana we yacunguye.
Munsi y'amababa ye nta gahinda, N'uburuhukiro bw'umutima, Mur'iyi si ntiharimw'agakiza, Mpirwa ndi mu mababa Ye gusa.
Munsi y'amababa ye niho heza, Nzajya mpihish'ibishuko byose, Niho buhungiro nta cyampangara, Nzibanira na Yes'amahoro.

praise.title: Mwami, Umurab'Urakaze!
praise.chorus: **S. na A.:** Umurab'uranyumvira rwose. Utuze. **T. na B.:** Umurab'uranyumvira rwose. U-tuze ...ze ...tuze **Bose:** Nib'ar'umurab'usheg'utyo, Cyangwa daimoni cyangwa s'abantu, Nta mazi yabasha kurengera Ubwat'Umwami wa byos'arimo. Dore byose biranyumvira. Bituze, Bituze. Dore byose biranyumvira, Biratuza.
stanzas: Mwam'umurab'urakaze, Urahorera cyane. Nta buhungiro nta bwugamo, Bw'umuzajoro nk'uyu. Mbese ko tugiye gupfa, Nawe wiryamiye? Dor'umuraba wabay'icyago, Tugiye kurengerwa.
Mwami mfit'agahind'ubu, N'umubabaro mwinshi, Umuraba urandengeye, Mwami tebuk'unkize. Isuri y'ibyaha byanjye, Dor'irantembanye, Ndarenganye, Ndarenganye rwose, Mwami tebuk'unkize.
Mwam'umurab'uratuje, Ubu nta bwoba mfite. Hamaze no gutamuruka, Mfit'ibyishimo byinshi. Nuko, Mwami ndakwinginze, Ntunsige jyenyine, Nduhukire mur'iki cyambu, Kirimw'amahoro masa.

praise.title: Nkweguriy'Ubugingo Bwanjye
stanzas: Nkweguriy'ubugingo bwanjye, Ng'ubugenz'uk'ushaka Mukiza, Nkweguriy'amaboko yanjye, Ng'uyakoresh'uk'ushaka Mwami, Ng'uyakoresh'uk'ushaka.
Nkweguriy'ibirenge byanjye, Bijye bijyan'ubutumwa bwiza, Nkweguriy'ijwi ryanjye na ryo, Ngo rijye rigusingiz'iteka, Ngo rijye rigusingiza.
Nkweguriye akanwa kanjye, Kuzuz'ubutumwa bwawe Mwami, Nkweguriy'ubutunzi bwanjye, Ntacyo nshaka kwisigaranira, Ntabwo nagir'icyo nkwima.
Nkweguriy'imigambi yanjye, Yikoresh'uk'ushaka Mukiza, Nkweguriy'umutima wanjye, Maz'uwimike m'Ubwami bwawe, Wimike m'Ubwami bwawe.
Nkweguriy'urukundo rwanjye, Sinshaka kugir'icyo nguhisha, Nguhay'impagarike yanjye, Nkweguriy'ibyanjye byose Mwami, Nkweguriy'ibyanjye byose.

praise.title: Abazacungurwa Bazaririmba
praise.chorus: **S. na A.:** Bazaririmbir'iyo Ntama y'i Kalvari Baririmbire Yes'Umwami Uhoraho. **T. na B.:** Bazaririmba, Bazaririmba, ...ma y'i Kalvari Ntama y'i Kalvari, Baririmbire, baririmbire ...mi, Uhoraho.
stanzas: Abazacungurwa bazaririmba, Bazashyir'amakamba yabo hasi, Imibabaro yab'izab'ishize, Bazahora banezerew'iteka.
Indirimbo y'urukund'itangaje, Izab'iririmbanyw'umunezero, Tuzabanayo n'Umukiza wacu, Tuzahora tunezerew'iteka.
Abamesh'ibishura byabo nibo, Bazegera ya ntebe ye ya cyami, Ibyaha tuzabikizwa na Yesu, Tuzahora tunezerew'iteka.

praise.title: Ku Musozi Kure
praise.chorus: Nzogeza uwo musaraba (musaraba), Kugez'ubwo nzat'umuruho, Nzikomeza ku musaraba (musaraba), Kugez'ubwo nzambikw'ikamba.
stanzas: Ku musozi kure har'umusaraba, Ubabaj'ukojej'isoni, Ndawukunda cyane kuko wabambweho, Uwacunguy'abanyabyaha.
Mbeg'umusarab'ab'isi bahinyuye, Ng'uranyur'umutima wanjye! Umwana w'intama yarets'ikuzo rye, Awikorer'ajy'i Kalvari.
Umusaraba wavushij'amaraso, Ya Yesu umwana w'Imana, Kuri wo nih'Umukiza yatangiye, Maz'ubwo mbabarirw'ibyaha.
Kubw'umusaraba, Nzab'umunyakuri, Nihanganir'isoni zawo, Kugez'ubw'uzanjyan'iwacu mw'ijuru, Tunezeranw'iteka ryose.

praise.title: Yes'Umukiza Yari Mu Gituro!
praise.chorus: Mu gitond'arazuka (arazuka), Atsinz'umwanzi bitangaje (bitangaje), Yaneshej'ubutware bw'umwijima, Azabana n'aber'iteka ryose. Yazutse (yazutse), Yazutse (yazutse)! Umwami Yes'ariho.
stanzas: Yes'Umukiza yari mu gituro, Ahategerereje ko bucya.
Barindiy'ubusa Yes'Umukiza, Bakinz'igituro ngw'aheremo.
Umukiza Yesu, Ntiyaheranywe, N'ingoyi z'urupfu, Yarazutse.

praise.title: Ahar'Uburuhukiro
praise.chorus: Mwami Yesu Mukiza watumwe n'Imana, Dukomereze twese bugufi bw'Imana.
stanzas: Ahar'uburuhukiro, Ni hafi y'Imana, Ahw'icyaha kitarangwa, Ni hafi y'Imana.
Ahatab'impagarara, Ni hafi y'Imana, Ahw'icyaha kitarangwa, Ni hafi y'Imana.
Ahahor'umudendezo, Ni hafi y'Imana, Ahahor'umunezero, Ni hafi y'Imana.

praise.title: Iteraniro Ry'Abera
praise.chorus: Haleluya, Haleluya, Dusingiz'Umwana w'Intama, Haleluya, Haleluya, Nimusingiz'Uwazutse.
stanzas: Iteraniro ry'abera, Inzovu n'ibihumbi, Ingabo z'abacunguwe, Barabagirana nk'umucyo, Barwany'uko babasha, None baratsinze, Mwagurir'amarembo, Kugira ngo binjire.
Ikobe ry'indirimbo, Rirangira mu kirere, Urusobe rw'amajwi y'inanga, Zizacurangw'urwunge, Mbeg'umuns'utangaje, Ni nk'uwo kurema, Mbega ng'umubabar'uratsindwa bitavugwa!
Hanezerew'abari mu mirenge y'i Kanani, Igitey'ubwuzu kandi, N'uko batazatandukana, Ya maso yariraga uzasang'akeye, Nta mpfubyi nta n'impfusha bizarangw'i Kanani.
Iteraniro ry'abera, Batsinze wa mubisha, Nimwumv'izo ndirimbo nziza, Ni nk'iz'abamarayika, Hehe n'imibabaro, Bayisezeyeho, Ntibazongera gusuhuz'imitim'ukundi.

praise.title: Nimwuname Imbere Ya Yehova
stanzas: Nimwunam'imbere ya Yehova, Yemwe mahanga yo mw'isi, Mumenye yuk'Uhorahw'ari we Mana, Niwe soko y'ubugingo.
Kand'imbaraga ze zitangaje, Zaturemye mu butaka, Ndets'igihe twazimiraga nk'intama, Yatugaruye mu bushyo.
Tumusingirize mu ndirimbo, Duhanik'amajwi yacu, Kand'indim'ibihumbi zo mw'isi yose, Zizasingiz'Uhoraho.
Amateka y'ageng'isi yose, Nta wager'urukundo rwe, Ukuri kwe gushikamye nk'urutare, Ukw'ibihe bih'ibindi.

praise.title: Mb'Uwawe, Mwami
stanzas: Mb'uwawe Mwami mbane nawe, Ni wow'umbumba, Jye nd'ibumba, Ngenz'uk'ushaka mere nkawe, Mwam'ubu ndakwiyeguriye.
Mb'uwawe Mwami mbane nawe, Ndondora Mwam'ungerageze, Unyeze nere nk'urubura, Njye ngusenga niyoroheje.
Mb'uwawe Mwami mbane nawe, Ubu ndagusab'untabare, Wowe Nyir'imbaraga zose, Nkorah'umvure we Mukiza.
Mb'uwawe Mwami mbane nawe, Nkomeza kuko nteraganwa, Nyuzuz'Umwuka wawe Wera, Ngo bose bambonemo Yesu.

praise.title: Mutuze
praise.chorus: Mwitonde (mwitonde), Mwitonde (mwitonde), Har'Uhoraho, Muze (muze) hafi ye, Mumwubashye cyane.
stanzas: Mutuze, Mutuze, Mwe guhwihwisa, Mwite kw'ijambo ryose mwumvir'aha.
Mutuze, Mutuze, Aha n'ahera, Turahumvir'ubutumwa bukiza.
Mutuze, Mutuze, Mwiyoroheje, Dusangir'ibyiza byo mur'Edeni.
Mutuze, Mutuze, Tubabarirwe, Mutuze, Turi kumwe n'Uhoraho.

praise.title: Mbes'Ushaka Guhirwa?
stanzas: Mbes'ushaka guhirwa? Tang'unezerewe. Bizakwiz'ubutumwa, Tang'unezerewe. Ntukikanyize rwose, Tanga unezerewe. Fatanya n'Imana, Tyo tang'unezerewe.
Reka wikwikanyiza, Tang'unezerewe. Rekur'impano zawe, Tang'unezerewe. Mbes'utunze bikeya? Tanga unezerewe. Izaguh'imigisha, Tang'unezerewe.
Kwiza hos'ubutumwa, Tang'unezerewe. Maz'umucyo wihute, Tang'unezerewe. Mbes'ushak'imigisha wahabga n'Uhoraho? Nuko rero mwumvire, Tang'unezerewe.

praise.title: Rangurur'Indirimbo
praise.chorus: Ririmba (ririmba), Ririmba (ririmba), Ririmban'ibyishimo, Ririmba (ririmba), Ririmba (ririmba), N'ibyishimo byinshi.
stanzas: Rangurur'indirimbo y'ibyishimo n'umunezero, Wikwiheba shir'agahinda, Ririmban'ibyishimo. Ririmbir'Uwaturinze, Waduhuje n'inshuti, Uwatuyoboy'inzira, Itugeza mw'ijuru.
Turirimbe dutway'amabendera tunezerewe, Turirimba hoziana z'umunezero w'iteka. Turirimbir'Umukiza, Turanguruy'amajwi, Tuvug'ibyabaye kera By'urukundo rw'Imana.
Turagushima Data Wera, Kubw'imbabazi zawe, Uko duteraniye hamwe, Turagushima cyane. Turagushima Mukiza, Kuko waducunguye, Uduhe Umwuka Wera, Atwegerez'Imana.

praise.title: Nshikamye Ku Masezerano
praise.chorus: **S.:** Nshikamye ku masezerano, Y'Umucunguzi wanjye, Nshikamye ku masezerano, Y'Umucunguzi. **A.,T. na B.:** Nshikamye ku masezerano, Masezerano y'Umucunguzi wanjye, Nshikamye ku maserano, Y 'Umucunguzi. Masezerano y'Umucunguzi.
stanzas: Nshikamye ku masezerano meza, Y'Umukiza wanjye, Mpora nsingiza, Nzahora musingiza, Ndanguruye, Nshikamye ku masezerano.
Nshikamye ku masezerano meza, N'ubwo naba mbuz'epfo na ruguru, Ijambo ry'Imana rimpa gutsinda, Nshikamye ku masezerano.
Nshikamye ku masezerano meza, Kuko nejeshejw'amaras'akiza, Niy'atuma mpora mu mudendezo, Nshikamye ku masezerano.
Nshikamye ku masezerano meza, Nkomezwa n'umurunga w'urukundo, Mpora neshesh'inkota y'Umwuka we, Nshikamye ku masezerano.
Nshikamye ku masezerano meza, Numv'Umwuka we Wer'ampamagara, Ngo ngume mu Mukiza nkesha byose, Nshikamye ku masezerano.

praise.title: Niba Mvug'Ijambo Rito
praise.chorus: Mana mfasha mvuge neza, Mpa n'indirimbo nziza, Mbashisha kurangurura, Ngo byumvikane hose.
stanzas: Niba mvug'ijambo rito, Rihumuriz'abandi, Niba ndirimb'indirimbo, Ntibongere kwiheba.
Niba urukundo rwanjye, Rwahumuriz'abandi, Niba nagir'icyo nkora, Kikunganir'abandi.
Niba nakor'umurimo, Ukaruhur'abandi, Mana mp'urukundo rwinshi, Rutume mfash'abandi.

praise.title: Umwami Yesu Yikorer'Umusaraba?
stanzas: Umwami Yesu yikorer'umusaraba wenyine? Umuntu wese yikorer'uwe, Nanjye har'uwanjye.
Nzawikorera ngeze igihe Azawunduhura, Anjyan'iwacu anyambik'amba yanteguriye.
Nzarambik'ikamba ryanjye iruhande rw'Umukiza, Haba hashashe izahabu, Nzogeza izina rye.

praise.title: Umwami Yesu Yazutse
stanzas: Umwami Yesu yazutse, Mwese nimwishime Haleluya, Abaremwe bamuramye, Mwese nimwishime Haleluya, Twese tumusingize, Mwese nimwishime Haleluya, Isi n'ijuru bimusingize, Mwese nimwishime Haleluya.
Umukiza wac'ariho, Mwese nimwishime Haleluya, Yaneshej'urupfu rwose, Mwese nimwishime Haleluya, Niwe waducunguye, Mwese nimwishime Haleluya, Yatsinz'imbaraga z'igituro, Mwese nimwishime Haleluya.
Yaducunguj'urukundo, Mwese nimwishime Haleluya, Yaturwaniy'intambara, Mwese nimwishime Haleluya, Yiganzura n'urupfu, Mwese nimwishime Haleluya, Yatwugururiye paradizo, Mwese nimwishime Haleluya.
Twishimire kujy'ahw'ari, Mwese nimwishime Haleluya, Tuger'ikirenge mu cye, Mwese nimwishime Haleluya, Azatuzura nkawe, Mwese nimwishime Haleluya, Tubikeshej'umusaraba we, Mwese nimwishime Haleluya.

praise.title: Mbese Yesu Ajy'Anyitaho?
praise.chorus: Anyitaho, Arandinda, Mu mibabaro yanjye, Mu bihe merewe nabi, Umukiza wanjy'anyitaho.
stanzas: Mbese Yesu ajy'anyitaho, Mu byago no mu mahoro, Mu mibabaro no mu miruho, No mu rugendo rurushya?
Mbese Yesu ajy'anyitaho, Iyo ngenda mu mwijima, N'iy'umwijima w'akag'ungose, Mbese Yes'amba bugufi?
Mbese Yesu ajy'anyitaho, Iyo nguye mu bishuko, Iyo mbabaye, N'iyo mbogoza, Mbese Yes'arantabara?
Mbese Yesu ajy'anyitaho, Iyo nsezeye ku nshuti, Iyo mbabazwa, Simpumurizwe, Mbese Yes'ab'abireba?

praise.title: Hanga Amaso Umukiza
praise.chorus: Hang'amaso Umukiza, Ngwin'arakureba neza, Uzumv'uhumurijwe kandi, Azakwemera akwakire.
stanzas: Iyo utewe n'ibyago bigatuma wiyunamira, Iyo kwiheba kukugezeh'ubwoba bukagutaha.
Iy'usatiriwe n'umuraba byose bihungabanye, Iy'ibyawe byose byagushijeh'ubwoba bwagutashye.
Iy ur'arakazuz'ubuz'urukundo rwawe rwa mbere, Iy'icyaha wakoze kigutotez'ijoro n'umunsi.
Iyo ugiz'ibicuguc'intege mu murimo wa Yesu. Iyo mu rugendo rwawe mw'isi utakimeny'inzira.

praise.title: Mfasha Ngo Ndusheho
stanzas: Mfasha ngo ndusheho kugukunda, Icyo nicyo ngusaba mpfukamye. Mbigusabye cyane mfasha Mwami Yesu, Ngo ndusheho kugukunda.
Nashats'iby'iyi si ngo nezerwe, Ubu ndabiretse, Ng'ump'ibyiza. Icyo nsaba gusa, Mfasha Mwami Yesu, Ngo ndusheho kugukunda.
Mfit'umubabaro n'agahinda, Nzishimira cyan'intumwa zawe. Iyo ndirimbana nazo biramfasha, Nkarushaho kugukunda.
Mu marembera y'ubu bugingo, Nzagushima cyane ngusingize. Nzakuririmbira maze mvuge nsenga, Ngo ndusheho kugukunda.

praise.title: Yes'Aje Yasanga Twiteguye?
praise.chorus: Mbese mugenzi twavuga tuti: Ubu turiteguye? Mbes'ah'Umwam'azasanga wowe nanjye, Tukimutegereje?
stanzas: Yes'aje yasanga twiteguye, Yasanga turi maso? Igihe cyose yagarukamo, Se twaba twiteguye?
Mbese n'az'umusek'utambitse akaduhamagara, Umunt'akabazw'icyo yakoze, Mbes'ahw'azadushima?
Mbese tujya tub'abanyakuri cyangwa turinezeza? Niba tuboneye mu mitima, Tuzagera mw'ijuru.
Hahirw'ab'Umwami azasanga bakimutegereje, Mbese n'agaruka mu gicuku, Tuzaba turi maso?

praise.title: Izuba Nirirenga
praise.chorus: Tuzahurirayo, Koko tuzahurirayo, Tuzibanira na Yesu, Muri cya gihugu cyiza, Tuzahurirayo, Koko tuzahurirayo, Twibanire (twibanire), mw'ikuzo rye.
stanzas: Izuba nirirenga turangij'imirimo, Ubwo tuzaba tunaniwe, Uhorah'utwara byose niw'uzadukiza, Duhurire kuri Siyoni.
Tunyura mu gicucu, No mu mugaru mwinshi, Tugoswe n'umwijim'ukaze, Ariko Uhoraho, Niw'uzatuyobora, Ab'ari w'utugez'iwacu.
Nubw'amaso yacu yuzuyemo amarira, Dufit'ubwoba mu mitima, Ariko Umukiza agiye kutujyana, Aho tuzashir'agahinda.

praise.title: Narebye Yesu
praise.chorus: **S:** Ye, ni koko, Nareby'Umwami Yesu; Arambona, Nzabana naw'iteka. **A, T na B:** Ye n'iby'ukuri koko, Nanjye nareby'Umwami Yesu, Maz'arambona, Nanjye rwose, Nzabana naw'iteka.
stanzas: Narebye Yes'igihe nari ndembejwe n'ibyaha, Nari nabuz'uko ngira, Maz'arampumuriza.
Nabony'Umwami Yes'ambambiwe ku musaraba, Nizera yukw'ibyaha byanjye bibambanywe nawe.
Nabony'Umwami Yesu, Azukany'icyubahiro, Niringir'imbabazi ze, N'ibyahanuwe kera.
Yandebany'impuhwe, Umutima wanjy'uranyurwa, Maz'anyiher'ikimenyetso cy'Umwuka We Wera.
Tuzabana n'Umwami Yesu Krist'ibihe byose, Mutezeho byose, Mbe nk'umwana wiringira se.

praise.title: Ntugire Icy'Utinya
praise.chorus: Ntabwo nzigunga, Sinzigera nigunga, Yesu arandinda, Ntabwo ajy'ansiga jyenyine. Ntabwo nzigunga, Sinzigera nigunga, Yesu arandinda. Ntabwo ajy'ansiga jyenyine.
stanzas: Ntugire icyo utinya, Ndi kumwe nawe, Ni isezerano ryo kwizera kwanjye. Umwijima ntuzigera unter'ubwoba, Ndahumurijwe, Ngendana n'Umukiza wanjye.
Umusek'umurik'iyo hakeye neza, Yes'umucyo wanjy'amurikir'iteka, Iyo ncitse intege, Yes'arandamira, Mucyo weyur'ibicu, Azangeza mw'ijuru.
Iyo ibyago bituruts'impande zose, Iyo nugarijwe Yes'amba bugufi, Ambwira ati: Komera, Humura “ Nijye” Ntutinye komera ndi kumwe nawe iteka.

praise.title: Mbeg'Inteko!
praise.chorus: **S. na A.:** Mbeg'inteko nini nziza! Inteko nini y'abacunguwe na Yesu ubwe! Mbeg'inteko nini y'abantu! Bazahora banezerew'iteka! **T. na B.:** Mbeg'inteko, mbeg'inteko! Nini nziza, nini nziza! Inteko nini y'abacunguwe na Yesu ubwe! Mbeg'inteko, mbeg'inteko! nini y'abantu! Bazahora banezerew'iteka!
stanzas: Umwana w'umunt'azaz'igitondo gitangaje, Nibwo twese tuzabon'ikuzo rye. Azakur'abantu be mu moko yose yo mw'isi, Iyo nteko nini iratangaje
Abasinziriye muri Yesu bazakanguka, N'ubwo bab'ikuzimu no mu nyanja, Bahabw'imibiri imeze nk'iy'abo mw'ijuru, Iyo nteko nini izatangaza!
Tuzabon'umudugud'urimw'amazu yera de, N'uruzi rwa ya mazi y'ubugingo. Abazaba baratandukanye bazabonana, Izab'ar'inteko nin'itangaje!
Nukuri Yes'agiye kugaruka bidatinze, Uwo muns'uzab'umuns'uhiriwe, Twese tuzahindurwa mu kanya, Nk'ako guhumbya! Iyo nteko nin'izab'itangaje!

praise.title: Umutima Wanjye Wari Wihebye
praise.chorus: Yankuyemo yaransayuye, Maz'ampagarika ku Rutare, Kand'anyigisha kuririmba, Ndamwogeza, Haleluya.
stanzas: Umutima wanjye wari wihebye, Ibyaha byanjye byantaye mu rwobo, Ntakambir'Uhoraho ndi mw'isayo, Maz'araz'ankuramo, None ndiho.
Yanyigije hafi ye ku Rutare, Nimpaguma ntabwo nzongera kugwa, Byatumy'intambwe zanjye zishikama, Nzahaguma nzahambikirw'ikamba.
Niwe wanyigishij'indirimbo nshya, Nyiririmba ku manywa na nijoro, Ubu nibereye mu mudendezo, Nzakomeza nsingiz'Uwankijije.
Nzaririmb'ibitangaza bya Yesu, Nzamusingiza bose babimenye, Nzajya ndirimb'agakiza k'iteka, Kugez'ubwo bose bameny'Imana.

praise.title: Ibihe By'Imibabaro
praise.chorus: Byose nabituy'i Kalvari, Kalvari, Kalvari, Byose nabituy'i Kalvari, Yes'ari bugufi.
stanzas: Ibihe by'imibabaro bitey'agahinda, Byose nabituy'i Kalvari, Yes'ari bugufi.
Muture Yes'amaganya yanyu uyu munsi, Byose nabituy'i Kalvari, Yes'ari bugufi.
Mutim'ubabaye cyane, Humura witinya, Byose nabituy'i Kalvari, Yes'ari bugufi.

praise.title: Wibuk'Imigisha Wahawe
praise.chorus: **S. na A.:** Wibuk'imigisha wahawe, Wibuk'imigisha y'Imana, Imigisha Iman'iguha, Ibyo yakoze biragutangaza. **T. na B.:** Wibuk'imigisha …gisha wahawe, Wibuk'imigisha…gisha y'Imana, Imigisha yose Iman'iguha, Ibyo yakoze biragutangaza.
stanzas: N'ubwo waterwa n'amakuba menshi, Maz'akagutera kwiheba cyane, Ibuk'imigisha yose wahawe, Ibyo yakoze biragutangaza.
Uhor'uremerewe n'amaganya, Umusarab'urakuremereye, Ibuk'imigisha yose wahawe, Uhor'ubiririmb'uko bukeye.
N'ubon'abandi bafit'ubutunzi, Wibuk'ubwo Yesu yasezeranye, Wibuk'imigisha yos'utagura, Ingororano yaw'iri mw'ijuru.
N'ubwo wab'utewe n'impagarara, Ntizizaguhagarik'umutima, Wibuke k'ufit'abamarayika, Bazakurinda baguhumurize.

praise.title: Mana Data, Ushobora Byose
stanzas: Mana Data, Ushobora byose, Duhe Mwami, Kurabagirana, Tukuririmbire tugushima, Kukw'ariw'ushobora byose.
Watuyoboy'ibihe byashize, Tuyobore no mur'iki gihe, Dukingire imyambi y'umwanzi, Tuyoboreshe ijambo ryawe.
Intambara ziraduc'intege, Tuber'ingabo idukingira, Duhe kwizer'imbaraga yawe, Dukeney'ubuntu bwawe Mwami.
Duhembure mur'urugendo, Tuyobore amanywa n'ijoro, Duhe kuguma bugufi bwawe, Guhimbazwa n'ibyawe iteka.

praise.title: Urukundo Rw'Umukiza
praise.chorus: Urukundo rw'Umukiza Nzahora nduririmba, Urukundo Yes'ankunda, Ruhebuj'ibintu byose.
stanzas: Ubu mpagaz'imbere ya Yesu w'i Nazareti, Ntangazwa n'ukw'ankunda kandi nandujwe n'ibyaha!
Ari mu gashyamb'asenga, Nijye yagiriraga, Bya byuya by'amaraso yabibize kukw'ankunda.
Maz'abamarayika baza kumuhumuriza, Kuko yar'ababajwe n'imibabaro y'abantu.
Tuzamureb'iteka abazaba bacunguwe, Duhore turirimba urukundo yadukunze.

praise.title: Amarembo Niyugururwa
praise.chorus: **S. na A.:** Amarembo niyugururwa, Amarembo niyugururwa. Mbeg'umunezero tuzahagirira, Amarembo yuguruwe! **T. na B.:** Amarembo niyu...ru... ...gururwa, Amarembo Niyu... ru... gururwa, Mbeg'umunezero tuzahagirira, Amarembo yuguruwe!
stanzas: Ntituzongera kuba mu mwijima, Amarembo niyugururwa. Ahubwo tuzaba muri rwa rurembo, Rumurikirwa n'Imana.
Inshuti zizandindira ku cyambu, Amarembo niyugururwa. Nzajya kwiber'ahatazarangw'icyaha, Amarembo yuguruwe.
Nta ndwara no kuribwa bizabayo, Amarembo niyugururwa. Tuziganirira n'abakunzi bacu, Amarembo yuguruwe.
Nzagir'umunezer'utarondorwa, Amarembo niyugururwa. Nzahora nirebera Yesu mu maso, Amarembo yuguruwe.
Tuzagendera mu mucyo w'Imana, Amarembo niyugururwa. Tuzaba turirimban'umunezero, Amarembo yuguruwe.
Ntabwo nzongera kuvunwa n'ishavu, Amarembo niyugururwa. Nzabana n'Umwami Yes'iteka ryose Amarembo yuguruwe.

praise.title: Nind'Uzagera Mu Rurembo?
stanzas: Nind'uzagera mu rurembo, Ruhorahw'ibihe byose, Akabon'ibyiza bihari, Mbese nijye, Cyangwa wowe? Akahabon'inzira zose zisizemw'izahabu nziza, Agahora mu munezero, Mbese nijye, Cyangwa wowe?
Nind'uzatur'umusaraba, Ngw'aruhuk'iteka ryose, Umwizer'azahabw'ikamba, Mbese nijye, Cyangwa wowe? Azareb'Umwami mu maso, Akiz'imibabaro yose, Abane naw'iteka ryose, Mbese nijye, Cyangwa wowe?
Kandi har'uzakingiranwa, Ubutazakingurirwa, Azabwirwa ngo ntabwo nkuzi, Mbese nijye, Cyangwa wowe? Azahamagarir'ubusa, Urugi ruzaba rwakinzwe, Bazagororerw'asigare, Mbese nijye cyangwa wowe?
Harih'uzishimir'intsinzi, Anesheje, Anesheje, Ari hamwe n'abacunguwe, Mbese nijye, Cyangwa wowe? Har'uzaramukanya n'abe, Batandukanijwe n'ibyago, Be kongera gutandukana, Mbese nijye, Cyangwa wowe?

praise.title: Ngufitiy'Ubutumwa
praise.chorus: Tyo reba (tyo reba) maz'ukire (maz'ukire), Reba Yes'Urakizwa. Byanditswe mw'Ijambo rye, Haleluya Muhugukire urakizwa.
stanzas: Ngufitiy'ubutumwa, Haleluya, N'ubutumwa bw'Umukiza, Bwanditse mw'Ijambo rye, Haleluya, Muhugukire urakizwa.
Ngufitiy'ubutumwa bw'urukundo, Mwene Data, Haleluya, Buturutse mw'ijuru, Haleluya, Bwatanzwe n'Umukiza Yesu.
Weguriw'ubugingo, Haleluya, Buhorahw'iteka ryose, N'uhanga Yes'amaso, Haleluya, Niwe wenyine ugukiza.

praise.title: Ndi Mu Murima
praise.chorus: Turakomeza turagendana, Maz'ambwira ko yantoye, Mbeg'ibyishimo twari dufite, Bitigeze bibaho!
stanzas: Ndi mu murima jyenyine, Ikime gitonze ku byatsi, Numv'ijwi rivuga riti: Umwana w'Iman'aratungutse.
Aravuga maz'ijwi rye ryiza ryikirizwa n'inyoni, Indirimbo nziza namwumvanye ntabw'izamva ku mutima.
Tugumana mu murima, Kuk'ubwire bwari bukubye, Maze anyoherez'ankangara, Arikw'ar'ukumpwitura.

praise.title: Ntabwo Ndamenya
praise.chorus: Kuko nzi nez'uwo nizeye, Kand'ariwe ushobora byose, Niwe undindir'ubugingo, Kugeza urya munsi.
stanzas: Ntabwo ndamenya nez'icyatumye Iman'ingirir'ubuntu, Bigatum'ingir'uwo mu muryango w'abana bayikunda!
Ntabwo nzi nez'uburyo yampaye, Uko kwizera gukiza, N'ubury'Ijambo rye ryampaye amahoro yo mu mutima!
Sinzi ubury'Umwuka yihanisha abanyabyaha nkanjye, Kumenyesh'abandi ibya Yesu, Bidutera kumwizera.
Ntabwo nz'icyo nateganirijwe, Ar'icyiza cyangw'ikibi, Imibabaro n'iminsi myiza, Byose bir'imbere yawe.
Sinzi igih'Umwam'azazira, Ndetse n'ahw'azaturuka, Niba mbana na Yesu mur'iki gihe, Nzamusanganira.

praise.title: Nguhay'Umwanya
praise.chorus: Nguhay'umwanya mu mutima, Uwiberemw'ibihe byose, Ndawukweguriye Mwami wanjye, Uwiberemw'ibihe byose.
stanzas: Wavuye mw'ijuru usig'ubwami bwawe, Uza mur'iyi si ku bwanjye, I Betelehemu, Ntiwabonay'icumbi, Kand'ur'Umwami w'abami.
Abamarayika bakuririmbiraga, Bogez'icyubahiro cyawe, Maz'ugeze mw'isi uvuk'ur'umukene, Wicisha bugufi cyane.
Ingunzu zitahiraga mu myobo yazo, Inyoni zirara mu byari, Ariko woweho wararaga butunda, Mw'ishyamba ry'i Galilaya.
Wazaniy'abantu Ijambo rihoraho, Ngo rizabah'umudendezo, Maze barakwanga bakujyan'i Kalvari, Bakwambikiray'amahwa.
Ubw'uzagaruka mw'ikobe ry'indirimbo, Uje mu cyubahiro cyawe, Ndifuza cyane yuko wazampamagara, Ut'icar'iburyo bwanjye.

praise.title: Twabony'Agakiza
praise.chorus: Yesu yabay'incungu y'ibyaha byacu, Yaducunguj'amaraso ye, Nzahora ndirimb'urukundo rwinshi, Yesu yankunze kera.
stanzas: Twabony'agakiza, Muri Yesu Kristo, Yadupfiriye i Kalvari, Mu rukundo rwe rutagir'iherezo, Twatsindishirijwe na Yesu
Igitambo cy'amaraso y'Umukiza, Nicyo cyadukijij'ibyaha, Cyadukuyehw'inenge twari dufite, Ubu tur'abana b'Imana.
Urukund'Imana yakunze umuntu, N'ukuri ruhebuje byose, Nta yindi mpano dufite twakwitura, Tuguhay'imitima yacu.

praise.title: Uko Ndushaho kumukorera
praise.chorus: Uko njya ndushaho kumukorera, Nawe, nikw'arushaho kunyuzura, Kandi uko ndushaho kumukunda, Nawe nikw'arushaho kunyuzuramo.
stanzas: Aho menyey'Umukiza, Nkanagengwa nawe, Uko ndushaho kumukorera, Nikw'arushaho kunyuzuramo.
Angirir'ubuntu bwinshi, Nkamererwa neza, Uko ndushaho kumuyoboka, Nikw'arushaho kunyuzuramo.

praise.title: Nabonye Kuza Kwa Yesu
praise.chorus: Nasingizwe, Haleluya, Nasingizwe, Haleluya, Nasingizwe, Haleluya, Niw'utuyobora.
stanzas: Nabonye kuza kwa Yesu afit'icyubahiro, Amaze gusenya rwos'ububiko bw'umujinya, Yadukijije n'ubugi bw'inkot'ityaye cyane, Niw'utuyobora.
Namubonye no mu mazu y'abantu benshi cyane, Bamwubakiramw'ibicaniro nimugoroba, Nongera kumubon'ac'imanza zitarenganya, Niw'utuyobora.
Akomeje guhamagaz'abant'ijwi ry'impanda, Arateguriz'abantu bose gucirw'imanza. Mutima wanjye mwitabe vuba unezerewe, Niw'utuyobora.

praise.title: Mbeg'Umunsi Mwiza!
praise.chorus: Inteko zingana n'umusenyi, Zingana n'umusenyi mwinshi, Abacunguwe bazangana n'umusenyi, Umusenyi bangana n'umusenyi.
stanzas: Mbeg'umunsi mwiz'ubw'abacunguwe bazaba bar'imbere ye. Bazaririmb'indirimbo kubw'ikuzo n'ubuntu bwayo.
Ndareb'ingabo zitabarika zerekan'umucyo w'ijuru, Zifit'amahoro atangaje ku maremb'arabagirana.
Numv'ijwi ryiza ry'Umucunguzi riva ku ntebe ye y'ubwami, Nimuz'abahiriwe na Data. Mwambikw'ikamba ryo kunesha.
Abera bazaririmba n'abamarayika batabarika, Isi izahind'umushyitsi kand'ibyago bizaba bishize.

praise.title: Nimutyo Turirimban'Umunezero
praise.chorus: **S. na T.:** Mu gihe gito, Mu gihe gito, Tuzaba tugezeyo, Tugiye kuban'ubudatandukana, Ubu tugiye kugerayo. **A. na B.:** Mu gihe gito, Mu gihe gito, Tuzaba tugezeyo, Tugiye kuban'ubudatandukana, Ubu tugiye kugerayo.
stanzas: Nimutyo turirimban'umunezero, Twegereje kuger'iwacu, Aho niho tuzaban'iteka ryose, Ubu tugiye kugerayo.
Mutyo dushishikare dukore neza, Twegereje kuger'iwacu, Kand'Imana yiteguye kutwakira. Ubu tugiye kugerayo.
Dukomez'urugendo twe gucogora, Twegereje kuger'iwacu, Nimutyo twamamaz'iyo nkuru nziza, Ubu tugiye kugerayo.
Mbeg'umunezero tuzagirirayo! Twegereje kuger'iwacu, Ntituzongera kubogoz'amarira, Ubu tugiye kugerayo.

praise.title: Muze Dusingiz'Umwami
stanzas: Muze dusingiz'Umwami, Abera muz'imbere ye, Abahora mumuramya, Mwamamaz'ububasha bwe.
Mumusingiriz'ahera, Muririmbe mwisanzuye, Nimumuramye mwunamye, Mumwubahe kukw'abumva.
Murahoran'ubuntu bwe butemba buv'i Siyoni, N'Umuremyi, N'Uhoraho, Bose nibamusingize.

praise.title: Ahw'Umukiza Anyobora
praise.chorus: Ahw'Umukiza anyobora, Nzemera mukurikire, Ahw'azanyobora hose, Nzajya mukurikira.
stanzas: Ahw'Umukiza anyobora, Nzemera mukurikire, Nzamukurikir'iteka, Sinzakorwa n'isoni.
N'ubwo haba mu mwijima, Nkagenda nyobagurika, Nzumv'ijwi ry'uwo Mukiza rinsubizemw'intege.
N'ubw'isi yambushabusha, Nkabur'epfo na ruguru, Mukiza uzandamira, Ntabwo nzarambarara.
Ibi byago nibishira, Azanyijyanir'iwacu, Ntihabay'umubabaro, Nzaba ntanye n'ibyaha.

praise.title: Twumvire Mwami
stanzas: Twumvire Mwami, Turakuramya, Uduteg'amatwi, Duh'amahoro. Amen.

praise.title: Nzinutsw'Ibyo Mw Isi
stanzas: Nzinutsw'ibyo mw'isi, Mpisemo Yesu! Sinzifatanya nabyo, Mpisemo Yesu! N'isi y'umwijima, Nta buruhukiro, Yesu niwe mugisha, Mpisemo Yesu!
Wa si we, winshuka, Mpisemo Yesu! Nzabana naw'iteka, Namuhisemo, Ibyo mw'isi byose, n'iby'igihe gito, Bimeneka nk'ibumba, Mpisemo Yesu!
Iby'isi n'inzozi, Mpisemo Yesu! Niwe umber'umucyo, Mpisemo Yesu! Nashatse kwikiza, Binsubiz'inyuma, Yesu niwe wanyuze, Niwe mpisemo!
Ntabwo ntiny'urupfu, Mpisemo Yesu! Nshaka kubahw'iteka, Mpisemo Yesu! Ndashaka kugera, Aho nzab'iteka, Nzaba mu gituza cye, Mpisemo Yesu.

praise.title: Mutima Wanjye Ucururuke
stanzas: Mutima wanjye ucururuke, Nugir'ibiguter'impagarara, Wiringire Ishobora byose, N'imigambi yayo myiza.
Mutima wanjy'iby'ari byo byose, N'ubw'ibihe byagenda bihinduka, Imbabazi, zayo ntizishira, Zihorahw'ibihe byose.
Mutima wanjye uremerewe, N'ubwo wab'utew'ubwoba n'urupfu, Ni wiheba wisung'Uwiteka, Agukingurir'ijuru.
Mutima wanjy'uhereye kera, Ntiwigeze ubur'umudendezo, Isung'Imana izakwakira, Wemere kugengwa na yo.
Ubugingo bwiza buboneye, Bushishikarira gukor'ibyiza, Mukiza mfasha ngo mbugereho, Ump'umutim'utunganye.

praise.title: Ikuzo Ni Iryawe!
praise.chorus: Mbeg'urukundo ruhebuje! Nababariwe, N'inkuru nziza kuri twe.
stanzas: Ikuzo n'iryawe Data wa Twese, Nari nahabiye kure yawe, Wangejeje mu mucyo w'itangaza, Umvana mu bubata ndakira.
Mbeg'urukundo rutarondoreka! Rwatumye Yesu azakunshaka. Nar'umuhanya sinari nkwiriye, Gukira ngukesha Yesu gusa.
Akir'uyu mutima wanjye Mwami, Nkweguriy'imibereho yanjye, Wowe wanyitangiye ukankiza, Wanyejeshej'amaraso yawe.
Mana yanjye nkingira ndakwinginze, Sinashobora kwirwanirira, Kugira ngo nzanezererw'iteka, Twishimye, Dusingiza Umwami.

praise.title: Umukiza Niw'Unyobora
stanzas: Umukiza niw'unyobor'iyo ndi mu bishuko, N'iy'amakub'angose, Amber'ubuhungiro, Niw'unkingir'ibishuko, Yesu nyiyoborere.
Uhosh'umuraba nk'umubyey'uhoz'umwana we, Ndets'uranawutegek'ubwaw'ukakumvira, Mwami wanjye Yesu nkunda, Ujy'Unyiyoborera.
Iyo negerey'inkengero ngashy'ubwoba, Nkakwihishamo, Ndaruhuka, Nkumv'umpumuriz'uti: Witinya ntacy'uteze kuba, Nzajya nkuyobora.

praise.title: Yesu Araduhamagara!
stanzas: Yes'araduhamagara, Ashaka kudukiza, Atubwiz'ijwi rye ati: Mukristo nkurikira.
Yes'araduhamagara, Ngo tuve mu by'iyi si, Araduhamagar'ati: Mukristo nkunda cyane.
Iyo tumerewe neza, Cyangwa se tubabaye, Araduhamagar'ati: Mukristo nkunda rwose.
Yes'araduhamagara, Mwami turakwitabye, Duhe kukumvira, Tugukunde kuruta byose.

praise.title: Nimucane Amatabaza
praise.chorus: Mubonez'amatabaza, Kandi nimwubah'Imana, Kuza kw'Umwami kuri hafi, Mubonez'amatabaza.
stanzas: Nimucan'amatabaza, Umwijim'ubay'icyago, Hazab'umwijim'ukaze, Umwam'ataragaruka.
Abant'ibihumbi byinshi, Bahinyur'ubu butumwa, Natwe tubushikamyemo, Dutegerez'Umukiza.
Ijambo rye n'itabaza, Ntituzigera tuyoba, N'ubw'amakub'ari hose, Ntabw'Iman'izaduhana.
Dukor'imirimo myiza, Twe guh'ab'iy'is'urwaho, Tuzabiherw'imigisha, Nidukomeza kwizera.

praise.title: Ujyuvug'Ibya Yesu
praise.chorus: Vuga Yesu gusa, Bizakuyobor'iteka, Jy'ubivug'uririmba, Kandi unasenga.
stanzas: Ujy'uvug'ibya Yesu, Inshuti y'ukuri, Ngwin'uduhumurish'ibyo yagukoreye.
