Ujy'uvug'ibya Yes'uzumv'ubabariwe, No kubw'ubuntu bwe tuzagera mw'ijuru.
Sinabura kuvug'iby'umusaraba we, Nkund'uwo Mukiza, Kuko yanyitangiye.
Uvug'ibya Yesu, Ntupfush'igih'ubusa, Kutita ku nshingano, Bitesh'agaciro.
Ujy'uvug'ibya Yesu, N'ubwo wacogora, Va mu ntege nke zawe, Umwiyegurire.

praise.title: Ushimirw'Ibyiza Byose
stanzas: Ushimirwe ibyiza byose, Siyoni murwa w'Imana, Itavuguruzwa yakugiz'ubuturo bwayo bwite, Wubatswe ku Rutare rw'iteka, N'iki cyaguhangara? Ugoteshejw'inkike z'agakiza, Reka gutiny'abanzi bawe.
Dore amazi y'ubugingo, Atemb'ava mu rukundo, Niy'abeshahw'abana bawe, Imibabar'igashira. Ninde se wacogora, Har'uwo mugez'umar'inyota? Ubuntu bw'uwo Mutanga-bugingo,tabwo buzagir'iherezo.
Ahazenguruts'uwo murwa, Har'ibicu n'umuriro, Byerekana ko kugaruka kw'Umwami kuri bugufi, Hahirw'abazatur'i Siyoni, Bejeshejw'amaraso, Biyeguriye Yes'abahindur'abami, N'abatambyi b'Imana.
Ndi mu muryango w'i Siyoni, Kubw'ubuntu bwawe Mwami, N'ubwo bampindur'urw'amenyo, Nzasingiz'izina ryawe, Ibinezeza byo mur'iyi si, Bihita nk'umuyaga, Umunezero uhoraho, Wateguriw'abana b'i Siyoni.

praise.title: Mbes'Aho Tuzahurira Ku Cyambu?
praise.chorus: Mbes'aho tuzahurira ku cyambu cya rwa ruzi? Tuzabonanirayo tuhanezererw'iteka?
stanzas: Mbes'aho tuzahurira ku cyambu cya rwa ruzi, Ahahor'umucy'iteka, Ntihab'umubabaro?
Tuzahurira ku cyamb'urugendo rurangiye? Mbes'aho tuzahurirayo, Maze twiruhutse?
Mbes'aho twese tuzahurira mu mudugudu, Wubatswe n'Uhoraho, Urimbishijwe yasipi?
Abacunguwe bose, Bazaririmb'indirimbo, Kand'ibiremwa byose bizasingiz'Uhoraho.
Mbes'aho tuzabonana n'abo twakundanaga, Maze twumv'amajwi yabo tubareba mu maso?
Mbese tuzabonana na Krist'Umukiza wacu, Aje kujyan'intore ze mu bwami buhoraho?

praise.title: Abatuye Mw'Isi Mwese
stanzas: Abatuye mw'isi mwese, Muririmbir'Uhoraho, Mumukorere mwishima, Mwogez'icyubahiro cye.
Mumenye kw'ari we Mana, Kukw'ariwe waturemye, Twese tur'umukumbi we, Turagiwe n'Uhoraho.
Muze mwese mu rugo rwe, Muze mwese mumushima, Muhanik'amajwi yanyu, Kukw aribyo bikwiriye.
Mwabaza muti: ni kuki? Nuk'Uhoraho ari mwiza, N'impuhwe ze zikaramba, Nta n'ubwo zizashiraho.

praise.title: Yesu Mucunguzi Wanjye
praise.chorus: Yesu Mucunguzi wanjye, Niwe ndirimbo yanjye, Nta yindi nshuti nabona, Nagereranya nawe.
stanzas: Yesu Mucunguzi wanjye, Niwe byishimo byanjye, Ni wowe ujy'ungoboka, Mu bihe by'amakuba.
Wagumye kumpumuriza, Mu bihe bibi byose, Ubwo nari nshumbirijwe, Ngoswe n'imibabaro.
Ur'ibyiringiro byanjye, Ndayob'ukanyobora, Ni wowe nshuti y'ukuri, Undutir'abo mw'isi.
Ni wow'undem'umutima, Mur'iyi si y'ibyaha, Nzakomeza ngusingize, Ngez'ubwo nzaz'iwawe.

praise.title: Yasezeranye Kuduh'Imvura
praise.chorus: Duh'umugisha, Turifuz'umugisha, Uvuy'iwawe mw'ijuru, Nyabuneka wuduhe.
stanzas: Yasezeranye kuduha, Imvura y'umugisha, Iri sezerano ryayo, Ryaturutse mw'ijuru.
Yasezeranye kuduha, Imvura y'umugisha, Yitugoborer'uyu muns' ikwir'impanda zose.
Yasezeranye kuduha, Imvura y'umugisha, Turayifuz'uy'umunsi, Sohoz'ibyo wavuze.
Yasezeranye kuduha, Imvura y'umugisha, Icyayiduh'uyu munsi, Mana tubabarire.

praise.title: Inkomangiro Yawe Yafata?
praise.chorus: Dufit'inkomangir'itsika, Imiraba yiyungikanya, Ikomangiye ku Rutare, Rushikamye, Umukiza wacu.
stanzas: Inkomangiro yawe yafata, Umuraba w'ibyag'uguteye? Ukagukanagira nk'ingoyi, Inkomangiro yaw'izashikama?
Nib'itsitse ntizateraganwa, Ifashwe n'ukuboko k'Umwami, Imirunga ye iraduhuza, Bitewe n'imbaraga y'ikomeye.
Izashikama mu gihe kibi, Ubw imivumb'izab'ihurura, Umuyaga w'ishuher'usheze, Ntabwo bizarenga ku bwato bwacu.
Ndetse no mu gihe kibi cyane, Twifuz'amazi yaduhembura, Tuzatsika ku nkombe z'ijuru, Umugar'ushire buheriheri.
Ubw'igitondo kizatangaza, N'amarembo arabagirana, Tuzatsika ku nkombe z'ijuru, Umugar'ushire buheriheri.

praise.title: Nta Rindi Zina Nka Yesu
praise.chorus: Zina (zina) ryiza (ryiza), Nta rihwanye n'irya Yesu, Zina (zina) ryiza (ryiza), Nta rihwanye n'irya Yesu.
stanzas: Nta rindi zina nka Yesu, N'izina rihebuje, Rihimbar'abo mw'ijuru, N'abakristo bo mw'isi.
Nta rindi zina nka Yesu, Rimar'imibabaro, Nta zina ryahwana n'irye, Ndetse no mu mahoro.
Mfit'ibyiringiro byo kuzamubon'agarutse, Nizeye kw'azanyakira, Maz'akampumuriza.
Nib'ashaka ko mukorera mu ruzabibu rwe, Azampira mu byo nkora, Kand'ahir'ibyo mvuga.
Nah'urupfu rwanyegura, Kuko nd'umukungugu, Ntacyo bizaba bintwaye, Niringiy'Umukiza.

praise.title: Singizwa Yesu
stanzas: Singizwa Yesu, Umukiza Yazutse, Yesu yaneshej'urupfu, Iteka ryose, Marayik'ufit'umucyo, Aramanuka, Yakinguye igituro, Yesu aranesha, Singizwa Yesu, Umukiza Yazutse, Yesu yaneshej'urupfu, Iteka ryose.
Itegereze: Ni Yesu Umukiza, Umucunguzi w'abantu, Ntushidikanye, Ishime kand'uririmbe! Yesu ariho! Ongera ubyamamaze, Yesu ni muzima. Itegereze: Ni Yesu Umukiza, Umucunguzi w'abantu, Ntushidikanye.

Nta bwoba mfite! Yesu ni muzima pe! Nzajya musingiz'iteka, Mahoro yanjye. Yesu yaraneshereje niwe nizeye. Ni Yesu umbeshejeho, Sinzigera ntinya, Nta bwoba mfite! Yesu ni muzima pe! Nzajya musingiz'iteka, Mahoro yanjye.

praise.title: Nyir'Impuhwe Nyinshi
praise.chorus: **S na A:** Ndaje Yesu, Ndakwitabye, Uko ndi kos'unyemere, Ndaje Yesu ndakwitabye, Mukiz'unyakire. **S na A:** Ndaje Yesu, Ndakwitabye, Uko ndi ko.. unyemere, Ndaje Yesu, Ndakwitabye, Mukiz'unyakire.
stanzas: Nyir'impuhwe nyinshi cyane, Iman'ibabarira, Kwibagirw'ibyaha ikababarir'uwagomye.
Nari kure y'uwo nkunda, Mbabaj'umutima we, Kuko namwimagahw'aba, N'uwanjye yamfiriye.
Yesu ndakwiyeguriye, Ndashaka kubaturwa, Icyaha cyose cyambase, Maze ngikire rwose.
Haleluya yanduhuye, Ubu sinshidikanya, Nderekez'iyo mw'ijur, Nejejwe no kubayo.

praise.title: Bazany'Amaturo Yabo
praise.chorus: Muture Yes'amaturo, Biramunezeza rwose, Muhay'umutima wanjye, Ndamwiyeguriye.
stanzas: Bazany'amaturo yabo, Kuyatur'Umwami Yesu, Kuko bari bamukunze, Maze barayamutura. Iyo neza n'urukundo, Byafashij'umukene, N'amaturo yose batuye, Yar'ay'agaciro.
Umukene yar'ahagaze, Kure y'abaturaga, Maz'abony'uburyo batura, Agir'umunezero. Yuzurwa n'ibyishimo, By'ayo maturo batuye, We, yar'afit'ituro rito, Imbere y'Umwami.
Abwiran'Umwam'agahinda, Ati: Nz'ineza yawe, Akir'iri turo ngutuye, Niryo mutima wanjye, Yes'asubiza yitonze, Ati: S'ituro rito, Nubw'abandi batuye menshi, Urabarengeje.

praise.title: Ari Hafi Kuza
stanzas: Ari hafi kuza, Nahimbazwe Yesu, Azakorany'abatoni be, Bajyane mw'ijuru, Turebe mw'ijuru, Twishime araje! Aje mu cyubahiro cye, Mucunguzi wacu.
Ari hafi kuza, Nahimbazwe Yesu, Imibabaro yacu yose, Ntizibukw'ukundi, Yes'azakuraho, Urupfu burundu, Azaza tuban'iteka, Mucunguzi wacu.
Ari hafi kuza, Nahimbazwe Yesu, Azaz'atungutse ku bicu, Ntidutinye rwose, Twubure amaso, Nguriya araje! Aje kujyana njye nawe, Mucunguzi wacu.

praise.title: Ndakwifuza Yesu Mwiza
stanzas: Ndifuza Yesu Mwiza, Ndagukennye cyane, Nd'umushyitsi n'umwimukira, Singira gakondo, Ndifuz'urukundo, Rwawe rumpumuriza, Runyobora ngakomera cyane, Sintezuke.
Ndifuz'umutima wa Yesu ngo nduhuke, Ng'untere kumutur'imibabaro yanjye yose, Ndifuz'Umwuka Wera, Ngw'ambwir'icyo ndi cyo, Arusheho kunyereka Umwana w'Intama.
Ndakwifuza Yesu, Nshaka kuzakubona, Ugoswe n'umukororombya ku ntebe ya cyami, Nzahora nezeranywe n'abo wacunguye, Nzahora ngusingiz'iteka, Ndi kumwe nawe.

praise.title: Iby'Usahaka Nibibeho
praise.chorus: Iby'ushaka (ushaka) nibibeho (bibeho), Utungany'umutima wanjye, Iby'ushaka bibe.
stanzas: Mukiza naraguhemukiye, Ndanakwimura ku mpamvu nkeya, Utungany'umutima wanjy'iby'ushaka bibe.
Nari mfit'imibabaro myinshi, Ntakir'inshuti nahemukiye, N'ubu ngubu ndacyavuga, Nt'iby'ushaka bibe.
Umwuka waw'utangir'ubuntu, Agenderer'umutima wanjye, Humuriz'umutima wanjy' ibyushaka bibe.
Hindur'ubugingo bwanjye bushya, Ubutegeke bub'uk'ushaka, Ndind'ibimbuza kuvuga, Iby'ushaka bibe

praise.title: Haba Ubwo Umwijima Ubudika
praise.chorus: Nzahungira kuri Yesu (kuri Yesu), Kukw'ariw'undush'imbaraga (imbaragaa), Nzahungira kuri Yesu (kuri Yesu), Kukw'ariw'undush'imbaraga.
stanzas: Hab'ubw'umwijim'ubudika, Maze nkabur'inzira pe, Ibyago bikiyongeranya, Bikantera no kwiheba.
Hab'umunsi umbera mubi, Natambuka ngateguza, Nuko nkumva nguy'agacuho, Maze nkisunga Rutare.
Nzanikomeza ku Rutare, Nibwo nzashir'agahinda, Nirwo ruzanshoboz'inzira, Zirimw'ibihanamanga.

praise.title: Nimusingize Umukiza
praise.chorus: Abantu bose basingiz'Umukiza wazutse, Musingiz'uwo Mukiza, Ubavana mu byaha.
stanzas: Nimusingiz'Umukiza, Mumurebe mukire, N'abanyabyaha nibaze, Arabamar'inyota, N'ubwo yigeze kwicisha bugufi, Yar'Umwami, Impumyi zihumuka kubw'amaraso ya Yesu.
Nimusingiz'uwo Mukiza, Mwese mumuramye, Abamushakan'umwete, Nabo azabakira, Bavuy'impande zose, Bihuta banezerewe, Batwaye umusaraba wa Yesu, Abakize.
Nimumuh'icyubahiro, Niwe Mwana w'Imana, Ndetse n'abatamwitaho, Arabiyegereza, Ngo bajye bibuk'umusaraba yatangiyeho, Bib'uruhererekane mu bantu, Bamuramye.
Mumusingize mu ndirimbo, No mu masengesho, Umucunguzi wikoreye ibyaha by'abantu, Abato n'abakuru bamwubahe, Bamuramye, Ibipfamatwi byumve, N'ibiragi biririmbe

praise.title: Hari Igihugu Kibamo Umucyo
praise.chorus: **S. na A.:** Twemer'umusaraba, Tuzambikw'ikamba, Dukomez'iby'ukuri, Nibwo tuzagerayo. **T. na B.:** Twemer'u ...sa...saraba, Tuzambikw'ika... ikamba, Dukome... by'u... by'ukuri, Nibwo tuzagerayo.
stanzas: Har'igihugu kibamw' umucyo urabagirana, Ntabwo habayo umwijima, Yesu n'umucyo waho.
Ibihe byaho ni byiza rwose, Nta mpinduk'ibayo, Ntabwo habay'impagarara, Tuhabik'ubutunzi.
Mw'ijuru hariy'amazu meza arabagirana, Tuzahahurira n'inshuti, Twakiranw'ibyishimo.
Twifuza cyane kwimuka vuba, Mur'iyi s'ishaje, Tujye guturana n'abera, Maze dut'umuruho.

praise.title: Nyobora Mwami Wanjye
praise.chorus: Mukiza we, Mpabura nahabiye kure, Unyambutse mw'isumo (mw'isumo), Mwami ngendane nawe (nawe).
stanzas: Nyobora Mwami wanjye (Mwami wanjye), Ne kurorongotana (mbane nawe), Mb'amahor'unyoboye (unyoboye), Iyo nkuri bugufi (nkuri bugufi).
Iyo ngeze mu kaga (ncits'intege) Umber'ubuhungiro (buhungiro), Nyakiran'imbabazi (imbabazi), Nezerwa turi kumwe (turi kumwe).
Ntabara Mwami mwiza (Mwami mwiza), Mu mibabaro yanjye (yanjye yose), Kugez'ubwo nzager'aho (nzager'aho), Ntazarir'ukundi (ntazarir'ukundi).

praise.title: Mbese Ngend'Imbokoboko?
praise.chorus: Mbese ngende ntacyo mfite, Nsanganir'uwo Mwami wanjye, Nta n'umwe namukirije, Mbese ngende ntacyo mfite?
stanzas: Mbese ngend'imbokoboko, Nsanganiy'Umukiza wanjye? Nta cyiza namukoreye, Mbese ngend'imbokoboko?
Sinterw'ubwoba n'urupfu, Umukiza yarankijije. Ku musanga ntacyo mfite, Numva binkojej'isoni.
Napfushij'igih'ubusa, Nakoz'ibyangwa n'Umukiza, Ubu ndamutakambira, Musaba kumbabarira.
Mwebw'abera mushishikare, Mukore hakiri kare, Dor'ijoro riraguye, Mutarakiz'imitima.

praise.title: Yesu Niwe Rufatiro
praise.chorus: **S. na A.:** Yesu n'Urutare, Bwugamo bwacu, Yesu niwe soko, Y'umunezero. **T. na B.:** Yesu Rutare, Yesu n'Urutare, Bwugamo bwacu, …cubwacu Yesu ni soko, Yesu niwe soko, Y'umunezero.
stanzas: Yesu niwe rufatiro, Twubakahw'ingo zacu, N'Urutare rukomeye, Ntabwo runyegenyega.
Iyo turi kumwe nawe, Atwuzuz'urukundo, Niwe byiringiro byacu, Atwonger'imbaraga.
Duh'urukundo nyakuri, Ukomez'ingo zacu, Turind'imigambi mibi, Iva kuri sekibi.

praise.title: Yesu Ntabwo Yakwanga
stanzas: Yesu ntabwo yakwanga, N'ubw'ur'umunyabyaha, Niwe nshuti ihebuje, Ntazanga kukwakira, Imana yatanze Yesu, Kugira ngo ducungurwe, N'ubwo wamuhemukiye, Ntazanga kukwakira.
N'ubw'ujy'umugayisha, Ntazakwirengagiza, Niwe nzira n'umucyo, Ntazanga kukwakira, Azagusendahw'ibyaha, maz'usigar'utunganye, Azagukiz'urupfu, Ntabw'azakwirengagiza.
Ngaho ngwin'utiganda, Ntazanga kukwakira, Gana ku musaraba, Ntazanga kukwakira, Numara gusanga Yesu, Ntuzasubira mu byaha, Ngwino uhabw'ubugingo, Butagir'iherezo.

praise.title: Uhoraho Iyo Nitegereje
praise.chorus: Nishimira kukuririmbira, Mana nkuru y'urukundo Nishimira kukuririmbira, Mana nkuru, Y'urukundo.
stanzas: Uhoraho, Iyo nitegereje, Ibitangaza by'ibyo wakoze, Ar'izuba, N'ukwezi n'inyenyeri, N'ibindi bintu byose waremye.
Mana nkunda, Iyo nitegereje, Igiti cyose mu byo waremye, Binyibutsa igiti cy'i Kalvari, Umwana wawe yambambiweho.
Iyo numva inyoni ziririmba mu biti byiza yaturemeye, Urusobe rw'amajwi yazo meza n'urw'amasumo biranezeza.
Igih'ibyago bizaba bishize, Abera bose bagukikije, Tuzagusingiza iteka ryose, Kandi turamy'Uwatwitangiye.

praise.title: Nzasa Na Yesu
praise.chorus: Nzasa na Yesu rwose, Niyo ndirimbo yanjye, Ndi hanze n'imuhira, Nzajya nsa na Yesu.
stanzas: N'ubw'ibyiza by'isi byancuka, Nzasa na Yesu, Ntacyo mw'isi kizampindura, Nzasa na Yesu.
Nabohow'ingoyi z'umwanzi, Nzasa na Yesu, Nzarushaho kumukorera, Nzasa na Yesu.
Naba mw'isi cyangwa mw'ijuru, Nzasa na Yesu, Nzahora mbyamamaz'iteka, Nzasa na Yesu.
Kugira ngo nzajye mw'ijuru, Nzasa na Yesu, Kuko nifuza kuzashimwa, Nzasa na Yesu.

praise.title: Iyi Isi Niya Data
stanzas: Iy'isi n'iya Data, Kand'iyo ntez'amatwi, Numv'ibiremwa bisingiza izina rye mu ndirimbo, Isi n'iya Data, Mpora mbitekereza, Iby'Uhoraho yaremye byose, Ni byiza bitangaje.
Iy'isi n'iya Data, Inyoni ziririmba, Umuseke wa mu gitondo, N'impumuro y'uburabyo, Ibimera byose, Hamwe n'ibyo mw'ijuru, Byose bigaragaz'ububasha, N'imbaraga ze nyinshi.
Iy'isi n'iya Data, N'ubwo yuzuy'ibyaha, Nta kizaganz'imbaraga ze, Azahor'ari ku ngoma, Isi n'iya Data, Mbese nakwiganyira? Imana yac'izahora ku ngom'ibihe bidashira.
Iy'isi n'iya Data, Ntabwo nzabyibagirwa, N'ubw'ibyaha biyuzuyemo, Imana n'umuyobozi, Isi n'iya Data, Ni kuki nababara? Data niwe uri ku ngoma, Ijuru n'isi byishime.

praise.title: Isi N'Ibiyirimo
stanzas: Isi n'ibiyirimo, Byose n'iby'Imana, Twese tur'ab'Imana, N'ubutunzi bwose, Imana ni nyir'ibintu byose, Turi ibisonga byayo, Dukwiriye kuyitunganira, Tub'ibisonga nyakuri.
Impano waduhaye, Ziguhesh'ikuzo, Duhe kuzikoresha, Mu murimo wawe, Zijye zikugaragaza Mwami, Ahantu hose tunyura, Impano waduhaye Mukiza, Tuzikoresh'umurimo.
Igihe waduhaye, N'impan'ikomeye, Tugikoreshe neza, Twitegur'Umwami, Buri gihe tubane n'Imana, Dukoresh'igihe neza, Igihe Imana yaduhaye, Tugikoresh'umurimo.
Yaduhay'ubutunzi ngo tubukoreshe, Ibyo dutunze byose, Byose n'iby'Imana, Tube ibisonga yishimira, Dukiranukir'Imana, Ibyo dutunze tubikoreshe, Umurimo w'Uwiteka.

praise.title: Bona N'Ubwo Ngoswe N'Ibicu
praise.chorus: Nagira Yesu wenyine, Byose byatamuruka, Niwe zuba ryaka nk' inyenyeri y'i Betelehemu.
stanzas: Bona n'ubwo ngoswe n'ibicu, Kandi nkab'inkehwe, Kandi nkaba ndembejwe n'amaganya menshi cyane.
N'ubw'urugendo rwo mw'isi rwantera gucogora, Najya gusingir'uburabyo, Ngasingir'amahwa.
N'ubw'umutima wanjye, Wazirikan'Uwankunze, Bigatuma ngir'agahinda, Kenshi nkababara.
Nzirikany'icyubahiro, Ntegereje kwinjira, Navuga Yesu wenyine, Byose byatamuruka.

praise.title: Intama Mirongo Cyenda N'Icyenda
stanzas: Intama mirongo cyenda n'icyenda, Zari mu kiraro cyazo, Imwe yazimiye yararagiye, Yagiye mu bihanamanga, Dor'irazerera mu kidaturwa, Yasiz'Umwungeri w'impuhwe nyinshi, Yasiz'Umwungeri w'impuhwe nyinshi.
Ufite mirongo cyenda n'icyenda, Mbese warets'iyo Mwami, Aransubiz'ati: Nayo n'iyanjye, Ibarirwa mu ntama zanjye, Bona nahw'inzira yakukumuka, Ndayikurikira mu kidaturwa, Ndebe ko nabasha kuyibonayo.

Nta muntu wamenya uko yarushye, N'uko yambuts'imigezi, Ryar'ijoro ribi kandi ntaw'uzi, Uko yataruy'iyo ntama, Yumvis'ijwi ryayo mu kidaturwa, Ntabwo yagirag'uwayitabara, Rwose yar'ishigaje hat'igapfa.
Mwami nyerek'inzira wanyuzemo, Mbone mw'amaraso yawe, Yavuye ku bwacu twarazimiye, Maz'utugarura mu bushyo, Nyereka za nkovu zo mu biganza, Wakomerekejwe muri ryo joro, N'igihe bakwambikaga ya mahwa.

Ku misozi hose no mu bikombe, No ku bitare ku manga, Har'ijwi rirenga ngo nimwishime, Intama yanjye yabonetse, Abamarayika bavuga bati: Nimwishim'Umwam'abony'intama ye, Nimwishim'Umwam'abony'intama ye.

praise.title: Mu Gihugu Cyiza Twasezeraniwe
praise.chorus: **S. na A.:** Tugeze hafi, Hafi y'iwacu, Dore hararabagirana cyane, Har'umucy'uturuka mu marembo, Aho niho tuzab'iteka ryose, Turirimbana n'abamarayika, Turi hafi yaho. **T. na B.:** Tuge… tugeze y'iwacu…, Hafi y'iwacu, Dore hararabagirana cyane, Har'umucy'uturuka mu marembo, Aho niho tuzab'iteka ryose, Turirimbana n'abamarayika, Turi, turi hafi …ho.
stanzas: Mu gihugu cyiza twasezeraniwe, Hariy'ururembo rwera rw'Imana, Tuzamuk'imisozi tunaniwe, Tukarabukw'aho tuzab'iteka.
Mu bitabo by'abahanuzi tubwirwa, Iby'umudugudu wera w'Imana, N'inzira zaho zisizwe zahabu, Amazu yahw'ararabagirana.
Abazajyayo n'abizera bakeya, Bakomez'amategeko y'Imana, Tuzahora turangurur'amajwi, Turirimb'indirimbo z'ibyishimo.
Mbese tuzahurirayo bene Data, Mu gihugu kirasirwa n'izuba? Nimwemera ubutumwa bw'Imana, Yesu n'aza azabahamagara.

praise.title: Wiringir'Umwam'Imana
praise.chorus: Izer'uko yakubwiye, Yihang'amas'iteka ryose, Uyiringire ibihe byose, Niyo Mwungeri wawe.
stanzas: Wiringir'Umwam'Imana, Kukw'ari y'izakuyobora, Izere Nyir'imigisha, Niw'uzagukenura.
Wiringir'Umwam'Imana, Umushukanyi nakwegera, Wiringir'Umwam'Imana, Ujy'uyihungiraho.
Wiringir'Umwam'Imana, Mu birushya no mu makuba, Wiringir'Umwam'Imana, Yih'umutwaro wawe.
Wiringir'Umwam'Imana, Mu mibereho yawe yose, Wiringir'Umwam'Imana, Kugez'ahw azazira.

praise.title: Habuka Wa Mpabe We
praise.chorus: Ngwino hakirih'umucyo, Yes'aragutegereje, Aramburiy'amaboko, Abe bahabye.
stanzas: Habuka wa mpabe we, Urahamagarwa, Rek'ibyaha byawe ngwino, Wikwinangira.
Umukiz'arakwinginga, Ntiwinangire, Umv'araguhamagara, Mukingurire.
Uraritswe n'ubutumwa, We kwinangira, Bukuzaniy'agakiza, Bukingurire.
We kwigomw'umunezero, Ngo winangire, Nibw'uzagir'amahoro, Mukingurire.

praise.title: Dutegerej'Igitondo Cyiza
stanzas: Dutegerej'igitondo cyiza, Tuzabon'abacu twabuze, Nibwo bazakanguka, Tuban'iteka ryose, Ntabwo tuzongera gutandukana.
Ubw'impanda izaba ivuze, Ibituro bizakingurwa, Abera babivemo, Ntibazongera gupfa, Abera bazahabw'indi mibiri.
Igitondo kiri hafi cyane, Bagenzi mwe bugiye gucya, Umucyo w'itangaza, Uturasire twese, N'umunsi w'ihumure kuri twese.

praise.title: Yesu Ni Umukiza Wanjye
praise.chorus: Niwe wampagaritse ku Rutare, Mu gihugu cy'umutarwe, Kand'ampisha mu rukundo rwe rwinshi, Andindish'ukuboko kwe, Andindish'ukuboko kwe.
stanzas: Yesu n'Umukiza wanjy'utangaje, Kuko andutira byose, Niwe wampagaritse ku Rutare, Mpaboner'umunezero.
Yesu n'Umukiza wanjy'utangaje, Antur'imitwaro yose, Arankomeza sinzanyeganyega, Kukw'ahor'ambumbatiye.
Ansesurahw'imigisha nk'ikamba, Anyuzuz'ubugwaneza, Ndirimba ntikenga nsingiz'Imana, Niyo Mucunguzi wanjye.
Ninambara kurabagirana kwe, Nibwo nzamusanganira, Nzajya ndirimbana n'abacunguwe, Indirimbo y'agakiza.

praise.title: Isi Ni Iy'Uhoraho
praise.chorus: Isi yose, Isi yose, Yamamaz'ubutumwa bwiza bwa Yesu, Mutwar'umusaraba, Mushing'ibendera, Kugez'ubw'abantu bose bazihana. Amen. (Ku gice cya 3).
stanzas: Isi n'iy'Uwiteka, Tumusingize twese, Imisozi n'inyanja n'ibirimo byose, Isi n'iy'Uwiteka, Bose bamuramye, Imidugudu n'ibiyaga byose n'ibye.
Isi n'iy'Uwiteka tuyibimenyeraho, Mpabe nimuhabuke mwe kuyob'inzira, Isi n'iy'Uwiteka ntimugacogore, Umusaraba niwo watuneshereje.
Isi n'iy'Uwiteka, Itegeko n'iri ngo: Mugende, Mwamamaze ubutumwa bwiza, Isi n'iy'Uwiteka, Ganz'iteka Mwami, Amahanga yose ahor'agusingiza.

praise.title: Yes'Arakomang'Ubu
stanzas: Yesu arakomang'ubu, Mukingurire? Aringing'umutima wanjye, Se mukingurire? Muri wo harimw'ibyaha, N'umwijima n'agahinda. Kristo ashaka ko musanga, Se mukingurire?
Se mubwiran'urukundo, Mukingurire? Nakir'uwo Mwami w'ubuntu, Se mukingurire? Ntantererana na hato, Ambabarir'ubugome. Mbese namwimura burundu, Cyangwa munambeho?
Umutima w'ubwibone, Ndawukinguye. Mwakirany'ibyishimo byinshi, Ndamukinguriye. Mukiza mwiza tubane, Undind'ibishuko byose, Mb'amahor'iyo turi kumwe, Ngwino Mwami Yesu.

praise.title: Nimushimir'Imbabazi Za Yesu
praise.chorus: Mbese ubw'Imana, Iri mu ruhande rwacu, Umubisha wacu, Ninde, Ninde? Umubisha wacu, Se nde?
stanzas: Nimwishimir'imbabazi za Yesu, Kuko yatwicunguriye, Ntacyo twatinya Yes'ashobora byose, Ni we Mukiza wacu.
Mukomerere mu Mwami wacu Yesu mub'abakiranutsi, Mu kaga kose muhagarare mushikamy'azabakomeza.
Nimwiringire Yesu mukomez' amategeko ye by'ukuri, Isi izashira arikw'amategeko y'azahorahw'iteka.
Tuzibanira n'Umwami wacu Yesu azaduh'ubugingo, Kandi nta muntu wabasha kudutesh'uwo Mukiz'umez'atyo.

praise.title: Har'Ijwi Rihamagara
praise.chorus: **S.:** Nimubamurikishirize umucyo w'ubutumwa, Bamenyeshe ko Yes'ariwe wabapfiriye bose. **A.,T. na B.:** Nimubamu... kishirize ...cyo bu....butumwa, Bamenyeshe Ye...riwe ....pfi...ye bose (bose).
stanzas: **S. na A.:** Har'ijwi rihamagar'abarushye, Mubamurikire Harihw'abatabaza ngo bakizwe, Mubamurikire **T. na B.:** Har'ijwi rihamagar'abarushye, Mubamu-rikire, Harihw'abatabaza ngo bakizwe, Mubamu-rikire

**S. na A.:** Harihw'abatabariza gukizwa, Mubamurikire, Tuzan'amaturo ku musaraba, Ngo bamurikirwe. **T. na B.:** Harihw'abatabariza gukizwa, Mubamu-rikire, Tuzan'amaturo ku musaraba, Ngo bamu-rikirwe.

**S. na A.:** Ubuntu bwa Yesu bugwire hose, Mubamurikire, Kand'Umwuka wa Yes'ukwire hose, Mubamurikire. **T. na B.:** Ubuntu bwa Yesu bugwire hose, Mubamu-rikire, Kand'Umwuka wa Yes'ukwire hose, Mubamu-rikire.
**S. na A.:** Twe gucogorera gukora neza, Tubamurikire, Twitegurire kuzahabw'ikamba, Tubamurikire. **T. na B.:** Twe gucogorera gukora neza, Tubamu-rikire, Twitegurire kuzahabw'ikamba, Tubamu-rikire.

praise.title: Mutim'Ufit'Intege Nke
praise.chorus: Wa munyantege nke we, Tegereza, Kandi nturambirwe, B'uretse, Tegereza, Ntukivovote.
stanzas: Mutim'ufit'intege nke, Harih'uburuhukiro, N'iwacu hadahinduka, Se ntiwifuza kubayo?
Ubw'uzatur'umutwaro, Ibyo mw'isi birangiye, Uzashyikir'agakiza Tegerez'utivovota.
Nib'amahw'ari mu nzira, Tekerez'uwayambitswe, N'ubabara wibuke k'Uwera, Nawe yababajwe.
Ujy'uhora wihanganye, Ntukibagirwe gusenga, Harih'ubw'uzaruhuka, Tegerez'utivovota.

praise.title: Ubugingo Bw'Abantu
praise.chorus: Ye ni koko, Burihuta, Rwose bwihuta nk'igicucu, N'iby'ukuri nta mumaro, Ubugingo bwacu n'ubusa.
stanzas: Ubugingo bw'abantu, Buhita nk'igicucu, Imbere yawe Mwami Mana, Buhita n'ingoga.
Umunt'ab'afit'izina rimutey'ishema, Imyaka yamara guhita, Rikibagirana.
Ya nyenyeri y'Umukiza y'i Betelehemu, Natw'ibasha kutuyobora, Tukamugeraho.
Mwami Mana komez'iyo nyenyer'imurike, Umucyo way'ukwire hose, Umwijim'uhunge.

praise.title: Ndabatuwe Sinkibabaye
stanzas: Ndabatuwe sinkibabaye, Yesu ndaje, Yesu ndaje, Nje mu munezero iwawe, Ubu Yesu ndaje, Nje nifuza gufashwa nawe, Ngutuy'intege nke zanjy'unkize, Mvuye mu byaha nje nkugana, Ubu Yesu ndaje.
Nkijijw'isoni sinihebye, Yesu ndaje, Yesu ndaje, Nemey'umusaraba wawe, Ubu Yesu ndaje, Mvuye mu mibabaro y'isi, Ubu ngeze mu mahoro yawe, Simbabaye ndanezerewe, Ubu Yesu ndaje.
Nkiz'imiruho n'ubwibone, Yesu ndaje, Yesu ndaje, Nje kuba mu mahoro yawe, Ubu Yesu ndaje, Nje kuba mu rukundo i wawe, Sinkihebye nje mu munezero, Nj'ah'uri nguruka nk'inuma, Ubu Yesu ndaje.
Wamaz'ubwoba bw'igituro, Yesu ndaje, Yesu ndaje, Nje mu munezero w'iwawe, Ubu Yesu ndaje, Wanyaruye mw'irimbukiro, Ungeza mu mahor'adashira, Ngo mpore nkureba mu maso, Ubu Yesu ndaje.

praise.title: Ni Wowe Gusa
praise.chorus: Ni wowe (ni wowe), Ni wowe (ni wowe), Wanyerets'urukundo, Ni wowe (ni wowe), Ni wowe(ni wowe), Ntaw'uhwanye nawe.
stanzas: Ni wowe gusa nkeneye, Ntaw'undi Mwami. Har'undi mfite mw ijuru, Mwam'atari wowe?
N'ubwo mfit'inshuti nyinshi, N'ibyiza byinshi, Utabirimo Mukiza, Nta mumaro wabyo.
Mbese harih'umutima wuzuy'ineza? Cyangw'ijwi ryiza nakumva rikampumuriza?
Iby'isi ntabwo byantanya nawe Mukiza, Ibyo mur'iy'isi byose, Nta mumaro wabyo.

praise.title: Munsi Mwiza Wejejwe
praise.chorus: Ngwino Sabato, Sabato nziza, Tuboner'imigisha, Mu munsi w'Uhoraho.
stanzas: Munsi mwiza wejejwe, W'icyumweru cyo kurema, Wagizw'uwa karindwi, Wahiriwe n'Imana.
Irangije kurema, Ishyiraho n'Isabato, Iman'irayihira, Natwe tuyiruhuke.
Benshi barwany'Imana, Baruhuka kuwa mbere. Shaka mu Byanditsw'urasanga nta habihamya.
Abanyakuri bazi ko wahinduwe n'umuntu, Ntabw'Ijambo ry'Imana rikwiye guhinduka.
Nashatse mu Byanditswe, Nsang'ariyo yategetswe. Mpera ko nyiruhuka, Kukw'ari yo y'ukuri.

praise.title: Gitare Kirekire
praise.chorus: Nkwihishemo, Nkwihishemo, Wowe Gitare cyanjye, Nkwihishemo.
stanzas: Gitare kirekire njya mpungiraho, Ni wow'umutima wanjye wifuza, Nd'umunyantege nke nshaka kukwisunga, Wowe Gitare cyanjye, Nkwihishemo.
Ngiz'imibabaro kumanywa y'ihangu, Nizingiweho n'ibigeragezo, Ndengewe n'imiraba yiyungikanya, Wowe Gitare cyanjye, Nkwihishemo.
Umwanz'anyibasiye ndi ku rugamba, Ni wowe mpungiraho nkaruhuka, Iyo nibasiwe n'ibigeragezo, Niwe nihishamo, Gitare cyanjye.

praise.title: Mpisemo Umukiza Yesu
praise.chorus: Rwose aho kub'Umwami w'isi, Ngaheranwa n'ibyaha, Nahitamo Yesu mur'iyi si, Niw'undutira byose.
stanzas: Mpisem'Umukiza Yesu gusa, Kurut'ubutunzi bwo mur'iyi si, Andutir'ifeza n'izahabu, Ikiganza cye cyarambambiwe.
Mpisemo Yesu kurut'ikuzo, No kumukorera nivuy'inyuma, Andutir'icyubahiro cy'isi, Nkunda kwitirirwa izina rye.
Arush'ibiremwa byos'ubwiza, Anyur'umutima kuruta byose, Azah'umutima wanjy'ibyiza, Nimwemerera akanyobora.

praise.title: Amahoro Masa
praise.chorus: Amahoro masa, Aturuka ku Mana gusa, Nyamuneka tungany'ubugingo bwanjye, N'urukundo rutarondorwa.
stanzas: Umutima wanjy'urasingiz'Imana, Mu ndirimbo y'umunezero, Nifitiy'amahoro ava mw'ijuru, Yuzuye mu mutima wanjye.
Nifitiy'amahor'arut'ubutunzi, Yuzuye mu mutima wanjye, Kandi nta muntu wabasha kuyanyaga, Ntawe n'aho yakwigir'ate!
Yambereye ubuhungiro nijoro, Bituma mb'uwa Yesu gusa, Nta cyampangara ku manywa na nijoro, Ntacyo rwose haba na gito.
Reka mvug'ibya wa mudugudu mwiza, Uwo nzabona nkanezerwa, Mu ndirimb'abera bazaharirimbir' Imwe n'iyi ngiyi wumva ngo:
N'ubwo nanyuraga makuba y'isi, Nkabur'umunt'umpumuriza, Umukiza wanjye n'inshuti y'ukuri, Yangoteshej'amaboko ye.

praise.title: Yesu Niwe Niringira
stanzas: Yesu niwe niringira, Niwe butunzi bwanjye, Nzakwishingikirizaho, Kugez'igihe nzapfa, Ni wowe umbeshejeho kuko ump'amahoro, Ni wow'ump'umunezero, Ur'ubuzima bwanjye.
Niba bikwiriye kureb'umusaraba wawe, Ngira intungane nkunde amategeko yawe, Ntawe unaniza ngw'akor'ibyo adashoboye, Ntacyo wasaba ng'umuntu abon'icyakwitura.
Njye ndashaka kugendera mu mucyo wawe Yesu, Ngo nzazuke nigira iwawe mw'ijuru heza. Aho niho hari igihugu nzabamw'iteka, Niho Yesu azanyakira ari mu ngoro ye.

praise.title: Igitekerezo Cyiza
stanzas: Igitekerezo cyiza cya Yesu Mukiza, Kivug'uburyo yahoranye n'abantu, N'uko yahamagarag'abana nk'intama ze, Maze bigatuma nkumbura Yesu, Numva nifuza kw'aba yaranshyizehw'ibiganza, Ngw'abe yaranzengurukij'amaboko, Yemwe mba narahiriw'iyo numv'avug'ati: Nimurek'abana bato bansange!

Nzeger'intebe ye ngo mutur'amasengesho, Maze musabe kuba mu rukundo rwe, Kand'uko ndushaho kumushaka mur'iyi si, Nizeye ko nzamubona mw'ijuru. Yagiye mw'ijuru guteguray'amazu meza, Azaturwamo n'abacunguwe gusa. Abana benshi bazaba bateraniyeyo, Kuk'ubwami bwo mw'ijuru ar'ubwabo.

Abantu benshi bazimiriye mur'iyi si, Ntabwo barumv'inkuru y'iwacu heza, Ndifuza ko bamenya ko har'umwanya wabo, Kandi Yesu niw'ubahamagara. Ndifuza kuzishima kur'uwo munsi mukuru, Uzab'ar'umuns'urut'iyindi yose. Ubw'abana bo mw'isi yose bazaterana, Akabaher'umugish'icyarimwe.

praise.title: Urukundo Yes'Ankunda
praise.chorus: Yankunz'urukundo rwinshi (urukundo rwinshi), Yankunz'urukundo rwinshi (urukundo rwinshi), Urukundo Umukiz'ankunda, Nta warurondora.
stanzas: Urukundo Yes'ankunda, Rwatumy'abambwa ku giti, Kugira ngo nkomeze kubaho, Ntawarurondora.
Uburyo yambabarijwe, Yambitsw'ikamba ry'amahwa, Kugira ngo nkomeze kubaho, Nta wabirondora.
Mfit'amahoro muri we, Kukw'ansabira kuri Se, Uko yankirishij'amaraso, Nta wabirondora.
Iyo ndi kumwe na Yesu, Amber'uburuhukiro, Ibyiringiro mfite muri We, Nta wabirondora.

praise.title: Umwami Arakomanga
stanzas: Umwam'arakomanga, Ashaka kubana nawe, Mbeg'ibyishimo kubana nawe? Kingurira uwo Mwami.
Witinya kumusanga! Araguh'ibyiringiro, N'ibyishimo mu mutima wawe. Ese ntubona umucyo?
Kumwakira n'ibyiza, N'ukubabarirwa nawe, N'ijuru Imana iguhaye, Araguha amahoro.
Ahagaze ku rugi, Ashak'umutima wawe. Mbeg'ibyishimo umwakiriye, Akakubera Umwami.

praise.title: Reka Yesu Yinjire Mu Mutima Wawe
praise.chorus: Ubu wishidikanya, Reka kumwihakana, Muh'umutima wawe, Wumwegurire burundu.
stanzas: Reka Yesu yinjire mu mutima wawe maz'akuruhure, Niba wifuz'ubugingo bushya, Umwakire mu mutima.
Nib'ushaka ku mutunganira, Umwemerere akuzemo, Hafi yawe har'isoko yeza, Sanga Yes'agutunganye.
N'ushaka kuzamuririmbira, Umwemerere akuzemo, Nib'ushaka kuzabana nawe, Umwakire mu mutima.

praise.title: Umunsi W'Umuzuko
stanzas: Umunsi w'umuzuko, Umuns'utangaje, Hazab'umunezero, Tuzabon'Imana, Abera bazakangurwa, Bazamurwe mu bicu, Baririmb'indirimbo, Nziza yo kunesha.
Tuzezwa imitima, Tuzabona Yesu, Tuzabana n'Imana mu mucy'utazima, Tuzahora duhimbaza, Dushim'Imana yacu, Yo yatuneshereje, Iduh'agakiza.
Wa juru we ishime, Wa si we ririmba, Abanambye ku Mana, Baranesherejwe, Ibindi biremwa nabyo , Byishime binezerwe, Umwami wacu Yesu, Nasingizw‘ iteka.

praise.title: Ntukumvir'Umubi
praise.chorus: Saba Yes'agufashe, Kand'aguhumurize, Yemeye kukurinda, Azatum'utsinda.
stanzas: Ntukumvir'umubi ujy'agushuka, Umwumviye wese ab'acumuye, Wamutsinda none kubw'Umukiza, Byagufash'ubundi kujy'umunesha.
Wirind'ubucuti bw'abantu babi, Bakunda kukoshya gukor'ibibi. Ntukavug'ijambo ritey'isoni, Ujye wubaha izina ry'Imana.
Ujy'ugira neza, Ufash'abandi, Wirinde kubeshya, Ahubw'ujy'uba, Inyangamugayo kukw'iby'aribyo, Bikundwa na Yesu, Uzagufasha.
Unesha Satani yandikiwe ko, Azahabw'ikamba n'Umukiza we, Tugir'intege nke, Ariko Yesu, Niwe Mutabazi, Udushoboza.

praise.title: Nzabana N'Umwami
praise.chorus: Iwacu, Iwacu, Ngeze hafi yaho.
stanzas: Nzabana n'Umwam'ibihe bidashira, Iryo jambo rivuga ngo: Nzatur'ibudapfa, N'ubwo nkingiranywe mur'uyu mubiri, Buzacya negereje gutah'iwacu heza.
Mu rugo rw'Umwami ndahararikira, Kwizera niko kunyerek'namarembo yaho, N'ubwo njya ncogora s'ukutahashaka, Iyo gakondo y'abera ni Yerusalemu.
Njya ngotwa n'ibyaha, Nkumva ndacogoye, Nka bur'aho mfata nka ya numa yo mu nkuge, Ibicu byeyutse, Umukororombya, W'ihumure urasira mu mutima wanjye.
Nkund'izo ndirimbo zihora mw'ijuru, Izo mw'isi yacu ni nk'indimi z'i Babeli, Harihw'icyo nkunda, Nukw'abazazuka, Bazongera kubana na Yesu, Yee, Amina.

praise.title: Mwami Yesu Mugenga
stanzas: Mwami Yesu Mugenga w'ibi bintu byose, Wambay'ubumuntu ku bwacu, Ndakwiyeguriye nzakubaha, Kuk'ur'ikuzo n'ikamba ryanjye.
Icyanya cyiza n'amashyamba ni meza, N'ibimera nabyo ni byiza, Yes'urabirusha kand'uraboneye, Uturuhur'imitima.
Umucyo ni mwiza, Umwez'ukawurusha, N'umucyo w'inyenyeri nuko, Yes'urabirusha kand'uraboneye, Kurush'abamarayika.

praise.title: Umwami Arahamagara
praise.chorus: Nimuhaguruke mushikame, Mw'izina ry'uwo Mwami, Muvuge inkuru y'agakiza, Muyamamaze hose.
stanzas: Umwam'arahamagara abasaruzi bitanze, Ibisarurwa bireze abasaruzi ni bake.
Nimwihute mutabare abari mu byaha bose, Mubatabaz'amaboko muc'ingoyi zibaboshye.
Nimumenyesh'abakene nabo baze mu birori, Yes'umutsim'uhoraho yiteguye kubakira.
Nimwihute dor'igihe cy'isarura kirashize, Hagiye kuzab'igihe tutazabasha gukora.

praise.title: Urukundo Rw'Imana Yacu
praise.chorus: Mbeg'urukundo rutangaje, Rutagir'urugero, Abera bazaruririmba, Ibihe bidashira.
stanzas: Urukundo rw'Imana yacu, Nta muntu warurondora, Rusaguts'ikirere cyose, Rugera no munsi y'isi. Abantu bose bacumuye, Bacunguwe na Yesu, Umwana we wese wahabye, Yaramwicunguriye.
Ubw'ibihe bizah'ibindi, N'ubwami bw'isi bwashize, Abantu bakanga gusenga, Amabuy'azaririmba. Urukundo rw'Imana yacu, Ntabwo rurondoreka, Rwacunguy'abo mw'isi bose, Ruzaririmbw'iteka.
Inyanja zose zaba wino, N'ijuru ryab'impapuro, Tukandikisha agati kose, Umuntu wes'akandika, Urukundo rw'Imana yacu, Rwakamy'inyanja zose, Ntabwo rwabon'aho rukwirwa, Rusaguts'ikirere.

praise.title: Umukiza Aragutegereje
praise.chorus: Umukiz'aragutegereje, Aragutegereje, Ngw'arebe ko wemera gukingura, Mbeg'ubury'abyifuza.
stanzas: Umukiza aragutegereje, Ntiwamusanga none? Ntaby'isi bigomba kumukuvutsa, Mbes'ub'uribaz'iki ?
Nshuti ter'intambw'ugan'Umukiza, Agutez'ibiganza, N'umwemerera arakuruhura, Muban'iteka ryose.

praise.title: Ubutumwa Bw'Ubuntu
praise.chorus: Ng'umwizera wes'adapf' Ahubw'ahabw'ubugingo, Ahubw'ahabw'ubugingo bw'iteka.
stanzas: Ubutumwa bw'ubuntu bwanyuz'umutima, Imana yadutangiy'Umwana wayo.
Nkuko Mose yamanits'inzoka ku giti, Niko Yesu yamanitswe ngo tubeho.
Numvise yuk'ukor'ibyaha wes'azapfa, None ndahabutse kubw'ijambo ryawe.
Yesu ntabwo yaje kuducirahw'iteka, Ahubwo yaj'atuzaniy'agakiza.
Mwami ndakwinginz'ongera kwizera kwanjye, Nakir'iby'ubutumwa bwawe bumbwira.

praise.title: Hariho Uburuhukiro Muri Paradiso
praise.chorus: **S.:** Tuzateranirayo, Tuzahurirayo Kuri rwa ruzi, Tuzateranirayo, Mu musek'igitondo gitangaje. **A., T. na B.:** Tuzate..., nirayo, Tuzahurirayo Kuri rwa ruzi, Tuzate…nirayo, Mu musek'igitondo gitangaje.
stanzas: Hariho uburuhukiro muri paradiso, Ahatazab'umubabar'ukundi, Tuzahurirayo.
Hariy'umudugudu mwiza utatswem'umucyo, Aho nihw'abakiranutsi bazibanira n'Umwami.
Hariyo amakamba meza, Ayo tuzambikwa, Kristo yateguriy'abamutegereje bihanganye.
Jy'ukiranuk'ibihe byose, Nubwo wabizira, Yesu yasezeranye kw'azaguh'ikamba ry'ubugingo

praise.title: Mukristo Ube Maso
stanzas: Mukristo ube maso, Nturuhuke na hato, Akaga kari hafi, Usenge!
Ababisha b'Imana bajya bakubikira, Baguciriy'ibico, Usenge!
Kenyer'intwaro zawe ku manywa na n'ijoro, Dor'umwanz'arakaze, Ba maso!
Umv'abatsinze kera iyo ntambar'urwana, Barakubwira bati: Usenge!
Umva Umwami wawe, Yesu wagupfiriye, Niwe wategets'ati: Wirinde!
Bik'iryo jambo ryiza, Mu mutima wemera, Kandi unabikore usenga.

praise.title: Mbese Wahereye Ryari?
stanzas: Mbese wahereye ryari uvugana n'Umwam'umutakambira? Mbese wahereye ryar'usenga, Ugez'ubw'ukesh'ijoro? Mbese wamaz'igihe kingan'iki wumva yuk'utay'umuruho? Se wamwit'inshuti, Wamenye ryari, Kw'akurind'akakwitaho?

Mbese wahereye ryar'upfukam' useng'Uhorah'uri mw'ijuru? Se wameny'ute ko washubijwe, Akakurinda bugacya? Ukamenya ko wiriz'uwo munsi, Mbese wamwit'inshuti yawe? Mbese wamenye ryari kw'akwitaho, Kandi akanakurinda?

praise.title: Igihe Cyo Kugaruka K'Umwami
praise.chorus: Mbes'aho ntiburi hafi gucya! Mbes'aho ntiburi hafi gucya! Mbese ntabw'ubona k'umusek'utambitse! Mbese k'ubanza bugiye gucya!
stanzas: Igihe cyo kugaruka k'Umwami kiregereje rwose, Inyenyeri zicwekereye, Kubw'umucyo w'igitondo gitangaje.
Ibimenyetso byose byahanuwe kw'izuba no ku kwezi, Birahamiriz'umuntu wese ko kuza k'Umwami kutwegereye.
Iki n'igihe rwos'itorero rikwiye guhaguruka, Kandi rikwiriye kuba maso, Kuko bidatinze bugiye gucya.
Nimusohoke mujye mu nzira ngari no mu nzira ntoya, Nimubwir'ibirema n'impumyi ko kuza k'Umwami kutwegereye.

praise.title: Ye Byose Biba Byiza
praise.chorus: Mu mibabar'idusagiriz'ibyiza, Iradukunda. Iraturinda, Mu mibabar'idukomez'imitima, Kukw'Imana yacu yumva gutaka kwacu, Irindira igihe cyayo kuzageza, Ku mperuka.
stanzas: Ye byose biba byiza sinzatinya, Nkeney'urukundo ruhebuje, Imiyaga n'imigaru biratuza. Imana yacu y'impuhwe nyinshi itwitaho.
Byose biba byiz'Iman'inyitaho, Munsi y'amababa ye sintinya. Nta cyago cyankuraho amahoro ye. Iyo niringiy'Imana mu mutima wanjye.
Biba byiza Yesu, Yabibwiy'abe. Mukumbi wanjye muto ntutinye. Iman'iri ku ngoma is'irabizi. Isi n'ijuru bizuzura ikuzo ryayo.

praise.title: Harih'Umunt'Umwe
praise.chorus: Byarabambwe byose, Byarabambwe byose, Yemw'uko yabyikorey'ubwe! Yemwe ngo arababara cyan'ajyayo! Ajyanyweyo n'ibyaha byanjye.
stanzas: Harih'umunt'umwe wapfuye ku bwanjye, aKandi ntibyari bikwiriye, Yemeye kujyanw'ajya ku musaraba, Kubwo kumbabarir'ibyaha.
N'umugwaneza kand'arankunda cyane, Yez'umutima wanjy'ibyaha, Sincirw'urubanza, Mfit'umudendezo, Kuko yambabariy'ibyaha.
Nzabana n'Umukiza akaramata, Nzajya ngendana naw'iteka, Ndirimbish'umunwa n'umutima wanjye, Kuko nababariw'ibyaha.

praise.title: Yesu Araje
praise.chorus: Yes'agiye kugaruka vuba, Yesu agiye kuza (agiye kuza), Nimubyamamaz'ahantu hose, Agiye kugaruka.
stanzas: Yes'araje nimubyamamaze, Aje kujyan'abo yacunguye, Azanywe no kwimik'ingoma ye, Yesu agiye kuza.
Yes'araj'abapfuye bazuke, Maz'abatoni be baterane, Bahurire nawe mu kirere, Yesu agiye kuza.
Yes'azanywe no gukiz'abera, Azanywe no gutang'amahoro, Imibabaro yos'izashira, Yesu agiye kuza.
Yes'araje nk'uko yabivuze, Ni bande batowe bamwizeye, Bamutegereje bari maso, Yesu agiye kuza.

praise.title: Mfite Umukiza
praise.chorus: Mfit'Umukiza umez'atyo (atyo)! Se nawe n'Umukiza wawe (wawe)? Yanyinjiyemo, Ntabwo ateze kumvamo, Se nawe n'Umukiza wawe (wawe)?
stanzas: Mfit'Umukiz'ukomey'undind'iteka? Unyobor'intambwe ngo ntayob'inzira, Niw'uyobora buri ntambwe y'uhabye, Mbes'ufit'Umukiza nk'uwo?
N'Umukiza niringir'ibihe byose, Mu byago n'amakub'ampor'iruhande, No mu bishukw'arandinda bitangaje, Mbes'ufit'Umufasha nk'uwo?
Mfit'Umwungeri mwiz'ukund'intama ze, Azihamagara mu mazina yazo, Azih'ubwatsi bwiza n'amazi meza, Mbes'ufit'Umwungeri nk'uwo?

praise.title: Ngwin'Umukiz'Aragushaka
praise.chorus: Umukiz'ahagaze ku rugi, Gira bwang'umusab'imbabazi, Witindigany'arategereje, Gira n'ingoga ngwino.
stanzas: Ngwin'Umukiz'aragushaka, N'inshuti nziza y'ukuri, Ubu ngub'aragutegereje, Arakwinginga ngwino.
Umv'amagambo ye y'ihumure, Yesu n'inshuti y'ukuri, Musange n'isoko y'ubugingo, Ntabw'uzabur'umwanya.
Umvir'uwo Mwuk'ukongorera, Wisuzugur'uwo Mwami, Mwakire vuba witindiganya, Hahirw'umwakiriye.

praise.title: Isengesho Ryanjye
stanzas: Isengesho ryanjye Mwami nyumvira, Nyobora mu nzira, Mu birushya byo mur'ubu buzima, Jy'umpor'iruhande.
Har'ibigeragezo byinshi mpura naby'aho njya hose, Mfash'umpe kub'umunyakuri, Kandi mb'umukiranutsi.
Igih'ub'ubuzima buzaba bugeze kw'iherezo, Ndagusaby'uzampe kubana nawe mu bwami bw'ijuru.

praise.title: Mfit'Inyota Mwami
praise.chorus: Buhungiro (buhungiro), Nihishamo (nihishamo), Ubwugamo (ubwugamo), Bw'umugaru (bw'umugaru), Murikira (murikira), Noye kuyoba (ne kuyoba), Kugez'ubwo (kugez'ubwo), Ngez'iwacu.
stanzas: Mfit'inyota Mwami, Ndagukennye cyane, Mpembura Mukiza, Wowe soko nziza, Soko y'ubugingo, Ngwin'umurikire, Unyobore (unyobore), Nger'iwawe.
Nd'umugenzi Mwami, Ngenda mu butayu, Kandi mfit'isari, Ndarushye Mukiza, Mpam'amazi Mukiza, Maze nshir'inyota, Kugez'ubwo (kugez'ubwo), Ngez'iwacu.
Iwacu mw'ijuru, Ngiye kugerayo, Nzambikw'ikamba Yesu yanteguriye, Nubw'indushya , Ndi hafi kugera, Mu gihugu (mu gihugu), Cy'ihumure.

praise.title: Reb'Ibimenyetso
praise.chorus: Reba ibimenyetso by'ubuhanuzi, By'ibihe byashize by'ubwami bune, Reba ibimenyetso by'ubuhanuzi, Byose byarangiye.
stanzas: Reb'ibimenyetso by'urugendo, Reb'ibimenyetso birashira, By'imyak'ishize by'ubwami bune, Twe turi hehe, Reb'urugendo.
Abasiriya bategets'isi, Haz'Abamedi n'Abaperesi, Abagiriki batway'iyi si, Haz'Abaroma, Twe turi hehe?
Ko turi mu bihe by'intege nke, Iby'ibumba n'icyuma byavanzwe, Nuko tuzareb'uko bizaba Yes'agarutse, Kwim'ingoma ye.

praise.title: Uwiteka N'Umwungeri Wanjye
stanzas: Uwiteka n'Umwungeri wanjye, Sinzakena na hato, Andyamisha mu cyanya cy'iruhande rw'amaz'adasuma.
Asubiz'intege mu bugingo bwanjye mu gihe ntebye, Anyobor'inzira yo gukiranuka kubw'izina rye.
Naho nanyura no mu gikombe cy'igicucu cy'urupfu, Sinzatiny'ikibi cyose Mwami kuko ndi kumwe nawe.
Untunganiriza ameza mu maso y'abanzi banjye, Unsize amavuta mu mutwe maze aratonyanga.
Kugirirwa neza n'imbabazi bizanyomahw'iteka, Nanjye nzaba mu nzu y'Uwiteka ibihe bidashira.

praise.title: Nari Nararohamye Mu Byaha
praise.chorus: Urukundo rwankuyemo, Ubwo nari nabuze uwamfasha, Urukundo rwankuyemo, Nari nabuz'umfasha, Mbona Yesu.
stanzas: Nari nararohamye mu nyanja y'ibyaha, Nta byiringiro narimfite byo kuvamo, Maz'Umukiza yumva gutabaza kwanjye, Ab'ariw'unkuramo none ndiho.
Muhay'umutima wanjye mushikamyeho, Nzajya ndirimb'iteka icyubahiro cye, Urukundo nyakuri nzajya nduririmba, Niwe nkesha kwizera n'urukundo.
Mutim'ubabaye reba Yes'agukize, Niw'uzakurokora, Mu murab'ukaze, Ategek'inyanja zose zikamwumvira, Arashaka kugukiz'uyu munsi.

praise.title: Mbega Igitambo!
praise.chorus: **S.:** Urukundo ruhebuje, Nirwo rwamuteye kumfira, Mbeg'urukundo rutangaje, Ngo ruratum'ancungura! **A., T. na B.:** Urukundo ruhebuje, Nirwo rwamute… kumfira, Mbeg'uruku…rutangaje, Ngo ruratum'ancungura.
stanzas: Mbega igitambo cy'amaraso Y'Umukiza, Wapfuy'ari njy'azira! Yambambiwe ku musaraba, Abitewe n'ukw'ankunda cyane, N'urukundo rutangaje Mwami wanjye, Kugira ngo wemere kubabara no kumfira.
Yasiz'intebe y'ubwami ya Se, Yemera kunyitangira ngo nkire, Nari mbuz'epfo na ruguru, Imbabazi ze zirangoboka, Maz'Urukundo rwe runter'umunezero, Mperako mererwa neza mu mutima wanjye.
Nari maz'igihe kirekire, Mboshywe n'umwijima w'ibyaha byanjye, Maze kumeny'ineza yawe, Ngukurikira mfit'ibyishimo, Kuko nari mbohowe ingoyi z'ibyaha, Mperako ndahaguruka, Ndagukurikira.
Nta teka ncirwaho kuko ndi muri Yesu, Naw'akab'ari muri jye, Niwe nkesha kubaho kwanjye, Nkeger'intebe ye ntacyo ntinya, Nkambikw'ikamba mbikesha uwancunguye, Ntabwo nzahwema kumusingiz'iteka ryose.

praise.title: Impanda Iravuze
stanzas: Impanda iravuze, Nimwumve, Nimwumve, Ivugira mw'ijuru, Yesu araje, Wow'uhunikira, Ngah'umva, Ngah'umva, Kanguka, Ubyuke, Umwam'araje.
Ese ntimwumv'impanda, Nimwumve, Nimwumve, Umugen'arayumva, Yes'ari hafi , N'ibyishimo byinshi, Nimwumve, Nimwumve, Araririmb'ati: Yes'ari hafi.
Impanda iravuze, Nimwumve, Nimwumve, Nimubyuke bwakeye, Umukw'araje, N'ibyishimo byinshi, Nimwumve, Nimwumve, Ngaho itegure, Dore araje.

praise.title: Dufit'Ibyiringiro
stanzas: Dufit'ibyiringiro by'ukuri, Ko Yesu azagaruka, Twizezwa n'uk'ubwe yabivuze, Twizer'isezerano rye, Ubw'amoko yo mw'isi, Azarangurur'ati: Haleluya, Yesu Kristo n'Umwami w'Abami, Twiringiye yuk'Umwami wacu, Ari hafi kugaruka.

Duhuriye muri Yesu Kristo, Duhujwe n'urukundo rwe, Abantu bifuz'urukundo rwe, Rwatumy'acungur'abantu, Ijuru rizakinguka Kristo agaruke, Abantu baririmbe, Haleluya, Araje! Dufit'ibyiringiro mu Mana, Twibumbiye muri Kristo.

praise.title: Nkunda Igitabo Cyera
stanzas: Nkund'igitabo cyera cy'Imana, Nicyo kindutir'ibindi byose, Kinyigish'ibyiza byo mw'ijuru, Nkameny'inzira y'agakiza.
Gitabo cy'ingenzi muri wowe, Mpabon'ubwiza bw'Umwami wanjye, Ibyanditswe byawe binyigisha, Iby'umunezero nzagira.
Ariko igihe nkiri mw'isi, Umbwir'iby'urukundo rw'Imana, Nkarushaho gusobanukirwa, N'umunezero wo mw ijuru.
Ni wowe werekan'imigambi, Yose ya Yes'Umukiza wanjye, Muri wowe niho har'ubwenge, N'ubuhanga butarondorwa.
Ur'umucy'umurikir'ab'isi, Ngo bave mu mwijima w'ibyaha, Ni wow'umurikir'imitima, Y'abahabye bagahabuka.

praise.title: Ku Musaraba
praise.chorus: Ku musaraba niho naboney'umucyo, Mbona gutur'umutwaro wanjye, Mbiboneshwa no kwizera Uherey'ubu nzahora nezerewe.
stanzas: Imbere y'Uhoraho ntabwo nkorwa n'isoni, Kand'ijambo ryawe rinshimish'ibihe byose.
Yesu Mana yanjye nzi yukw'ari ryo zina rye, Ntazemerer'umutima wanjye kuzimira.
Yasezeranye yukw'intebe y'izahoraho, Biragaragara kw'ibyo yavuz'ar'ukuri.

praise.title: Mana Yac'Ur'Umufasha
stanzas: Mana yac'ur'umufasha, Byiringiro byacu, Bwugamo bw'umugaru, Niwe buturo bwacu.
Ku ntebe yawe y'ubwami, Tubon'amahoro, Iyo dutabawe nawe, Tugir'ihumure.
Imisoz'itarabaho, Is'itarabumbwa, Kuva kera kose Mana, Ur'uko wahoze.
Imyak'igihumbi uyibona nk'umuns'umwe, Ni migufi nk'isah'imwe, Ihita ni ngoga.
Man'ur'umufasha wacu, Byiringiro byacu, Utuber'umuyoboz'uzatugez'iwacu.

praise.title: Ntabaza Yesu Iyo Mbabaye
praise.chorus: Ntabaza Yesu, Ntabaza Yesu, Kuko ntacyo nakwishoboza, Ntabaza Yesu, Ntabaza Yesu, Yesu gusa niwe wamfasha
stanzas: Ntabaza Yesu iyo mbabaya, Ankiz'imibabaro yanjye, Mur'iyo mibabaro nt'ampana, Ahubw'arantabara rwose.
Mu makuba yanjy'arantabara, Kukw'ari we nshuti y'ukuri, Iyo mutabaj'arantabara, Ankiz'imibabaro yanjye.
Mbeg'ukuntu iby'isi binshuka, Bikanyoshya gukor'ibyaha, Mbibwire Yesu kand'azamfasha, Niw'uzampa gutsind'iby'isi.

praise.title: Mwuka Wera
praise.chorus: Mwuka Wera We, We numa nziza, Ubane natwe, Utwuzuz'urukundo, Turaguhimbaza kuk'uduhira, Turataha tudashidikanya yuko duhiriwe twese.
stanzas: Aha hantu har'amahoro, Kandi hari n'Umwuka Wera w'Uhoraho, Kandi n'umuntu wese uhari, Afit'umunezero mwinshi bihebuje.

praise.title: Nzabon'Umwami
praise.chorus: Tuzahorana ibihe byose, Yankirije i Kalvari Amaherezo nzabon'Umwami wanyitangiye kera.
stanzas: Nzabon'Umwami wanjy' aririmbirwa n'abamarayika Tuzabana naw'iteka ryose mu gihugu cy'ibyiza.
Mur'icyo gihugu cyiza nta joro rizabay'ukundi. Nzabana n'Umwami wancunguje amaraso y'akiza.
Nzabana n'Umwami wanjye nkunda nzamureba mu maso, Nzamuririmbira mushimira ubuntu yangiriye.

praise.title: Icyampa Kugendana N'Imana
stanzas: Icyampa kugendana n'Imana, Mu nzir'ijya mw'ijuru, Nibyo byamber'umucy'ungeza, Ku Mwana w'Intama.
Garuka, Mukunzi garuka, Ntumwa nziza y'amahoro, Nang'ibyaha byakubabaje, Bikantanya nawe.
Mbega ngo ndagir'amahoro, Ntazigera nibagirwa! Ariko byansizemw'imvun' itakungwa n'ab'isi.
Icyo nagusimbuje cyose, Uko cyaba kiri kose, Mfasha nitandukanye nacyo, Ngusenge wenyine.

praise.title: Nimumenyesh'Abantu Bose
praise.chorus: Nimusingiz'uwo Mwana w'Intama watambwe, Nimwamamaze ko Yes'agiye kwima.
stanzas: Nimumenyesh'abantu bose ko Yes'ari hafi, Is'imurikirwe n'umucyo, Maze Yes'agaruke.
Amahanga yasubiranyemo, Muyaburire, Is'imurikirwe n'umucyo, Maze Yes'agaruke.
Bana b'Imana, Nimuririmbe, Muyih'ikuzo, Hahirw'ababa maso, Bukarinda butandukana.

praise.title: Nejejwe N'Iri Turo
praise.chorus: Akir'ituro ryanjye We Mwana w'Imana, Kand'umanurire ku mucyo uv'ahera.
stanzas: Nejejwe n'iri turo ntuy'Umwami Yesu, Igitambo kizima nicyo jyew'ubwanjye.
Mpaz'ubugingo bwanjye, Nticuza, ntatinya, Kubw'ubuntu bwawe warancunguye Mwami.
Yesu ngwin'unyigishe wowe wancunguye, Nshaka kubana naw'ibihe bidashira.

praise.title: Dusingiz'Uwiteka
stanzas: Dusingiz'Uwiteka, Tumushimir'ineza ye, Kukw'imbabazi ze nyinshi, Zizahorahw'iteka.
Umuremyi wa byose, Uwakwij'umucyo kw'isi, Agir'imbabazi nyinshi, Zizahorahw'iteka.
Abibeshaho byose, Akabimar'ubukene, Agir'imbabazi nyinshi, Zizahorahw'iteka.
Yahiriy'ubwoko bwe, Ubwo bwari mu butayu, Agir'imbabazi nyinshi, Zizahorahw'iteka.
Ni nyir'impuhwe nyinshi, Ameny'ubukene bwacu, Agir'imbabazi nyinshi, Zizahorahw'iteka.
Tumusingiz'iteka, Kubw'imbabazi ze nyinshi, Ahoran'impuhwe nyinshi, Zizahorahw'iteka.

praise.title: Kuber'Iki Utindiganya?
praise.chorus: Kuki? Kuki? Utamusang'uyu munsi? Kuki? Kuki? Utamwitaba none?
stanzas: Kuber'iki utindiganya? Yes'aragushaka none, Haguruk'uve mu mwijima, Aragukunda, Musange.
Igihe kirahita vuba, Uyu munsi niwo wawe, Reka Yes'aguhumurize, N'ubutunzi bw'igiciro.
Ese ntiwumva mu mutima, Wuzuwe n'Umwuka Wera? Ntiwifuza kumurikirwa na Yesu agukomeze.
Kuber'iki wanga kwitaba? Urupfu rugusatira! Ngwino Yes'akumurikire, Ngwin'aragutegereje

praise.title: Ku Rutare Har'Isoko
praise.chorus: Yesu niwe Gitare, Yaradupfiriye twese, Mugenzi ngwino kw'isoko, Maz'unywe ushir'inyota.
stanzas: Ku Rutare har'isoko itemb'imar'inyota, Mugenzi ngwino kw'isoko maz'unywe ushir'inyota.
Arahamagar'ati: Ngwino kw'isoko y'ubuntu, Mugenz'ufit'inyota, Mbese ntiwakwitaba Yesu?
Munyabyaha ngwino Yesu akwambuts'ubutayu, Umukiz'aragutegereje, Ngwino umusange.

praise.title: Ineza N'Imbabazi
praise.chorus: Ineza n'imbabazi ze nibyo bizanyomaho, Iminsi yo kubaho kwanjy'ibihe byose, Ineza n'imbabazi ze nibyo bizanyomaho, Iminsi yose nzaba ndiho. Kandi nzaba mu nzu y'Uwiteka iteka, Nzarira ku meza yanteguriye kera, Ineza n'imbabazi ze nibyo bizanyomaho, Iminsi yose nzaba ndiho. ''Iminsi yose nzaba ndiho''.(Ku gice cya 3).
stanzas: Igihe nari nd'inzererezi, Ngenda mu mwijima w'ibyaha, Nih'Umwungeri yantaruye, None ndi mu nzir'ijy'iwacu.
Ansubiz'intege mu bugingo, Anyonger'imbarag'iteka, Anjyan'ahar'amaz'atuje, Arind'intambwe zanjye zose.
Mu gikombe cy'umwijim'ukaze, Umukiz'azabana nanjye, Azanyoboz'ukuboko kwe, Angez'aho yanteguriye.

praise.title: Yesu Ndagutakambiye
praise.chorus: Unyakir'uko ndi, Unyakir'uko ndi, Mwami wanjye warampfiriye, Unyakir'uko ndi.
stanzas: Yesu ndagutakambiye, Kuk'utantabaye napfa, Ungeze ku gakiza kawe, Unyakir'uko ndi.
Ntabwo ngira kivurira, Arikw'amaraso yawe, Niyo yangize uk'ushaka, Unyakir'uko ndi.
Sinabasha kwitegura, Nguhay'imigambi yanjye, Unkize kubw'izina ryawe, Unyakir'uko ndi.
Dore Mwami nje ku birenge byaw'ungir'uk'ushaka, Utungany'umurimo wawe, Unyakir'uko ndi.

praise.title: Yesu Niw'Ujy'Unyobora
praise.chorus: Yesu warancunguye, Yesu warancunguye. Yanteguriye umwanya, Nzabana naw'iteka,
stanzas: Yesu niw'ujy'unyobora, Amurikir'inzira, Mu ntege nke zanjye zose, Yesu niw'unyobora.
Yesu niw'ujy'undengera, Yamviriy'amaraso, Kwizera igitambo cye, Byatumye mbabarirwa.
Anyezahw'inenge zose, Igihe munambyeho, Amp'ubugingo bw'iteka, Ntadukana n'urupfu,
Yanyishyuriy'umwenda, Ufit'igiciro cyinshi, Yanteguriye umwanya, Nzabana naw'iteka,

praise.title: Mukiza Wanjye Nyobora
praise.chorus: **S:** Nzagukurikira hose, Mukiza wanjye, Ngukurikire, Nzagukurikira Mukiza unyobore. **A.,T. na B.:** Nzagukuriki… ,…gukurikira hose, Mukiza wanjye, Ngukurikire, Nzagukuriki…,…rikira unyobore, …za unyobore , nyobora.
stanzas: Mukiza wanjye, Nyobor'ah'ushaka, Mfat'ikiganza maze nkumve bugufi, N'ubw'amahwa yampanda, Ngukurikire, Nyobor'ah'ushaka, Mukiza wanjye.
Mukiza wanjye, Nyobor'ah'ushaka, Ukomez'undinde unampumurize, N'ubw'umwijima wab'umbudits'imbere, Ntabwo nzatiny'unyoboye Mukiza.
Njyan'ah'ushaka Mwam'icyo ngusaba, Nyuza mu nzira ntoya ne guteshuka, Nubwo Satan'anyoshya anyongorera, Mfasha njye nsubiza bwangu mpakana.

praise.title: Shimwa Ntama Y'Imana
praise.chorus: Shimwa haleluya, Shimwa haleluya, Singizwa Mukiza, Wowe Ntama y'Imana.
stanzas: Shimwa Ntama y'Imana, Turagushima Ntama, Shimwa Ntama y'Imana, Turagushima cyane.
Ubwami bwawe buze, Dutsindire icyaha, Waradukunze cyane, Shimwa Ntama y'Imana.
Tukunambeho Mwami, Tujye tuguh'ikuzo, Turi kumwe n'Umwami, Ku musozi Siyoni.

praise.title: Nzahimbaza Imana
stanzas: Nzahimbaz'Imana mfite umutima unyuzwe, Kubw'urukundo rwawe n'imbabazi wangiriye, Mfasha mu ntege nke zanjye, Unsindire icyaha. Murikir'umutima wanjye, Nguhimbaze Mwami.
Mutima wanjye umvira, Wubahe Uwiteka, Ungarure hafi yawe, Ne kuyoba Mukiza, Narazimiye, Mvana mu nzira y'urupfu Mwami. Wampaye ibyiringiro igihe wapfiraga.
Mfukamye imbere yawe, Ngushima Mwami wanjye, Ndakwinginze Mwami mpa umugisha uyu munsi, Nkeney'urukundo n'ubuntu biva kuri wowe. Maz'imibereho yanjye ijy'iguhesh'ikuzo.

praise.title: Yesu Araguhamagara!
stanzas: Yes'arahamagara, Munyabyaha ngwino, Ubu turagusabira, Nyamuna ngwino, Arakwiteze munyabyaha, Ngwino, Ngwino, N'igihe cyo kumumenya, Nyamuna ngwino.
Nib'uremerewe n'ibyaha, Ngwino, Ngwino, Yesu aragutur'uwo mutwaro ngwino, Yesu n'umunyebambe, Munyabyaha ngwino, Niwe wagucunguye, Munyabyaha ngwino.
Umv'ubury'akwinginga, Munyabyaha ngwino, Ngwin'araguh'umugisha, Nyamuna ngwino, Araguhamagara, Munyabyaha ngwino, Ubu turagusabira, Nyamuna ngwino.

praise.title: Ndi Mu Maboko Akiza
praise.chorus: **S. na A.:** Ndi mu mabokw'akiza, Amaboko y'akiza, N'ubwo naba ngeze no mu kaga, Ndi mu mabokw'akiza. **T. na B.:** Ndi mu mabo... ...kw'aki...mabokw'akiza, Amaboko akiza ....mabokw'akiza, N'ubwo naba ngeze no mu kaga, Ndi mu mabokw'akiza.
stanzas: Iy'Umukiza wanjy'anyoboye, Uko ndi kose ngir'amahoro, Ankirish'umuraba w'ibyaha, Amaboko y'akiza.
Ahor'andamiz'amaboko ye, Akanambwiz'ijwi ry'ihumure, Ati: Humura, Nzakuramiza, Amaboko akiza.
Azandinda anyobor'iteka, Ntacyo nzatinya ndi kumwe nawe, Nzi kw'ahor'andind'iteka ryose, Ndi mu mabokw'akiza.

praise.title: Manyur'Umutsima
stanzas: Manyur'umutsima w'ubugingo, Nk'uko wabigize mu kibaya, Natw'uduhaz'Ibyanditswe Byera, Turakwifuza Jambo rizima.
Mwami hir'ukuri menyeshejwe, Nk'uko wahiriye wa mutsima, Uri ku nyanja y'i Galilaya, Mbeshweho naw'Ushobora byose.
Mwam'ur'umutsima w'ubugingo, Ijambo ryawe rimbeshejeho, Mpa guhazwa naryo tuzabane, Mpa kugukunda nzabane nawe.
Amagamb'uvuga n'ubugingo, Mfasha ngo nyumvire, jye nta ntege, Ni wowe nkesh'ubugingo bwanjye, Ijambo ryawe rimpa gutsinda.

praise.title: Nakurikiye Yesu
praise.chorus: **S.:** Mbega ngo biranezeza gukurikira Yesu, Akanyoboz'ubuntu bwe akangeza mw'ijuru. **A., T., B.:** Mbega ngo biranezeza, …rikira, …ra Yesu, … .Akanyoboz'ubuntu bwe, …kangeza; Mw'ijuru.
stanzas: Nakurikiye Yesu mu kibaya akiz'abarwayi, Ac'iminyururu y'ibyaha no kuruhur'imitwaro.
Namukurikiye ku musoz'igihe yahindurwaga, Imana iravuga iti: Ur'Umwana wanjye nkunda.
Namukurikiy'i Kalvari, Agend'atukwa na benshi, Akomez'inzira y'Umwanzi, Yikorey'umusaraba.
Nzamukurikira nkiriho, Maz'atume mpora nesha, Kugez'ubwo nzager'iwacu ahahor'umunezero.

praise.title: Nabony'Umuntu Unaniwe
stanzas: Nabony'umunt'unaniwe, Kand'agenda yihanganye, Yikorey'umusaraba, Nyamara ntabwo yari yihebye, Imibabar'iba myinshi! Arik'uw'urahebuje! Mubaz'ikimuh'intege, Ati: Nuko mfit'ibyiringiro.
Nabony'afite n'intwaro, Arwany'iby'is'ashikamye, Kand'arwan'amaramaje ngw'azabon'ikamba rihoraho, N'ubwo yari yarenganye, Ntiyigeze yivovota, Mubaz'ikimuh'intege, Ati: Nuko mfit'ibyiringiro.
Nabony'uwasiz'inshuti ze, Bakundanaga cyane, Atandukana n'iby'isi, Ahitamw'inzir'imuruhije, N'ubw'irimw'ibibabaza, Arikw'ariyumanganya, Mubaz'ikimuh'intege, Ati: Nuko mfit'ibyiringiro.
Tur'abagenzi mur'iyi si, Y'akaga n'agahinda, Irimw'ibyago n'urwango, N'ibituro byuzuye mw'abantu, Kugez'ubwo Krist'azaza, Akarokor'abe bose, Se, n'iki cyadukomeza, Atar'ibyiringiro bishyitse?

praise.title: Mugenzi Komera
stanzas: Mugenzi komera Yes'ari hafi, Twamutegereje kera, Tugiye kwitahir'iwacu heza, Turirimbe ko dutsinze, Twihangane twe kumuhemukaho, Kandi w'ataduhemukiye, Yatwerets'urukundo ruhebuje, Nirwo rwatumy'adupfira.
Mugenzi komera, Utegerez'umudugudu w'izahabu, Wateguriwe abakiranutsi, Niho tuzaruhukira, Ihangane ntabwo tuzagum'aha, Mu buhanya no mu miruho, Harubw'umwijim'uzatamuruka, Igitondo gitangaze.
Mugenzi komera dore araje, Uwo Muremyi wa byose, Azanye n'abamarayika benshi, Azanye n'ingororano, Ihangan'ugez'igih'Umukiza, Azakubwir'aya magambo, Ngo mugaragu mwiz'ukiranuka, Igire mu munezero.
Mugenzi ujy'uhora wihanganye, Komeza kwizera kwawe, Amarira yawe ahanagurwe maz'uzahabwe n 'ikamba, Ihangane mwene Data ni koko, Isezerano rye n'impamo, Uzibanirayo n'abakijijwe, Na Yes'Umukiza wacu.

praise.title: Umunsi Mwiza Uri Bugufi
praise.chorus: Umwijim'ugiye gutamuruka, Tukabah'ubutazongera gupfa. Mbega ihumure twahawe na Yesu! Dor'ari bugufi.
stanzas: Dor'umunsi mwiza ugiye kugera, Tukibera ibudapfa. Aho tuzibera hahebuj'ubwiza, N'umuns'utangaje!
Imitima yacu irahumurirwa, Ntabwo ijya igoheka. Turifuza kubon'uwo munsi mwiza, Tuzaba mu bwiza.
Za ntwari zasinzirany'ibyiringiro, Tugiye kuzabonana. Nta marir'azongera kuturangwaho, Mu murwa w'Imana.

praise.title: Nitugera Mw'Ijuru
praise.chorus: Nitugera mw'ijuru, mbeg'umunezero tuzagira!' Turirimb’indirimbo nziza z’abanesheje.
stanzas: Turirimb'urukundo rwa Yesu; Impuhwe ndetse n'ubuntu bye. Ari kudutegurir’aho tuzaba, mw’ijuru.
N'ubw'ibicu bidukingirije, Bitubuza kureba neza, Turi hafi yo gusoz' urugendo rukomeye.
Dukomeze dukorer’Imana, Tuzabihemberwa nta shiti; Turi hafi guhabw’ubugingo bw’iteka ryose!
Dor’ikamba rir’imbere yacu, Tuzaryambikirwa mw’ijuru, N’ahantu h’igikundiro, harahebuje rwose.

praise.title: Mu Maboko Ya Yesu
praise.chorus: Mu maboko ya Yesu, Ndi mu gituza cye; Mpabon'umunezero, Kubw'urukundo rwe.
stanzas: Mu maboko ya Yesu, Ndi mu gituza cye! Mpabon'umunezero, Kubw'urukundo rwe. Mbega ngo ndaririmba, Nk'abamarayika: Aho hantu heza, Ku Nyanja ya Yasipi!
Mu maboko ya Yesu, Anyitaho rwose; Ntsind'ibigeragezo, Ni ho nesh'icyaha. Mu maboko ya Yesu, Hehe n'umubabaro! Ntabwo ngishidikanya, Yes'amar'ubwoba.
Yesu Mukunzi wanjye, Wowe nihishamo; Ni wowe niringira, Wowe wampfiriye. Gitare gikomeye, Ndagutegereje; Nuza ku manywa cyangwa nijor'uzanjyana!

praise.title: Mbe! Basare Tugashya
stanzas: Mbe! Basare tugashya tugana hakurya; Nidusakirana n’umuraba, Har’aho gutsik’ubwato, Ku cyambu gituje cyane. **Gusubiramo Ibice bya 1,2 na 3:** Ku cyambu gi-hora gitekanye iteka, I-wacu mw’ijuru hahora hatuje! Ku cyambu gituje, hahor’amahoro! (Hahor’amahoro.)
Twe kurangamir’inyungu z’igihe gito, Nta mumaro zifite haba namba! Dushak’aho dutsika, Ku nkombe hakury’iwacu.
Yesu ni we Nyenyeri itumurikira, Kandi ni w’udukingir’umuraba. Tyo twerekez’ubwato, kuri Yesu Murengezi.

N’ubw’ubukana bw’inyanja bwakara gute! Urusaku rukaba rwinshi cyane! Ntacyo ruzadutwara, Yes’azaruducyahira. **Gusubiramo Igice cya 4:** Mw’ijuru n’iwacu hakurya ku cyambu Mw’ijuru mw’ijuru ni ho tuzibera. Mw’ijuru heza pe! Mw’ijuru n’iwacu (mw’ijuru n’iwacu).

praise.title: Turakuramya Mana
stanzas: Tuje kukuramya Mana yacu y'icyubahiro, Twubamye nk'ukw'indabyo zimer'imbere y'izuba. Wow'utang'umunezero, Utubabarir'ibyaha; Utumurikire Mana twe guteshuk'inzira.
Imirimo yawe Mana yigaragaza hose! Ijuru n'isi bihamya icyubahiro cyawe; Inyenyeri, izuba n'inyanja, ndetse n'imisozi, N'inyoni ziririmbira mu biti by'inzitane.
Soko y'imigisha yose, uratubabarira! Ni wowe Nyir'ubuzima, ni wow'utubeshaho. Utwuzuze urukundo, uduhire Mana yacu; Uduhaz'umunezero, turagusabye Mana.

praise.title: Nkomoko Y'Ibyiza Bidateka
stanzas: Nkomoko y'ibyiza bidateka, Mana y'amahoro; Tw'abana bawe tuje kugusingiza; Akira kuramya kwacu, Mana yacu. Tw'abana bawe tuje kugusingiza; Akira kuramya kwacu, Mana yacu.
Dushoboze gukor'iby'ushaka Mana, Uduhire. Tukumvire rwose, tukubahe Mana; Naw'uduhundagazehw'imigisha yawe. Tukumvire rwose, tukubahe Mana; Naw'uduhundagazehw'imigisha yawe.

praise.title: Ndishimye Pe! Yes'Arankunda
praise.chorus: Ndishimye pe! Yes'arankunda; Arankunda, arankunda! Ndishimye pe! Yes'arankunda; Anyakir'uko ndi.
stanzas: Nishimiye ko Data wa twese, Yandikishij'iby'urukundo rwe. Mu byanditswe muri Bibiliya, Nta cyaruta yuko Yes'ankunda.
Iyo nyobye maze ngateshuka, Ntabw'ajy'amvirira haba namba. Angaruz'ineza n'urukundo, Nkamugarukira kukw'ankunda.
Ningera mu bwami bwo mw'ijuru, Nzaririmb'indirimbo z'ikuzo. Ariko cyane cyane nzishima, Ndirimb'urukundo rw'Umukiza.

praise.title: Yesu Yarampinduye Rwose!
praise.chorus: Yarampinduye rwose, Anyigisha gusenga. Nzasingiz'urukundo Rwe! Ubu yangiz'uwe rwose; Nahinduts'umuntu mushya.
stanzas: Nahoze ndindagira mu mwijima w'ibyaha; Maze Yes'arambatura, none narahindutse; Nd'umwana w'Imana rwos'ubu, mfit'amahoro.
Nahoze nd'ikigenge, sinari nzi gusenga; Yes'araz'arampindura, Yankunze bihebuje; Arapfa kubwanjye; Ubu narihannye rwose.
Urukund'umunezero n'amahoro, Ni byo byuzuy'umutima wanjye! Yesu yanyuzuyemw'amp'ubugingo bushya; Nzibanira na w'iteka.

praise.title: Umucyo Uva Mw'Ijuru
praise.chorus: Mwami Yes'umucyo waw'umurikir'abagenzi Winjire mu nyanja, Maz'ubakingir'umuraba.
stanzas: Umucyo uva mw'ijuru, Uyobor'abagenzi, Uzadufasha tugere, Ku nkombe yo hakurya.
Umwijim'urabuditse, Inyanj'irahorera; Yes'aduhozahw'amas' azadufasha twambuke.
Mutyo ducan'amatara, Dukomez'urugendo. Twe kuyobywa n'abasare, Badafit'urumuri.

praise.title: Wisubika Kwihana Nshuti
stanzas: Wisubika kwihana nshuti; Ni nko kubwir'Umwuka Wera, Ngo genda rwose, Jye nzihan'undi munsi. Mbega ng'uribuza amahirwe!
Wisubika kwihana nshuti; Dore Yes'atez'ibiganza. Ihan'uyu munsi, emer'umusange; Aguh'ubugingo agukize.
Wisubika kwihana nshuti; Dor'igihe kirarangiye. Rwos'igihe cy'imbabazi kirashize, Fatirana bwang'usange Yesu.

praise.title: Ubuntu Butangaje!
stanzas: Mbeg'ubuntu butangaje cyane! Umutindi nkanjye gukizwa! Ntabwo nabonaga, none ndabona. Nakijijw'ibyaha byanjye.
N'ubuntu bwanyerets'aho nari; Nari mu byaha byinshi cyane. Kubw'ubuntu Yesu yarandokoye; Singifit'ubwoba rwose.
Navanywe mu kaga nari ndimo; Mpagaze mu buntu bwa Yesu. Kubw'ubwo buntu nzager'ibudapfa; Mw'ijuru kwa Data heza!
Imyak'igihumbi ndi mw'ijuru; Nzabanayo n'Umwami Yesu. Mbeg'indirimbo nziza nzaririmba! Nzaba nkeye cyane rwose.

praise.title: N'Umutima Utuje
stanzas: N'umutim'utuje, nj'imbere yawe; Umbe hafi Yesu, nkumve bugufi.
Nta rindi jwi nshaka kumva na gato; Kerets'ijwi ryawe, Yesu Mukiza.
Amagambo yaw'ambe mu mutima; Yes'ump'ubugingo bw'iteka ryose.

praise.title: Yesu Mu Bugingo Bwanjye
praise.chorus: Niba har'ikinezeza, Kurut'ibindi byose; Yesu mu bugingo bwanjye, Rwos'andutira byose
stanzas: Mbese har'icyanezeza, Nko kubana na Yesu? Nta cyanezeza nko kubana N'uwo munyakuri.
Yitangiye kuncungura, Kubw'ubuntu bw'Imana. Urukundo rwe rusumb' Ijuru n'inyanja zose.
Ntacyo nshobora gukena, Mfit'uwo Mucunguzi. Ni w'ump'ibyo nkennye Byose, Ni w'unshoboza byose.
Ku mugez'ubengerana, Nzaririmb'indirimbo; Ndi kumwe n'abarokotse, Turirimbir'Imana.

praise.title: Nyir'Ukwiringirwa Mana
praise.chorus: Nyir'ukwiringirwa Mana ikomeye, Ni wow'uduh'ibyo dukeneye. Ikiganza cyawe, kitugabira, Ibyo dukeneye buri munsi.
stanzas: Nyir'ukwiringirwa, Man'Ihoraho, Ntabw'ubundikirwa n'umwijima. Ntuhinduka Mana yac'idatsindwa; Kand'uhor'uko wahoze Mana.
Haba mu cyi cyangwa se mu muvumbi, Inyenyeri, izuba n'ukwezi, Ibyo waremye byose Mana yacu, Bihamya k'ur'Iman'ikomeye.
Ugir'imbabazi n'impuhwe nyinshi. Umunsi ku wund'uraturinda. Uduh'ibyiringiro bikomeye; By'uko tuzabahw'iteka ryose.

praise.title: Dor'Umwami Yes'Araje
praise.chorus: Ndatwaranira rwose, Kugera mw'ijuru heza. Haleluya Yesu nahimbazwe!
stanzas: Dor'Umwami Yes'araje, Nguriya araje mu bicu. Ashagawe n'abamarayika, Benshi batabarika.
Reb'abera bazamurwa, Baririmb'indirimbo nziza. Impanda zirangurura, Mbega ngo Yes'aramwenyura!

praise.title: Isoko Itemba
praise.chorus: Iyo Soko, Ihora itemba; Uyinywaho iramukiza.
stanzas: Har'isoko y'ubunt' Isokw'ihor'itemba. Mu mitim'inaniwe, Sokw'iryoshye cyane. N'isoko nziza cyane pe! N'isokw'itumar'inyota.
Ndumv'ijwi ryongorera, Nk'indirimbo nziza! Rituruka mw'isoko Nziza idakama. Ni yo soko y'ubugingo, Ni y'idukiz'ubwihebe.
N'isoko y'umugisha, Itang'ibyishimo. N'amaraso ya Yes' Akiz'abanyabyaha. N'amaraso y'Umukiza, Kand'aratunganye rwose.

praise.title: Kubw'Ijambo Ryawe
praise.chorus: Waduhaye Bibiliya Yera, Turagushimye Nyagasani. Dufashe twumv'Ijambo ryawe, Tuyoborwe na ryo Muremyi.
stanzas: Kubw'Ijambo ryawe Nyagasani, Turagushima Mwami Mana. Uduh'amaso abona neza, Kangur'imitima yacu.
Mw'Ijambo ryawe harimw'umucyo, Tubonamw'amasezerano. N'itabaza ry'ibirenge byacu, Ritumurikir'inzira.
Hahirw'abakomez'iryo Jambo, Bazabana na Yes'iteka. Bazarya ku giti cy'ubugingo; Hafi y'umugezi mwiza.

praise.title: Kwizera Kwanjye
praise.chorus: Nta yindi ncungw'ikenewe, Yesu yarishye byose. Yarapfuye, arazuka; Yaranyitangiye.
stanzas: Kwizera kwanjye Kwabonye uburuhukiro; Niringiye Uhoraho Wantangiy'incungu.
Nta bwoba ngifite namba! Yes'arampagije. Yankuyehw'ibyaha byose, Kubw'amaraso Ye.
Yesu yaje gukiz' Imitima yazimiye. Yatanz'amaraso Ye, Kugira ngo ndokoke.
Har'Ijambo rihindura, Kandi rimp'ituza. N'Ijambo ryiza ry'Iman' Ijambo ry'ubugingo.

praise.title: Ibyaha Byanjye Mbihaye Yesu
stanzas: Ibyaha byanjye mbihaye Yes'Umwana w'Intama; Byose ndabimwikoreje, Ngo mbon'umudendezo. Ibicumuro byanjye, Mbihay'Umwami Yesu; Anyejesh'amaraso Ye, Anyeze nse n'urubura.
Kand'ibyo nkennye byose, Mbishyize ku birenge Bye. Yes'akiz'indwara zose, Ndetse n'ibicumuro. Intimba zanjye zose, Nzishyikiriza Yesu; Kand'imitwaro yanjye yose, Yes'arayinyakira.
Ndifuza kuba nka Yesu, Niyoroheje nka We. Ndifuza kureba Yes'Umwana w'Imana Data. Ndifuza kuzabana, Na Yes'iyo mw'ijuru; Nkaririmbana n'abera, Ntozwa n'abamarayika.

praise.title: Twegerej'Igihe
stanzas: Twegerej'igihe cyo gutah'iwacu; Abacu twabuze tuzongera kubonana. Mwami Yesu, Tegur'ubugingo bwanjye; Nyejesh'amaraso yaw'ankiz'ibyaha byanjye.
Dore duhanganye n'imirab'ikaze; Arikw'iri hafi kurangira bidatinze. Tugiye kwiber'ahatab'amakuba; Yesu nkiz'ibyaha mbashe kuzager'iwawe.
Intugunda zose zigiye gushira. Turi hafi guhanagurw'amarira yose. Mwami Yesu wamviriye amaraso. Mfasha rwose, nzabe mur'uwo muns'uhiriwe.
N'igihe kigufi Yes'akagaruka. Yaradupfiriye, kugira ngo tuzabeho. Mwami Yesu, Tegur'ubugingo bwanjye; Nyejesh'amaraso yaw'ankiz'ibyaha byanjye.

praise.title: Nagiriw'Ubuntu
praise.chorus: **S. na T.:** Kubw'ubuntu bw'Imana, Butangaje cyane: Mbeg'ubuntu! Ubuntu, Bwankijij'ibyaha. **A. na B.:** Mbeg'ubuntu, mbeg'ubuntu; Bw'Imana butangaje cyane: Mbeg'ubuntu! Mbeg'ubuntu! Ubuntu bwankijij'ibyaha
stanzas: Nagiriw'ubuntu na Yesu, N'ubuntu bw'ikirenga rwose. Umutwaro w'ibyaha byanjye, Wasigaye i Kaluvari.
Ibyaha byarazimanganye; Mbese nk'uk'umurab'utuza. Kubw'ubuntu butarondorwa; Nakize kubw'umusaraba.
Ubuntu butagereranywa, Bwahawe uwizera wese. Ushaka kubon'agakiza, Nasange Yes'aramwakira.

praise.title: Kwa Kwizera Kw'Abakurambere
praise.chorus: Uko kwizera natw'ubu, Tugufite mu mitima. Tuzakunambaho rwose, N'iyo byaba ngombwa gupfa.
stanzas: Kwa kwizera kw'abakurambere, Kwa kundi kwababashishaga, Kwemera kuzir'akarengane; Kwicishw'inkota n'umuriro.
Baraboshywe baranakubitwa, Baroshywe mu mazu y'imbohe; Bajugunywa mu byobo by'intare, Nyamara bagumye kwizera!
N'ubwo batotejwe bikomeye, Nta nzika bigeze bagira! Ntibikomy'ababatotezaga, Babasabirag'imigisha!

praise.title: Tur'Abagenzi
praise.chorus: Bizab'umunezero kubana na Yesu, Mu Bwami bwo mw'ijuru, turirimb'iteka. Itorero Rye ryo mw'ijuru, rizaririmb'aleluya! Rihimbaza Yes'Umwami Mucunguzi wacu!
stanzas: Tur'abagenzi mw'iyi si, Twerekeje mw'ijuru. Yes'araduhamagara, Ku nkombe ya yor’dani. Yes'uw'uduhamagara, Arashaka ko tumusanga, Tukabana mu bwiza bwe, Turirimb'iteka.
Mbeg'ukuntu bizaba byiza, Kumv'amajwi meza; Asingiz'Umwana w'Intam' Amajw'atey'ubwuzu! Kand'amajwi yac'azab' Urwunge n'ay'abamarayika. Twese tuzaririmbira Umwami w'abami.
Abacunguwe na Kristo, Bazabon'ubwiza bwe, N'abapfuye bamwizeye, Bazakangurwa na we. Tuzasingiz'intsinzi ye, Twese dukikij'intebe ye. Tuzataramana n'Umwam'atuganirize.
Dor'umunsi w'Uwiteka, Uri hafi kugera, Kand'abamwizeye twese, Tuzamusanganira. Tuzasingiz'urukundo, Rwatumye atang'Umwana We, Yesu Krist'akadupfir' Akadukiz'urupfu.

praise.title: Duhimbaz'Imana Y'Abrahamu
stanzas: Mana y'Abrahamu, Data wo mw'ijuru; Mana y'urukundo, Uhorahw'iteka. Uwiteka Mana, Ijuru n'isi bikuramye. Izina ryawe niryubahwe, Muremyi wacu.
Mana y'Abrahamu, Mu biganza byawe, Ugabir'is'umunezero nyakuri. Ubwema n'ikuzo, n'ibyawe Mana yacu nziza. Uri kw'isonga, Nta wahwana nawe Gitare.
Twese dusingiz'Iman' Isumba byose. Icyubahiro cyose, n'icyawe Mana; Wowe Mana Data, Man'Umwana na Mwuka Wera; Nyir'ubushoboz'uhimbazwe, Iteka ryose.

praise.title: Mbeg'Urukundo!
stanzas: Mbeg'urukundo ruhebuje byose! Turasaba Man'urukomeze; Rub'urukundo rw'iteka n'iteka; Nibab'umwe muri wowe Mana.
Bah'ubuzima bwiza Mana yacu; Bibere mu bwishingizi bwawe. Ubahe gushikama mu kwizera; Banesh'imibabaro y'iyi si.
Bah'ubutwari buzira kwiheba; Banezerwe bagir'amahoro; Man'ubahe urukundo rusāze; Bah'urukundo rutagajuka.

praise.title: Isabato Yera, Munsi W'Uwiteka
stanzas: Isabato yera, Munsi w'Uwiteka; Duhabw'amahirwe, Yo kumv'Ijambo ry'Imana.
Mbeg'umunsi mwiza, Umunsi w'Imana! Ukwiye kubahwa rwose, tukaramy'Imana.
Abera b'ijuru baterana natwe; Tugafatanya guhimbaz' Umuremyi wacu.
Ubwo tuzava mw'iyi si y'igomero; Tuzakomereza kwez' Isabato mw'ijuru.

praise.title: Shuri ry'Isabato Nkunda
praise.chorus: Mvugisha Mwami Yesu, Nyongera kwizera. Mw'ishuri ryo kw'Isabato; Ntabwo nzacogora.
stanzas: Shuri ry'Isabato nkunda, Munezero wanjye; Unyongeramw'imbaraga; Mu rugamba ndwana.
Nig'ibyigisho by'ingenzi, Umunsi ku wundi. Bituma nsobanukirwa, Ibyiza by'ijuru.
Mw'ishuri ryo kw'Isabato, Twiga Bibiliya; Tugahabw'amabang' Atuma twizera cyane.

praise.title: Mwami Ha Umugisha Uru Rugo
stanzas: Aba bashyingiwe, Bah'umugisha wawe; Wow'ubagiz'umwe, By'itek'uyu munsi. Barabagiranishwe n'ubwiza bwawe. Bagwiriz'urukundo n'umunezero.
Bari ku birenge, Byawe Mwam'ubahire; Uhir'amasezerano bagiranye. Mu nzira y'ubuzima bwab'ubane na bo; Bahore babumbatiwe naw'iteka.
Amahoro yawe, Atah'urugo rwabo; Kand'Ijambo ryawe, Ribamurikire. Yes'abane na bo, Mu migendere yabo. Yes'ahore yonger'urukundo rwabo.
Baba mu mahoro, Haba se mu makuba; Yes'ubagumane, Mu maboko yawe. Be guhungabanywa n'imiraba y'iyi si; Ukuboko kwawe kubahe kunesha.

praise.title: Mbeg'Umunsi Mwiza!
stanzas: Mbeg'umunsi mwiza! N'umunsi wera de! Munsi wo kuruhukwa; Twongerwa mw'imbaraga.
Kand'Umwuka Wera, Aterana natwe; Agatesh'inkomyi yatubuz'umudendezo.
Mbeg'ikiruhuko! Gituma turamya, Imana yo mw'ijuru, Maze tugasābana.
Mbeg'umunsi mwiza, Umunsi wejejwe! Imitim'irakanguka; Tukanesh'urupfu.

praise.title: Umunsi W'Isabat'Uragarutse
stanzas: Umunsi w'Isabat'uragarutse; Munsi wera wahiriwe n'Imana yacu. Munsi mwiza turuhuk'imirimo; Munsi w'ituze, Munsi w'amahoro.
Twite kur'uyu munsi w'Uwiteka; Twige kandi tumenye gukor'iby'ashaka. Azajya yumv'amasengesho yacu; N'indirimbo zacu zizamunyura.
Uwiteka Mana, duteg'amatwi; Wumv'ijwi ry'abana bawe bagutakira. Udukomerez'amasezerano; Ubuntu bwawe busage muri twe.
Data wo mw'ijur'ur'Umurengezi; Ni wowe twubatsehw'ibyiringiro byacu. Ur'inshuti itadutererana; Icyubahiro kib'icyawe Mana!

praise.title: Mwami Nyir'Isabato
stanzas: Mwami Nyir'isabato yera de! Nkez'umunsi wawe w'ikiruhuko. Muns'umpora ku mutima, N'umuns'ungarura mw'intege; Mpabwamw'imigisha ngakomera.
Munsi wuj'amahoro n'ituze, Umunsi wose numva nezerewe! Intekerezo mbi zose, Zirahunga zikanjya kure; Nkibwir'ibyiza byera by'ijuru.
Mbeg'ukunt'ar'iby'igikundiro, Iyo ngeze mu munsi wahiriwe! Nkumv'indirimbo z'ihozo, Ntwarwa gusa n'ibyo mw'ijuru! Munsi mwiza mbonamw'imigisha.
Ntaramana nawe Mwami Yesu, Mur'uyu munsi mwiza wahiriwe! Jyew'umugaragu wawe, Gukomez'isabato yawe, Bizampesha imigisha myinshi.

praise.title: Umubano Uba Mwiza
stanzas: Umubano uba mwiza, Mu rugo Yes'arimo; Urukundo ruranesha, Hab'ituze rihamye. Ikinyabupfura ni cyo kiranga urwo rugo, Umugabo n'umugore, Iyo bubah'Imana.
Urugo rwunguts'umwana, Hab'ibyishimo byinshi. Nahabw'uburere bwiza, Ab'umwana w'ijuru; Umwan'unezez'Imana, Kand'uzabana na yo; Abane n'Umwami Yesu, Kand'ayoborwe na we.
Urugo rwa hano mw'isi, n'urw'igihe kigufi, N'ubund'ibyo mw'isi byose, Ntabwo biramba rwose. Ibyiza birut'ibindi, Kandi bizahoraho, Tuzahurizwa mw'ijuru; Tuzabana by'iteka.
Ibyo duhabwa n'Imana mu rugendo turimo; Tubyakiran'ibyishimo, Tubyifatemo neza. Twirinde gutsindwa n'ibigeragezo by'Umwanzi; Dusarur'iby'urukundo, Rw'Imana yac'iduha.

praise.title: Mu Gihe Ntugarijwe
stanzas: Mu gihe ntugarijwe N'akaga gakomeye; Yes'umbwiz'ijwi ryiz'uti: Humura ndahari.
Iy'umurab'ukaramye, Ntabwo mpungabana. Krist'ankomez'ambwir'ati: Humura ndahari.
Umwijim'iy'ubuditse, Nkabur'iyo ngana; Numv'ijwi rimpabura ngo: Humura ndahari.

praise.title: Inyungu N'Ibyubahiro…
stanzas: Inyungu n'ibyubahiro byo mw'iyi si, Jye ndabizinukwa. Iyo ndeby'umusaraba Yes'Umwami yabambweho; Nsang'iby'is'ar'impfabusa.
Yesu yarababajwe cyane, Intimba imen'umutima; Kubw'ubuntu yangiriye, N'urukundo ruhanitse, Rwamuteye kuncungura.
Nari narazimiye rwose, Narabuze ibyiringiro; Ancunguz'amaraso ye, Nanjye mpabw'icyubahiro; Maz'amahor'aransāba.
Urukundo rwawe rurera, Ruhoraho ibihe byose. Nzahora ndwogez'iteka, Kandi nzahora ndurata; Sinzareka kuruvuga!

praise.title: Munsi Mwiza W'Umunezero
stanzas: Munsi mwiza w'umunezero! Ur'umunsi wera de! Ur'umuns'urut'indi yose; Munsi wo kuruhukwa. Abakomeye n'aboroheje, Bunamir'Uwiteka; Baririmba: Wera! Wera! Wera! Uhimbazw'iteka.
Muns'urinzwe cyane n'Imana; nta cyawuhungabanya. Tugomororerw'amasoko yo muri Paradizo. Soko y'amariba mez'afutse, Y'amaz'amar'inyota. Duhagarara kuri Pisiga, Tureb'i Kanani.
N'umunsi tuzirikana cyan'urukundo rw'Imana; Turushaho gutekereza ibyiza byo mw'ijuru. Duhabw'imigisha myinshi cyane, Mur'uyu munsi mwiza; Twumva rwose twakwigumira, Mur'uyu munsi wera!

praise.title: Ibyaremwe Byose…
stanzas: Ibyaremwe byose nibiter'amajwi hejuru; Byishimir'Umuremyi, Bimuririmbire. Koko yaraturemye; Kandi n'Umurinzi wacu, N'Umuyobozi wacu, Kugez'imperuka. Adukingir'ibihe byose, Atugend'imber'iteka. Mu mwijim'atuber'inkingi y'umuriro; Atamurur'ibihu; Akadukiz'umwijima; Tukagendera mu mucyo wera w'Imana.

Yahanits'inyenyeri; Ategek'izuba kuva. Ni we wahanz'imisozi, N'inyanja zose; Imigezi n'inzuzi n'amasoko birasuma! Byose kw'itegeko ry'Umuremy'udukunda. Guhera mu bushorishori, No mu kuzimu mu nyanja; Byose bihamy'Imana, Yukw'ar'Umuremyi. Natwe biradukwiye, Guhanik'amajwi yacu; Tugasingiz'iyo Mana; tuti: Hozana!

praise.title: Iyo Ngukoreye Yesu
praise.chorus: Nguhay'ubugingo bwanjye, Bwakire Yesu Kubw'ubuntu bwawe Mwami, Undind'ibibi.
stanzas: Iyo ngukoreye Yesu, Biranezeza; Iri turo ntuye, Mwami rikunezeze.
Warancunguye Mukiza, Mb'uwawe rwose. None rer'umbashishe, Gukor'iby'ushaka.
Ungir'umumarayika wihuta cyane; Njyan'Ijambo ryawe hose, Mvug'ubutumwa.
Rwose kuzaba mw'ijuru, Ni byo nifuza; Nta byago nta n'amakuba bizantezura.

praise.title: Gihome Kidukingira
stanzas: Mana yac'urakomeye; Gihome kidukingira; Udukingir'imiraba, Y'ingorane n'amakuba. Uturind'Umwanzi uhor'aduhiga; Afit'imbaraga, Ntabwo twamwifasha; Ntitwamwibashisha na gato.
Dushatse kwirwanirira, Twatsindwa rwose ruhemu. Keretse dufite Yesu, We mukiranutsi wera. Yaneshej'umwanzi; Kandi yiteguye Kuturwanirira; Turi kumwe na We; Nta kabuza tuzanesha.
Iyi si yuzuy'ibibi, Bishobora kuturimbura. Ntidukwiye guhabuka; Twisung'umucyo w'Imana. Ntiduterw'ubwoba n'Umwanzi w'umucyo. Ni Se w'umwijima; Kand'azarimburwa; Azajugunywa mu muriro!
Nta wabasha guhindura ubushake bwa Rurema; Ibyo yategetse byose, Ntibikomwa mu nkokora. N'ubwo byab'urupfu, Cyangw'ikindi cyose, Ijambo ry'Imana nta cyarivanaho, Kugez'iteka n'iteka.

praise.title: Gihome Kidukingira
praise.chorus: Tyo shikama, Ukomere ub'intwari; Utsind'Umubisha.
stanzas: Mukristo byuka, Yes'aragushaka. Ambar'intwaro zose z'urugamba; Hangana n'Umwanz'udafit'ubwoba; Rwana; Shikama; Ntutiny'urugamba.
Rwanira Yesu, Ushyizeh'umwete; Kand'ube maso kugez'iherezo; Ujy'aho Yes'akuyobora hose. Rwana; Shikama; Ntutiny'urugamba.
Ntushidikanye Yesu n'Umugaba. Azakurinda; Azagukomeza, Kand'akuyoboresh'urukundo rwe. Rwana; Shikama; Ntutiny'urugamba.

praise.title: Mbes'Aho Tuzahurira Ku Cyambu? (B)
praise.chorus: Se koko tuzahurira hakurya y'uruzi? Tuzabonanirayo tuhanezererw'iteka?
stanzas: Mbes'aho tuzahurira, Ku cyambu cya rwa ruzi, Ahahor'umucy'iteka, Ntihab'umubabaro?
Tuzahurira ku cyamb' urugendo rurangiye? Mbes'aho tuzahurirayo, Maze twiruhutse?
Mbes'aho twese tuzahurira mu mudugudu, Wubatswe n'Uhoraho, Urimbishijwe Yasipi?
Abacunguwe bose, Bazaririmb'indirimbo; Kand'ibiremwa byose, Bizasingiz'Uhoraho.
Mbes'aho tuzabonana n' abo twakundanaga? Maze twumv'amajwi yabo, Tubareba mu maso?
Mbese tuzabonana na Krist' Umukiza wacu, Aje kujyan'intore ze, Mu bwami buhoraho?

praise.title: Data Umv'Isengesho Ryacu
stanzas: Dat'umv'isengesho ryacu; Uduhire, Uduh'umugisha. Amen.

praise.title: Ducan'Amatara Yacu
praise.chorus: Twitegure kuririmba tuti: Hozana! Tuzasabwa n'ibyishimo turirimb'Aleluya; Turirimba Aleluya!
stanzas: Muze dushikame, Ducany'amatara yacu; Umukw'agiye guhamagar'Umugeni we.
Abamarayika hamwe n'abatoranijwe; Bazateranira hamwe, Basingize Yesu.
Yesu n'umuneshi wacu, Yaratwitangiye. Afit'umucy'utangaje, Urabagirana.
Yes'azahamagar'abo yacunguye bose; Ati: Muz'abihanganye, Mu rugo rwa Data.

praise.title: 393 Bana, Nimwitonde
stanzas: Bana nimwitonde, Kandi mwishime; Muse n'abo mw'ijuru, Munezerwe.
Mur'abavandimwe, Nimukundane; Mwubah'ababyeyi, Kandi mwumvire.
Mwirind'umujinya; Ntimukabeshye; Ibyo muvuga, Bishimishe Yesu.

praise.title: 394 Gupfa Ni Ibitotsi
stanzas: Gupfa n'ibitotsi gusa, Kandi by'akanya gato. N'ubw'urupfu rubabaza, Rugater'agahinda; Ijoro rizatamuruka, Maz'umucy'utangaze; Abasinziriye mu bituro, Bazakangurwa.
Gupfa n'ibitotsi gusa, Kandi by'akanya gato. Yesu yaneshej'urupfu; Yavuye mu gituro. N'akanya gato gasigaye, Tukigira mw'ijuru; Aho Yes'azatujyana; Tuzaban'ibudapfa.

praise.title: Hagarara Kigabo Nka Daniel
praise.chorus: Hagarara kigabo nka Daniel; Hamy'Imana n’ubwo wab'usigay'ur'umwe.
stanzas: Komez'amategeko yera y'Imana; Shikama mu kuri kw'Imana nka Daniel.
Benshi barananiwe, Bacits'intege; Ntibashoboye gushikama nka Daniel.
Benshi baharanira iby'isi gusa; Ntibazi gufat'icyemezo nka Daniel.
Twirinde cyane rwose, Kandi tuneshe; Twung'ubumwe na Daniel, Tumere nka we.

praise.title: Ngwino Mwuka Wera We!
stanzas: Ngwino Mwuka Wera We! Maz'uture muri twe. Tuber'umuyobozi; Tugan'iwacu.

praise.title: Har'Igihe Ntegereje
stanzas: Har'igi-he ntegereje, Nza-nezerwamo; Icyo gi-he kiri hafi, nza-habw'ikamba. Amasengesho yanjye, Imana ira-yumva; Nzakome-za mpirimbane, Nza-habw'ikamba.
Ikamba ritegereje a-bazanesha. Nzashika-ma, Nzakomeza nyo-boke Yesu; Sinshaka kuza-bura mu bwami bwo mw'i-juru; Mu biro-ri byateguriwe abaneshi.
Ndatanya, ndater'intambwe, Si-ndeb'inyuma. Nyobowe na Nyagasani si-nzatezuka; Ibirangaza by'isi, Simbyitayeho namba! N’ubw'ibi-ndwany'ari byinshi, Mfi-t'a-mahoro.
Mana y'u-buntu n'impuhwe, U-murikire. Mfatish'u-kuboko kwawe, Ma-z'unkomeze. Nd'umunyantege nkeya, Ariko nitu-bana, Sinshidi-kanya na gato, Ma-na nzanesha.

praise.title: Uwiteka Ari Mu Rusengero
stanzas: Uwitek'ari mu rusengero; Ari mu rusengero rwe rwera. Isi yose nituze; Duturiz'imbere y'Imana; Tyo dutuze, dutuze, dutuze. Amen.

praise.title: Yesu Nikoreye Umusaraba
stanzas: Yesu ndagukurikiye, Ndetse byose ndaje Mwami. Nikorey'umusaraba, Ndagukurikiye Mukiza. Dor'ibyar'indamu zanjye, Sinkibyitayeho namba; Mpisemo kugira Yesu, Akaba mu bugingo bwanjye.
Ab'isi barantoteza, Kuko badafite Yesu. Batay'Umukiza wanjye, Barashaka kungerageza N'ubwo bampana bakandeka, Yesu ampor'iruhande. Yes'ampa kwihanganira, Ingorane z'iyi si zose.
Isi yahaw'agakiza, Yesu yarayicunguye. Yesu yaneshej'icyaha; Nta bwoba ngifite na gato. Umwuka Wer'ari muri twe; Mbeg'umunezero mwinshi! Nawe yaragupfiriye, Ng'uzabane na we mw'ijuru!
Twar'intwaro zo kwizera; Senga cyan'ubudatuza; Ugiye gutah'ijuru, Hazab'umunezero mwinshi! Ibyo dukorera mw'isi, Biri hafi kurangira. N'ibyiringiro bishyitse, Tuzabona Data mw'ijuru.

praise.title: Mwami Nje Ngusanga
stanzas: Mwami nje ngusanga, Nje bugufi bwawe. Umpire Mwami, Wowe soko y'ubugingo bw'iteka; Umpire Mwami; Wowe soko y'ubugingo bw'iteka.
Mp'umutim'utuje, Mwami ndakwinginze. Ngwin'umvugishe, Unganirize, Mwami mwiza wera; Ngwin'umvugishe, Unganirize, Mwami mwiza wera.
Umpe gusa nawe, Mpa kamere yawe; Ndashaka rwose kumera nkawe, Mpa kumera nkawe; Ndashaka rwose kumera nkawe, Mpa kumera nkawe.
Mp'ubutwari Mwami, Unshoboze Mwami; Umpe gukor'umurimo wawe, Uko bikwiriye; Umpe gukor'umurimo wawe, Uko bikwiriye.
Ubw'uzab'uje kujyan'intore zawe; Nanjy'uzanjyane Mwami w'abami, Ubw'uzagaruka; Nanjy'uzanjyane Mwami w'abami, Ubw'uzagaruka.

praise.title: Uko Duteraniye Hamwe
stanzas: Uko tur'aha, Duteraniye hamwe, Mwami Nyagasan'uduh'umugisha. Uduhana kugira ngo twihan'ibyaha; N’ubwo tur'abanyabyaha, Ntujy'utureka.
Ni wow'uturinda, Nyagasani Mana; Wow'udushyira ku murimo wawe. Ni wowe uduha kunesha ku rugamba, Maz'Imana yac'igahabw'icyubahiro.
Twererez'izina ryawe Mana yera. Urind'umukumbi waw'amakuba, Utuber'Umurengezi mu bihe byose. Duh'umudendezo, Tuguhimbaze Mana.

praise.title: Mfat'Ikiganza
praise.chorus: Mwami mwiza cyane, Umfate unkomeze. Ndarushye, Ndihebye, Nta ntege. Mu mwijim'ukaze, Umfate unkomeze; Mfat'ikiganza, Maz'ungez'iwacu.
stanzas: Mu gihe ndi hafi kubur'ibyiringiro; Mu gihe ntentebutse; Yesu ndakwinginze, Wumve gutaka kwanjye; Mfat'ikiganza, Maz'ungez'iwacu.
Mu gihe mbundikiwe n'umwijima mwinshi, W'ibyago n'amakuba, Umpe kwambuk'inyanja y'ibigeragezo. Mfat'ikiganza, Maz'ungez'iwacu.

praise.title: Mwami Wanjye Nyakira
stanzas: Mwami wanjy'akir'umubiri wanjye; Uwuhindur'urusengero rwawe rwera. Nywugukoreshereze kujya nguhimbaza, Mpore nguhesh'ikuzo.
Mwami wanjy'akira impano zanjye; Zikoresh'uk'ushaka, Ziguhesh'ikuzo. Ngiz'italanto zanjye, Zikuramye Mwami, Mpore nguhesh'ikuzo.
Mwami wanjye nguhay'igihe cyanjye; Umwanya wose mfite, ndawukweguriye; Ngo kimber'igihe cyo gukor'iby'ushaka, Mpore nguhesh'ikuzo.
Mwami wanjy'akir'ubutunzi bwanjye; Wabumpereye kugira ngo mbukoreshe. Unyonger'imigisha, mubyo nkora byose, Mpore nguhesh'ikuzo.

praise.title: Mucunguzi Mwiza
