salvation.title: Mfit’ amahor’ i Gologota
stanzas:
Mfit’ amahor’ i Gologota,
Ni ho Yesu yanyitangiye.
/: Ni naho mfit’ ubuhungiro,
Kwa Yesu wabanje kunkunda. :/

Simparanir’ ubwiza bw’ isi,
Kukw isi yuzuyemw ibyaha.
/: Ahubwo mfitiy’ agakiza,
Mu nkovu za Yesu Mukiza.:/

Ni we wadutuy’ imitwaro,
Yaciy’ imigozi y’ ibyaha.
/: Nejejwe n’ agakiza mfite,
Kavuye mw ijambo ry’ Imana.:/

Ijambo ry’ Iman’ Ihoraho,
Rituber’ ibyo kurya byera.
/: Ni ryo mbaraga yo gufasha,
Umukristo mu rugendo.:/

Nabay’ urusengero rwera,
Ntuwemo n’ Umwuka w’ Imana.
/: Nsigaye nyoborwa na Yesu,
Mu nzira y’ isezerano rye.:/

Nawe munyabyaha, tebuka
Kwa Yesu Mukiza wa bose.
/: Akuramburiy’ amaboko
Y’ Urukundo, yo ku gufasha.:/

salvation.title: Ngwin’ unyigishe ya nkuru nziza
salvation.chorus:
Nar’ impumyi, non’ ubu ndabona.
Kuko yumvise gusenga kwanjye.
Kandi ntazanyibagirwa,
Kuko nzi yukw ankunda.
stanzas:
Ngwin’ unyigishe ya nkuru nziza,
Ya nkuru y’ agakiza,
Nubwo ntabasha kumenya neza
Ubuntu bwe bwinshi.
Nzi yuk’ ubwo nari mu mwijima,
Yesu Mukiza yarahansanze.
Aherakw amp’ agakiza,
Ampa n’ ibyiringiro.

Kand’ iy’ abumbuy’ ibiganza bye,
Tubonamw agakiza.
Nib’ unaniriwe mu mutima,
Ngwin’ usange Yesu.
Waruhijwe n’ ibyo byaha byawe,
Tumbir’ Umukiza wawe Yesu.
Kand’ araguhe agakiza,
Ngwino kukw agukunda.

salvation.title: Izina rya Yesu Kristo, Rihorahw iminsi yose
salvation.chorus:
Iryo zina ndarikunda.
Rinezeza mu mutima.
No kubw’ iryo zina ryiza,
Nanjye nahawe agakiza.
stanzas:
Izina rya Yesu Kristo, Rihorahw iminsi yose.
Iryo zina n’ iry’ iteka, Kandi nta bwo rihinduka.
Rikwiriy’ abantu bose, Abasaza n’ abasore.
Rishobora kuyobor’ umuntu wes’ ushak’ Imana.

Iryo zina ryamamaye mu mpande zose z’ iyi si.
Rizanir’ abantu bose Ibyiringiro bizima.
Iryo zina rishobora Kudukurah’ ubugome.
Rigatuma, mu mutima Hategekwa n’ Umukiza.

Iryo zina rishobora Kumurika mu mwijima.
Rishobora kuyobora Inzira nshya y’ ubugingo.
Nahw izuba ryakwijima, Iryo zina, ryo riraka.
Rihimbazw’ iteka ryose Mw isi ndetse no mw ijuru.

salvation.title: Iby’ Iman’ ikora biradutangaza
stanzas:
Iby’ Iman’ ikora biradutangaza,
Nta n’ uwabimeny’ uko biri.
Arikw icyo nzi nukw iby’ Iman’ ishaka,
Ari byo nkwiriye gukora.

Mu rugendo nta bwo nabimenya byose,
Ariko nzi ko nzabimenya.
Ni kuki turizwa n’ ibyago biriho,
Kand’ ari byo mu gihe gito.

Yesu nzi k’ ufit’ amagar’ ibihumbi,
Harimo n’ iryo wangeneye.
Icyo wampitiyemo n’ ukugira ngo
Nzagere mw ijur’ amahoro.

Kandi nk’ ukw Eliya yajyanywe ningoga,
Nanjy’ uko ni ko nzava mw isi.
Ubw’ ibyago byose bizaba bishize,
Hariho guhimbaz’ Imana.

Tuzab’ ibihumbi turamy’ Umukiza.
Tuzamuririmbira twese:
Ur’ Iman’ ikiranuka muri byose
Ku buntu n’ inam’ utugira.

Ubu ntegereje kandi nihanganye
Kuzasobanukirwa byose.
Mfit’ ibyiringiro bifit’ ubugingo,
Mfit’ umugabane mw ijuru.

salvation.title: Yes’ ubu tukuragij’ uyu mwana
stanzas:
Yes’ ubu tukuragij’ uyu mwana.
Turakwinginze umuturerere.
No kubw’ ubuntu bawe, buri munsi
Umuduher’ umugisha, Yesu.

Mw isi huzuyemw ibigusha byinshi.
Harimw ibyago byinshi bidutega.
Ub’ umwungeri w’ uyu mwana, Yesu.
Umuyobore, umuber’ inshuti.

Yesu, kubw’ urukund’ umukomeze.
Mufashe ntananirirwe mu nzira,
Kand’ umurinde kubw’ ubuntu bwawe.
Ahore mu maboko yawe Yesu.

Umwohererez’ umucyo w’ ubuntu.
Umuh’ amazi yawe y’ ubugingo.
Turakwinginga cyane Mwami Yesu:
Rindir’ umwana wacu mu mahoro.

salvation.title: N’ igihe git’ intambar’ igashira
stanzas:
N’ igihe git’ intambar’ igashira.
N’ igihe git’ umurab’ ugacyahwa.
Noneho nkarambik’ umutwe wanjye
Muri rwa rubavu rwa Yes’ unkunda.
/: Mw ijuru ntihazageramw ibyaha,
Ni cyo gituma huzuy’ amahoro. :/

Umubabaro n’ uw’ igihe gito.
Ijoro, na ryo n’ iry’ igihe gito.
Ndirira kenshi mur’ iyi si ndimo,
Ariko nuko ntarabona Yesu.
/: Hazabahw igitondo gihoraho,
Ni bwo ntazongera kurir’ ukundi. :/

N’ igihe gito ngifit’ umuruho.
N’ igihe gito nkazabona Yesu.
Ni bwo nzaba ntandukanye n’ ibyago.
Nzaba mbumbatiwe mu maboko ye.
/: Nzi ko mw ijuru hatab’ umwijima.
Habah’ umucyo uhorahw iteka. :/

Noneho nta cy’ umubabar’ untwaye,
Kuko nzawibagirirwa kwa Yesu.
Nubwo ngifite kubabazwa mw isi:
Mw ijuru nta mubabaro n’ urupfu.
/: Iman’ izahanagur’ amarira,
Izavanah’ umubabaro wose. :/

salvation.title: Nahaw’ ubugingo buhoraho rwose
salvation.chorus:
Nejejwe n’ Imana mu mutima wanjye
N’ umuriro w’ ijur’ urimo
Nsigaye ngendera mu mucyo w’ ukuri.
Yesu Mukiza ni we mucyo
stanzas:
Nahaw’ ubugingo buhoraho rwose.
Kand’ ubwo bugingo ni Yesu.
N’ ukuri yinjiye mu mutima wanjye.
Kandi yanshyizemw ubutwari.

Imigisha yo mu gakiza k’ Imana
Kubw’ ubuntu narayihawe
Nayihawe mu gihe nihanny’ ibyaha
Imbere y’ Umukiza Yesu

Umukiza ni we wankuye mu ishyamba
Nsigaye mba mu murima we.
No kubw’ imvura n’ izuba byo mw ijuru
Nshobora kwer’ imbut’ ashaka.

Ubugingo bwiza nahisemo n’ ubu:
Gukorer’ Umukiza Yesu.
Kubaho ni Kristo no gupfa n’ inyungu
Ku Mukristo wese w’ ukuri.

salvation.title: Tuzanezerwa cyane mw ijuru
salvation.chorus:
Tuzanezerwa, Turamy’ Umukiza
Imbere y’ Imana mw ijuru.
Tuzanezerwa, turamy’ Umukiza
Mu gihe tuzagerayo.
stanzas:
Tuzanezerwa cyane mw ijuru,
Har’ ibyicaro by’ abahiriwe.
Tuzasingiz’ Umukiza wacu.
Kandi tuzabana n’ Imana.

Mur’ iyi s’ umunezero waho
Kensh’ uhinduka kub’ amaganya.
Ariko mw ijuru nta maganya,
Nta mubabar’ uzahagera.

Iyo gushidikanya n’ ibyago
Bigiye kudindiz’ urugendo.
Tuzuburir’ amaso mw ijuru.
Ni ho dufit’ umunezero.

salvation.title: Ririmb’ inkuru nziza: Iman’ ikunda bose
salvation.chorus:
Yesu ku musaraba yadupfiriye twese.
Yatwujuje n’ Imana, ni yo Data wa twese.
Wa mwenda war’ ahera, nziko watabutsemo.
Jye nawe, none twugururiw’ inzira.
stanzas:
Ririmb’ inkuru nziza: Iman’ ikunda bose.
Wigishe ya maraso yatwejej’ imitima.
Uvug’ iby’ iyo mpano, yuko twahaw’ Umwana.
Gend’ uvug’ iyo nkuru ku bantu bose.

Abababaye bose, gend’ ubaririmbire
N’ abari mu ntambara cyan’ abageragezwa
Ririmba mu misozi, vug’ iyi nkuru nziza,
Yuko Yes’ abashaka kubw’ urukundo

Mu mwijim’ uririmbe, naho hatav’ izuba
Bos’ ubaririmbire, bos’ uko bamerewe.
Mu gitond’ uririmbe, no ku manywa y’ ihangu
Shim’ Umukiza nubw’ ijoro riguye

salvation.title: Yemwe bantu mwese, mushimir’ Imana
salvation.chorus:
Shim’ Imana! Shim’ Imana!
Kukw ari yo iturinda twebwe twese.
Shim’ Imana! Shim’ Imana!
Kukw irind’ abayo neza.
stanzas:
Yemwe bantu mwese, mushimir’ Imana,
Ku mbabaz’ ihor’ itugirira.
Yesu Kristo, aturind’ iminsi yose,
Kand’ atuyobor’ inzira.

Yesu yakubabariy’ ibyaha byose.
Aragukiz’ intege nke zawe.
Araguhanagur’ amarira yawe,
Urahazwa n’ ubuntu bwe.

Yes’ ashobora kuguh’ imbaraga nshya,
No kuguh’ intwaro yo kunesha.
Uyoborwa neza mu nzira ya Yesu,
Akurinda mu mahoro.

Hor’ ushikamye mu Mwami Yesu Kristo.
Ni ko gukiranuka gushyitse.
Ni nako gakiza, ndetse ni bwo bwenge.
Turonkera mu Mukiza.

Umuns’ umw’ Umwami Yes’ azagaruka,
Aje kutujyan’ iwe mw ijuru.
Uwo Mwami wacu, tuzamuhimbaza,
Kukw ari we Mucunguzi.

salvation.title: Mu bimenyetso byose tubona
stanzas:
Mu bimenyetso byose tubona
Yuk’ Umukiza wac’ aza vuba
Nk’ uk’ umuraby’ uhita ningoga,
No kugaruka kwe ni ko kuri.
Tuzamusanganira mu bicu.
Hazabah’ umunezero mwinshi.
Azab’ ahamagay’ abe bose,
Abasohoze mw ijuru kwa se.

Kur’ uwo muns’ abantu babiri
Bazaba bari mu kiganiro.
Umwe muri bo azazamurwa,
Arik’ und’ asigare wenyine.
Hazabahw abagore babiri
Bazaba basya ku rusyo rumwe,
Umwe muri bo, azazamurwa,
Arik’ und’ asigare wenyine.

Mur’ iryo jor’ abantu babiri
Bazaba baryamye ku buriri.
Umwe muri bo azazamurwa,
Arik’ und’ asigare wenyine.
Iyo nyir’ inzu ameny’ umunsi
N’ igih’ umujur’ azaza kwiba,
Yabaye maso kurind’ inzu ye,
Uwo mujura nta cyo yatwara.

Na ba bakobwa ukw ar’ icumi,
Bagiye gusanganir’ umukwe.
Bari bafit’ amatara yabo,
Bategereje yuk’ umukw’ aza.
Abanyabwenge bari batanu,
Ni bo bajyany’ amavuta menshi.
Umukw’ asohoye barinjira,
Urugi ruherako rukingwa.

Abandi batanu bar’ abapfu,
Bo nta mavuta bari bafite.
Barakomanze barasubizwa
Yuko bat’ azwi habe na gato.
Inama Yes’ abagira n’ iyi:
Nimube maso kuko mutazi
Igih’ Umwam’ azagarukira.
Biradukwiye ko twitegura.

salvation.title: Umuns’ umwe tuzabona
salvation.chorus:
Vug’ ubutumwa bw’ Imana
Ubuvug’ ufit’ umwete
Igihe kiregereje,
Cyo kugaruka kwa Yesu
stanzas:
Umuns’ umwe tuzabona
Ubwiza bw’ Umwami Yesu.
Atab’ aje mu mucyo we
Umeze nk’ uw’ umurabyo.

Uwo munsi umez’ utyo,
Twawutegereje kenshi
Ubw’ imbaraga z’ urupfu
Zizaba zirangiy’ ubwo

Uwo munsi w’ Abakristo
Wo gusanganira Yesu
Bazambikw’ imyenda yera
Mw ijuru ku Mucunguzi

Uvug’ iyo nkuru nziza,
Ndets’ ukize n’ abarwayi
Ugarur’ abazimiye
Gir’ umwet’ udakererwa

Mu bimenyetso tubona
Yuko Yesu ari hafi
Uwo Mwam’ azagaruka
Kutujyan’ iwe mw ijuru.

salvation.title: Harih’ umuns’ izuba rizarasa
salvation.chorus:
Tuzamusanganira Yesu Kristo.
Kukw ari we wadukirije mur’ iyi si.
Tuzamwitegerereza mw ijuru.
Tuzamushimir’ urukundo yadukunze.
stanzas:
Harih’ umuns’ izuba rizarasa,
Wa munsi tuzageraho mw ijuru.
Ni ho tuzaba dutay’ umuruho.
Tuzaba dufit’ umunezer’ udashira.

Harih’ umunsi tuzabona byose
Iman’ ibihinduye kuba bishya.
Kur’ uwo munsi Umukiza wacu
Azatwugururir’ urugi rwo mw ijuru.

Tugeragezwa kenshi mu rugendo.
Tuzanezerwa tugeze mw ijuru.
Kand’ umwijima nta bw’ uzahagera.
Tuzarushaho guhimbaz’ Umucunguzi.

salvation.title: Nifuza cyane kuzagera
salvation.chorus:
Muri wa murwa w’ ubugingo
Duteraniyeyo n’ abera;
Tuzaboneray’ Umukiza
Tuzanezererway’ iteka
stanzas:
Nifuza cyane kuzagera
Muri wa murwa wo mw ijuru.
Mbasezeyeho bantu mwese
Mushaka gukorer’ iyi si.

Ntihazageray’ amarira
Muri wa murwa wo mw ijuru
Urupfu ntiruzahagera
Mu murwa w’ amahor’ iteka

Ibyago ntibizahagera
Muri wa murwa wo mw ijuru
Agahinda n’ imibabaro
Nta bwo biba mur’ uwo murwa

Tuzasangay’ inshuti zacu,
Zatubanzirije mw ijuru
Ubwo turamuts’ Umukiza,
Tuvuz’ impundu turirimba

salvation.title: Twese uko tur’aha turanezerewe
salvation.chorus:
/: Ko twishimye dutya!
Ko twishimye dutya!
Bizagenda bite
Ubwo Yes’ azaza?: /
stanzas:
Twese uko tur’aha turanezerewe.
Tugusanganiye, duhuj’ umutima.
Twabisaby’ Imana ngw ikurinde neza
Mu rugendo rwawe no kukugarura.

Ntitwakwibagiwe, ubwo twasengaga,
Kand’ Imana yacu yaratunejeje.
Iduh’ ukwizera, kukw izakurinda
Non’ ishimwe rwose, turanezerewe.

None, mwene Data, twongere, twishime,
Kukw Imana yacu ikiranuka.
Iby’ ivuga byose, irabisohoza
Ngaho tuyishime dufatanije.

salvation.title: Umukiza wac’ ashobora Kutunezeza mw isi
stanzas:
Umukiza wac’ ashobora Kutunezeza mw isi.
Atuyobora kubw’ ubuntu, Ni w’ uduhaz’ ibyiza.
Twizey’ ubuntu bwe, kuko na we Yemeye kutuyobora twese
Haleluya, haleluya, Haleluya, ashimwe

Ni byiza gukund’ iyo Mana, Kuko yaducunguye
Kandi ni byiza ko mb’ uwayo, Bindinda kuzimira
Tuzahoran’ umunezero no Mu bihe byose bizahinduka
Haleluya, haleluya, Haleluya, ashimwe

Iyo tugeragejwe kenshi Mu mwijima w’ iyi si,
Tumenya kw ibyo byose mw isi Ar’ iby’ igihe gito
Mw ijuru nta mubabar’ uhari, Nta n’ amarira azahagera
Haleluya, haleluya, Haleluya, ashimwe!

Tureke kwiganyira kenshi, Kubw’ inzu n’ ibyo kurya,
Kukw ibyo byose tubihabwa Kubw’ ubuntu bw’ Imana
Atuyobora mu nzira yose, Kand’ atwikorerer’ imitwaro
Haleluya, haleluya, Haleluya, ashimwe

Ubw’ ari byiza mur’ iyi si Kwizer’ Umwami Yesu.
Bizamera bite mw ijuru Tubony’ uburanga bwe.
N’ ukuri tuzanezerwa cyane Tubony’ ubwiza bwe budashira.
Haleluya, haleluya, Haleluya, ashimwe!

salvation.title: Turi mu gihe cyiza cy’ umunsi w’ agakiza
salvation.chorus:
Yesu, Mwana w’ intama, twese turagushima
Wadutunganirij’ ubugingo buhoraho
Kandi
Waduhinduye kub’ intumwa z’ Imana
No mu mazina yose nta rihwanye n’ iryawe
stanzas:
Turi mu gihe cyiza cy’ umunsi w’ agakiza.
Yesu yarangirije byose ku musaraba,
Abantu benshi cyane basang’ uwo Mukiza.
Bahabw’ umunezero, bakizwa mu mutima.

Waducunguye twese, utuvir’ amaraso
Ubuntu bwawe butumurikira nk’ izuba
Tumaze kumeny’ urukundo rw’ Imana yacu
Amaraso ya tumenyeshej’ isezerano

Ngwino nawe mugenzi, naw’ ugishidikanya,
Iman’ irakuzuza ubuntu bwayo bwinshi
No mu mutima wawe harab’ umunezero
Ibyiringiro byinshi n’ urukundo rukwiye

salvation.title: Dor’ urukundo rw’ Imana Rumurik’ iminsi yose
salvation.chorus:
Umucyo wac’ umurike, imbere ya bene wacu.
Kugira ng’ umunt’ umw’ umwe
Abon’ inzir’ itunganye.
stanzas:
Dor’ urukundo rw’ Imana Rumurik’ iminsi yose.
Icy’ ishaka nuko natwe Twab’ umucyo mur’ iyi si.

Kandi harih’ umwijima Mw isi, wazanywe n’ ibyaha.
Hariho n’ abantu benshi bashaka kubon’ umucyo.

Ube maso mwene Data, Tungany’ Itabaza ryawe.
Kiza bamwe bazimiye, Bakirish’ umucyo wawe.

salvation.title: Birakomeye gusobanukirwa
salvation.chorus:
None nsigaye nz’ Imana
Niy’ indindir’ umunani wanjye
Nzawubon’ umuns’ umwe,
Ubwo Yes’ azugaruka
stanzas:
Birakomeye gusobanukirwa
Ubuntu bw’ Iman’ Ihoraho.
Nari nuzuy’ ibyaha byinshi
Cyane ariko yarambabariye.

Birakomeye gusobanukirwa
Ubwinshi bw’ urukund’ agira
Nizeye gus’ ijambo rye rizima
Kandi ryampay’ umunezero

Birakomeye gusobanukirwa
Iby’ imirimo y’ Umwuka we
Kukw ashobora kumenyesh’ umuntu
Kwizer’ Umwami Yesu Kristo

Ntabwo nz’ iminsi yanjye nsigaranye,
Yo kuba mur’ iyi si ndimo
Har’ ubwo nkigiriramw’ amakuba,
Ndetse n’ umubabaro mwinshi

Urupfu niba ruzansanga mw isi,
Cyangwa se Yes’ akagaruka,
Aje guhindur’ abamwiringiye
Azaba ahagaze mu bicu

salvation.title: Kubw’ urukundo rwinshi rwa tumy’ aza kunshaka
salvation.chorus:
Yaj’ aje kunshaka kugira ngw ankize.
Yamvanye mu musayo w’ urupfu.
Yanshyize mu rugo rwe rw’ intama.
stanzas:
Kubw’ urukundo rwinshi
Rwa tumy’ aza kunshaka,
Anshyira ku bitugu
Anjyana mu rugo rwe.
Haririmbw’ indirimbo nziza
Ziririmbwa na marayika.

Yesu, Mwungeri mwiza,
Yanzuye mu mutima.
Aherakw ambwir’ ati,
Mwana Wanjye nakunze.
Uko ni kw iryo jwi rye ryiza
Ryahojej’ umutima wanjye.

Nta bwo nakwibagirwa
Ko yavuy’ amaraso.
Ubwo bamwambikaga
Na rya kamba ry’ amahwa.
Kandi ku musaraba ni ho
Nshimir’ Umwami Yesu Kristo.

Ubu nsigaye ngendera
Mu mucyo w’ ukuri.
Mfit’ amasezerano
Mur’ iyo nzira ncamo,
Nzahora nshim’ Umwami
Yesu iteka ryose nezerewe.

Ibihe birihuta
Ndindiriy’ igitondo,
Ubw’ uzampamagara
Unyinjiza mw ijuru
Nzahagarar’ imbere yawe
Nezerewe kandi ndirimba

salvation.title: Mu gihe cyo gusenga, amasengesho yacu
stanzas:
Mu gihe cyo gusenga, amasengesho yacu
Agera kure cyane, atambuka n’ inyenyeri.
Umutima w’ umuntu ujy’ imbere y’ Imana,
Ugakomang’ urugi, Ushaka kureb’ Imana.

Nta mahoro yuzuye twabona mur’ iyi si,
Kwa Data ni ho gusa hasenderey’ amahoro.
Umutim’ uzatuza, N’ umucy’ uzaba mwinshi,
Niba dukurikiye inzira y’ amasengesho.

Ndetse n’ umwana muto uzi guseng’ Imana,
Nta bw’ azagir’ ubwoba, azafashwa no gusenga.
Kandi ntitwibagirwe yukw' aho tujya hose,
Yuko gusenga kwacu kugera ku Mana Data!

salvation.title: Mwami Yesu uranyobore, Mur’ iyi nyanj’ ariyo si
stanzas:
Mwami Yesu uranyobore, Mur’ iyi nyanj’ ariyo si.
Mur’ uyu muraba mwinshi Kubw’ umuyaga w’ inkubi.
Mwami Yesu Uranyobore, Ni wowe niringira.

Mwami Yesu uranyobore, Uhoz’ umutima wanjye.
Iy’ uvuz’ ijambo rimwe inyanj’ iherakw ituza.
Mwami Yesu uranyobore mpore ntsind’ ibyo bishuko.

Mwami Yesu uranyobore, Ntsindir’ ibingerageza.
Byinshi bishaka kunshuka Ndetse no kumpumy’ amaso.
Mwami Yesu uranyobore, Mpozwe n’ amahoro yawe.

salvation.title: Uyu munsi mwiza w’ urwibutso
salvation.chorus:
Yemwe bantu mwese muririmbe,
Muririmbe byumvikane!
Mut’ icyubahiro n’ icy’ Imana
N’ amahoro mw isi.
stanzas:
Uyu munsi mwiza w’ urwibutso
Rwo kuvuka kw’ Umukiza,
Nimwumv’ iri jambo n’ iry’ ukuri.
Yesu yaje mur’ iyi si.

Nta bwo mfit’ ifeza n’ izahabu
Byo kukuzanira Mwami.
Nguhay’ umutima wanjye, Yesu,
Uwutegek’ uk’ ushaka.

Muze twese, duhimbaz’ Imana
Ko yatwerets’ urukundo.
Yatwohererej’ Umucunguzi
Umwana we Yesu Kristo.

salvation.title: Yesu n’ ibyishimo byanjye
stanzas:
Yesu n’ ibyishimo byanjye
Kuko yuzuy’ urukundo.
Ashobora gukomeza
Umunyantege nke wese.
Amp’ ubushizi bw’ amanga
Amp’ imbaraga zikwiye.
Naho nanyura mu rupfu,
Yesu n’ Umwungeri wanjye.

Umugozi w’ urukundo
Ni wo Yes’ ambohesheje.
Ntabwo n’ urupfu rwabasha
Kuntandukanya na Yesu,
Nemeye yukw antegeka
Nzamwumvira muri byose.
Yankijije kubw’ ubuntu
Nazinutsw’ ibyaha byose!

Mbumbatiwe n’ Umukiza
Mu maboko y’ urukundo.
Urwo rukundo rw’ ankunda
Simfit’ uko naruvuga.
Ni we wampay’ imbaraga,
Zifash’ umutima wanjye.
Yes’ ubu ni w’ unyobora
Mu rugendo rwanjye rwose.

salvation.title: Nageze ku Mwami Yesu
salvation.chorus:
Umutim’ uraririmba
Yuko nabohowe rwose.
Negerey’ Umwami Yesu
Ndirimban’ umunezero.
stanzas:
Nageze ku Mwami Yesu
None mu mutima wanjye
Harimw izuba ry’ ubuntu
Rimurik’ iminsi yose.

Umuriri w’ ubuntu bwe
Uri mu mutima wanjye.
Agakiza ke muri jye
Ni nk’ umuraba mu mazi.

Non’ Umwami Yesu Kristo
Namuberey’ ubuturo!
Ndetse nahaw’ Umufasha
Umwuka w’ isezerano.

Ubw’ Umwuk’ azabazaho
Muzaherako mumenya,
Yuko nicaranye namwe
Byavuzwe n’ Umwami Yesu.

N’ ukuri yatugezemo
Asigay’ aba na na twe
Ngwino wih’ Imana Yera
Yoz’ uwo mutima wawe.

Ubwo Yes’ azagaruka,
Aje mu bwiza bw’ ijuru.
Nzahindurwa nse na Yesu
Ndusheho gushim’ Imana!

salvation.title: Ba bakobwa cumi biteguye Kujya gusanganira wa mukwe
stanzas:
Ba bakobwa cumi biteguye Kujya gusanganira wa mukwe
Bari bajyany’ amatara yabo, Ngw abamurikire mu mwijima.
Abatanu bar’ abanyabwenge, Bujuj’ amavuta mu mperezo,
Nahw abandi batanu b’ abapfu mu mperezo zabo hari humye.

Hanyuma yah’ umukw’ aratinda Nuko bose barahunikira.
Bigeze mu gihe cy’ igicuku, Habah’ urusaku bat’ araje!
Bumv’ irindi jwi rivuga riti: Mwihute kumusanganira.
Ba bakobwa bose bitegura Gutunganya ya matara yabo.

Ba bapfu batangira kuvuga bati Kw amatara yac’ ataka!
Bati: Nyamuneka, nshuti zacu, Nimuduhe ku mavuta yanyu.
Na bo bati: Ntabwo yadukwira, Nimugende mujye kwigurira.
Bafat’ inzir’ ubwo baragenda Bajya gushak’ aho bagurira.

Uwo mwanya bamaze kuv’ aho, Umukw’ aherakw arasohora.
Ba bakobwa bar’ abanyabwenge Binjirana n’ umukwe mu bukwe.
Ba bapfu baza bavuga bati: Data-buja we, dukingurire.
Arabasubiz’ ati: Simbazi. aherakw arabakingirana.

Nta bwo tuz’ umunsi cyangw’ igihe, Tube maso n’ amatara yacu.
Yes' ashobora kutwuzuriza. Amavuta mu mitima yacu.
Mwene Data, wumv’ izi nyigisho Zituruka k’ Umukiza wacu.
Ukwiriye kwitegura kumusanganir’ ubw’ agaruka.

salvation.title: Nta bwo nkwiye kujya niganyira
stanzas:
Nta bwo nkwiye kujya niganyira,
Nibaz’ ukw ejo nzaba merewe.
Nzajya nibuka yukw Ihoraho
Imeny’ ibyo byos’ uko bingana.
Ifit’ umutima w’ urukundo
Kukw ijy’ intungish’ ibinkwiriye.
Umunezero n’ umubabaro
Byos’ abi nzaniramw amahoro.

Amba hafi ndetse buri munsi,
Kand’ angerer’ ubuntu bukwiye.
Ajy’ anyikorerer’ imitwaro
Ni we Data kandi ni we Mana!
Nguk’ ukw ajy’ antunga buri munsi,
Ajy’ andamira mur’ ibyo byose.
Buri muns’ azajy’ amp’ imbaraga
Iryo n’ isezerano yampaye.

Mana yanjye, komez’ ujy’ umfasba
Ngutaramire ntez’ icy’ umbwira
Mpore nizey’ ijambo wambwiye
Sinkabure ku mbaraga zawe.
No mu bikomeye birih’ ubu
Undamburir’ amaboko yawe
Ump’imbaraga ku buntu bwawe
Kugez’ igih’ uzaza kunjyana

salvation.title: Igihugu cyiza kiradutegereje mw ijuru
salvation.chorus:
Dor’ ubwami bw’ Imana buregereje!
Dor’ ubwami bw’ Imana buregereje!
Mutima wanjye ba maso,
Utungan’ iminsi yose,
Dor’ ubwami bw’ Imana buregereje!
stanzas:
Igihugu cyiza kiradutegereje mw ijuru,
Kizicarwamo n’ abatowe na Yesu.
Kand’ iminsi turimo nayo nikw ihita ningoga
Uwihangany’ azaragw’ icyo gihugu.

Twizeye rwose kuzabon’ icyo gihug’ uko kiri,
Dutegereje gus’ uwaducunguye.
Ibimenyetso bitwereka kw agiye kugaruka,
Bitwereka ko wa munsi wegereje.

Kand’ ibyanditswe na byo bivuga ko Yes’ aza vuba.
Kand’ ubw’ azagaragarira mu bicu.
Haleluya, haleluya.
Azaboha wa mugome.
Umwe wagerageje kuturimbura.

Kand’ abantu benshi barananiwe kutegereza,
Ubakanguze vuba bya bimenyetso.
Kukw ijambo ry’ Imana
Rishaka gusohora vuba.
N’ ukuri tubona ko Yes’ aza vuba.

salvation.title: Reka gutiny’ ibizakubaho Iman’ izakurinda
salvation.chorus: Iman’ irakurinda Iminsi yose mu nzir' ucamo. Iraguhaz' amahoro, Iman' irakurinda.
stanzas: Reka gutiny’ ibizakubaho Iman’ izakurinda! Reb’ ubushake bw’ Imana gusa Iman’ irakurinda.
Nubw’ uwo mutwar’ uremereye, Iman' irakurinda. N' ibyago biri mu nzir' ucamo, Iman' irakurinda.
Iman’ imeny’ ubukene bwawe, Iman’ irakurinda Uyimenyesh’ ibikubabaje, Iman’ irakurinda.
Kand' ubw' uzaca mu bikomeye, Iman' izakurinda. Komez' ubane n' Imana gusa, Iman'irakurinda.

salvation.title: Muri Betesida marayik’ agezemo
salvation.chorus:
Agakiza kacu, agakiza kacu.
Kateguwe na Yesu Kristo.
Niwinjire mu mazi yihinduriza.
Betesid’ iri hano none.
stanzas:
Muri Betesida marayik’ agezemo
Umukiza na w’ arahari.
Niwinjire mu mazi yihinduriza,
Betesid’ iri hano none!

Niwumv’ ijwi rya marayik’ ugezemo,
Risab’ unyunyutse kwizera!
Urakizwa na Yesu Mukiza mwiza,
Urakira ndetse no kwezwa.

Ubw’ udashoboye gukora ku nshunda
Umukiza ntakuyobewe.
Ijambo ry’ Imana ni ryo rigukiza,
Haguruk’ ubashe kugenda.

Betesida ni nk’ amaraso ya Yesu,
Marayika n’ Ijambo n’ Umwuka.
Injira mu ruzi ruv’ i Gologota,
Uhabw’ agakiza k’ Imana.

salvation.title: Iman’ iri hamwe natwe
salvation.chorus:
Utwumvire, Mana yacu,
Duh’ umugish’ uyu munsi.
Turagutegerej’ ubu
Tuvubir’ imvura yawe.
stanzas:
Iman’ iri hamwe natwe
Kugira ngw idukomeze.
Ijuru rifit’ ibihu
Byo kutuzanir’ imvura.

Iman’ iri hamwe natwe
Hano hahinduts’ ahera.
Twese turategereje
Kuzuzwi imbaraga zawe.

Iman’ iri hamwe natwe
Turasaban’ ukwizera.
Mana can’ uwo muriro
Mu mitima yacu twese.

Ugurur’ ijuru, Mana,
Uduh’ imbaraga zawe.
Duh’ umugish’ uyu mwanya
Kubw’ ubuntu bwawe, Mana.

salvation.title: Nshut’ iby’ ushidikanyamo
salvation.chorus:
Ndakwizeye, ndakwizeye,
Ndakwizeye, Mwami Yesu.
Ndakwizeye, ndakwizeye,
Nizey’ iryo jambo ryawe.
stanzas:
Nshut’ iby’ ushidikanyamo
Ubishyir’ Umwami Yesu.
Uwizer’ Umwami Yesu
Nta bw’ azakorwa n’ isoni.

Wihan’ ibyo byaha byawe,
Wezwe no mu maraso ye.
Kand’ arakwambik’ ukuri
Kugez’ ubw’ azakujyana.

Imiruho yawe yose,
Uyerek’ Umwami Yesu.
Naho waca mu gicucu
Nta bwo Yesu yakureka.

Kand’ umunezero wawe
Umenyekane kwa Yesu.
Ni we Mwami muri byose
Niw’ uzaguh’ umugisha.

Wiyegurir’ Umukiza,
Muh’ ubwenge n’ umutima,
Kukw ashaka gutunganya
Ubugingo bwawe bwose.

salvation.title: Harihw igihugu cyiza cyane
stanzas:
Harihw igihugu cyiza cyane
Gituwemo n’ abanezerewe,
Nta bwo batinya bomb’ atomike.
Baririmb’ indirimbo z’ ishimwe.

Ibyaho byose ni byiza cyane.
Har’ uburuhukiro bw’ ukuri
Nta magamb’ atey’ ison’ abayo,
Nta n’ imfubyi zihakubitirwa.

Icyo gihugu si nk’ icyo mw isi
Kukw ibyaho byose bitunganye.
Bene Dat’ icyo nifuza n’ iki:
Kuzababonayo muririmba.

Mbese ni kiguzi kidutanga
Kwinjira mur’ uwo murwa mwiza.
Nta kiguzi na kimwe twatanga,
Yesu yishyuriy’ i Gologota.

salvation.title: Umv’ iri jambo n’ iryo kwizerwa
stanzas:
Umv’ iri jambo n’ iryo kwizerwa
N’ iryo kwemerwa n’ abantu bose.
Yuko twahaw’ Umukiza Yesu.
Yaje gukiza abanyabyaha.

Nar’ uwa mbere mu banyabyaha,
Ariko nsigaye nezerewe.
Umukiza wanjye, Yesu Kristo,
Yanyogesheje ya maraso ye.

Yesu Mukiz’ ari hamwe natwe,
Akor’ imirimo nk’ ukw ashaka.
Acan’ umuriro we muri twe.
Ni nde wabasha kumuzitira?

N’ ibipfamatwi bibasha kumva,
Ndetse n’ ibimuga bikagenda
N’ abanyabibembe barakizwa.
Ubutumwa bwe buramamazwa.

Mwami Yesu, duh’ Umwuka Wera
Umuduhuhireh’ uyu munsi,
Sayur’ abarohamye mu byaha,
Ubamurikire bagaruke.

Ugurur’ ijur’ ugush’ imvura,
Ahumagaye nko mu butayu.
Uhahindure kub’ ahatoshye
Havuz’ impundu z’ umunezero.

N’ abapagani bakunamire
Bagupfukamire bakuramye,
Ukwiy’ ishimwe ku bantu bose
N’ icyubahiro, Haleluya!

salvation.title: Yemwe mwa bushyo bw’ Imana
stanzas:
Yemwe mwa bushyo bw’ Imana
Mwihangan’ ibihe bito.
Muri wa murw’ uhoraho
Muzabonay’ Ibyishimo.
/: Hasigay’ igihe gito,
Intambar’ ikazashira. :/

Ntukarogwe mur’ iyi si
Ntukarek’ Imana yawe.
Mu makuba no mu byago
Kurikir’ Umwami Yesu.
/: Buri munsi, buri munsi
Aguha kunesha byose. :/

N’ unanirwa mu rugendo
Inzir’ imaze kuramba.
No mu makuba y’ iyi si
Iman’ izakuruhura.
/: Hazabah’ umunezero
Wo kunezez’ umugenzi. :/

Ni twizera tuzabona
Cya gihugu cyo mw ijuru.
Kand’ iyo n’ inkuru nziza
Nta bizatugerageza.
/: Turi hafi, turi hafi
Yo guhurira mw ijuru. :/

Ni dutumirwa n’ urupfu
Tuzimukan’ ibyishimo.
Ibyo twiringiye byose
Tuzabibona mw ijuru.
/: Hazab’ amahoro menshi
N’ umunezer’ uhoraho. :/

salvation.title: Murebe urukundo rukomeye cyane
salvation.chorus:
Tuzanezerwa cyane mw’ijuru
Tuzaririmbana n’abera.
Tuzambikw’ikuzo
Mur’urwo rukundo.
Nta marir’azaba mw’ijuru.
stanzas:
Murebe urukundo rukomeye cyane
Twahawe n’Imana ihoraho,
Twahinduw’abana b’Iman’ Ihoraho.
Dukwiye kubana amahoro.

Utugirir’ubuntu
Man’Ihoraho
Mu rugendo rwacu dufite.
Utwoherereze umugisha Mukiza,
Tubashe kukumenya Mana.

Sinshaka gukorera abami babiri,
Niko gukund’isi n’ijuru.
Harih’abakunda ubutunzi bwo mw’isi
Bakaburutisha ubw’ijuru.

Harihw’abahamya b’urupfu rwa Yesu,
Nibo barungurutse mu mva Yesu
Ubwo yamaraga kuzuka mu mva
Hanyuma yagiye mw’ijuru

No mu gihe tugendera mur’iyi si,
Tuyibonamo ibidushuka.
Ariko dukwiye kunesha ibyo byose
Kuko arikw’Imana ibishaka!

salvation.title: Uhamagarwa na Yesu kenshi
salvation.chorus:
Yew’ ugendera mu byaha
Yesu aragushaka!
Ngw akubabarir’ ibyaha.
Ngwin’ umusange vuba!
stanzas:
Uhamagarwa na Yesu kenshi,
Umwitab’ uyu munsi.
Har’ ubw’ iri jwi wumv’ uyu munsi.
Ryab’ ari ryo rya nyuma.

Umudendezo wo mur’ iyi si
Nta bw’ uguh’ amahoro,
Kand’ ibikorwa by’ abanyabyaha
Byose biragushuka.

Mu gih’ utazi nih’ umwijima
W’ urupf’ ukugeraho.
Mugenzi wanjye nkugir’ inama
Ngwino witabe Yesu.

Yes’ azi yuko ufit’ imvune
Y’ ibyaha mu mutima.
Uk’ uri kose arakwakira,
Ndetse no kugukiza.

Uhor’ uhamagarwa na Yesu,
Kuki s’ utamwitaba?
Nib’ ukomeje kumwim’ amatwi
Uzarimbuka rwose.

salvation.title: Kubw’ Umwami Yesu
salvation.chorus:
Mwami Yesu shimwa!
Mwami Yesu shimwa!
Mwami turagushimira
Wuzuy’ urukundo.
stanzas:
Kubw’ Umwami Yesu,
Turanezerewe.
Kubw’ ubuntu bw’ Umwuremyi
Duhaw’ uyu munsi.

Wavuye mw ijuru,
Uza mur’ iyi si.
Waratuvukiye Mwami
Mu nda ya Mariya.

Wahinduts’ umuntu,
Arik’ ur’ Imana.
Wavukiye mu nzu y’ inka
N’ igitangaza pe!

Na ba marayika
Baranezerewe
Kuk’ Umwan’ atuvukiye
Aje mu mbaraga.

Na ba banyabwenge
Babony’ inyenyeri,
Ni yo yabamenyesheje
Yuk’ Umwam’ avutse.

Herode yashatse
Kwic’ Umwana Yesu.
Arikw Iman’ ihoraho
Yarinz’ uwo Mwana.

Mwami wacu, Yesu,
Ufit’ ububasha,
Kuko watsinze n’ urupfu
Urw’ ari rwo rwose.

Mwami wacu, Yesu,
Natw’ uraturinde.
Ni wowe rukundo koko
Utwifashirize.

Shimwa Yesu Kristo,
Ko waje muri twe.
Watubabariy’ ibyaha
Utumar’ ubwoba.

Shimwa Mana yacu,
Wohereje Yesu.
Kuvukira mur’ iyi si
Adukiz’ ibyaha.

salvation.title: Nifuza kuzagera muri wa murwa, Wo mw ijuru mwiza cyane
stanzas:
Nifuza kuzagera muri wa murwa,
Wo mw ijuru mwiza cyane
Ariko se ko ntaz’ inzir’ ingezayo,
Ni nd’ ubasha kuyinyereka.
/: Ngwino vuba, ngwino vuba!
Umukiz’ arakwerek’ inzira. :/

Ubwo najyaga ngendagend’ uko nshaka
Nih’ umucyo wantunguye.
Uwo mucyo waramurikaga cyane
Uturuka ku musaraba.
/: Natunguwe n’ uwo mucyo,
Uwo mucyo wangezemo rwose.: /

Kand’ ijwi ryaturutse mur’ uwo mucyo,
Riti: Niwambur’ inkweto
Kuko han’ ugeze hahinduts’ ahera
Kand’ Imana nay’ ar’ iyera
/: None nsigaye nyoborwa
Neza rwose n’ iyo Mana yera.: /

Habab’ umunezero mwinshi mw ijuru
Umunyabyaha yihannye
None Yesu naw’ aragutegereje
Kugira ngo wezwe mw iriba
/: Ngwino wezwe, ngwino wezwe,
Amaraso y’ arakweza rwose.: /

Kandi mumenye ko azagaruka vuba.
Azab’ aje nk’ umujura
Nyir’ inz’ iy’ ameny’ igih’ umujur’ aza
Yaba maso kugez’ ubw’ atibwa
/: Mube maso, mube maso,
Kuko mutaz’ umunsi n’ igihe.: /

Kandi mumenye ko ngiye kuza vuba
Nzaba nzanywe no guhemba
Ibikwiranye n’ umurimo w’ umuntu
Nimukomez’ icyo mwahawe.
/: Kor’ ibyiza, kugira ngo
Uzahembw’ ibikwiranye na byo.: /

Najyanywe no kubategurir’ ahanyu,
Kugira ngo muzabeho.
Hariy’ ibyicaro byinshi kandi byiza
Mukwiriye kuzabyicaramo.
/: Nimusenge cyane cyane
Kugira ngo mutazaburayo.: /

salvation.title: Nkunda kumv’ amakuru y’ umurwa
stanzas:
Nkunda kumv’ amakuru y’ umurwa
Uri kur’ ahateger’ ibyago,
Kand’ umucyo n’ Umwana w’ intama
Umuns’ umwe nzawinjiramo.
Haleluya, ni ko mvuz’ impundu!
Haleluya, nzinjira mu murwa!
Haleluya, ndi hafi kujyamo.
Umuns’ umwe nzawinjiramo.

Nta marir’ aba mur’ uwo murwa,
Nta muruh’ ubayo n’ intambara.
Nta n’ indwar’ ishobora kubayo.
Umuns’ umwe nzawinjiramo.
Haleluya, nuzuy’ ibyishimo.
Haleluya, nzinjira mu murwa.
Haleluya, ndi hafi kujyayo.
Umuns’ umwe nzawinjiramo.

Abazajya mur’ icyo gihugu
Bazaba bambay’ imyenda yera.
Babikiw’ ikamba ry’ izahabu.
Umuns’ umwe nzakigeramo.
Haleluya, nta gushidikanya.
Mw ijuru hariy’ umunezero.
Nta bw’ umubabar’ uba mw ijuru.
Niringiye kuzinjiramo!

salvation.title: Tuzajyanwa kuri wa munsi
salvation.chorus:
Hazabaho kurira gusa
Ndetse no guhekeny’ amenyo.
Igihe cyo kwizera Yesu
Kizaba gishize rwose!
stanzas:
Tuzajyanwa kuri wa munsi
Ubw’ impand’ izab’ ivuze.
Tuzateranir’ imbere ye,
Dushimir’ Umwami Yesu.
Hazamanuka ba marayika
Bazaza kurimbur’ abantu,
Abanze kwakir’ Umukiza,
Bakamurutish’ iby’ iyi si.

Abafit’ abagore benshi
Icyo gihe bazahanwa,
Abarozi n’ abashikisha
Ndetse n’ abapfumu bose,
Bazakorwa n’ isoni rwose
Imbere y’ Umukiza Yesu.
Bazashak’ aho bahungira
Nyamara ntibazahabona.

Abatunz’ iby’ iyi si gusa
Bazashyirwa mu rubanza.
Ubutunzi bwabo bw’ iyi si
Buzahinduk’ umurama.
Nta cyo bazabasha kubona
Cyabakiz’ ibyaha bakoze.
Bazafatwa kur’ uwo munsi
Batabwe muri wa muriro.

Natwe Bakristo ba Mesia
Nta teka tuzacirwaho
Tuzaba tujyanywe mw ijuru,
Tuzasangira na Yesu
Azatwambik’ imyenda yera
N’ ingofero nziza cyane
Inkota z’ abamarayika
Zizirukan’ abanyabyaha

salvation.title: Amaraso yawe, Mukiza
salvation.chorus:
Nye. . . za nk’ urubura.
Nye. . . za nk’ urubura.
Nyogesh’ amaraso wavuye
Kugira ngo ntunganir’ Imana.
stanzas:
Amaraso yawe, Mukiza,
Ni yo yoz’ ibyaha twakoze.
Yaviriye ku musaraba
Ubwo wapfaga Mwami Yesu,
Nar’ uwo gucirwahw iteka
Kuko ntari mbashije kwizera.
Mwami nyogesh’ ayo maraso,
Kugira ngo ntunganir’ Imana.

Yes’ ubwo wambikwag’ amahwa,
Bakujyana ku musaraba.
Wihanganiy’ imibabaro
Ubwo wakubitwag’ inguma.
Iryo riba ni ryo nkeneye,
Ni ryo gusa ribasha kunyeza.
Mwami nyogesh’ ayo maraso
Kugira ngo ntunganir’ Imana.

Nta bwo ngutunganiye, Mwami,
Mfit’ intege nke mu mutima.
Ndakubona nt’ ese Mukiza
Nanjye ngo mbabarirw’ ibyaha?
Ku musaraba wawe Yesu,
Nizeye kw ari ho na kirira,
Mwami nyogesh’ ayo maraso
Kugira ngo ntunganir’ Imana.

Mwami, ndaje mbe hafi yawe
Kugira ng’ ujy’ uhor’ undinda.
Umbohore buri mugozi,
Untunganiriz’ umutima.
Neger’ umusaraba wawe,
Mpore muri wo kugeza gupfa
Mwami nyogesh’ ayo maraso
Kugira ngo ntunganir’ Imana.

salvation.title: Mbes’ aho wamenye rya zina ryiza
salvation.chorus:
Yesu ni we zina rihebuje,
Rirut’ ayandi yose mw isi.
Rifit’ imbaraga zo kudufasha,
Ridukiz’ ibyaha byose.
stanzas:
Mbes’ aho wamenye rya zina ryiza
Ry’ Umukiza wacu Yesu?
Riraririmbwa mur’ iyi si yose,
Rivugwa mu bantu bose.

Ni ryo rihoz’ umutim’ ubabaye
Riratunezeza rwose.
Mu mubabaro no mu byago byinshi
Ribasha no kuturinda.

Ndetse no mu mwijima mur’ iyi si
Rimurika nk’ inyenyeri.
Rimp’ amahoro, rimpa n’ ubutwari
Ndetse no kugeza gupfa.

Amazina yos’ aribagirana
Kerets’ izina rya Yesu.
Rizahora rimurika mw ijuru.
Yesu ni we zina ryiza.

salvation.title: Urukundo rw’ Umukiza
salvation.chorus:
Yesu ni we wuguruye
Rwa rurembo rwo mw ijuru,
Kugira ngo ndwinjiremo
Kubw’ ubuntu bwinsh’ agira.
stanzas:
Urukundo rw’ Umukiza
Ni nk’ amazi menshi cyane.
Ameze nk’ isoko nziza
Idudubiza muri we.

Nababay’ iminsi myinshi,
Nasaga n’ inyon’ ihigwa.
Natakiy’ Umwami Yesu
Na we ntiyanyirukanye.

Mwiyumvir’ igitangaza,
Yanyogej’ ibyaha byose,
Kuber’ ubwo bunt’ agira
Ndirimban’ umunezero.

Mu gitondo cy’ agakiza
Nzagera mur’ iryo rembo.
Kuber’ urukund’ afite
Nzinjira mur’ uwo murwa.

salvation.title: Uduh’ Umwuka wawe, Mana Yera
stanzas:
Uduh’ Umwuka wawe, Mana Yera,
Nk’ uko wawohererej’ abakera
/: Ucan’ umuriro wawe muri twe
Ntidukomeze kub’ abazuyazi.: /

Uduh’ Umwuka wawe, Mana Yera,
Nk’ uko wabigenje kuri wa munsi
/: Intumwa Peter’ ubwo yigishaga,
Yigishiriza mu nzu ya Kornelio. :/

Uduh’ Umwuka wawe, Mana Yera,
Uduhe Pentekote yacu none!
/: Abanyabyah’ ibihumbi bakizwe
Ijambo ryawe ribashe kogera. :/

Uduh’ Umwuka wawe, Mana Yera,
Uturamburir’ amaboko yawe.
/: Ukor’ ibitangaza byawe, Mana,
Ndets’ abarwayinabo ubakize. :/

Abasinziriy’ urabakangure
Cyane cyan’ abarushye mu rugendo.
/: Mwami, dusange nko kuri wa munsi
Ubwo wuzuzag’ abigishwa bawe. :/

salvation.title: Umugisha w’ Imana ni wo nkeneye rwose
salvation.chorus:
Umugish’ atanga, umugish’ atanga,
Uva mu buntu bwe ni nk’ amazi menshi.
Arawunyuzuz’ ubu, abasha no kunkiza,
Niyubahwe rwose n’ Umukiza wanjye.
stanzas:
Umugisha w’ Imana ni wo nkeneye rwose
Ndashaka kubatizwa muri wa Mwuka Wera.
Nejejwe mu mutima n’ amasezerano ye
Yaransezeranije kump’ uwo Mwuka Wera.

Itorero ry’ Imana n’ iryo guhabw’ imvura,
Isoko y’ umugisha dor’ iradudubiza.
Twishimir’ ubugingo
Twahawe n’ Ihoraho
Haleluya, dushime, dushimir’ Umukiza!

Ibicu by’ agakiza bitugezeho rwose.
Utwuzurize Man’ imitima yacu twese.
Abera bawe bose bahore bezwa nawe.
Haleluya, dushime, dushimir’ Umukiza!

Ibicu by’ agakiza bitugezeho rwose
Turagusaba, Mana, ubyohereze mw isi.
Ibihumbi by’ abantu bihabw’ ako gakiza.
Haleluya, dushime, dushimir’ Umukiza!

salvation.title: Hazabahw igihe cy’ imperuka
stanzas:
Hazabahw igihe cy’ imperuka
Urubanza rucibwe na Yesu.
Azarucir’ abaremwe bose
Kuko bazaba bar’ imbere ye.
Nibw’ azaherakw abarobanura
Nk’ umwungeri mu ntama n’ ihene:
Intama niz’ azashyir’ iburyo bwe,
Ibumos’ azaha shyir’ ihene.

Maze Yes’ azabwir’ ab’ iburyo ati:
Nimuz' mwahaw' umugisha.
Dor’ ubwami mwahamagariwe.
Uhereye ku kuremwa kw’ isi.
Uwo muns’ azabashimira cyane.
Bazarabagirana nk’ izuba.
Azabamurikir’ Imana Data.
Hazabah’ umunezero mwinshi.

Azabwira abo b’ ibury’ ati:
Nari nshonje muramfungurira.
Mwaranshumbikiye nd’ umushyitsi.
Mwaranyambitse nambay’ ubusa.
Na bo bati: Ryari war’ umushyitsi,
Cyangwa ryari twakubony’ ushonje,
Ryari twakubonye wambay’ ubusa.
Tugukorer’ ibyo byos’ uvuze?

Azabwira ab’ ibumoso bwe ati:
Muv’ aho ndi mwabivume,
Nimugende mujye mu muriro
Wa Satani hamwe n’ ingabo ze.
Ntimwamfunguriy’ ubwo nari nshonje.
Mfit’ inyota ntimwampay’ amazi.
Nar’ umushyitsi ntimwanshumbikira
Ntimwansuye ubwo nari ndwaye.

Nuko bazabwir’ Umwami Yesu bati:
Ryari twakubony’ ushonje?
Ryari twakubony’ ufit’ inyota?
Ryari twakubony’ ur’ umushyitsi?
Ryari twakubony’ urwaye, Mukiza?
Ryari twakubonyehw ibyo byose?
Ibyo byos’ uvuze ntitwabibonye
Ngo tubure kukwerek’ ineza.

Nuko Yes’ azabwir’ ab’ iburyo,
Ndets’ abwire n’ ab’ ibumoso bwe ati:
Byose mwakorey’ abato
Burya nijye mwabikoreraga.
Bose bazibuka ibyo bakoraga.
Hazarira abo b’ ibumoso.
Ab’ iburyo bazajyanwa mw ijuru
Bazahora banezerw’ iteka.

salvation.title: Icyubahiro n’ icyawe, Yesu
salvation.chorus:
/: Shimwa. . . ur’ uwo gushimwa,
Yesu. :/
stanzas:
/: Icyubahiro n’ icyawe, Yesu,
Ni ko ndirimbir’ Imana. :/

/: Gusenga kwanjye kukugereho,
Man’ ur’ amahoro yanjye. :/

/: Sinsaba mvugavuga nk’ inyoni,
Isakuriza mw ishyamba. :/

/: Umutima wanjy’ urakangutse
Kuririmbir’ Ihoraho. :/

/: Abagir’ umwete wo gusenga,
Ni bo banesha Satani. :/

/: Abera bose muhaguruke,
Turirimbir’ Umukiza. :/

/: Tubabajwe n’ ababyeyi bacu
Bagikorera Satani.:/

salvation.title: Ai Mana y’ ukuri
stanzas:
Ai Mana y’ ukuri,
Komeza kunyobora,
Uranshishe mu nzira yo gukor’ iby’ ushaka.
Mwami kubaho ntagufite
Binter’ ubwoba n’ amaganya
Ndetse byabasha kungeza no mu rupfu vuba.

Ibyiza mbona n’ ibi:
Kwizer’ Umwami Yesu.
No guhora ngendera mu nzira ye ntunganye.
Nawe yemeye kujy’ andinda,
Ndetse no ku nyobora neza.
Ampesha no kwinjira vuba mu mahoro ye.

Ub’ urugendo mfite
N’ urwo kujya mw’ ijuru.
Umukiza niy’ ari nanjye nkwiye kujyayo.
Kand’ umunsi nzaba ngezeyo
Nzamuhimbazany’ ibyishimo
Nzanezezwa nuko ari we wanguz’ amaraso.

Mur’ iyi si huzuy’ umuruho n’ amahane
Icyo nkeneye cyose simperako nkibona.
Ariko ku munsi mukuru
Ubwo nzabon’ Umucunguzi
Niringiye kuzabon’ ingororano yanjye.

Mw’ ijuru sinzabona
Abanzi banjy’ ukundi,
Nta n’ icyo nzahabura mw ‘ ijuru ry’ amahoro.
Nzashim’ Imana mvuz’ impundu
Nti: Haleluya, haleluya!
Nzarambur’ amaboko mpimbaz’ Umwami Yesu.

salvation.title: Namaze kumeny’ ibyiza byinshi
salvation.chorus:
Yesu Krist’ uko yar’ ari ni kw ahor’ iminsi yose.
Arashak’ abazimiye ndets’ akiza n ‘ abagome
Uwo Mukiza ntahinduka.
stanzas:
Namaze kumeny’ ibyiza byinshi
Yesu yakoraga mu gihe yagenderaga mur’ iyi si.
Aho yageraga hose ni ko yajyag’ abafasha
Nejejwe no kuririmba Yuko Yes’ adahinduka.

Kandi hariho n’ impumyi Yitwa ga Barutimayo.
Imaze kumenya ko Yes’ ari hafi
Yinginga Yesu yizeye, nukw ikizwa kubw’ ubuntu.
Nejejwe no kuririmba yuko Yes’ adahinduka.

Yes’ ahamagar’ abanyabyaha ndetse n’ abarwayi
Bos’ abahamagarira kubakiza
Naw’ ukore ku nshunda ze Urahabw’ imbaraga nshya.
Ugire nka wa mugore Kuko Yes’ adahinduka.

Namaze kumenya yuko Yasabirag’ abanzi be.
Cyane cyan’ ubwo yari ku musaraba
N’ ukuri yarababajwe Ubwo yambikwag’ amahwa.
Nejejwe no kuririmba yuko Yes’ adahinduka.

salvation.title: Mw ijuru ni heza cyane Kuko hatabamo ibyaha
salvation.chorus:
Dushimire Yesu Kristo, Kuko yaduteguriye
Ibyicaro byiza cyane Mw ijuru ku Mana Data.
stanzas:
Mw ijuru ni heza cyane Kuko hatabamo ibyaha,
N’ ukuri ni heza cyane Ni Yesu wahateguye.

Mw ijuru ni heza cyane Nta musinz’ uzahagera.
N’ ukuri ni heza cyane Nta mujur’ uzahagera.

Mw ijuru ni heza cyane Nta muroz’ uzahagera.
N’ ukuri ni heza cyane Nta mwicany’ uzahagera.

Mw ijuru ni heza cyane Ntihazajy’ abahehesi.
N’ ukuri ni heza cyane, Nta mugom’ uzahagera.

Mw ijuru ni heza cyane. Hagenew' abakijijwe.
N’ ukuri ni heza cyane Kandi hazicar’ abera.

salvation.title: Yesu Mukiza, ni we wanshunguye kera, Yanyitangiriye ku giti
salvation.chorus:
Nzi kw ibyaha byabambwe Ku musaraba,
Yes’ ubwo yitangago kera Yanzwe n’ abantu benshi.
Arasuzugurwa Ni ko yatwujuje n’ Imana.
stanzas:
Yesu Mukiza, ni we wanshunguye kera, Yanyitangiriye ku giti.
Yikorey’ ibyaha byanjye ndetse n’ ibyawe,
Atwoz’ atyo mu maraso ye.

Yes’ afit’ urukundo rutangaje rwose
Rwatumy’ anyeza mu mutima.
Yesu Mukiza ni we wambatuye rwose
Ubwo yabambwaga ku giti.

Niyemeje kugundir’ Umukiza wanjye
kuko yemeye kumpfir’ atyo.
Ndagushimira Yesu kuko wankunz’ utyo,
Nzahora ngushima, Mukiza.

salvation.title: Nezerwa, mutima wanjye, Kuko warons’ agakiza
stanzas:
Nezerwa, mutima wanjye,
Kuko warons’ agakiza.
/: Namaze kubabarirwa
Nd’ uwa Yesu na we n’ uwanjye. :/

Yankijije mu mutima
N’ umuganga mwiza cyane.
/: Kandi mu Mwuka we Wera
Nihw abatiriz’ abantu be. :/

Nzi ko nanditswe mw ijuru
Kubw’ Umwami wanjye Yesu.
/: Nd’ ubutunzi bw’ Umukiza,
Nzahora nd’ uw’ iteka ryose. :/

None mu mutima wanjye
Ndaririmb’ Imana Data.
/: Buri munsi ni we nshuti
Yo kunezeza muri byose. :/

Yankuyehw ibyaha byose
Nanjye sinzabisubira.
/: Kandi Yes’ aracyakiza
Abamusanga buri gihe. :/

Indirimbo zimushima
Zikwiriye kuba nyinshi.
/: Mu mutima wanjye naho
Hati: hashimw’ Iman’ iteka!: /

salvation.title: Ndashaka kuririmbira Yesu
salvation.chorus:
Nzahora ndirimbira
Yesu Kubw’ urukundo yangiriye,
Yanyishyuriy’ imyenda yose,
Yarambohoye muri byose.
stanzas:
Ndashaka kuririmbira Yesu,
Yaj’ ar’ Umwami w’ igikundiro.
Yarababajwe ndetse no gupfa,
Kugira ngw ambature mu byaha.

Nd’ uwo guhamy’ iby’ urwo rukundo
Rwabonetse mu Mukiza wanjye,
Cyane cyan’ uko yaj’ akankiza
Kandi nar’ uwo kurimbuka.

Ndashimir’ uwo Mukiza wanjye,
Kubw’ ububasha bwe butangaje.
Kandi niw’ unshyiramw imbaraga
Zo kunesh’ umwanzi Satani.

Ndashaka rwose kuririmbira
Uwo Mwami wanjye, Yesu Kristo.
Koko n’ ukuri yarankijije.
Nzahora mpirw’ iminsi yose.

salvation.title: Mukiza wanjye wagiye mw ijuru
stanzas:
Mukiza wanjye wagiye mw ijuru
Kwicar’ iburyo bw’ Iman’ Ihoraho.
Uzagaruka kutureba twese,
Utujyane mu bwami bwo mw ijuru.
Har’ ibyicaro waduteguriye
Non’ ub’ uradutegereje rwose

Yesu ni wow’ uhor’ udusabira
Imbere y’ Imana Dat’ ihoraho.
Uhor’ urinda twebw’ ubushyo bwawe
No kudufasha mu bigerageza.
Uhor’ udusabira buri munsi
Ni cyo gituma tunesha Satani.

Ubwo wazamukag’ ujya mw ijuru
Waramburiy’ abawe bya biganza
Kandi no mu gihe cyo kugaruka
Abakwizey’ uzabah’ umugisha.
Uko wagiye ni k’ uzagaruka
Nkwiye gusenga ndetse nkaba maso.

salvation.title: Ifeza n’ izahabu nta bwo zibasha
salvation.chorus:
Narakijijwe, si kubw’ imari,
Kubw’ ubuntu narakijijwe.
Yanyishyuriye ya myenda yose
Yamviriy’ amaraso ye.
stanzas:
Ifeza n’ izahabu nta bwo zibasha
Gukiz’ umutim’ ubabajwe n’ ibyaha,
Nyamar’ amaraso ya Yesu Mukiza
Yashoboye kunkura mu byaha byose.

Ifeza n’ izahabu nta bwo zibasha
Kundihirir’ imyenda yanjye y’ ibyaha,
Nyamar’ amaraso ya Yesu Mukiza
Yanyogej’ ibyaha mbon’ agakiza ke.

Ifeza n’ izahabu nta bwo zibasha
Gukingur’ urugi rugeza ku Mana.
Nyamar’ amaraso ni yo yanshoboje
Kugera ku buntu bw’ Iman’ ihoraho.

Ifeza n’ izahabu nta bwo zibasha
Kungeza ku Mana niba nkor’ ibyaha,
Nyamar’ amaraso ni yo nacungujwe,
Ni yo kimenyetso kigeza mw ijuru.

salvation.title: Abazaba bakijijwe bazateranira hamwe
salvation.chorus:
Bazava mu nyanja zose, Bazava mu byago byose,
Bave mu misozi, bave mu mataba
Bager' imbere y' Imana.
Bazambar’ imyenda yera, bareb’ Umukiza wabo.
Ni we wabapfiriye Kera ku musaraba.
stanzas:
Abazaba bakijijwe bazateranira hamwe
Ku meza mw ijuru hamwe na Yesu
Mu bami budashira, bazareb’ uburanga bwe.
Bameny’ uko yabakunze.
Bazahora baririmbira mw ijur’ iteka.

Bazateran’ ari benshi abakirijw’ ino mw isi.
Ibyago n’ urupfu, cyang’ umwijima Ntibizabah’ ukundi.
Nta bya kera bizabaho
Hazaba harihw ibishya.
Hazabah’ umunezer’ utagir’ amakemwa.

Niwitegerez’ urugi, ni wowe rukinguriwe,
Na Yesu Mukiz’ arakubwir’ ati:
Ngwino nawe winjire bagenzi bacu bariyo
Baradutegereje pe!
Ba marayika bishimiye kuzatubona.

salvation.title: Nshatse kugukurikira Buri munsi, Mwami Yesu
stanzas:
Nshatse kugukurikira Buri munsi, Mwami Yesu.
Mu gihe cy’ umunezero Ndetse no mu mubabaro.
Ubwo watubanjirije tuje tugukurikiye.
Tuzi rwose k’ uri hafi yo kutugeza mw ijuru.

Sinahora mbaririza Urugendo rwawe Yesu,
Cyangwa se ngo nshidikanye Kugukurikira, Yesu.
Umurimo wanjye n’ uwo Kugukurikira Yesu,
No gukomez’ iyo nzira nk’ uko wayimenyesheje.

Mu gihe hagiz’ icyaza Kikantesh’ inzira yawe,
Cyangwa kikandemerera Mur’ urwo rugendo mfite,
Uzaz’ uc’ uwo mugozi Uzab’ umbeshy’ umutima.
Nezezwa no kubohorwa Nkabon’ uko ngukorera.

Urandinde, Mwami Yesu, Ntunganiriz’ imigambi.
Niba naniw’ urugendo Uzanyibuts’ urukundo
Uti Ngwino, mwana wanjye, Hasigay’ umwanya muto,
Kuk’ uzahozw’ ibyo byose Ugez’ iwanjye mw ijuru.

salvation.title: Abahoze mu mwijima
stanzas:
Abahoze mu mwijima
Babony’ umucyo w’ ukuri.
Haleluya, haleluya,
Umwana yatuvukiye,
Uwo Mwana w’ umuhungu.
|:Haleluya:|x5

Kand’ azitw’ Igitangaza,
Azitwa n’ Umujyanama.
Haleluya, haleluya,
Azitw’ Iman’ ikomeye,
Yitw’ Umwami w’ amahoro.
|:Haleluya:|x5

Izina rizwi ni Yesu
Risobanur’ Umukiza.
Haleluya, haleluya,
Azitwa n’ Imanueli,
Yukw Iman’ iri muri twe.
|:Haleluya:|x5

Icyubahiro mw ijuru
Kib’ icy’ Iman’ ihoraho.
Haleluya, haleluya.
No mw isi hab’ amahoro,
Abe mubo yishimira.
|:Haleluya:|x5

Kand’ abemey’ uwo Mwana
Bakizera n’ izina rye.
Haleluya, haleluya.
Bahaw’ ubushobozi pe,
Bwo kub’ abana b’ Imana.
|:Haleluya:|x5

salvation.title: Habayeh’ umusozi warih’ umusaraba
salvation.chorus:
Nkund’ uwo musaraba wa Yesu
Uvamw imbaraga zo kunesha
Nzahora ngundir’ umusaraba
Kugez’ ubwo nzambikwa rya kamba
stanzas:
Habayeh’ umusozi warih’ umusaraba
W’ umubabar’ utey’ isoni.
Ariko ndawukunda kuko Yesu yatanze
Ubugingo bwe ngo mb’ ukijijwe.

Kand’ uwo musaraba tubonahw amaraso
Dukomeze tuwuririmbe.
Yes’ Umwana w’ Imana, yapfuy’ urwo baseka,
Aduhesh’ agakiza k’ Imana.

Kand’ uwo Musaraba ni w’ unkundisha Yesu,
Nubw’ usuzugurwa na benshi.
Kand’ Umwana w’ intama yahets’ umusaraba
Awujyana hamw’ i Gologota

Kand’ uwo musaraba nubwo wab’ uw’ isoni,
Nzakomeza kuwuhimbaza.
Kugez’ ubw’ Umukiza azanjya na mw ijuru
Muri bwa bwami bwe buhoraho

salvation.title: Ump’ akanya, Yesu, nze nkwegere
salvation.chorus:
Ump’ akanya, Yesu, nze nkwegere,
Kuk’ umwijim’ ukabije mw isi.
Icyo nkeneye n’ ukukwegera
Kugira ngo numv’ ijambo ryawe.
stanzas:
Ump’ akanya, Yesu, nze nkwegere,
Kuko naniriwe mur’ iyi si.
Ndetse no mu gihe cy’ intambara,
Na bwo Mwami, ujy’ ump’ amahoro.

Ump’ akanya, Yesu, nze nkwegere
Mu bingerageza n’ amakuba.
Ni wowe buhungiro nizeye
Mu gihe cy’ akaga mur’ iyi si.

Ump’ akanya, Yesu, nze nkwegere
Kuko wanyikorerey’ ibyaha.
Ndumva nshaka kukubwira byose
Kuko, Mwami, nizeye k’ unyumva.

salvation.title: Yesu yazutse n’ ukuri
stanzas:
Yesu yazutse n’ ukuri
Yabonekey’ abigishwa.
Haleluya, haleluya.
Maria na bagenzi be
Bazindukira ku mva ye.
|:Haleluya:|x5

Basang’ imva y’ ikinguwe
Harimo ba marayika.
Haleluya, haleluya.
Nuko babwir’ abagore
Yuko Yes’ ari muzima.
|:Haleluya:|x5

Ba bagore barihuta
Kubimenye sh’ abigishwa
Haleluya, haleluya,
Nukw abigishwa babiri
Birukankira ku mva ye.
|:Haleluya:|x5

Nuko n’ abandi bigishwa
Mu nzir’ ijya Emausi
Haleluya, haleluya,
Baganirag’ ibya Yesu
Uko yapfuy’ agahambwa.
|:Haleluya:|x5

Yes’ arababonekera,
Ariko ntibamumenya.
Haleluya, haleluya.
Yes’ ati: Yemwe, mwa bapfu.
Kristo yar’ uwo kuzuka.
|:Haleluya:|x5

Bugorobye Yes’ araza,
Aboneker’ abigishwa
Haleluya, haleluya,
Ati: Mugir’ amahoro!
Abahumeker’ Umwuka.
|:Haleluya:|x5

salvation.title: Yesu, ni wowe mucyo
salvation.chorus:
/: Yesu, ur’ amahoro yacu,
Kuko watuberey’ inshungu. :/
stanzas:
Yesu, ni wowe mucyo,
Ni wowe nshima kuko wankunze.
Mwami, byose wakoze
Kutwitangira ndabigushima.

Mwami, ndanezerewe
Kukuririmba kuko wankunze.
Yesu, komez’ umfashe,
Nanjye ngukunde, nkuririmbire.

Yesu, ngwino tubane,
Ngwin’ unyobore mu nzira yawe
Kandi ni wowe nzira,
Ur’ ubugingo ndetse n’ ukuri.

Nzi ko har’ igihugu cy’ umucyo mwinshi ku bakijijwe.
Ndetse icyo gihugu
N’ icy’ izahabu zitatse neza.

salvation.title: Narimboshwe rwose mu mwijima mwinshi
salvation.chorus:
N’igitangaza pe! Nigitangaza pe!
Rwose n’igitangaza ko Yesu yankijije.
Umwuka we Wera niw’ ujy’ unyobora.
Uzangez’iwanjye mw’ijuru amahoro.
stanzas:
Narimboshwe rwose mu mwijima mwinshi,
Sinarinzi Yesu wavuye mwijuru
Yambohoy’ingoyi zose nari mfite.
Haleluya, nsigaye ndirimba Yesu.

Iyo ngeragejwe n’umwanzi satani,
Ndwan’iyo ntambara nambay’ukwizera.
Ijambo ry’Imana ni ryo nkota yanjye,
Kandi rizangeza mwijur’amahoro.

Nyura mu misozi, nyura mu mataba.
Aho hose ni ko harushy’umutima.
Njya nsab’Uwiteka kugira ngw amfashe.
Uwiteka na we ntatinda kunyumva.

Mu gihe nanirwa mu rugendo rwanjye,
Ndebesh’ukwizera ibiri mw ijuru.
Uzat’umuruho ndetse tuzahazwa
Yesu Mukiza ni we waturaritse.

salvation.title: Abantu bose batuye mw isi
salvation.chorus:
Noeli nziza! Noeli nziza!
Nimuze twese tuyiririmbe!
Niy’ itwibuts’ agakiza kacu
Noeli nziza ni Yesu.
stanzas:
Abantu bose batuye mw isi
Ni bo bahawe Noeli.
Ntidushobora kuzibagirwa
Iyo Noeli twahawe.

N’ igitangaza kukw abashumba
Batanz’ abandi Noeli.
Nta cyubahiro bari bafite,
Nyamar’ Iman’ ikor’ ityo.

N’ igitangaza kuk’ uwo mwana
Yavukiye mu nzu y’ inka.
Natw’ abakene turashobora
Kuririmbira Noeli.

Mur’ iryo joro ritey’ ukwaryo
Ryaririmbwe na marayika Bat’:
Icyubahiro n’ icy’ Imana
Nay’ amahor’ abe mw isi.

Kand’ uwo mwana nubwo yavutse
Si bose bamwakiriye.
Nyamara bose bamwakiriye
Babay’ abana b’ Imana.

salvation.title: Twemezwa n’ iki ko tuzagera mw ijuru
salvation.chorus:
/: Dushak’ uwo Mwuka Wera
Ni Yesu wawutugeneye. :/
stanzas:
Twemezwa n’ iki ko tuzagera mw ijuru?--
N’ Umwuka w’ Ihoraho
Ibyiringiro nk’ ibyo twabihabwa na nde?--
N’ Umwuka w’ Ihoraho

Umwuka Wer’ akora imirim’ ikomeye.
Ni wo wemez’ abantu.
Tugir’ ubwoba cyan’ iyo tutakimwumva
Twibaz’ icyo twakora.

Mu gih’ ubona k’ utagifit’ urukundo
Menya yuk’ uwo Mwuka Yabonye
K’ uyoborwa n’ umubiri wawe
Musab’ uti: garuka!

Turagusaba Mwami Yes’ umwohereze
Uwo Mufasha wacu,
Kuko dufit’ intambar’ ikomeye mw isi.
Turamukwiye rwose.

salvation.title: Yew’ usonzey’ agakiza
salvation.chorus:
Uhamagawe na Yesu,
Na Yesu Mukiza.
Aragushak’ uyu munsi
Mwemerer’ agukize.
stanzas:
Yew’ usonzey’ agakiza,
Ng’ ubabarirw’ ibyaha.
Umv’ agakuru k’ imvaho
Yuko Yes’ agushaka.

Nawe wabay’ inzimizi
Kuko wahunze Yesu,
Menya ko yagupfiriye.
Ngwin’ umusange none.

Naw’ uhamagawe none
Wite kur’ iryo jwi rye.
Reka gutind’ uyu munsi.
N’ uwawe w’ agakiza.

Harihw abumvis’ iri jwi
Bararisuzugura,
Hanyuma bajy’ ikuzimu
Kimwe na wa mutunzi.

salvation.title: Pasika yacu niy’ itwibutsa
salvation.chorus:
Nimuze twese tumuhimbaze
Kuko yemeye kudupfir’ atyo.
Yasatuyemo na rwa rusika
Yatumye natwe twinjir’ ahera.
stanzas:
Pasika yacu niy’ itwibutsa
Amaraso y’ Umwana w’ Imana.
Ni yo yadukuye mw Egiputa,
Aho Satani yicir’ abantu.

I Getsemani Yes’ arasenga Ati:
Data, niba byashoboka
Iki gikombe sinkinywereho
Ariko byose bib’ uk’ ushaka.

Umwami Yesu n’ Umucunguzi
Yadupfiriye ku musaraba.
Byavuye kuki? Ku rukundo rwe
Rwatumy’ atanga ubugingo bwe.

Uwagambaniye Yesu Kristo
Kandi yar’ uwo mu bigishwa be.
Nyamara yikururiy’ ishyano
Ryatumye yimanika ku giti.

Nuko kw isaha ya gatandatu
Hose habah’ ubwirakabiri.
Bwafash’ amasah’ atatu yose,
Bwagejeje mw isaha ya cyenda.

salvation.title: N’ utagir’ umwete mu nzira y’ Imana
stanzas:
N’ utagir’ umwete mu nzira y’ Imana,
Ntabw’ uzinjira mw ijuru.
Rindir’ umutima mw ijambo ry’ Imana,
Ni ryo rizagukomeza
Irembo ni rito ndetse n’ inzira nto.
Wihangane rwose kugira ng’ ucemo,
Niwemere non’ agakiza k’ Imana.
Nibw’ uzagera mw ijuru.

Ibigusha byinshi biri mu rugendo
Kandi bizanwa n’ umwanzi.
Ushobora rwose kunesh’ ibyo byose
Bishaka kukudindiza.
Ntugakurikire ijwi wumva ryose
Kuko byashobora kukuyoby’ inzira.
Ukwiye kumenya ko Yes’ agukunda
Nawe witang’ ukomeje.

N’ utizer’ Imana ntuzajya mw ijuru
Habe no guc’ umutaru.
Kandi n’ ubugingo ntabw’ uzabubona
Iryo n’ ijambo ry’ Imana
Mu kwizera gusa ni ho wakirizwa.
N’ ubu ndetse wumv’ ijambo ry’ agakiza
Niwihan’ ibyaha, wizer’ Umukiza,
Inzira y’ ukuri n’ iyo

Iman’ irashaka ko bose bakizwa.
Kandi bahabw’ ubugingo.
Iraguha naw’ umurage w’ ijuru
Nib’ uwusha kan’ umwete,
Kand’ Iman’ ikunda umutima wawe.
Yesu na we agashaka kuwukiza,
Kand’ Umwuka Wera aragukangura,
Niba wumvir’ uzahirwa.
